store_data.about_the_game:
Build railways. Solve puzzles. Deliver cargo.

Guide colored cargo containers to their final destination by building railways through a voxel world of islands, deserts and mountains. Each handcrafted puzzle introduces new ideas and gradually expands on what you’ve learned. As the challenges grow, you’ll build multi-level bridges across the ocean and over great heights, tunnel to reach uncanny valleys, and find your way through increasingly intricate layouts. Intuitive track-building mechanics make it easy to build rail, while carefully designed puzzles provide satisfying challenges that reward observation and logical thinking. Watch your solution come to life as trains collect, transport, and deliver thousands of cargo containers to their ultimate destination - or get mixed up into oblivion.

Handcrafted Puzzles

Every puzzle is carefully designed to present a new challenge with new mechanics introduced gradually, combining to create increasingly rich and satisfying railway conundrums.

Intuitive Rail Building

Simple railway tools allow for easy building while supporting complex rail systems with tunnels, stacking bridges and myriad ways to connect and interconnect your routes. 

Train Traversal

Carefully route your trains to untangle mixed up cargo with train scheduling, routing and filtering of cargo. Trains will try not to crash - but anything's possible!

Build Across 3D Worlds

The landscape is integral to every puzzle. Traverse the ocean with bridges, tunnel through mountains and fully harness the third dimension to reach new heights.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Disordered me and Paradise" is a role-playing game that combines story exploration with turn-based combat.

After the program called 'Disordered Paradise' is activated, demons from the digital world appear in the amusement park through 'Digital Deployment,' threatening the real world.

You'll travel through distinct areas like the main street of the park, rescue stations, laundries, and park roads, encountering anomalies and collecting clues in seemingly ordinary spaces, gradually uncovering the secrets hidden behind the cracks of reality.

Along the way, you'll meet companions with different personalities, fight alongside them, and try to survive against oppressive enemies and surreal events. The battles use a turn-based system that emphasizes attribute advantages and skill combos—you need to manage the rhythm and exploit enemy weaknesses to turn the tide from the brink of danger again and again.

Beyond combat, you can interact with characters in various scenes, advance side quests, track missions, and enjoy visually striking performances and cutscenes.

Game Features

- Story-driven RPG experience

- Scene progression combining exploration, interaction, and quest advancement

- Turn-based combat emphasizing attacks on weaknesses and skill combinations

- Immersive gameplay enhanced by sound effects and visual performances

- Multiple areas with distinct styles and event animations

store_data.about_the_game:
Every night, a little girl is haunted by terrifying nightmares.

Become Mo, a mythical creature that feeds on bad dreams, and munch the nightmares to bring her smile back!

Key Features

  • Dreamlike Atmosphere: Experience a dreamy illustration of hand-painted visuals.

  • Casual Gameplay: A runner-action game that's easy to pick up, using just two keys.

  • Nightmares vs. Sweet Dreams: Munch only on the nightmares—be careful not to touch her sweet dreams!

  • Two Different Mornings: The girl will awaken to one of two different endings, shaped by how you play.

Who is Mo?

Mo(Baku) is a mythical creature from East Asian folklore. Said to feed on nightmares, Mo protects people by devouring their bad dreams so they can sleep in peace.

store_data.about_the_game:
Noctheron: The Eclipse Bringer is a dark pixel art RPG focused on story, exploration, and turn-based battles. Set against a war driven by the ambition of three kingdoms, it follows a tale of power, loss, romance, and moral choices, where every decision helps shape the protagonist’s path and the fate of those around him.

In an age consumed by moral decay, each chapter reveals new conflicts, enemies, and regions torn apart by violence, superstition, and despair. Use fear, theatricality, and the power of a mysterious sword to face cruel figures and leave your mark on a world that no longer believes in salvation.

Between the Man and the Legend

The journey explores the duality between Auren Draguësthi and Noctheron: the man behind the mask and the legend born from fear. Between the humanity he still holds onto and the creature the world believes it sees, your actions will define whether Noctheron is remembered as justice, a curse, or something even worse.

Explore decaying regions, face cruel figures, take part in conflicts between kingdoms, and choose how your character evolves. Develop offensive and defensive abilities, use gadgets, and adapt your playstyle to face each threat in your own way.

The Duality Between Auren Draguësthi and Noctheron

Behind the mask is Auren Draguësthi, a man divided between the last traces of his humanity and the dark legend being born around him.

Explore a Decaying World in Pixel Art

Travel through villages, roads, and shadowed environments as you uncover secrets, threats, and fragments of a land consumed by plague, fear, and corruption.

Side-View Turn-Based Battles with Strategic Depth

Face enemies in side-view turn-based battles, where every decision can shift the course of the fight. Choose between offensive abilities, defensive techniques, and gadgets to adapt your strategy against different threats.

Survival is about more than attacking. It requires reading the enemy, preparing your next move, and controlling the pace of battle.

Moral Choices That Shape the Journey and the World’s Perception

In Noctheron, every dialogue, confrontation, and moral decision helps shape how the world sees him. Your choices can inspire fear, respect, hatred, or unexpected consequences, influencing relationships, conflicts, and the path that leads to the birth of Noctheron.

Romance, Alliances, and Relationships Marked by Tension, Loss, and Consequence

Amid war, fear, and corruption, Auren Draguësthi still holds bonds that remind him of his humanity. Romance, alliances, and personal choices will carry weight throughout the journey, shaping relationships marked by tension, desire, guilt, and consequence.

But the more Noctheron is born in the shadows, the harder it becomes to protect what Auren still fears losing.

Forge Terror Your Own Way

Noctheron’s sword is not just a weapon. It is part of his transformation. Throughout the journey, develop abilities, master gadgets, and choose how to face each enemy: through aggression, endurance, control, or precision.

Every tool shapes the way Noctheron imposes fear, turns battles into sentences, and draws closer to the legend the world will learn to fear.

Command Armies in a War Between Three Kingdoms

Make strategic decisions as Auren Draguësthi, lead armies, and influence the fate of a continent divided by ambition, fear, and corruption. Each conflict reveals new alliances, enemies, and consequences that shape the rise of Noctheron.

store_data.about_the_game:
After a war ended, we were abandoned at the end of the story.

Cold winters, intermittently passing typhoons, and occasional seismic waves.

It seems like every disaster wants to erase the existence of 'us.'

But this shouldn't be the end for 'us.'

Even if we've already lost so much...

The visual novel 『终点站』 will tell a story from the aftermath of war.

Welcome to your visit and your valuable feedback

『Game Introduction』

As a military doctor, you were selected before the war to serve as the resident physician at the Far Vision Collaborative Space Station.

By a twist of fate, you and another mission specialist managed to escape the war.

During the war, people forgot about your existence, and your name dramatically appeared on the list of deserters.

Five years later, you are forced to return to Earth alone to seek help.

On this unique journey, you meet 『理』 and  『临』

You try to rebuild communication and attempt to restore the life you once had.

But can it really succeed? Can we truly go back to the past?

...Maybe... maybe...

We might have a very special story.

『Character Introduction』

理 идеал

Likes: Driving/repairing tractors

Dislikes: Pain, talking about past experiences

A child from the former alliance, who survived disasters through her own perseverance and a bit of luck.

『理』 is a gentle child, but that doesn’t mean she’s weak.

『理』 has many people and things she wants to protect.

Although she can get lost sometimes, please don’t give up on her.

临 valediction

Likes: eating, sleeping

Dislikes: seeing others in pain

『临』 was originally a research subject of the former Unified Front's 'Angel' project, but was later taken by Alliance personnel during the war.

『临』is a naturally born angel, not an artificial angel created by the Unified Front.

Because of this, 『临』 became an important target during the war.

After the war, with nowhere to go, 『临』was discovered by 『理』 and has been living with 『理』 ever since.

『STAFF』:

Character/CG Artist: 赤橙chio

Voice Acting CV (Li/Lin): 希夜 Lily

Copywriting/Programming/UI: XiAoRaN_Channel

Main Menu OST: Chelle Mok

Public Assets CC0/CC-BY:

Erling Net, Pixabay (Music)

Unsplash (Backgrounds)

花间莉萝 (Code Reference)

Kinetic-Text-Tags （github）

Due to development progress, STAFF will be expanded later.

Sincere thanks to all creators here！ww

store_data.about_the_game:
Rubblefield takes the arcade skeleton of classic Asteroids and rebuilds it around real momentum. Your ship thrusts and drifts instead of snapping to a stop, and the field wraps seamlessly at every edge - but wrapping was never the safe zone it used to be. A purpose-built phantom system mirrors every wrapped object, including the boss, so it stays fully solid and shootable right at the seam. There's no free pass at the border.

The field gets busier as you climb the levels, and no two rocks play by the same rules. Ten distinct asteroid types keep you reading the field instead of running on autopilot, and a boss shows up every few levels with its own entry sequence, health bar, and gunfire aimed straight at you.

KEY FEATURES

- Ten distinct asteroid types - fast ones, chasers, orbit-shielded rocks, multi-hit bruisers with health bars, ones that explode into shrapnel, ones that grow instead of shrink when hit, phasing ghosts, teleporting blinkers, and more

- A recurring boss fight with its own attack pattern, plus a guaranteed power-up and shield drop on every kill

- A dozen-plus power-ups to chain together, including Multi-Shot, Pierce Shot, Homing Shot, Bomb Shot, a mine-laying Field, an auto-firing Gun Buddy drone, a screen-clearing Nuke, a time-slowing Hourglass, and a sustained, auto-targeting Death Laser

- A true screen-wrap world where wrapped objects are always hittable, not just visible

- Full keyboard, mouse, and gamepad support

- Adjustable feel: keep the camera fixed and steady, or unlock it so the world spins with your ship for a more disorienting, old-school arcade feel - turn sensitivity and camera smoothing are tunable too

- A custom retro CRT shader (scanlines, screen curvature, chromatic aberration) and pixelization filter over a procedurally generated, parallax starfield backdrop

- Tracks your best level reached and lifetime asteroid count locally, so every run chips away at a personal record

Free to play. Fly loose, drift fast, and see how deep into the field you can get.

ART CREDITS

Spaceship icon by Freepik -
Shield icon by Nikita Golubev -
Asteroid icon by Smashicons -
Bomb sprite by Znevs -

store_data.about_the_game:
Massive Endless Maps for Stress Relief

Break the board limits of classic Minesweeper with infinitely expanding maps. Clearing mines tile by tile is perfect for perfectionists. Tidying up the entire grid melts stress away completely — ideal for casual downtime at work.

Quick Number Click Mode, Double the Fun

Skip tedious right-click flagging. Click numbers to reveal tiles instantly. Smooth controls greatly boost your efficiency. Clearing large areas in one go doubles your enjoyment instantly.

Freely Switch Between Various Color Themes

Swap multiple visual themes at will. Tired of the same look after long play? Switch hues with one click to regain freshness, so you never get bored.

Mine Strikes Come With Fun Trivia

No need to feel upset when hitting a mine. A pop-up will show interesting Minesweeper facts. Take a short break to learn handy tips, then reset and start a new round.

ESC Boss Key for Instant Window Hide

A lifesaver for office gamers! Press ESC to minimize the window right away. Stay calm during unexpected checks and play with total peace of mind.

Secret Gameplay: Test Mouse Precision & Train Coordination

It works as a free DPI tester! Precise tile clicks continuously sharpen your clicking accuracy and reaction speed. Friendly reminder: avoid rapid clicking for hours to prevent wrist soreness and tenosynovitis.

Break the board limits of classic Minesweeper with infinitely expanding maps. Clearing mines tile by tile is perfect for perfectionists. Tidying up the entire grid melts stress away completely — ideal for casual downtime at work.

Quick Number Click Mode, Double the Fun

Skip tedious right-click flagging. Click numbers to reveal tiles instantly. Smooth controls greatly boost your efficiency. Clearing large areas in one go doubles your enjoyment instantly.

Freely Switch Between Various Color Themes

Swap multiple visual themes at will. Tired of the same look after long play? Switch hues with one click to regain freshness, so you never get bored.

Mine Strikes Come With Fun Trivia

No need to feel upset when hitting a mine. A pop-up will show interesting Minesweeper facts. Take a short break to learn handy tips, then reset and start a new round.

ESC Boss Key for Instant Window Hide

A lifesaver for office gamers! Press ESC to minimize the window right away. Stay calm during unexpected checks and play with total peace of mind.

Secret Gameplay: Test Mouse Precision & Train Coordination

It works as a free DPI tester! Precise tile clicks continuously sharpen your clicking accuracy and reaction speed. Friendly reminder: avoid rapid clicking for hours to prevent wrist soreness and tenosynovitis.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Shuffle Bistro" is a restaurant-themed deckbuilding roguelike where you sell various types of dishes to break your revenue records every single day.

🍽️ Unique Synergy Mechanics for Each Menu Type

Find the optimal menu synergy amidst limited table rotations and urgent customer complaints. Collect various recipe cards from Fine Dining to Fast Food to thin out your deck, deploy powerful kitchen facilities, and break through the ever-rising spike revenue goals!

  • Fine Dining: Dishes that maximize sales value when served completely on their own.

  • Fast Food: High-rotation dishes that can be easily served in any situation to secure stable revenue.

  • Dessert: Precision dishes that boost revenue when sold alongside other items of the exact same price.

  • Diner: Combo dishes that boost revenue when sold alongside other items with consecutive prices.

🃏 Explode Revenue with the Perfect Serving Chain

Every morning, you open for business with a hand of 7 menu cards. Each time you play a card to serve a dish, a new card is drawn. Find the perfect sequence and combination to maximize chain synergies between cards and skyrocket your revenue in a single turn!

⚙️ Build Your Dream Kitchen with Facility Synergies

Once the business day ends, the shop opens with a random selection of menu cards and passive facilities. Combine unique 'Facilities'—such as kitchen appliances for bulk serving or interior decors that multiply the value of specific menus—to complete a powerful synergy build.

👑 Evolve Your Playstyle with 4 Powerful Perks

Every 5 business days, game-changing Perks are unlocked. Your playstyle will completely evolve depending on which Perk you choose each run.

  • Chef: A build focused on thinning out your deck to the absolute limit and maximizing raw revenue scaling.

  • Manager: A build focused on expanding facility slots and rerolling the shop to solidify your infrastructure.

  • Gourmet: A high-risk, high-reward build that explodes your multipliers every time a card is discarded due to customer complaints.

  • Waiter: A build focused on securing more tables for high stability, putting everything on the line for a grand finale service.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bliss Point


In a world engineered to keep you craving, the hardest thing to choose is the truth.

Bliss Point is an adult romance visual novel set inside Beanstalk Foods, a beloved "better-for-you" kids brand built on a founder's real hunger and a too-perfect lie. Tobin Greaves didn't set out to get rich — he set out to feed families like the one that raised him. Then the company's growth became a science of engineered craving: the bliss point that keeps children eating, the green box that sells comfort to exhausted parents, and a buried heavy-metal screen that should have stopped everything.

Now the clocks are running. An FTC and state-AG action, a lawsuit built around a real child's blood-lead level, and an acquisition that needs the scandal contained. In the middle of it, Tobin is pulled into three simultaneous romances with three women who each hold a different piece of what his company has done — and each demands the one thing he never put on the label. The truth.

Meet the Cast




Hazel Fenn — The Outsider
A public-health dietitian pulled from WIC clinics and school-lunch lines into corporate headquarters as Beanstalk's first Chief Wellness Officer. Hired to make "Better Beanstalk" look honest, stubborn enough to demand it be honest. Her route is a slow-burn partnership where trust is conditional, reform is costly, and love only holds if the rebuild is real.



Camila Salazar — The Protégée
The young food scientist Tobin personally recruited, mentored, and made. A first-gen striver who believed his mission because she needed it to be real, she also ran the heavy-metal screen with her own hands — and her initials sit on a paper trail someone tried to bury. Her route is devotion turning into self-authorship, strained by power, gratitude, and the moment she realizes doing the right thing may mean walking away.



Delia Marsh — The Toxicologist
The independent environmental-health toxicologist whose data can end Tobin — and the one adversary he can't charm, buy, or out-talk. Fifteen years ago she published early warnings about Beanstalk's engineered harm and got professionally dismantled for it. Now she's back with clean findings and a ledger she never stopped keeping. Her route is a hostile reunion where attraction is an ethical hazard.

Key Features


  • Three distinct romance routes with one defining choice — a hostile reunion, a patron-and-protégée bond, or an outsider partnership that makes rebuilding conditional and real.
  • A corporate thriller romance setting — federal scrutiny, class-action discovery, an acquisition close, and a recall-or-don't deadline form the pressure-cooker backdrop to every relationship beat.
  • A grounded, modern moral conflict — "within legal limits" becomes a weapon, forcing you to decide what consent, safety, and responsibility actually mean when the customer is a child.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.
  • Themes with bite — engineered craving, institutional self-justification, and the question that lingers after every scene: what do we feed the people we love?

Content Notice


Bliss Point is intended for mature audiences (18+). It contains explicit sexual content and adult themes, alongside story elements involving corporate misconduct, deceptive marketing, legal conflict, and child harm (non-graphic; no on-page child death).

store_data.about_the_game:
The lights are gone. The walls are closing in. Somewhere ahead is the only way out - and somewhere behind you, something is listening.

Pinched is a multiplayer survival-horror race through a maze of pitch-black tunnels that is never the same twice. Up to 8 players spawn deep underground and scramble for the single exit, armed with nothing but a failing flashlight and a handful of flares. Every footstep echoes. Every whisper carries. And you are not alone down here.

Descend into procedurally generated caves and flooded storm drains where the landmarks lie and the dead ends kill. Work together or leave each other behind, but move fast, stay quiet, and pray the dark stays empty.

Features

  • A maze that fights back. Every round regenerates the tunnels - there is no memorizing the way out.

  • Pitch-black by design. Your flashlight is your lifeline... and a beacon to everything hunting you.

  • Flares change everything. Light the path, mark your trail, or hold back what's chasing you.

  • Sound is survival. Footsteps, voices, and racing hearts travel down the halls. Sprint and you're heard. Crouch and you might just live.

  • Proximity voice chat that echoes through the tunnels. Coordinate, panic, or listen for the screams around the next corner.

Modes

  • Race - first one to the exit wins. Trust no one.

  • Hunter - one player becomes the predator. The rest run.

  • Escape the Flood - the water is rising. Climb, or drown together.

  • Escape the Monster - something lives in these tunnels. Outsmart it, or feed it.

Grab your friends. Grab a flashlight. Don't get caught. Don't get lost.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lead a group of Vagrants through the surreal open world of the Afterlife. Observe their journey through the eyes of a drone operator. Hide from blind monsters. Avoid malicious fog. Embrace the Cycle. Survive. Escape.

Fog'n'Silence is a slow-paced exploration-oriented adventure that blends survival, resource management, stealth, puzzle-solving, RPG elements, and timeline-based tactical combat.

EXPLORE AN EVER-CHANGING WORLD

Freely travel on foot in any direction across the vast expanses filled with impossible structures, anomalies, environmental hazards, and isolated settlements. Meet weird characters. Gather rare and valuable supplies. Uncover fragments of hidden stories and piece them together.

Observe the world through the directly controlled camera drone. Scout the horizon from above, descend for a closer look, investigate suspicious objects, and guide the Vagrants through hostile terrain.

Exploration rewards curiosity, but the world is never safe. Unpredictable weather, altered laws of physics, blind monsters, and baleful fog that mutates flesh and distorts minds can quickly turn a promising expedition into a disaster.

KEEP THE VAGRANTS ALIVE

All expeditions begin with a group of three Vagrants. Each has their own strengths, weaknesses, passive abilities, equipment, as well as various physical and mental traits.

Manage their:

  • Health, hunger, stamina, and sanity

  • Injuries and negative status effects

  • Weapons, equipment, and limited space in their backpacks

  • Position within the group and role during exploration

During the journey, it is possible to recruit new Vagrants, pack animals, machines, and other secondary units, gradually turning a small group into a strange-looking caravan. They're scattered across the world that rarely stays the same for long, so, of course, first you need to find them.

A larger group provides more skills, tools, and carrying capacity, but it also consumes more resources, produces more noise, and becomes harder to manage.

EVERY SOUND HAS A COST

Lowlands covered with fog are not empty. The fog is inhabited by Shells, hostile, blind creatures with an unnaturally sharp sense of hearing. They investigate footsteps, gunfire, operating machinery, and any other suspicious sounds.

All the actions Vagrants make, and almost all of the equipment they use, produce noise. Smart sonars reveal nearby points of interest, turbines temporarily push back the fog, metal detectors discover buried valuables - every tool creates new possibilities, but also new risks.

Move carefully, control the group’s noise level, use distractions, and choose your route before something hidden in the fog notices you. Avoiding confrontation is often safer than winning it.

PLAN YOUR ACTIONS ON THE TIMELINE

When confrontation becomes unavoidable, take control with the timeline-based Combat Sequencer. Study the intentions of your enemies, assign actions to Vagrants, arrange their movements, attacks, and special abilities on a shared timeline.

After the Planning Phase, in which time stops, both Vagrants and their enemies execute their actions simultaneously. Positioning, coordination, interruption, and precise timing matter more than reflexes. A well-planned sequence can eliminate a threat before it has time to react, while a single mistake can cause the entire plan to collapse.

LEARN FROM EVERY EXPEDITION

Fog'n'Silence is built around repeatable expeditions through an ever-changing open world.

Death may end the current journey, but the Knowledge you uncover survives. Learn how the world and its inhabitants behave, complete quests, build relationships, gather bits of information to fill the Compendium, and accumulate Knowledge to unlock new possibilities for future expeditions and make Vagrants stronger.

The world changes.

The Tower remains.

And every failed escape attempt teaches you how to travel farther next time.

Move carefully, control the group’s noise level, use distractions, and choose your route before something hidden in the fog notices you. Avoiding confrontation is often safer than winning it.

PLAN YOUR ACTIONS ON THE TIMELINE

When confrontation becomes unavoidable, take control with the timeline-based Combat Sequencer. Study the intentions of your enemies, assign actions to Vagrants, arrange their movements, attacks, and special abilities on a shared timeline.

After the Planning Phase, in which time stops, both Vagrants and their enemies execute their actions simultaneously. Positioning, coordination, interruption, and precise timing matter more than reflexes. A well-planned sequence can eliminate a threat before it has time to react, while a single mistake can cause the entire plan to collapse.

LEARN FROM EVERY EXPEDITION

Fog'n'Silence is built around repeatable expeditions through an ever-changing open world.

Death may end the current journey, but the Knowledge you uncover survives. Learn how the world and its inhabitants behave, complete quests, build relationships, gather bits of information to fill the Compendium, and accumulate Knowledge to unlock new possibilities for future expeditions and make Vagrants stronger.

The world changes.

The Tower remains.

And every failed escape attempt teaches you how to travel farther next time.

store_data.about_the_game:
If you don't know who you are, how can you know who to trust?

Impostor Syndrom is a multiplayer social deduction game built on communication, psychology, and pure player interaction. The twist: at the start of every match, you don't even know your own role.

You have to figure out who the Impostor is — and who you are — from nothing but words and behavior.

Three Hidden Roles

Designed for 4–10 players. Every match secretly sorts you into one of three roles — and never tells you which:

  • Admin : keeps the game running and stays neutral.

  • Suspect : works to identify and eliminate the Impostor.

  • Impostor : blends in and avoids detection.

No one is told their role. You discover who you are through discussion and behavior.

How It Plays?

  • Each round, everyone receives a secret word — Suspects and Impostors get words that are similar, but slightly different.

  • Players take turns describing their word without saying it directly.

  • Clues must be subtle — too obvious and you expose yourself, too vague and you look guilty.

  • Read the room: work out whether you're a Suspect or an Impostor, spot who's different, and adapt with every clue.

Impostors must mimic the others while quietly gathering clues. Suspects must catch the inconsistencies and drag the truth into the light.

Winning Condition

  • Impostor win : when their number equals the number of Suspects.

  • Suspect win : when every Impostor is eliminated.

Features

  • Real-time voice chat (VOIP) — the game lives and dies on how you talk.

  • Peer-to-peer rooms — Host or Join instantly with a Room ID.

  • Flexible identity — pick a custom name every match.

  • Four playable characters with unique human-animal hybrid designs.

    Built for group play with friends.

Best experienced with friends or a pre-made group.

🚪Every door hides a new nightmare. Every room could be your last.

⚠️WARNING: This game contains flashing lights, intense combat, and fast-paced action that may not be suitable for players with photosensitive epilepsy.

The Next Room is a fast-paced 3D action roguelite where every room is a new challenge and every decision can mean the difference between survival and death. Fight your way through relentless monsters, avoid deadly traps, uncover hidden secrets, and defeat powerful bosses guarding the path ahead.

No two runs are the same. Experiment with different builds, discover rare equipment, craft stronger gear, and adapt your strategy as you venture deeper into the unknown. store_data.about_the_game:
A Horror Otome Game Set in a Village of Otherworldly Rituals — Hyakume no Hananie

Story

Tokyo, 202X.

On the day of your twentieth birthday, a single letter arrives.

You don't recognize the sender's name—but the return address bears the name of the village where you were born.

The letter contains a simple invitation:

"Now that you have come of age, we would be honored to have you attend the village's Coming-of-Age Ceremony."

Something isn't right.

The village where you were born was buried beneath a volcanic eruption when you were still a child.

You know you shouldn't go.

And yet, as though lured by something unseen, you find yourself taking the first step.

On Coming-of-Age Day, dressed in formal attire as snow falls around you, you begin your journey toward a village that should no longer exist...

Characters

Heroine (You)　Mikanagi Himari

(Default name, Only the first name can be changed.)

Having lost both your parents and your hometown before you were old enough to remember, you were raised in Tokyo by a close friend of your late mother.

The moment you accept an invitation from the homeland that should have been lost forever and step into the village beyond reality, the gears of fate begin to turn...

Kazuki Sho

One of the people who accompanies you throughout the village.

Though often curt and reserved, he is earnest and dependable.

Yet he always seems to keep you at arm's length, as if there is a side of himself he refuses to reveal.

Raiden Kaname

One of the people who accompanies you throughout the village.

His swordsmanship, delivered with the strength of his towering frame, is nothing short of breathtaking.

Despite his intimidating appearance, he is considerate and approachable toward everyone.

Still, there is an impenetrable composure about him that makes it impossible to tell what he is truly thinking.

Hisaizu Rin

One of the people who accompanies you throughout the village.

A gentleman with a playful streak, Rin runs the village's funeral home and seems to know everything that happens there.

Behind his carefree smile lie unwavering convictions and a delicate nature that instinctively shies away from the touch of others.

Mihoto Yukihito

One of the people who accompanies you throughout the village.

A painter by trade, his kimono is perpetually stained with oil paints.

Warm, cheerful, and unusually quick to close the distance with others, perhaps his peculiar upbringing is what shaped the person he has become.

Goensama

At the heart of the village stands a volcano where the revered deity known as Goen-sama resides.

Goen-sama banished the night and bestowed fire equally upon all who lived in the village.

Fire is what makes humans human.
Those without fire are not human...

Game System

Hyakume no Hananie

Abbreviated as: Hyakunie

This game is a text-based adventure game in which the story branches according to the choices you make.

Your relationships with the characters and the decisions you make throughout the story will have a profound impact on your fate.

The game is planned to include the standard quality-of-life features expected of a modern visual novel, allowing players to comfortably experience multiple routes and endings.

Content Volume

Additional details—including estimated playtime, scenario volume, number of endings, and specific gameplay features—will be announced as development progresses.

store_data.about_the_game:
Short Description

The Collector is a multiplayer psychological auction game where you bid against three real players for a container full of unknown treasures. Use cards to uncover clues about what's inside, place open bids in a high-stakes environment of shifting information, and compete not for the highest bid—but for the highest profit margin. Spend less, earn more, and dominate the season rankings.

General Overview

The Collector is a multiplayer psychological auction game built around open-bid bidding wars. In each match, you face off against three real players in a five-round auction for a shipping container packed with unknown items—ranging from worthless modern trinkets to priceless artifacts. Use a card-based investigation system to piece together clues about what's inside, place bids that everyone can see and react to in real time, and compete to claim the entire container. Your goal isn't simply to outbid everyone—it's to achieve the highest profit margin. The player who turns the smallest investment into the greatest return wins the season. With a margin-based ranking system, cultural collection bonuses, and a personal gallery to showcase your rarest finds, every artifact tells a story worth collecting.

Detailed Description

Every Bid Is a Statement

You're not playing against a computer—you're reading three other human players. Each round, everyone places their bids in the open, watching each other's moves in real time. Someone just jumped the price by thirty percent—are they confident, or are they bluffing? Someone's been sitting quietly all match and just made their first move—are they baiting you into overpaying? Every bid is a move in a psychological chess match.

What's Inside the Container?

Every match centers on a single shipping container filled with dozens of items—from mass-produced junk to one-of-a-kind masterpieces. You don't know what's inside, but you can use cards to investigate. Reveal an item's quality. Check the dimensions of a piece. Count how many rare artifacts are in the container. Each clue narrows your valuation range. Meanwhile, your opponents are doing exactly the same thing—and their bids tell you what they think they've found.

Cards Are Your Eyes

Draw three cards each round, play one. You might reveal an item's quality, scan an entire category for promising leads, or count how many legendary pieces are up for grabs. The information you gain is private—but your opponents can see what type of card you played, and they're watching your bids to deduce what you've learned. Using a card or holding it back is a strategic choice in itself.

From Darkness to Light

The five-round structure progressively reveals information. Early rounds offer vague hints about what categories are in the container. Mid-game reveals the total value of certain quality tiers. Late rounds might even disclose which category holds the most valuable item. Meanwhile, the bids on the table tell their own story—who's confident, who's cautious, and who's about to make a move.

Artifacts Tell Stories

Every item carries cultural tags—dynasty, kiln, artistic movement, subject matter, material, function. When multiple items in a container share the same tag, they trigger a cultural collection bonus, dramatically increasing their combined value. From the Five Great Kilns of Song Dynasty China to the masters of the Italian Renaissance, from Ming Dynasty scholars to Silk Road treasures—you're not just collecting numbers. You're collecting stories.

Profit Margin Is Everything

Winning the auction isn't enough—you need to win smart. Your ranking is determined by profit margin, not gross revenue. Spending one million to earn a hundred thousand is worse than spending a hundred thousand to earn fifty thousand. Losing money doesn't deduct points, but it won't earn you any either. Your best fifty matches each season determine your rank.

Your Personal Gallery

Rare items won at auction can be placed in your personal gallery, earning collection points. Leveling up your collection unlocks new privileges—more character options in the selection phase, card refresh tokens, entry fee discounts, and exclusive cosmetics. Complete an entire themed set to earn special commemorative coins.

Key Features

  • Open-Bid Mind Games: Place bids everyone can see, react to your opponents in real time, and master the art of psychological warfare

  • Card-Based Investigation: Draw three cards per round, play one—piece together what's inside the container before committing your bid

  • Cultural Collection Bonuses: Artifacts carry cultural tags; multiple items sharing a tag trigger value multipliers based on historical themes

  • Margin-Based Ranking: Your season score depends on capital efficiency, not absolute profit—spend smart, not big

  • Five-Round Matches: Each match lasts 8-12 minutes, with a sudden-victory mechanic that can end the auction early

  • Seasonal Ranked Play: Your best 50 matches determine your rank each season—climb the ladder from Apprentice to Legendary Collector

  • Gallery Progression: Collect rare artifacts, level up your gallery, and unlock exclusive perks and cosmetics

From Darkness to Light

The five-round structure progressively reveals information. Early rounds offer vague hints about what categories are in the container. Mid-game reveals the total value of certain quality tiers. Late rounds might even disclose which category holds the most valuable item. Meanwhile, the bids on the table tell their own story—who's confident, who's cautious, and who's about to make a move.

Artifacts Tell Stories

Every item carries cultural tags—dynasty, kiln, artistic movement, subject matter, material, function. When multiple items in a container share the same tag, they trigger a cultural collection bonus, dramatically increasing their combined value. From the Five Great Kilns of Song Dynasty China to the masters of the Italian Renaissance, from Ming Dynasty scholars to Silk Road treasures—you're not just collecting numbers. You're collecting stories.

Profit Margin Is Everything

Winning the auction isn't enough—you need to win smart. Your ranking is determined by profit margin, not gross revenue. Spending one million to earn a hundred thousand is worse than spending a hundred thousand to earn fifty thousand. Losing money doesn't deduct points, but it won't earn you any either. Your best fifty matches each season determine your rank.

Your Personal Gallery

Rare items won at auction can be placed in your personal gallery, earning collection points. Leveling up your collection unlocks new privileges—more character options in the selection phase, card refresh tokens, entry fee discounts, and exclusive cosmetics. Complete an entire themed set to earn special commemorative coins.

Key Features

  • Open-Bid Mind Games: Place bids everyone can see, react to your opponents in real time, and master the art of psychological warfare

  • Card-Based Investigation: Draw three cards per round, play one—piece together what's inside the container before committing your bid

  • Cultural Collection Bonuses: Artifacts carry cultural tags; multiple items sharing a tag trigger value multipliers based on historical themes

  • Margin-Based Ranking: Your season score depends on capital efficiency, not absolute profit—spend smart, not big

  • Five-Round Matches: Each match lasts 8-12 minutes, with a sudden-victory mechanic that can end the auction early

  • Seasonal Ranked Play: Your best 50 matches determine your rank each season—climb the ladder from Apprentice to Legendary Collector

  • Gallery Progression: Collect rare artifacts, level up your gallery, and unlock exclusive perks and cosmetics
store_data.short_description: "The Collector" is a multiplayer auction game of sealed bids and hidden information. Face three players in five-round auctions for a container of unknown treasures. Use cards to uncover clues, place secret bids, and compete for the highest profit margin. Spend less, earn more.

Stasis Asset Management

［ Now Hiring: Night Observation Temp ］

We are an asset management company overseeing a number of facilities. We are currently hiring night-shift personnel for the position below.

◆ Position

Night Observation Temp · Contract · Solo shift, no rotation

◆ Duties

  • Monitor the several CCTV feeds assigned to you.

  • The moment you notice anything "different from usual," report it at once, per protocol.

  • Also keep an eye on the state of your monitoring terminal. It occasionally malfunctions on its own, but there is no need to worry — we issue the tools to set it right.

  • Shifts begin at night and end at dawn. Make it safely through your hours and the day's work is done.

◆ Requirements

  • Able to keep your eyes on the screens for long stretches

  • A sharp eye that misses no small change

  • Able to stay calm no matter what you see

  • Not the type to wonder about the previous worker

  • Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement regarding anything witnessed on shift

◆ Please Note

  • Even if something on the screen looks back at you, do not leave your post.

  • Not everything the terminal shows you is true. Even so, the work must continue.

  • If someone calls your name during your shift, do not turn around. Our staff do not speak to observers on duty.

  • If the time shown on screen differs from your own watch, always take the screen as correct.

  • Repeatedly missing or misfiling reports will be handled accordingly.

  • Diligence and performance are logged at all times and reflected in contract renewal.

◆ Benefits

  • New hires are provided orientation training to help you settle into the role.

  • Meals and snacks on shift are entirely up to you — bring whatever you like and eat while you work.

  • You may listen to music on shift. The terminal we issue comes with a Music app stocked with tracks to play while you work. That said, it may disturb other staff, so headphones or earphones are strongly recommended.

  • When your shift ends, we take it upon ourselves to see you safely home. We will never leave you alone on the way back.

  • Should any harm come to an observer through an on-shift incident, we will restore you at no cost, up to the prescribed number of times. We cherish those who will stay with us for the long term, so anyone who applies themselves has little to fear.

◆ How to Apply

The position is always open. Applicants able to start tonight will be given priority.

Shall we begin your shift?

About This Game

An observation sim in which you watch CCTV feeds, find anything "different from usual," and report it. Switch between the cameras yourself, pick out whatever has slipped out of place, and hold your post until the shift is over.

store_data.about_the_game:
One grid. One plan. One way out.

Pixel: The Challenge is a 3D puzzle game in the spirit of the great tile-based logic classics — completely re-built. On every level you collect all the Pixels, find the right keys, and cross water, ice, conveyor belts and monsters until the Plenum portal opens.

The logic is grid-clear and deterministic, just like the classics — but the world is real 3D with smooth animation. Best of all: every one of the 80 levels is provably solvable. A solver works out each solution in advance and stores a replay. No level is down to luck, none is unfair.

Why you'll love it

  • 80 hand-crafted levels across 8 worlds — every one guaranteed solvable.
  • Classic logic, real 3D — plan it, solve it, execute it cleanly.
  • Two art styles — switch between Voxel (chunky and bright) and Low-Poly (soft and modern) at any time.
  • Three cameras — third-person, first-person or top-down.
  • Fair for everyone — chase 3 stars as a pro, or switch on Casual mode with no time pressure, plus a "watch the solution" helper.
  • Clean — no ads, no tracking.

What stands in your way

Keys & doors · water · fire · slippery ice · conveyor belts · bombs · teleporters · cloning machines · switches & buttons — and all sorts of monsters that move on their own.

Try it free

Play the first 20 levels free in the demo — download it right here on the Steam page. If the puzzle bug bites, the full game with all 80 levels is waiting.

Already in the works

After launch, Pixel: The Challenge keeps growing: a premium level pack with fiendish master puzzles and a level editor to build and share your own levels — both planned as a separate add-on (DLC). Add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss it.

Languages

Interface and level texts in English, German, French and Spanish.

store_data.about_the_game:
Picofender is an incremental defense action game where you control a hero with your cursor and defend a village alongside your allies.

Waves of monsters march toward the village at the center of the battlefield. Move the hero directly, attack enemies with left click, and let your allies fight automatically as they support the defense.

Defeat enemies to earn gold, then spend it after battle on permanent upgrades through the skill tree. Improve your stats, recruit allies, unlock skills, and survive each wave.

Your build gradually changes through equipment drops and active skill upgrades. Charge in with a sword, shoot from afar with a bow, knock enemies back with a mace, or strike groups with a rod. The hero’s combat style changes depending on the weapon you equip.

As the waves progress, the battlefield expands and new enemy types appear. Overcome ranged attacks, summons, fast chargers, and heavily armored foes as you push toward the final battle.

Features

  • Hands-on defense action with a cursor-controlled hero

  • Incremental progression through repeated combat and upgrades

  • Permanent growth via a skill tree

  • Allies with a variety of roles

  • Hero attack styles that change by weapon type

  • Equipment drops and active skill upgrades

  • A bright medieval fantasy world in pixel art

Picofender combines the satisfying growth of idle and incremental games with a touch of action, letting your own hands shift the tide of battle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every evening you come home. Every night you try to fall asleep. It doesn't always work.

The Night

Your thoughts arrive as cards. Every thought you unwind fills the Moon. But every move winds the Spiral, and the Spiral bends the night. Some ideas can only be caught on the way down.

The Deck

Each night shows its hand in advance: you know which insomnias are coming. You pick ten cards to meet them - seven of the Body, three of the Will. No two cards are alike, and none of them quite says what it does.

The Tea

Some evenings, friends are already there when you come home. You pour the tea and listen. When it's your turn to speak, you speak in cards - the same ideas you take to bed. Each conversation circles a single idea, and when the cups are empty, the idea stays with you.

The Home

The rest of the evening is yours. The apartment is small, and everything here has a story, told an evening at a time. The curtains stay drawn.

 

The days take care of themselves.

Sleep well.

store_data.about_the_game:
Spark's Escape is pure, adrenaline-fueled 2D arcade action that pushes your reflexes to the absolute limit. This isn’t about deep strategy – it’s about precision, instinct, and split-second reactions. No epic story, no complicated menus. You launch the game and jump straight into the action.

The concept is simple but brutal: navigate with pixel-perfect precision, dodge relentless enemies, and react at the exact right millisecond. Deploy powerful power-ups at the perfect moment and plan your next moves on the fly to crush every brutal challenge. Your ultimate goal: guide Sparky safely through the time portal.

Do you have what it takes to climb the leaderboards and cement your name in the Hall of Fame?

Key Features:

  • Pure Arcade Gameplay: Fast-paced, intense rounds that are perfect for quick sessions.

  • 500 Handcrafted Levels: A massive variety of precise challenges designed to test your reflexes.

  • Nasty Enemy Types: Tons of distinct foes with unique, unpredictable movement patterns to keep you sweating.

  • Powerful Power-Ups: Collect game-changing extras to turn the absolute chaos to your advantage when it matters most.

  • Standard vs. Hell Mode: Play the regular game or push your sanity to the edge in the brutally difficult extra mode.

  • Score Attack: Chase down your personal bests and immortalize yourself in the global Hall of Fame.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build steam locomotives. Haul freight. Prove your engine.

Locomotive Works is a train-building and freight simulator set in the early twentieth century golden age of steam. Design steam locomotives and use them to deliver freight across a working railway network. Find out whether your engineering choices can handle real jobs.

Choose the parts that make up your locomotive, then use it to haul freight, earn money, climb grades and complete delivery contracts. A good-looking engine is not enough: weight, cost, pulling power, speed, range and running performance all matter.

Build locomotives that do real work

Design steam locomotives from practical components such as chassis, boilers, cabs, tenders, chimneys, domes and fittings. Choose paint colours and add wear and grime to give each locomotive its own working character. Your choices affect how the engine performs, what it costs to build, how much it can haul, and which jobs it is suited for.

A small engine may be cheap and efficient, but can struggle with heavy loads. A larger freight locomotive may have the power for steep grades, but it costs more to build and run. The aim is not just to make a locomotive that looks right — it must be able to do the work.

Run freight across a working railway

Take freight jobs, move wagons between industries, and choose the right locomotive for the route. Loads, distance, gradients and running costs all affect whether a job is a good match for your current engine.

Earn money from successful work, invest in new builds, and improve your locomotive designs as the jobs become more demanding.

Prove your design

Once your locomotive leaves the depot, the railway becomes the test. Heavy trains, steep climbs, braking distances, fuel, water, and boiler pressure all matter when you are trying to make your deliveries.

Drive the engine yourself and see how your build performs in practical conditions. A locomotive that looks powerful in the workshop still has to prove itself on the grade.

Design for real railway challenges

Trains feel heavy, momentum matters, and poor design choices have consequences. Clear controls and readable feedback help newcomers get started, while heavier loads, steeper grades and more demanding jobs give experienced players a real challenge.

Drive through mountains, forests, and open countryside across a varied freight railway. Design the locomotives you need, meet the challenges of the routes, and make the deliveries your customers depend on.

About This Game

This is not a game about football giants.

This is a game about miracles.

In World Cup: Road of the Underdog, you will lead an overlooked national team from the group stage all the way toward the World Cup trophy.

No superstars. No world-class squad. No one believes you can make it.

But you have the chance to rewrite fate again and again.

Every match is a new challenge. Choose talents before the game, build your own goalkeeper playstyle, predict how the match will unfold, and make crucial decisions at key moments to pull off impossible saves and create your own miracle.

Failure is not the end.

After each run, you gain new abilities and new possibilities. Unlock stronger talents, crazier skill combinations, and different tactical paths as you take on tougher World Cup challenges.

Maybe you will park the bus and survive until penalties.

Maybe your legendary goalkeeper will deny one certain goal after another.

Maybe you will create the greatest upset in World Cup history with your own hands.

Features

  • Lead a low-ranked underdog nation to challenge for the World Cup title

  • Roguelite World Cup runs where every journey plays out differently

  • Combine talents, skills, and random events to build your own road to glory

  • Make key decisions during matches and experience penalties, saves, comebacks, and last-minute drama

  • Unlock new abilities and take on greater challenges

  • Create your own World Cup legend and bring an unknown nation to the top of the world

The World Cup has never belonged only to the strongest teams.

This time, make the world remember the name no one believed in.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Path Is Long, the Sword Is Drawn

Jian Lai is a hardcore, action-heavy martial arts MMORPG in the spirit of Mir and the original Legends of Blood. Single-class Warrior, four great sects, fifty continents of epic adventure — no class-selection dilemma, just the pure thrill of cutting your way forward.

Here, every monster you slay drops vouchers and recharge cards. Top-tier VIP is free to claim. World Bosses spawn every hour with guaranteed 8888 recharge card drops. No pay-to-win, no endless grind — every strike carries the thrill of real rewards.

One sword. One class. Fifty continents. Your martial journey begins with Jian Lai.

Single Class · Warrior — Pure Adrenaline

No class to pick — only how you fight.

Jian Lai features a single-class Warrior system where all players start on equal footing. Strength is determined purely by skill and gear. No class counters, no team composition headaches — just one goal: get stronger.

  • Every Hit Lands: Melee physical combat with visceral, bone-crunching impact

  • Skill Progression: Flame Blade, Sun-Chaser Slash, Heaven-Cleaving Strike — classic Warrior skills unlock as you level up, growing deadlier with practice

  • Gear Defines Your Build: Attack-speed builds, critical-strike builds, tank builds — one class, a hundred ways to play

  • Fair Starting Line: Everyone is a Warrior. In PvP, there are no class advantages — only skill gaps

Four Great Sects — Choose Your Path

During your journey, you must pledge allegiance to one of four great sects. Your sect determines your martial arts path and exclusive skills — the core decision in defining your personal playstyle.

Wudang Sect — Offense · Burst Wudang disciples are renowned for their razor-sharp swordsmanship, pursuing ultimate attack power and instant burst damage. One strike, and all foes fall. Perfect for players who crave the thrill of one-shot kills.

Shaolin Temple — Defense · Control Shaolin disciples possess iron skin and unbreakable bodies, dominating the battlefield with devastating outer techniques and Buddhist crowd control. Tank damage like a mountain, lock down enemies, and clean up at leisure. Ideal for players who want to be the team's anchor.

Huashan Sect — Attack Speed · Lifesteal Huashan disciples fight with unorthodox blade techniques, combining extreme attack speed with lifesteal to grow stronger the longer they fight. Attack like a whirlwind, heal with every strike — the longer the battle, the deadlier they become. Suited for players who love prolonged combat.

Five Poisons Cult — Stealth · Armor Penetration Five Poisons disciples master venom and the art of stealth, shredding defenses before striking from the shadows. Here one moment, gone the next — impossible to guard against. Perfect for players who prefer cunning tactics over brute force.

Four sects, four martial philosophies. Your choice defines how you fight in this martial world.

Fifty Continents — An Epic Journey

Fifty continents. Fifty chapters of adventure.

Jian Lai spans a massive progression line across fifty continents, each with its own unique world, monster ecosystem, and dungeon challenges. From the beginner lands to the ultimate battlefield, difficulty escalates step by step, each more thrilling than the last.

  • Continent Progression System: Defeat each continent's Boss to unlock the next, ensuring balanced pacing and exploration rewards

  • Exclusive Dungeons & Hidden Quests: The deeper you explore, the richer the rewards

  • Progressive Difficulty: Easy to pick up early on, hardcore challenges await in the late game

  • Endless Content: Fifty continents isn't the end — it's the beginning of your martial journey, with more content to explore continuously

From the first monster on the first continent to the ultimate Boss on the fiftieth — the road is long, but every step is worth it.

Every Hit Drops Vouchers — Every Strike Earns Real Rewards

This is Jian Lai's defining feature: every monster you kill drops vouchers and recharge cards.

Every creature you slay in the game has a chance to drop vouchers or recharge cards. Grinding monsters means earning currency. Running dungeons means stockpiling recharges.

  • Every Hit Is a Surprise: Each monster has a chance to drop vouchers and recharge cards

  • Free-to-Play to the Top: Put in the time to grind, and premium resources are available to everyone

  • Fair Progression: Paying players can accelerate, but free players can keep pace through grinding

  • Always Motivated: You never know what the next monster will drop — that anticipation keeps grinding exciting

World Boss — Hourly Spawns, Guaranteed 8888 Recharge Card

Server-wide World Bosses spawn on a fixed schedule, every hour, drawing massive crowds of players to compete for the kill.

  • Guaranteed 8888 Recharge Card: Every kill drops one — test your luck and your strength

  • Random Drops: Vouchers, treasure tickets, rare materials, high-tier equipment — this is where the lucky shine

  • Open to All: No entry requirements — anyone can fight, anyone can loot

Every hour brings a new celebration. Miss one? The next is just around the corner.

Free Top-Tier VIP

No payment required, no grind needed — top-tier VIP is free to claim.

VIP privileges include experience bonuses, drop-rate bonuses, exclusive features, and more — all obtainable in-game for free. Every player can enjoy VIP benefits. The only difference is whether you bother to log in and claim them.

New Server Events — A Martial World Feast

Every new server launch brings four signature events, running simultaneously for non-stop excitement:

Heroes' Banquet at the Hall of Sages Martial heroes gather for a grand feast. Complete exclusive quests for generous rewards — the first step in the new server rankings.

Dragon Gate Escort Agency Escort cargo, or raid the escorts for their goods. Play as a guard protecting shipments, or as a bandit ambushing them mid-route — strength decides who keeps the loot.

Notorious Bandit Hunt Server-wide bounties are posted. A notorious bandit roams the land — track him down, defeat him, and claim the bounty. Players with the best intel profit first.

Siege of Xiangyang City The entire server rallies to defend Xiangyang. Monsters siege the city while players hold the walls. Survive wave after wave for massive rewards. A true test of server coordination and individual prowess.

Four major events, non-stop action from day one of every new server.

Rewards Hall — Free Rewards Galore

Jian Lai's Rewards Hall offers a variety of free bonuses — claim them the moment you log in:

  • Login Rewards: Daily login rewards with escalating value for consecutive sign-ins

  • Online Time Rewards: Accumulate online time and rewards are automatically delivered

  • First Kill Bonus: Server-wide first kills of specific monsters grant bonus rewards — test your speed and luck

  • Monthly Pass: Activate once for daily rebates all month long — unbeatable value

  • CDK Redemption: Enter redemption codes for exclusive bonuses

First thing every day: sweep through the Rewards Hall. Who doesn't love free loot?

Martial Wardrobe — Collect Every Epic Look

Martial titles, footprints, auras, costumes, and mounts — all collected in your Wardrobe system.

  • Martial Titles: Hundreds of epic titles, combining combat stat bonuses with personal flair

  • Martial Footprints: Leave unique effect trails as you walk — turn heads wherever you go

  • Martial Auras: Glowing auras surround your character — be the center of attention anywhere

  • Martial Costumes: A rich wardrobe of outfits to mix and match — express your martial style

  • Martial Mounts: Epic mounts to ride across the continents — fast and fabulous

Your Wardrobe is your calling card in the martial world.

More Features Await Your Discovery

Beyond the core gameplay, Jian Lai offers a wealth of systems to explore:

  • Achievement Rewards: Complete achievements to unlock rewards and record your martial journey

  • Free In-Game Currency: Earnable through gameplay, with free trading and no barriers

  • Auto-Patrol: AFK grinding with auto-patrol — progress even while offline

  • Leaderboards: Server-wide rankings for combat power, level, and wealth — compete for the top

  • Auction House: Free-bid trading where premium gear circulates across the entire server

More features await in-game. The martial world is vast — take your time and explore.

Game Features

  • Single-class Warrior — pure PvP, skill speaks for itself

  • Four great sects: Wudang burst, Shaolin control, Huashan lifesteal, Five Poisons armor-penetration — four martial paths

  • Fifty continents of epic adventure, progressively challenging

  • Every monster hit drops vouchers and recharge cards — free-to-play players can reach the top

  • World Bosses spawn hourly with guaranteed 8888 recharge card drops

  • Top-tier VIP available for free

  • Four major server events: Heroes' Banquet, Dragon Gate Escort, Bandit Hunt, Siege of Xiangyang

  • Rewards Hall: Login rewards, online rewards, first-kill bonuses, monthly pass, CDK redemption

  • Martial Wardrobe: Titles, footprints, auras, costumes, mounts — all collectible

  • Achievements, leaderboards, auction house, auto-patrol, and more

No payment required, no grind needed — top-tier VIP is free to claim.

VIP privileges include experience bonuses, drop-rate bonuses, exclusive features, and more — all obtainable in-game for free. Every player can enjoy VIP benefits. The only difference is whether you bother to log in and claim them.

New Server Events — A Martial World Feast

Every new server launch brings four signature events, running simultaneously for non-stop excitement:

Heroes' Banquet at the Hall of Sages Martial heroes gather for a grand feast. Complete exclusive quests for generous rewards — the first step in the new server rankings.

Dragon Gate Escort Agency Escort cargo, or raid the escorts for their goods. Play as a guard protecting shipments, or as a bandit ambushing them mid-route — strength decides who keeps the loot.

Notorious Bandit Hunt Server-wide bounties are posted. A notorious bandit roams the land — track him down, defeat him, and claim the bounty. Players with the best intel profit first.

Siege of Xiangyang City The entire server rallies to defend Xiangyang. Monsters siege the city while players hold the walls. Survive wave after wave for massive rewards. A true test of server coordination and individual prowess.

Four major events, non-stop action from day one of every new server.

Jian Lai's Rewards Hall offers a variety of free bonuses — claim them the moment you log in:

  • Login Rewards: Daily login rewards with escalating value for consecutive sign-ins

  • Online Time Rewards: Accumulate online time and rewards are automatically delivered

  • First Kill Bonus: Server-wide first kills of specific monsters grant bonus rewards — test your speed and luck

  • Monthly Pass: Activate once for daily rebates all month long — unbeatable value

  • CDK Redemption: Enter redemption codes for exclusive bonuses

First thing every day: sweep through the Rewards Hall. Who doesn't love free loot?

Martial Wardrobe — Collect Every Epic Look

Martial titles, footprints, auras, costumes, and mounts — all collected in your Wardrobe system.

  • Martial Titles: Hundreds of epic titles, combining combat stat bonuses with personal flair

  • Martial Footprints: Leave unique effect trails as you walk — turn heads wherever you go

  • Martial Auras: Glowing auras surround your character — be the center of attention anywhere

  • Martial Costumes: A rich wardrobe of outfits to mix and match — express your martial style

  • Martial Mounts: Epic mounts to ride across the continents — fast and fabulous

Your Wardrobe is your calling card in the martial world.

More Features Await Your Discovery

Beyond the core gameplay, Jian Lai offers a wealth of systems to explore:

  • Achievement Rewards: Complete achievements to unlock rewards and record your martial journey

  • Free In-Game Currency: Earnable through gameplay, with free trading and no barriers

  • Auto-Patrol: AFK grinding with auto-patrol — progress even while offline

  • Leaderboards: Server-wide rankings for combat power, level, and wealth — compete for the top

  • Auction House: Free-bid trading where premium gear circulates across the entire server

More features await in-game. The martial world is vast — take your time and explore.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE YEAR... 20XX - A polished corporate utopia masks a sinister reality controlled by an omnipotent AI. Survival in this high-speed, vehicular action-roguelite demands unrelenting aggression, delivering a chaotic, adrenaline-fueled experience. Inspired by Risk of Rain and other classics, fueled by one solo dev's passion.

Gameplay focuses exclusively on high-stakes vehicular combat and mastering a profoundly deep system of items and synergies. Runs begin with a basic chassis and escalate rapidly into screen-clearing devastation, where meticulously combining game-breaking artifacts results in an overwhelmingly overpowered state. The corporate AI scales its defensive forces limitlessly, but an immense volume of unlockable upgrades guarantees the destructive capabilities required to break the system entirely.

Dynamic Combat Vehicles: Master a growing lineup of specialized combat machines, with 16 planned for the full release. Each vehicle offers unique handling profiles, primary armaments, and alternate skills.

Infinite Build Synergies: An enormous catalog of stackable items guarantees that no two escape attempts are identical. Loot combinations scale exponentially, generating unpredictable and catastrophic effects.

Sinister 20XX Dystopia: Discover the dark, horrifying truth buried beneath the chrome and neon of a megacorporation's gleaming exterior across a variety of handcrafted stages.

Nostalgic Retro Aesthetic: Low-poly 3D models combine with crunchy, unpolished pixel-art textures to evoke the golden era of classic PSX and N64 action titles.

Solo-Developer Passion Project: Solo dev energy lv99.

dobert_dev welcomes you... to the world of TAKEDOWN 16.

store_data.about_the_game:
[ Welcome to GrindFall! 👻]

Death is just the beginning of the fun! GrindFall is a vibrant, chaotic, and incredibly dynamic Co-op Action Roguelite in the Survivor-like / Bullet Heaven genre. Take control of a ghost, arm yourself to your spectral teeth, and show the endless waves of enemies who truly rules the night!

[ Catch, Transform, Haul! 🎃]

Your goal isn't just to survive. Humans are roaming the procedurally generated map. Catch them and turn them into pumpkins - the game's main currency! But simply creating a pumpkin isn't enough; you need to deliver it to the crypt.

  • Power of the Crypt: With every delivered pumpkin, the crypt's power grows, unlocking entirely new areas of the map!

  • Heavy Burden: Beware - some pumpkins apply debuffs to you, and the largest specimens are so heavy that you'll need a teammate to help you carry them back!

[ Become the Embodiment of Chaos ⚡]

Each run lasts about 30 minutes, during which your ghost will evolve from a harmless little spirit into an unstoppable force of destruction. Level up, choose upgrade cards, and build deadly synergies. Upgrade your Dash to skillfully evade danger, and unlock new devastating weapons!

[ Key Features: ]

  • 🤝 Co-op Madness: Play solo or gather a squad of up to 4 players in the lobby. Everything is more fun together (and it’s much easier to haul massive pumpkins)!

  • 🃏 Deep Progression: Choose cards every time you level up. Combine weapons and stat upgrades to create unique and incredibly overpowered (in a good way!) builds.

  • 🗺️ Living Map & Events: The map is procedurally generated and constantly expands as you deliver pumpkins to the crypt. Sudden random events during the match will keep you on your toes and completely change the flow of the run!

  • 👻 Unique Ghosts: Unlock passive bonuses for different ghosts to suit your playstyle, and customize them with cool cosmetic items.

  • 🎨 Vibrant 3D Low-Poly Style: Enjoy cartoony, colorful graphics and a fun atmosphere where even the most intense bullet-hell battles will bring a smile to your face.

  • 👹 Diverse Enemies: Fight hordes of enemies of varying strengths, each with their own unique traits and behaviors.

Are you ready to gather the ultimate pumpkin harvest and unleash a true GrindFall? The crypt is waiting!

store_data.about_the_game:
Dinosis: Quantum Island

You were never supposed to come here.

Explore a mysterious island where prehistoric predators roam freely, gather resources, craft essential equipment, and fight to survive in a hostile world where every expedition could be your last. Uncover the truth behind the island's experiments while facing creatures that should have disappeared millions of years ago.

Every bullet matters. Every decision counts. And on Quantum Island... nothing is quite what it seems.

Features

  • Survive against dangerous dinosaurs with unique behaviors.

  • Explore a vast tropical island filled with dense jungles, ancient caves, and abandoned research facilities.

  • Gather resources, craft tools, weapons, and survival equipment.

  • Discover hidden laboratories and piece together the story behind the mysterious Quantum Project.

  • Adapt to changing weather conditions and the challenges of day and night.

  • Choose your own approach-avoid danger through stealth or fight for survival using crafted and military weapons.

  • Freely explore a living open world full of secrets, hidden locations, and unexpected encounters.

Will you escape the island...or become another forgotten part of its experiments?

A Personal Project

Dinosis: Quantum Island is a prequel to Dinosis Survival, a game I released nearly nine years ago as a solo developer.

With Quantum Island, I'm finally returning to the Dinosis universe to reveal the origins of that catastrophe. This project is the game I always wanted to create, built with everything I've learned over the past nine years.

Whether you're a returning fan or discovering Dinosis for the very first time, I hope you'll enjoy uncovering the mystery behind the beginning of the end.

See you on Quantum Island!

store_data.about_the_game:
这是以封神榜为题材MMORPG。化身杨戬，奉元始天尊之命下山伏魔。斩杀妖魔，收集五行灵材，感悟火木水金土五大祖巫法则——祝融锻攻防、句芒筑铁壁、共工养气血、蓐收破万军、后土御乾坤。解锁祖巫禁地与时间长河，挑战极限副本，赢取稀世珍宝。从听令而行到执掌天命，一步步书写属于你的封神霸业！

《霸业封神传奇》—— 天眼一开，三界俯首。

你，是杨戬。那个额生天眼、手握三尖两刃刀的玉虚宫门下。故事始于元始天尊的一道法旨：山下妖气横流，殷商气数将尽，你需即刻下山，扫荡群魔。这不仅是任务，更是你踏上“霸业”之途的第一步——从听令而行的阐教门徒，到执掌封神榜的旷世霸主，这一切，由你亲手铸就。

五大祖巫，铸我神躯

封神之路上，你将陆续迎战五大祖巫。战而胜之，感悟其法则，便能将祖巫之力化为己用。消耗通过降妖任务获得的五行灵材，即可提升对应祖巫法则的等级，获得永久属性成长：

  • 火之祖巫·祝融—— 烈焰不灭，攻防一体。提升火之法则，可同时增强攻击与防御，让你在输出与生存间游刃有余。

  • 木之祖巫·句芒—— 生生不息，铜墙铁壁。提升木之法则，可极大提升防御能力，如古木扎根大地，万邪不侵。

  • 水之祖巫·共工—— 怒涛不息，气血长存。提升水之法则，可提升生命力上限，让你在鏖战中愈战愈勇。

  • 金之祖巫·蓐收—— 锋芒毕露，无坚不摧。提升金之法则，可极大提升攻击力，一刀劈开朝歌妖雾。

  • 土之祖巫·后土—— 厚德载物，攻守兼备。提升土之法则，兼顾攻防两端，是均衡之道的不二之选。

没有哪一条法则可有可无，也没有哪一条可以轻松满级。资源如何分配，祖巫之道如何取舍，将决定你的杨戬是“一力降十会”的攻伐之神，还是“不动如山”的不败金身。

封神地图，步步天机

随剧情推进，一张张封神世界的地图徐徐展开：

  • 玉虚宫脚下—— 起点之地，接取元始天尊法旨，初遇山野小妖。

  • 巫族大陆—— 在这里将得到五大祖巫的指点，逐渐增强自己的实力。

  • 朝歌城外—— 妖气弥漫的都城郊野，妲己的狐妖爪牙遍布。

store_data.about_the_game:
In the aftermath of the chaos in London, darkness emerges as the world's natural balance unravels. A series of devastating disasters strike India, unleashing disarray and devastation. Parvati, a guide in the city of Varanasi, invites Morgan Johnson, along with his trusty companions Jack Brown and the mystic Tenzin, to uncover the mysteries behind these cataclysms. The calamities are attributed to the wrath of Lord Shiva, whose sacred relics have been stolen, driving the world into turmoil.

Their quest unfolds in five thrilling chapters as they traverse the mystical landscapes of India and journey into Tibet, chasing clues and piecing together a sinister puzzle. With the fate of the world hanging in the balance, our intrepid investigators embark on an adventure like no other. Parvati guides them through the turmoil of India, introducing them to ancient mythology and mystical occurrences.

  • Immerse yourself in a compelling narrative filled with mysticism, adventure, and intrigue.

  • Engage in challenging match-3 puzzles as you gather crucial resources to unlock the next stage of the story.

  • Unlock 20 upgrades, each revealing new layers of the narrative and enhancing the characters' abilities.

  • Explore rich and diverse landscapes across India and Tibet, discovering ancient relics, secrets, and new allies as you piece together a puzzle that may decide the world's destiny.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fly, Yakko, fly

Yakko was a loyal servant turned into a kite and banished to the world of Tako, a grumpy
octopus who rules the sky and would very much like you to stay down.

Hold to fly. Steer to survive. Your string tenses as you pull: release before it snaps,
pull again, and climb an endless, ever-changing sky of birds, squids, festival toys and
shifting winds.

The sky fights back

  • Tako himself blocks the way, tracks your kite, and shoves you down when you touch
    him. At certain heights he even sneaks up from behind.
  • Temari streaks tumble from above in quiet skies. Thread a whole streak untouched and
    earn a tailwind, a jingle, and an extra life.
  • Updrafts and downdrafts announced by drifting petals. Ride the updrafts idle, and do
    not try to out-fly a downdraft: steer, or sink.

Seven lucky gods have your back

Catch daruma power-ups as they drift by: Hotei restores your lives, Bishamonten makes you
invulnerable, Benzaiten turns you invisible, Fukurokuju flies for you, and the string gods
Daikokuten and Ebisu bless your rope. Stash them in the drawer and deploy them when it counts.

Made for the Deck

  • Gyro steering on Steam Deck: lean the Deck and the kite banks with you, like holding
    a real string in the wind. Toggle it in Settings.
  • Full controller and keyboard support.
  • Steam leaderboards: race the world in Normal, Time Trial and Flappy.
  • Hand-drawn ukiyo-e skies that change as you climb. Some of them flip the world upside down.
  • Earn gifts every flight and spend them at the Ennichi festival stall on new kites, darumas,
    worlds and game modes.
  • No ads, no tracking, no data collected.

Fly high, Yakko.

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Shape your own destiny and conquer a world beyond the elements!

The City Of Akhetaten delivers an adrenaline-fueled experience where high-stakes top-down combat meets the ultimate creative freedom of sandbox base-building. In these unforgiving lands, a sharp blade won't be enough to survive. You must make tactical decisions, fortify your sanctuary, and step through mysterious portals to unravel the secrets of a changing world.

⚔️ Choose Your Path & Master Your Skills

Don't just be another warrior. Embark on your journey by selecting a class that perfectly fits your tactical playstyle:

  • Offense: A high-damage, frontline bruiser built to crush enemy lines.

  • Support: A defensive powerhouse focused on survival, utility, and shielding allies.

  • Marksman: A swift, agile ranged combatant who rains down death from the shadows. As you level up, dive into a detailed, branching Skill Tree to customize your active spells and passive buffs to create the ultimate build.

🔨 Gather, Craft, and Reshape the World

The world is your canvas and your laboratory. Chop down sturdy oak trees, mine precious veins, and harvest wheat fields. Use the advanced, free-form building mode to design your fortress or village from scratch—placing walls, roofs, windows, and defensive structures. Set up crafting benches to forge tier-based gear, upgrading your equipment from basic copper to legendary golden swords and armor.

🗺️ Portals and Uncharted Realms

Journey through arid desert outposts and past the shadows of ancient pyramids to activate mystical portals. These gateways transport you to entirely different ecosystems—like lush, dense, yet deadly forests teeming with region-specific resources and unique threats. Don't trek across these vast lands on foot; summon your loyal mount to traverse the open world with speed.

🏹 Fluid Hack & Slash Combat & Looting

Desert bandits, goblin encampments, and ancient anomalies—every corner of the map is crawling with hostile forces waiting to ambush you. Engage in responsive, combo-driven top-down combat. Vanquish hordes of enemies to gain XP, level up, and harvest rare loot like leather scraps and precious ores to constantly upgrade your build.

💰 A Living Sandbox Economy

Discover secure desert oases and trading hubs to interact with local merchants. Sell your excess materials gathered from dangerous expeditions to accumulate gold, or spend your fortune on rare crafting ingredients, powerful gear blueprints, and vital supplies to accelerate your progression.

KEY FEATURES

  • Versatile Class System: Dynamically mold your character to fit your exact combat preferences.

  • Modular Base Building: Enjoy total creative freedom with a free-form building system to protect your loot.

  • Portal Exploration: Travel between drastically different biomes in search of rare, high-tier resources.

  • Deep Crafting Progression: Forge and upgrade your weapons and armor through various material tiers (Copper, Iron, Gold).

  • Mount System: Summon customizable mounts to explore a vast, beautiful open world efficiently.
