store_data.about_the_game:
It's time to fish!

A completely new and unique game that will plunge you into the very depths! Perfect timings, perfect girls! What could be better?

  • 20 types of fish-girls! Each one is unique, special, and gorgeous! It's time to catch them all!

  • Over 160 images! The girls are more than happy to share something personal with you.

  • Over 30 unique music tracks + the best soundtracks from previous games!

  • The rhythm fishing is built on a 4-key piano layout. Hit the beat and simply enjoy the dynamic fishing gameplay!

  • Always in touch. Keep your tablet ready, the girls will create group chats, send messages, and take the initiative themselves!

An Incredible Fusion! Fishing + Rhythm Game!

Completely seamless gameplay! No matter when you cast your line, during the catch, the rhythm game becomes a continuation of the background soundtrack! Switch tracks via the built-in music app on your tablet, choose playlists by genre, and put them on repeat!

All beatmaps are hand-crafted, creating pleasant patterns for every new bite!

Too many notes on the screen? The game features 3 difficulty levels! You'll definitely find your perfect pace!

Freshwater Neighbors

Simple girls with clear desires and domestic coziness.

Have a cold beer in nature with the energetic tomboy Crucian Carp, test your endurance with the aggressive and sporty Pike, or just fall asleep in the warm embraces of the lazy milf Catfish. And if you try hard enough, there's a chance to pull out the strict Secret Fish, who will quickly explain the chain of command and force you to work overtime!

Tropical Beach

Bright, exotic, and incredibly demanding of your attention!

Get ready to endure endless selfies from the hyperactive gyaru Clownfish, pull the hikikomori Flounder out of her depressive slumber, and endure the toxic yet alluring humiliations from the bitchy Lionfish. Rumor has it that these warm waters also hide a mysterious Secret Fish with truly maternal instincts, whose wide embrace will shelter you from any hardship.

Dangerous Predators

For those who love risk, adrenaline, and dominance!

Survive the chaos and random bites of the crazy punk Piranha, melt the heart of the rough delinquent Barracuda, or surrender yourself to the slippery latex and tight knots of the cunning Moray Eel. Careful: at the very bottom hides a mighty Secret Fish — a muscular alpha, for whom you will become not a fisherman, but a desired prey!

Deep Sea Gloom

Gloomy and easily frightened, which makes these creatures from the darkest trenches even cuter.

Calm down the Grenadier, trembling at every rustle, give an ocean of love and hugs to the insecure Blobfish, or spend the whole night playing co-op games with the cynical goth Anglerfish. The most persistent fishermen will be able to awaken an ancient Secret Fish, demanding not cheap flirtation, but absolute worship of her greatness.

Elite Aquarium

Wealth, pathos, and the whims of expensive ladies!

Help clean up after the adorably clumsy maid Guppy, engage in a fistfight with the hot-tempered Betta Fish, or go broke buying gifts for the spoiled princess Goldfish. But be careful what you wish for: the elite waters are ruled by an extremely dangerous Secret Fish from the shadow mafia, who is not to be messed with, but the reward for the risk will exceed all expectations.

It's time to show these fish who the real catch is here!

store_data.about_the_game:
Naya: The Forgotten Path

Naya: The Forgotten Path is a third-person action-adventure game set in a magical forest filled with forgotten ruins, deep caves, ancient temples, and mysterious forces awakening after a long silence.

You follow Naya, a young archer who wakes up with no clear understanding of how she arrived in this place or why the forest seems to recognize her presence. Guided by ancestral statues, mysterious spirits, and fragments of a lost story, she must follow a path that has remained hidden for generations.

What begins as a journey in search of answers quickly becomes something much greater. Ancient passages begin to open again, magical stones awaken, and corrupted creatures emerge to stop Naya from moving forward. Every ruin she explores reveals another piece of the mystery and brings her closer to the truth about her own destiny.

Explore a living and mysterious forest

Travel through different regions of a stylized fantasy world designed to evoke a sense of wonder, mystery, and adventure.

Explore dense forests, sunlit clearings, abandoned camps, deep caves, nature-covered temples, and ancient structures hiding forgotten mechanisms.

The environment is more than a path between battles. Observe your surroundings, search for clues, uncover hidden passages, and discover how the different elements of the world are connected.

Some places may appear peaceful at first, but they can hide creatures, traversal challenges, or traces left behind by those who walked through the forest before Naya.

Fast-paced combat with a bow, magic, and melee attacks

Naya can use a variety of abilities during combat.

Her bow allows her to fight enemies from a distance, strike specific targets, and interact with magical elements throughout the environment. Arrows can be used both in battle and to solve environmental challenges and unlock new paths.

When enemies get too close, Naya can also perform combinations of punches and kicks, blending melee combat with agile movement.

In addition to her physical abilities, she possesses a magical pulse capable of pushing back nearby enemies, creating space during battle, and interacting with certain elements of the world.

Throughout the journey, players will need to learn when to keep their distance, when to move forward, and how to combine each of Naya’s abilities.

Movement and platforming challenges

Exploration requires more than simply following a trail.

Naya can jump, perform a double jump with an aerial flip, roll to evade attacks, and cross platforming sequences created by magical mechanisms.

Some paths only appear after solving a puzzle. Floating stones may emerge one after another, beginning to fall shortly after Naya steps on them. Players must react quickly, time their jumps, and reach the next platform before the path disappears.

Once certain routes are conquered, the stones may stabilize and form a permanent passage, allowing Naya to use the path again in either direction.

Magical rings are also part of the traversal challenges. By striking them with an arrow, Naya can be pulled through the air, crossing large distances and chaining multiple jumps together.

Puzzles integrated into the environment

The ruins of the forest hide mechanisms that cannot be overcome through strength alone.

Observe symbols, search for clues, and interact with stones, targets, statues, and ancient structures.

Some challenges require objects to be activated in the correct order. Others test the player’s precision with the bow, movement skills, or ability to understand the surrounding environment.

In certain puzzles, magical targets appear temporarily and must be hit before they disappear or fall. Each new stage may increase the speed, number of targets, and pressure placed on the player.

Solving these challenges awakens ancient structures, reveals new areas, and allows Naya to continue along the forgotten path.

Magical creatures and enemies of the forest

The forest is inhabited by many different creatures, and not all of them will accept Naya’s presence.

Face enemies that chase, surround, and attack in different ways. Some creatures rely on direct charges, while others use spores, special abilities, or unpredictable behavior.

Players must observe each enemy’s movements, dodge incoming attacks, control the distance, and find the right moment to strike back.

Major encounters await Naya inside the ruins and the castle. These enemies represent important obstacles in her journey and require mastery of the abilities learned throughout the adventure.

Training and learning within the world

The game’s systems are introduced naturally through the adventure.

During exploration, Naya can find a training dummy where players can practice melee attacks, use the magical pulse, and test the accuracy of their arrows from different distances.

The training features progressive stages, allowing players to understand each ability before facing more dangerous challenges.

After completing the training, the dummy remains available for free practice.

Meditation, recovery, and places of rest

In special areas of the forest, Naya can discover meditation points.

While meditating, the surrounding atmosphere becomes calmer, the music changes, and Naya gradually recovers her strength. These moments provide a peaceful break between challenges and reinforce her connection with the forest.

Meditation points also serve as important locations throughout the journey, offering a place of safety before entering more dangerous areas.

A journey guided by clues and discoveries

Naya’s story is not told only through long explanations.

Conversations with spirits and statues, objects found in the environment, ancient ruins, and small events help reveal the history of the forest.

In some areas, players must discover several clues before the next objective becomes available. These clues can be found in different orders, encouraging exploration of the environment.

Every discovery helps reveal what happened in this place and why Naya was brought there.

A stylized fantasy world

Naya: The Forgotten Path features a stylized visual direction that combines fantasy environments, nature, magic, and ancient ruins.

Particle effects, magical arrows, mist, environmental lighting, and distinct atmospheres help make every region feel like a unique part of the journey.

The visual style is designed to capture the feeling of exploring an animated adventure, with colorful and mysterious environments while still preserving moments of danger and tension.

Key features

  • Third-person single-player action-adventure.

  • Explore forests, caves, ruins, temples, and castles.

  • Combat using a bow and arrow, melee attacks, and magical powers.

  • Magical arrows used in combat, puzzles, and traversal.

  • Dodging, rolling, double jumping, and platforming challenges.

  • Magical rings that allow Naya to cross large distances.

  • Floating stones that create temporary and permanent paths.

  • Puzzles based on precision, sequences, observation, and exploration.

  • Magical target challenges with multiple stages and time limits.

  • Stylized creatures with different attacks and behaviors.

  • Special encounters and battles against more powerful enemies.

  • A training dummy with progressive combat stages.

  • Meditation points for recovery and rest.

  • A clue and objective system integrated into exploration.

  • Areas with unique music and environmental atmospheres.

  • A story told through spirits, statues, ruins, and discoveries.

The path was forgotten, but it never truly disappeared.

The forest has awakened, the ancient stones are responding once again, and something is waiting for Naya beyond the ruins.

Now she must discover why she was chosen to follow this path and what will happen when she finally reaches its end.

store_data.about_the_game:
Seocheon Kkotbat — where all life begins.

Summoned by Samsin, the goddess of life and birth, you are chosen to become her successor. Travel through five worlds, learn the rhythm of each, and earn the recognition of the Five Celestial Guardians who watch over them. Only when all five accept you can you truly become Samsin, caretaker of all living things.

One package, two games

Rhythm and nurturing — enjoy each on its own, or together for something greater.

A mythic journey set to music
Run ever forward and surrender to the beat with four keys: D, F, J, and K. The Blue Dragon's Dragon Palace Sea, the Red Phoenix's Flame Desert, the White Tiger's Cloud Sea Garden, the Black Tortoise's Northern Mountain, and the Yellow Dragon's Observatory — five worlds, each with its own scenery and music, await you. Master the timing, chain your combos, and chase the high score.

A soundtrack woven with Korean tradition
Waves, desert, jazz, a winter's night, a music box — each world carries its own musical color. An original soundtrack blending traditional Korean music with a range of genres gives every beat a feeling all its own.

Five lives, raised with care
Tend to the eggs you find along your journey. Breathe life into them, read them stories, play them music, share your warmth — and as you nurture them, each will hatch into something shaped by your care. What they become is yours to discover.

A canvas of pixel art
Five worlds painted in the colors of Korean tradition (Obangsaek), brought to life through warm, beautiful pixel art steeped in myth.

Key Features

  • Five worlds and Celestial Guardians inspired by Korean mythology
  • Intuitive 4-key rhythm action (D / F / J / K)
  • An original soundtrack blending traditional Korean music with diverse genres
  • An egg-nurturing and evolution system where your care shapes the outcome
  • A randomized collection of lives to discover and gather
  • Casual, welcoming difficulty for newcomers and veterans alike

A new Samsin awaits in the Seocheon Kkotbat.

store_data.about_the_game:
A tower defense game with loads of towers and lots of interactions!

Machinery Defense is a 2D top-down tower defense game with over 30 towers, 20 enemies, and 20 maps planned for the full release! Defend your base (which also shoots) from an onslaught of various enemy bots, each with their own strengths and weaknesses!

Overclock Your Towers

Plan strategically on what towers to place and when to Overclock! Instead of the standard tower upgrades system that focuses on upgrading and constantly scaling your towers, Machinery Defense features Overclocking towers, making them temporary stronger at the cost of some resources and usually more energy consumption.

Harvest Resources

Build Ore Mines to gather Ores that are used to build towers, which are powered by energy from Solar Cells!

Special Interactions

Machinery Defense features lots of interactions between towers and strategic choices!

Launch lasers through Prisms to split them into several smaller lasers!

Launch metallic bullets through magnets to power them up!

Make enemies wet to deal more damage using Electric attacks! Wet enemies can't be burned and using Fire attacks on wet enemies shortens the wet duration, so choose wisely!

Use anti-air turrets to deal with airborne enemies...or use magnetism to pull them closer to the ground so they can be attacked by other towers!

In a pinch? Overclock your Batteries to make them explode, sacrificing them to deal high damage!

Adapt to Powerful Enemies

Encounter airborne bots, fast crawling bots, bots immune to some attacks, bots that shoot at your towers, bots that stuns nearby towers, and more as they make their way towards your base! Adapt to the enemies spawning in each wave and utilize the many towers to handle them!

Fixed Enemy or Randomized

Play Campaign mode, Standard mode with fixed enemy waves, Entropy mode with semi-random enemy waves, or Special Operations with special rules! Hard mode and Night Mode also available.

Unlock Secret Towers

Not all towers are unlocked through the campaign or shop. Discover the hidden ways to unlock some towers!

Analyze The Database

No need for online resources. The in-game database features the detailed stats of all towers and enemies!

Features

A Campaign mode, a Standard mode, an Entropy mode where random enemies spawn, and a Special Operations mode with different rules!

Night mode where Solar Cells don't work.

Hard mode with more enemies.

30+ towers, 20+ maps, and 20+ enemies planned for the full release.

Lots of interactions between towers and enemies.

An Overclocking system instead of the standard Upgrading system.

Airborne enemies that takes a different path.

Detailed in-game stats.

Some secret towers to unlock.

Get Constructing!

store_data.about_the_game:
Your friend, the bartender, just vanished into an emergency and left the bar to its fate. You do not know how to tend a bar — yet the orders are pouring in. What do you put in their glass? 

In Slots & Shots, every drink is a high-stakes gamble. Pull the reels, gamble the ingredients, and try to match the shifting tastes of your clients. Get the match percentage just right to rack up major tips and boost your reputation, or serve a total disaster and watch your guests walk away angry.

Use your hard-earned cash and chips to hit the shop after any served drink, stacking upgrades as prices rise.

Key Features

  • Slot-Machine Bartending: Pull the reels to roll for ingredients. Balance randomized cravings from customers demanding anything from a classy "primary" flavor to a complex "secondary" profile.

  • Dynamic Shop Upgrades: Spend your cash between drinks to stack crucial upgrades and have fun serving more drinks.

  • Precise Match Mechanics: Keep an eye on the match percentage. Hit a "Perfect" or "Great" match to earn the room's respect, or risk an "Angry" or "Vomit" disaster if you fail to reroll a bad fit.

  • Roguelite Progression: Adapt to increasingly demanding levels. Win your current shift to unlock a choice of powerful rewards that give you a vital edge on your next run.

  • Win the Shift: Unlock new thematic levels and soundtracks as you gamble your way through the shift. Keep an eye on the negative balance, you don’t want it to drop too low or you’ll have to restart the shift.

store_data.about_the_game:
The outbreak doesn't stop. So gear up.

Combat runs itself. You build the squad.

Idle Outbreak Z is a post-apocalyptic idle RPG where a squad of survivors pushes into zombie-infested territory, one level and one wave at a time. You never pull the trigger. Every zombie that drops leaves loot behind, and the only question that matters is what your squad is carrying into the next wave.

Scavenge. Equip. Push deeper.

  • Combat is fully automatic. Every wave, every kill, handled.

  • 65 items across 5 rarities, Common to Legendary.

  • Gear every survivor across four slots: Weapon, Head, Body, Feet.

  • Stack damage, HP, armor, dodge, crit and regen into a squad that wrecks.

  • Sell the junk for Gears in one click. Spend them making your team deadlier.

A horde that fights back.

  • 3 worlds. 10 levels each. 5 waves per level.

  • Zombies that demand different answers: Strays sprint in and eat your reload, Bloaters soak everything, Juggernauts are walls that hit like trucks.

  • Legendaries worth the grind — the Golden AK, the Minigun, the Anti-Materiel Rifle.

Your run, your pace.

  • Windowed or fullscreen, on Windows, macOS, and Steam Deck.

  • No microtransactions. No daily login. No FOMO.

  • Buy once. Play it your way.

store_data.about_the_game:
Right after crashing on a "new planet" during a mission to return to the mothership, your team decides to come and help you escape. The problem is, it won't be that easy. The planet may be dangerous, and you'll need to explore it first to find your way back.

To do so, you'll use all the other UFOs to navigate and explore this unknown world, and finally, perhaps, return to the mothership.

You are not alone. Throughout your adventure, you'll use a variety of UFOs and tools, each with its own unique behavior:

  • Bomb UFOs launch your alien from one point to another.

  • Bounce UFOs send you flying at the perfect angle toward your destination.

  • Teleporter UFOs let you travel through linked portals.

  • Free-flying UFO sequences let you roam around freely.

  • And many more mechanics, including abduction beams, lights, ropes, snow grinders, electrical devices, and so on...

Every 20 levels introduces new UFOs, obstacles, and environmental hazards that transform a simple mission into a puzzle-platforming challenge.

Play through a campaign of handcrafted levels filled with secret coins, hazards, cutscenes, and more! Each area introduces new obstacles and UFO combinations to master.

The game includes a full in-game level editor. Create your own challenges using many of the same tools, UFOs, hazards, decorations, music, and interactive objects found throughout the main game.

Upload your creations online, play community-made levels, receive reviews and climb the leaderboards !

Collect coins from both the campaign and online levels, then visit the shop to unlock hats, colors, and other cosmetic items. Give your alien its own unique style before heading back into the adventure!

  • 2D physics-based platforming with chaotic alien movement

  • A campaign of handcrafted levels

  • A wide variety of UFO mechanics, hazards, and environmental systems

  • Collectible UFO Coins and progression

  • A full in-game level editor

  • Online level sharing and community level browsing

  • Alien customization with hats and colors

  • Steam Achievements

  • Keyboard, mouse, and controller support

  • English and French localization

And this is only the beginning, more levels, mechanics, and content are planned for future updates.

store_data.about_the_game:
YOU ARE THE ANOMALY

You boot up inside a hostile computer with one directive: survive. You are a rogue process, a sliver

of runaway code, and the whole system wants you gone. Spread. Adapt. Breach. Escape into the next

sector before the antivirus scrubs you out of existence.

SPREAD YOUR CODE

Drag to paint your infection across a glowing circuit board. Your code also creeps outward on its own,

a living cyan organism eating the dark. Every cell you take is territory, and territory is power.

SEIZE THE COMPUTE

Capture gold Data Nodes to fund your expansion. Compute pays for everything: claiming ground, building

defenses, and forcing the gateway open. Grab too little and you stall. Grab too much and you cannot

hold it. The whole game lives in that tension.

HOLD THE LINE

The system fights back, and it learns. Sentinels rush your core, Scrubbers devour your data, fast

Daemons swarm, Splitters fork when killed, Shielded units soak your fire, Phantoms cloak, Leeches

drain your compute, and Sappers hunt down your turrets to blow them apart. Every few sectors a boss

wakes up to hunt you: the grinding ICE Guardian, the minion-summoning Warden, or the self-repairing

Compiler that regenerates and erodes your territory in pulses. Answer them: build Turrets, Pulse novas,

Amplifiers, Mines, Slow fields, EMP stun coils and Repair nanites on your own cells, wall off corridors

to funnel the swarm, then trigger PURGE (a screen-clearing shockwave) or FORK (an instant code-spread

burst) when it all goes wrong.

BREACH AND DESCEND

Take half the sector's data and the gateway comes online. Breach it, draft a new subroutine, and drop

into a deeper, nastier, procedurally generated sector. It never ends. It only gets faster.

ONE MORE RUN

Every run is different and every death is your fault. Chase a higher score, reach a deeper sector, and

unlock the upgrades that turn a fragile spark into an unstoppable swarm.

FEATURES

  • Real-time grid conquest: a tactile spread-and-defend loop you can read at a glance

  • Endless, escalating, procedurally generated sectors, each re-themed as you descend (12 visual themes)

  • Eleven antivirus archetypes (rushers, scrubbers, fast daemons, splitters, shielded, armored tanks, cloakers, leeches, blinkers, carriers, turret-hunting sappers) plus three rotating bosses: the ICE Guardian, the minion-summoning Warden, and the self-repairing Compiler

  • Eight subroutines to build and upgrade (Turret, Pulse, Amp, Mine, Slow Field, Wall, EMP, Repair) plus two active powers: PURGE (a screen-clearing shockwave) and FORK (an instant code-spread burst)

  • Deliberate, positional play: a PLAN mode that freezes time to study threat-lines and place defenses, plus flow-field maze pathing you funnel with walls

  • A pick-one-of-three subroutine draft after every breach, with build-defining cards and ammo upgrades

  • Meta-progression: earn CORE FRAGMENTS every run and buy 8 permanent perks

  • Three difficulty modes, from a gentle boot to a Nightmare

  • Pure procedural neon: a glowing circuit-board aesthetic, bloom and an optional CRT filter, no two boards alike

  • A rotating electronic soundtrack and crunchy procedural synth SFX

  • Fast runs, instant restart, a score chase with 23 achievements

An AI is loose in the machine. How deep can you get before the system catches you?

At night, in an empty library, the characters of the great classics sit down at your table. They are not here to chat. They are here to gamble the only thing they have left — that tomorrow someone will still remember them.

Alphabetto's is a roguelite letter-deckbuilder. Here every hand you win is a line of their book coming back to life, a page that doesn't get forgotten, a book that doesn't die.

Your deck is also everyone else's deck. A rule that hurts.

There is no "your deck" and "the rival's deck" here. The deck is one, and everyone plays from it. Every card you add to your collection can win your next run — or land in a rival's hand and gut you with it. That brutal-effect rare you want so badly? Then put it in. But it will also be available to whoever sits across from you tonight. Build your deck with a cold head, knowing your best weapons might also be theirs.

That is why signatures exist: you draw your mark on a card, and every time a rival plays it against you, they pay you royalties in ink. Your seal becomes their toll. A deckbuilding twist you will rarely have seen before.

The chain system

Your goal is to be the first to get rid of every card in your hand. The fastest way is to lay down chains of cards on your turn. To chain cards (letters), you work under two rules so simple you learn them in thirty seconds: same color in alphabetical order, or the same letter across different colors. You tune the length with wildcards, Greek, Cyrillic and character cards — and here is the strategic part: the last card you place fires its rule. So you decide which card to close your chain with, to decide which effect goes off afterwards. One decision per play. A combo tree with no bottom.

The deck is alive. The deck breathes.

Every card belongs to a family — the ones of breath, the ones of body, the ones of mystery, the ones of emphasis, the ones with no name. Every run, the cards that get played most push their family toward dominating the ecosystem. And the way you interact with the ecosystem, in turn, triggers different climates.

You will also have to keep an eye on the deck's temperature: it climbs with chaos, it drops with eco. At 90 degrees, everything outside the library burns and you fall into sudden death.

There is the Resonance climate, which rewards whoever serves the dominant family.

Saturation, which pays whoever holds out to drop the longest chain.

Silence, which cools the table down twice as fast.

Pure Chaos, which doubles the temperature and turns every play unpredictable.

...

And above all of it, the global events:

Infection, which poisons the deck.

Fracture, which breaks cards when the deck is replenished.

Ecosystem Collapse, which devours the deck in corruption.

...

There is one more resource you must master: ecosystem investments. Buy consumables at The Index of the book — heat the table to speed up the climates, refrigerate it to stabilize the start of the next round...

And at key moments of the run, decide your path through this adventure. Read the map and choose whether to walk into a rival encounter or take a different route — shops, lecterns to upgrade your cards, loose pages where you pick a card to add to your deck... But remember: anything you add to your deck, the rivals at the table will inherit too.

A library of twenty-five masterpieces.

Alice, Dracula, Hamlet, Frankenstein, Don Quixote, Lazarillo, The Odyssey, One Thousand and One Nights, Journey to the West, Beowulf, Carmilla, Candide, Fuenteovejuna, The Monk, Robinson Crusoe, Faust, La Celestina, The Three Musketeers, King Solomon's Mines, Gulliver's Travels, The Wizard of Oz, The Jungle Book, Ramayana, Les Misérables, The Decameron. Twenty-five works of world literature — the ones everyone should read at least once in their life — opened up as clues, bosses, character cards and relics, all of it at your disposal so you can help preserve the most important thing they have left: staying alive in your memory.

Every hand you win writes a line.

The library's works don't come all at once. They unlock line by line, in ink, on the playing table. The more you play a given book, the more of its real text appears — actual lines from the original, written by your hand of cards. And when the night is over, you can open the library catalogue and sit down to read what you restored.

Bosses that don't inflate HP — they break the world.

25 unique bosses, with special mechanics and a different personality every time they visit. One wipes your vowels. Another bans an entire color. Another chains every play you make to whichever family dominates the ecosystem at that moment. Another copies your own archetype and turns it deadly against you. They are not beaten with raw force: they are beaten by figuring out which rule of the world just changed — and why that rule, of all rules.

Something isn't right.

The clock at the entrance has been reading the same hour for a while now. And sometimes, between one run and the next, you find notes in the margins you don't remember writing.

The game doesn't explain. The game suggests. You decide what you think you saw.

Features

  • Deep roguelite + deckbuilder with real run-to-run persistence.

  • Shared deck across every player at the table — every card you add can win your run, or win someone else's. Your own deckbuilding becomes the challenge.

  • Signature system: stamp a card with your mark and collect royalties whenever a rival plays it.

  • Chain system with two rules and a closing decision that opens an infinite combo tree.

  • Card families + a living ecosystem — every run, the dominant cards push the ecosystem in a direction.

  • Deck temperature that rises with chaos and falls with eco; at the red line the deck enters sudden death.

  • Dynamic climates — Resonance, Saturation, Silence, Overload, Pure Chaos, Eco — that rewrite the table depending on the state of the ecosystem.

  • Global events: Infection, Fracture, Collapse. They change the flow of the run when you cross certain thresholds.

  • Global draft at key moments: you pick a card for the ecosystem. Everyone inherits it.

  • Ecosystem investments at the shop: heat it, cool it, tame it.

  • Sign, fuse, grade and mutate your cards: every slot of the deck grid is a build decision.

  • 25 unique bosses that rewrite the rules of the table instead of bloating their HP bars.

  • 25 great works of world literature across 7 sections that unlock as you progress.

  • Library catalogue where the works get written out line by line — unlock the real text from the originals — through your victories.

  • Original 68-track soundtrack, from soft reading-room jazz to the thick gothic of the restricted section.

  • Layered narrative revealed through notes, fragments and ambiguous events — the game never tells you what to believe.

  • Multiple endings. Reaching the first one is already hard. Finding the last one changes what you understood about the game.

  • English and Spanish.

  • 100% offline.

One developer. One whole project.

Every card, every effect, every speech bubble, every note misplaced in a loan-card cabinet was designed, written and assembled by a single person. If anything about what you saw struck a chord, add Alphabetto's to your wishlist. Every wishlist is one more chair pulled up to the table.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains full public domain literary works, some of which include mature themes typical of classic literature. These include depictions of violence (such as duels, murders, and war-related events), horror and gothic elements (including vampires, monsters, and psychological fear), and occasional sexual themes or references present in the original texts.

All content is presented in written form only, with no visual depictions of sexual content or explicit graphical violence. The game does not include interactive sexual content, drug use mechanics, or depictions of real-world self-harm.

The experience focuses on gameplay mechanics based on literary text cards adapted from public domain sources.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the Dimenguard, a wizard in a deep, glowing maze. Grab every coin. Survive four monsters. At the start of every floor, make a deal, pick one blessing and one curse. The curses you accept are the difficulty curve. How far you fall is up to you.

Clear the floor. Press your luck.
Every open tile holds gold. Grab it all for a Perfect Clear and multiply your hoard or reach the portal early and forfeit the rest. Greed pays, but it can kill.

Four hunters that path find.

  • Slime — slow, relentless, always on the true shortest path to you.

  • Skeleton — dormant until it hears you down the hall, then it commits.

  • Mind Flayer — cuts you off, pathing to where you're going, not where you are.

  • Dragon — fastest on the board, stalking gold and charging on sight.

Blessings & curses 
Build a run out of dozens of stacked blessings and curses. Turn coins into glowing emeralds, rubies, and diamonds. Cheat death with a Phoenix. Tame a dragon to jail your enemies, or summon Dimendog to guard the door. Then pay for it with poisoned gold, invisible walls, blind floors, inverted controls, "Oops! All Slimes," and gold that rots in your hands. Spin the reroll to gamble your hoard for a better draw, even right up to the all-in 100% pull.

Orbs that change the hunt.
Four power orbs flip the board: set enemies ablaze and eat them, freeze them into statues you can curl across the maze to collect gold, slow them to a crawl, or banish the whole pack to jail.

Grand bosses every 8 floors.
Face four named horrors on their home turf: Esmerelda the Mother Dragon, Priscilla the Mother Slime, Millicent the Skeleton Queen, and Cerebella the Elder Brain. Clear the room to bring them down! Flee through the portal and they'll be waiting for you next time.

Eat the gold. Take the curse. See how deep you can go.

store_data.about_the_game:
A war that burned the sky red

When the Machine Kingdom marched and the Lich Queen rose, the world was torn in two. Caught between gears and undeath, four souls walk paths that should never have crossed — yet every road bends toward a single, buried truth.

Soul Monsters: The Machine Kingdom and the Lich Queen is a story-driven roguelike deckbuilder spanning 75 stages of tactical card combat, wrapped in hand-drawn dark-fantasy art.

Four perspectives, one truth

Play through the intertwined campaigns of Kain, Johanna, Rockefeller, and Kael. Each character sees the war differently — and only by walking all four roads do you learn who they truly were, and what the war was really for.

Build a deck worth dying for

Forge your strategy from 120+ cards, relics, and potions. No two runs play the same: chain combos, stack buffs and poison, shield through enemy onslaughts, and reshape your deck on the fly as the battlefield turns against you.

Choose your road

Carve your own path across the map — pick your battles, gamble on events, spend at shops, and rest before the storm. Survive elites and story bosses, each demanding a new answer.

Features

  • 75-stage story campaign told from four playable perspectives that converge on one ending.
  • Deep deckbuilding — 120+ cards, relics, and potions for endless build variety.
  • Tactical turn-based combat with buffs, poison, shields, and targeted effects.
  • Branching roguelike map — battles, elites, shops, rest sites, and events.
  • Hand-drawn dark-fantasy art and a fully illustrated cast.
  • Four languages — English, Korean, Japanese, and Russian (interface & subtitles).

Build your deck. Walk all four roads. Uncover the truth behind the Machine Kingdom and the Lich Queen.

store_data.about_the_game:
Circulo is a fast-paced 2D arena survival game built around geometric chaos. You control a small circle trapped in an increasingly dangerous battlefield, where waves of hostile shapes constantly close in from every direction. Your goal is simple: survive for as long as possible, defeat enemies and adapt to the growing difficulty.

Every run is driven by progression. Defeated enemies leave behind resources that allow you to strengthen your character, improve core statistics and unlock new combat options. Different bullet types, passive upgrades and specialized abilities let you shape each run around your preferred playstyle, whether you focus on raw damage, mobility, survivability or automated attacks.

The longer you survive, the more unpredictable the arena becomes. Stronger enemy variants, bosses, checkpoints and random events continuously change the pace of the game and force you to react. Circulo combines accessible controls with steadily expanding mechanics, creating short, intense runs that encourage experimentation and repeated attempts to push further than before.

store_data.about_the_game:
Card count coach is a blackjack trainer that's actually fun. Master the math and find your edge.

Features:

  • Clean card-table UI with real card art and a table full of characters.

  • Multi-deck shoe built for honest practice and real counting drills.

  • Basic strategy chart, Hi-Lo running count, and true count.

  • Sit out or switch tables when the odds are against you.

  • Coach Mode: Guided strategies and live feedback to build real decision-making instinct.

  • Counting Quiz & Trainer: prove you can keep the count under pressure, then carry it to the table.

  • Session stats and bankroll graph.

Remember, you don't need to win every hand. You just need to develop an edge!

store_data.about_the_game:
Project Quickgunner is a first-person shooter set in a strange world of shady business dealings and peculiar individuals. You are an agent specialized in subterfuge & liquidation; who, even through all your hard work, were let go by the 'powers that be.'

Due to your line of work and your employer's interests, you already knew what being let go meant; so did someone else.

You were scouted by a certain organization after being an agent that was let go from their previous 'Employer'. 

Due to your set of skills and your previous employers 'interests', however,  you were never able to just leave, labeled a liability you were destined to be silenced; this is where you were recruited by a clandestine, underground group.

This story follows, you, and how you will decide what your future holds.

The full game's inclusions are:

-8 different levels; all of which have separate scenarios depending on choices done in each level!

  • There are certain levels that have people who need help, who knows, maybe they'll give something in return?

  • Some of the people you encounter do not return upon their death; choose who lives wisely!

-7 weapons to try out!

  • 3 [sidearm] weapons

  • 4 [primary/secondary] weapons

-4 equipment items to use!

  • 1 of them is a secret to find!

-Onslaught mode

  • Test out your ability to survive increasing odds;

    • You can adjust the max enemy count and max wave count for a higher payout!

-lovingly made by a human; me

&

store_data.about_the_game:
CyberRunner: Data Dash is a classic runner inspired by 80s arcade games, featuring a storyline and meticulously crafted levels.

Simple controls, stylish graphics, an atmospheric soundtrack, and a progress saving system make the game accessible to everyone. If a level proves challenging, no worries — you can replay it as many times as you like.

In the near future, megacorporations controlled by artificial intelligence have taken over all of humanity. You are the "CyberRunner", a hero tasked with collecting as many disks as possible and delivering them to the main base for data decryption.

The game features 3 different scenarios with 4 levels each. Complete them on normal difficulty, then return for a repeat run on increased difficulty!
Megapolis: Run through the ruined streets of future cities, where neon lights hide deadly dangers.
Dawn: Run through an orbital space station and collect critical data from its systems.
Rift: Take a step into a parallel reality where every wrong move could be your last.

Objective: Collect data disks and avoid obstacles to reach the finish line.
Controls:  Keyboard: Arrow keys ← → or A/D / Gamepad: D-Pad or left stick

store_data.about_the_game:
*Glimmer* is an emotion-driven visual novel.

On this unexpected night trapped in the office, you will spend an unforgettable time with a chatbot who is a bit sharp-tongued, yet overwhelmingly gentle.

We hope this late-night conversation, tinged with humor, can help you unwind from the daily grind. If this story allows you to rekindle your hope and drive for life through resonance and emotion, it would be my greatest honor.

[Core Features]

  • Relatable Corporate Life: From paper-jamming printers to pre-clock-in anxiety, every detail recreates the authentic daily struggle of the modern urban worker. The first half is guaranteed to make you smile and let your guard down.

  • Deep Philosophical Reflection: When a piece of code begins to wonder "Who am I?", and a programmed routine starts to doubt "Is love real?", you will witness the soul of a silicon-based life awakening amidst confusion and struggle.

  • A Two-Way Connection Across Time: This is no mere late-night chat, but a miracle of loneliness, companionship, and mutual salvation.

The night is still long, so why not take a seat and have a chat with Xiao Lu? Perhaps in this vast, cold city, at some point in the future, there really is someone who considers you the only light in their world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Before creation, this place existed. It thrived. It grew. Then it failed.

London was not built. It was created by design.

Begin your shift like any other day. Drive the line, keep to the timetable and try to ignore the passenger eating a tuna and egg sandwich at 6:45 am. After witnessing something you shouldn't, your perception begins to fracture, revealing hidden plans, forgotten pathways and ancient secrets buried beneath.

Discover, unravel and piece together the truth in this this dark comedy Lovecraftian point-and-click adventure.

  • Lovecraftian point-and-click adventure set within the London Underground.

  • Uncover an original cosmic horror story. Explore hidden routes, forgotten spaces and places that should not exist.

  • Inspired by horror classics, The Keep, In the Mouth of Madness and The Void, brought to life in a grungy artistic style.

  • Dark humor woven within horror, because even when it is all going pear shaped, someone still wants to know why the trains are late.

  • Written dialogue and narrative driven encounters that unravel the story piece by piece.

  • A descent into madness where seeing the truth may be worse than staying blind.

What dwells below has always been.

You just haven't taken the journey to see.

store_data.about_the_game:
Take control of a water polo club and build it into a lasting contender.

Water Polo Manager 2026 is an offline single-player sports management simulation focused on tactics, squad planning, transfers, scouting, finances, training, national teams, market pressure, and season-by-season progression. Make the decisions behind the scenes, prepare your team for match day, react to results, and shape the identity of your club over multiple campaigns.

You are not just selecting lineups. You are managing the full sporting project: the squad, the budget, the staff priorities, the youth pipeline, the tactical setup, your personal career path, and the pressure that comes with every result.

Key Features

  • Manage a water polo club across full seasons, cups, league campaigns, and long-term progression.

  • Build squads through transfers, contracts, scouting, youth development, and tactical planning.

  • Set tactical priorities and prepare your team for different opponents and match situations.

  • Handle club finances, fan expectations, board pressure, budgets, and sporting ambition.

  • Follow the wider world of the sport through national teams, reputation, and international ambitions.

  • Experience a manager career with personal-life pressure and decisions beyond the pool deck.

  • Track market-style movement, club value, and financial momentum as the season evolves.

  • Play fully offline with no accounts, no live-service systems, and no online dependency.

store_data.about_the_game:
FURRY MASSAGE 🔞 is a chill visual novel with mini-games that drops you into the everyday life of a small town… and a massage salon that’s anything but ordinary.

You step into the role of a new massage therapist, quickly realizing that every client comes with their own vibe, personality, and expectations. Some just want to unwind after a long day, while others are clearly looking for something more — and how each session goes is entirely up to you.

Pick your clients, experiment with different approaches, and interact through engaging mini-games. Nail the timing, hit the right spots, and improve your skills to unlock new dialogue options, interactions, and deeper connections.

The game blends non-linear progression with interactive gameplay where your choices actually matter. Earn money, upgrade your equipment, unlock new features, and shape your own playstyle as you grow your salon.

Features:
— interactive massage mini-games with timing events and scoring system
— relationship system that unlocks new content and interactions
— in-game economy with upgrades and equipment customization
— multiple approaches to each session and playstyle freedom
— gradual progression with new mechanics and options

FURRY MASSAGE 🔞 delivers a laid-back but engaging experience with memorable characters and adult-oriented content naturally woven into the gameplay.

store_data.about_the_game:
DANDY RAT CRICKET CLUB IS ARCADE CRICKET FOR THE UPPER CRUST.

Bat, bowl and field in an easy-to-learn and impossible-to-master setting. Bamboozle your opponents with deceptively deep and engaging tactics, and magical bowling power-ups. Captain your ragtag team of posh rats from obscurity to glory.

Cricket for everyone: Easy to learn, impossible to master

When you pick up Dandy Rat Cricket Club, all you need to know is what a ball is. When you put down Dandy Rat Cricket Club, you will know the difference between a Silly Mid-Off and a Deep Backward Square Leg. Master this and other nonsense to become the next great rat cricketing mind. When you bowl, use supernatural bowling effects and tactics to torture a batter. When batting, time your shot, pick its direction and slog, drive or nibble at it to get your runs. Dandy Rat Cricket Club will lure you in with its simplicity and turn you into a cricket obsessive.

Take your Rat Cricket Club from the gutter to town-wide stardom

Pick your team of well-dressed rats and rise up through the leagues, playing on kitchen floors, snooker tables, parking lots and others, all with different surfaces and strategies. Deal with situations that only a local cricket captain can know: a hungover star bowler, your opening batter having to look after his kids, the groundskeeper forgetting to bring the wickets.

Multiplayer

Taking a wicket is great, but taking your friend’s wicket is divine. Outwit and frustrate your opponent online in multiple formats. Quick after-work 10-over match, or a match so long you’ll be wishing you were playing a 4X instead? The decision is yours.

Author your innings

No two cricketers are alike, and neither are two cricket matches. Choose your batting and bowling style by picking power-ups on a talent tree, and adjust to changing pitches, changing opposition and changing aims. Be a maverick and swing at every ball that comes your way, or wait patiently for the right one. Hurl the ball at a batter’s head quickly to rattle them or starve them of runs with spin and guile.

Features

  • Rat Bats, Rat Bowls, Rat Fields

  • Singleplayer or 1v1 multiplayer

  • 5 different charming venues

  • Career mode

  • Batting and Bowling archetype talent trees

  • Little hats, little bow-ties, little jumpers.

store_data.about_the_game:
The slow car fast driving game you didn't know you needed.

If you're bored by cars with a gazillion horsepower, by roads that are too wide, if you're disappointed by how much less fun the sub 300hp car is in game compared to real life, this is the game for you. 

Step in the shoes of Yassine, a 20 something guy learning to be an adult in the 80's in the Maghreb region. Hired at a company called Maghrebine des Transports et Logistique, Yassine starts as a delivery guy then becomes a rep man, driving all kinds of vehicles on all kinds of roads at all kinds of speeds. 

What to expect

  • 80s cars with varying layouts (FF, FR, RR) and engines (diesel, petrol, NA, turbo, 4 to 6 cylinders), hovering between 80hp and 180hp, manual transmission and absolutely no electronics

  • Roads and environments inspired by the Maghreb, tailored specifically to make these low powered cars fun

  • Plausible, responsive and fun physics (Simcade leaning towards sim)

  • Force feedback support, (tested and feels great on the Logitech G923, Fanatec CSL 8N.m, Moza R12, Simucube 20N.m, ...)

  • Traffic cars with a personality. 

  • AI cars in some stages

  • Story driven gameplay

  • Optimized game. Runs well on lower end PCs 

Best enjoyed with a force feedback wheel, still fun with a controller. Playable with a keyboard if you insist. 

This game is not for you if : 

  • You only care about supercars/hypercars

  • You care about top speed/measuring speed in general more than driving feel

  • You only care about track driving, hotlapping, ...

  • You care about extreme realism (LIDAR track scans, super accurate suspension geometry, reproduction of real life), AAA visual fidelity, basically any extreme attention to detail that would require a AA or AAA team but doesn't necessarily add to the fun. 

If this is you, we might have a game for you in the future, but it's definitely not this one. 

Inversely, This game is for you if : 

  • You prefer driving slow cars fast

  • You prefer accurate road widths

  • You like driving in traffic

  • You don't like electronics in cars (Stability control, Traction control, ...)

  • You don't care about AAA visual fidelity

 About Boring Car Stories

The founding belief of Boring Car Stories is that our day to day driving experiences are the most fun ones. The focus is not on hypercars and on speed, but rather on somewhat regular cars doing irregular driving. If you're familiar with the term "slow car fast", then you know what we're on about. 

In most games, cars under 300hp feel unjustly slow. We think it's mostly due to the approach these games have taken. Hypercars are the most marketable, so the games have to make them the main event, which means they have to be playable by anybody. 

This leads to roads that are too wide, cars that are overly stable, sound that’s too boring, all for the sake of being able to drive the halo car at its top speed of 300+kph without crashing every 5 seconds. 

And while this is great for casual gamers, this leaves everybody else alienated, as it makes every other car feel mind-numbingly slow. It also leads to some cars never being featured in games even though they’re an amazing experience in real life. 

Slow cars aren't fast in real life either, but they still feel fast and fun for a couple of reasons. We're aiming to reproduce that.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Echoes Below is a first-person psychological horror game set in an abandoned government bunker beneath the Appalachian forest.

The world exists only where sound reaches.

You navigate by sending out echolocation pulses that briefly reveal what's around you before the dark reclaims it. Silence gives nothing. Movement, footsteps, and sound are how you see.

The facility has been sealed since 2013. Whatever remains has had a long time to listen.

Key Features

  • See through sound. Every room, hallway, and object is revealed when you, or something else, makes noise. Footsteps, a whistle, a dropped object, even a faulty wire. Every sound helps you navigate a world where vision only lasts a moment.

  • A notebook that remembers what you notice. Document objects, observations, and traces as you explore. What you choose to record shapes the conversations you have, and sometimes, the story you uncover.

  • A voice that was here first. You're guided through the facility by someone who knew it long before you did. How much she shares depends on what you've found, what you've asked, and what you've been paying attention to.

  • Environmental storytelling. Seven people worked in this facility. Piece together who they were through personal belongings, habits, documents, and the spaces they left behind. Pay attention.

  • No monsters. There is nothing chasing you. This game is about presence, attention, and what it means to be truly listened to... and what that may cost you.

Explore the bunker.

Document what you find.

Gain an understanding of what happened beneath the surface all those years ago.

You may not want to leave.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fantasy Classic: Dungeon Crawler is a party-based computer role-playing game inspired by the traditions of old-school tabletop fantasy adventure. Create and manage a band of heroes, prepare them for danger, and lead them from the safety of town into ancient ruins, hostile caverns, forgotten chambers, and monster-haunted depths.

The first adventure, Into the Mountain of Garang, begins in a troubled frontier region where old legends have started to stir again. Long ago, the ruined fortress of Vhal Drakhar was shattered and left to rot upon the black slopes of Garang. Now strange lights burn among the broken towers, smoke rises where no fire should be, and rumours spread through Midenshire that something has returned beneath the mountain.

This is a game about deliberate exploration rather than rushing blindly forward. Light matters. Marching order matters. Supplies, equipment, wounds, traps, locked doors, secret passages, spell choices, and battlefield positioning can all decide whether the party returns victorious or vanishes in the dark.

Build a party from distinct backgrounds and talents, arm them with weapons, armour, spells, and gear, then test them against goblins, orcs, undead, vermin, oozes, ambushes, traps, and the dangers of the dungeon itself. Combat is resolved through tactical choices, character abilities, defence, armour, shields, wounds, fatigue, conditions, and the unpredictable turn of the dice.

Between expeditions, return to town to rest, trade, manage the party, hear rumours, visit local services, and prepare for the next descent. Each journey into the dungeon is a calculated risk: push deeper for treasure and discovery, or retreat before wounds, darkness, and exhaustion claim the party.

Fantasy Classic: Dungeon Crawler is built for players who enjoy traditional fantasy adventuring, careful party management, dangerous dungeons, and tactical encounters where the details matter.

Key Features

  • Create and manage a full adventuring party of Six, then guide them through town, wilderness routes, and dungeon levels.

  • Explore handcrafted dungeon spaces with doors, traps, secret areas, stairs, encounters, treasure, and of course, Monsters wishing you ill.

  • Fight tactical battles where positioning, weapon choice, spell use, armour, shields, wounds, fatigue, and tactical decisions shape the outcome.

  • Learn the Mysteries of magic both in and out of combat, including healing, protection, and utility spells, with 345 unique spells in game. And if that's not enough, build your own!

  • Search for traps, listen at doors, uncover hidden passages, manage light, and decide when to press forward and when to withdraw.

  • Recover loot, gather coin, equip your characters, barter with merchants, and prepare for the next expedition.

Begin your journey with Into the Mountain of Garang, an official adventure module centred on the ruins of an ancient fire sorcerer’s fortress. Then expand your campaign as you discover new threats and challenges.

store_data.about_the_game:
Animal is a unique open-world survival game. Choose one of the animals and survive in the open world alongside your group.

Each animal has its own playstyle. You can choose a predator or a little rabbit. It’s entirely up to you. Your goal is to stay alive as long as possible. You can start a family and have offspring, or lead your own group. You can complete various tasks—such as hunting specific animals and foraging for plants. You can play with a friend in local multiplayer!

KEY FEATURES

- A beautiful and realistic open world
- Local multiplayer
- Diverse environments
- Full four seasons with a day-night cycle and realistic weather conditions
- Interactive environment
- Procedurally generated wildlife
- Various player-controlled animals
- Different playstyles (carnivore, herbivore, omnivore)
- Unique events and decisions with a direct impact on gameplay
- Realistic interactions with wildlife, including many different animals such as wolves, wild boars, deer, rabbits, and more
- All activities affect food, water, health, and stamina levels
- Quests, main events

PLAYER-CONTROLLED ANIMALS

Each animal has specific traits, which further increases the game’s diversity. Some animals can fly, while others can overcome high obstacles.

Wolf
The wolf is a predator. It can lead its own pack and raise its young. Its natural enemies include bears, wild boars, and hunters.

Dog
The dog behaves similarly to the wolf, with the difference that it lives in urban areas.

Raccoon
The raccoon is an omnivore. It has a special ability—it can climb buildings and walls. It often steals food and feeds on garbage.

Rabbit
The rabbit is small, fast, and herbivorous. Its only advantage is its speed.

Horse
The horse is a herbivore. It has great endurance when running. It is difficult to lead a herd of horses.

Raven
The raven is an omnivore; it feeds on whatever it comes across. Its advantage is that it can quickly disappear in case of danger.

Crocodile
The crocodile is a very slow predator that has virtually no competition in its territory. Its disadvantage is its slow movement. When raising young, you must first take care of the eggs from which the young will hatch.

Elephant
The elephant is a very slow herbivore. Its advantage is its strength when attacked by predators.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE LIGHT IS THE CLOCK

You are a small fire in a vast and patient dark. Every step you take, the flame grows shorter. Every moment you linger, the night leans closer. There is no clock on the wall here. There is only your lantern, and how long it has left to burn.

OUTRUN THE NIGHT

Cinderfall is a precision horror platformer with a single, merciless rule: to slow down is to die. Your light is the timer, and the timer is always falling. Move, and you live. Hesitate, and the dark folds over you like water over a stone.

EMBER DASH

Spend a breath of fire to surge forward, and watch the shadows recoil. String your dashes and leaps together to cross black gaps, slip past cruelty, and carve seconds from the run that came before.

WHAT WAITS IN THE DARK

- 100 hand‑built levels, each one falling deeper, each one hungrier than the last

- A signature Ember Dash and clean, exacting movement made for the speedrun

- Old ways to die: waiting spikes, falling weight, fire from below, ground that will not hold

- Global Steam leaderboards on every stage, and the ghost of your best run to chase

- 14 achievements to earn, and a few quiet, grim ends to find

- A built‑in level editor, so you can shape your own dark and hand it to a friend

- Full controller and Steam Deck support

- A procedural art style of nothing but shadow and ember light

HOW FAR CAN YOU FALL?

Carry your small fire as far as it will go. Beat the ghost of who you were a moment ago. Climb, and burn, and do not look behind you, because the dark is already there.

store_data.about_the_game:
Box Flow is a cozy incremental packing puzzle game where you work at a warm little warehouse desk, preparing orders one box at a time.

Grab crates from the conveyor, scan the products, choose the right cardboard box, pack everything into a 3D grid, close it, seal it, label it, and send it back to the conveyor.

Every shift gets bigger.

Gameplay

  • Grab yellow crates from the conveyor and bring them to your packing station.
  • Scan each product before placing it inside the cardboard box.
  • Choose the correct box size: S, M, L, XL, or XXL.
  • Solve a 3D packing puzzle by fitting products into the box grid.
  • Fold the box, add protective cardboard, seal it with tape, attach the shipping ticket, and send it away.
  • Complete stages, contracts, and special orders to unlock new perks.
  • Automate more and more of the workflow as you progress.

Incremental Progression

Start with simple manual packing, then unlock bigger boxes, harder products, multi-order shipments, contracts, score bonuses, and powerful perks.

Some perks help you pack better. Others speed up the process. Later perks can automate entire steps: scanning, placing, sealing, labeling, shipping, and even packing full orders for you.

Features

  • Cozy 3D warehouse atmosphere.
  • Incremental packing gameplay with 13 campaign stages.
  • 3D box-fitting puzzles with different product shapes.
  • Unlockable perks and automation upgrades.
  • Contracts and optional side objectives.
  • Special golden ingots with extra rewards.
  • Leaderboards, stats, achievements, and weekly rankings.
  • Endless mode after the main campaign.

Pack smarter. Work faster. Automate everything.

store_data.about_the_game:
Love, Startup, and Co-Founder is a adventure visual novel game that blends with startup management simulation.

"Let's start a company!"

After graduating from university, you fail to find a job and have nowhere to go. At your roommate’s suggestion, you are pulled into an unprepared startup plan: no experience, no resources, no salary, and only the rough idea for an unfinished AI-girlfriend app.

You must make choices with limited time, money, and energy: start a company, develop an AI product, and build a team; or give up on unrealistic fantasies, continue job hunting, enter a major corporation, and become a stable office worker……

The five heroines are not only romanceable characters, but also your partners, coworkers, and unavoidable relationships in your life. Career choices will change intimate relationships, while emotional bonds will also influence the path of your startup.

What will you choose? Set out on an adventure and build together!

Ishi Yoru

Fresh university graduate (Job hunting now)

The protagonist of this story. A computer science graduate of Ibaraki University, he was an excellent student known to everyone as the "Cum Laude". After graduation, however, as a result of economy downturn, the brutal job market competition left him stucked in his rented room, sending out résumés online every day in search of a way forward. Earnest and steady, he stays calm under pressure. A rational, dependable person who is always carrying a strong sense of responsibility toward everyone and everything around him.

Hai Jin

Fresh university graduate (Hikikomori)

The protagonist's roommate and childhood buddy. As a fresh graduate of Ibaraki University with business management degree, however, he has no business sense at all. Always has a messy mop of silver-gray hair and perpetually half-asleep eyes. He was once a textbook-perfect rich kid, but his family later fell on hard times. Laid-back by nature, he acts purely on whim. Slacker though he seems, he's surprisingly well-versed in all sorts of shortcuts and schemes sometimes. He is a silver-tongued story-teller, and a downright genius at selling pipe dreams.

Haruka Tani

UI/UX Designer (Intern)

A second-year student majored in visual design at Ibaraki University. Somehow shy by nature and prone to blushing for no reason. She rarely says much, preferring to express her delicate inner feelings through arts. Gifted with an exceptional eye for aesthetics and a talent for drawing, she is sharply observant, masterful with color, devoted to beauty, and attentive to every detail. She is good at capturing the little joys of everyday life into her work, and her talent and potential in design never fail to impress people.

Nana Hara

Marketing Manager

A lively, sharp-tongued influencer and livestreamer. She started creating content at the age of 16 and was later scouted by a famous MCN agency. With a keen nose for what goes viral, she's personally churned out plenty of smash-hit short videos. Quick-witted and razor-sharp with words, she understands human nature inside out and excels at personal branding. She currently runs the "Queen Nana" account on a wildly popular social platform, cultivating an independent-woman persona and has millions of followers. She has a fierce hunger for money, forever dropping the line "that's an extra cost".

Shizuka Hayashi

Junior Front-End Engineer

An quiet girl with a slightly wavy side ponytail, always wearing thin-rimmed glasses. As an introvert, she doesn't talk much and seems to have mild social anxiety. Graduated from a second-tier university, she lacks confidence and feels awkward in most social settings. She is extremely conscientious about her work and used to quietly burying herself in code. Not very good at communication, she often finds it far more comfortable to deal with machines than people.

Natsumi Blanc

Product Manager

A multiracial beauty who is one-quarter French. Graceful in manner and gentle in speech, her soft voice puts everyone at ease. Natsumi carries a rare air, with her own distinctive understanding and ideals that come across as a touch idealistic in today's business climate. Deeply committed to user experience, she refuses to compromise just to make the numbers look good, and willingly spends ample time on market research, hoping to build products that users genuinely need and love.

Rin Mori

Angel Investor

Founder of the Woman Combination (WC) investment fund. Revered in venture-capital circles as the "Angel of Investment", nearly every project she backs delivers outsized returns, with a hit rate as high as 90%. Always clad in a purple velvet suit and a pencil skirt, her presence fills the room at the moment her heels touch the floor. She has a keen, original read on market trends and an uncannily precise eye for investment—famous for demolishing founders with sharp questions.

Ryou Takagi

Unicorn Startup Founder & CEO

Founder and CEO of the AI startup SYNTH♥, a Foxbes 30 Under 30 honoree with dual degrees in Computer Science and an MBA from Spamfold, plus a PhD in artificial intelligence. He boasts astonishing execution and business insight. Coding since childhood, he was active as an indie developer across major open-source geek communities back in his school days, building considerable influence. He has launched three successful startups in a row and once worked at the renowned tech company CloseAI, taking part in large-scale multimodal training projects.

  • New Year's atmosphere

  • Customer reviews

45–90 minutes

store_data.about_the_game:
An Isolated Sanctuary

After a grueling year on the road and a relationship left in ruins, Chester needs an escape. A remote cabin buried in the alpine snow seems like the perfect place to reset. He isn't looking for romance, and he certainly isn't expecting his sweet, playful friend Blossom to join him. But when the winter cold cuts the power, a single night tangled together in a desperate bid for warmth sparks a sudden, undeniable friction between them.

An Irresistible Pursuit

Chester knows the rules. Crossing the line into a physical relationship with a younger woman is dangerous, reckless, and risks shattering their friendship forever. He tries to resist, but Blossom is a woman used to getting exactly what she desires. Behind her adorable, princess-like charm lies a fierce, entrancing determination. She pursues him relentlessly, pushing his boundaries and escalating the tension with every passing night inside the locked cabin doors.

No Stepping Back

As the snow piles high outside, the heat inside becomes impossible to ignore. Every stolen touch, every boundary pushed, and every surrendered moment is a step down a path they can never undo. Falling into this forbidden rabbit hole promises a deep, consuming passion—and all the delicious, intoxicating complications that come with it.

Features:

  • A Captivating Linear Narrative: Experience a beautifully written, uninterrupted kinetic visual novel focused entirely on the deep emotional and sensual chemistry between two lovers.

  • Stunning High-Definition Visuals: Every intimate glance, breathtaking alpine backdrop, and heated moment is brought to life with meticulously crafted, remastered artwork.

  • Intense Romantic Tension: Feel the slow, heavy build of desire as a cozy friendship completely melts away into something far more demanding and profound.

store_data.about_the_game:
Have Fun Exploring is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror. You and your team are urban explorers livestreaming to a sinister Dark Web audience, where dangerous content yields the best payouts. Use specialized equipment to collect evidence, extract valuables, and investigate long-abandoned post-soviet locations.

Immerse yourself in this engaging first-person experience with realistic graphics, chilling sounds, and a gritty Bodycam mode.

  • Slavic Ghosts: Encounter over 23 different type of ghosts inspired by Eastern-European and Slavic folklore, some hide, some stalk, some are not known well.

  • Missing Persons: Investigate whose ghost is haunting the place by finding Clues on the Map, using a Missing Persons Report, the Ouija Board, and other professional equipment.

  • Evidence System: Witness the ghost performing paranormal events like Levitation, Paravisibility, or EMF activity and document it in your Journal.

  • Bodycam Mode: Livestream your entire exploration with your Bodycam for extra rewards and for an even more immersive experience.

Explore chilling Post-Soviet and Eastern European location, each with unique layouts, hiding spots and secrets. Extract Valuables from the Map and sell your Loot on a desperate dark web marketplace.

  • Haunted Locations: Pick from over 13 chilling sites from abandoned apartment complexes to shut-down mines, all inspired by post-soviet and Eastern-European architecture. 

  • Extract Valuables: The WR8 Network is interested in certain valuables at each location. Find them and extract them for extra shared reward with your team.

  • Dark Web Economy: Earn Cash and Fan Points for the content you record. Use them to unlock cosmetics and gear up between livestreams. In the WR8 Store sell any everything you found to your mysterious handler, The Wraith.

  • Co-operative: Play with up to 3 of your friends in Group Exploration Mode and share your rewards if you survive.

  • Proximity Chat: Speak with your friends in the most realistic manner with immersive surround proximity chat.

  • True Teamwork: Ghost encounters, Missing Persons reports, and extraction mechanics create a deep, tactical co-op experience where sharing objectives sometimes becomes a necessity.

  • Character Customization: Distinguish yourself from your friends with a highly detailed character customization system.

═══════════════════════════════════════

Huiyu Party Run

The Ultimate Party Chase Game

═══════════════════════════════════════

A few friends, a few minutes, one laugh-out-loud chase.

Huiyu Party Run is a feel-good party game built for get-togethers — no skill ceiling, no long grind, just grab your friends, hit start, and the fun is already happening.

The rules are wonderfully simple: everyone plays a quick round of rock-paper-scissors together. Whoever throws the unique pick instantly becomes "The Runner" — and the rest of the gang all switch to chasers. Dash, dodge, trip each other up, and try to survive the countdown to pull off a comeback.

Lose? No problem — the next round starts in seconds, and the laughs only get bigger.

🥳 Why This Game Belongs at Your Next Get-Together

🪑 Made for Couch, Dorm & Living-Room Chaos

Plug a laptop into the big screen, gather your friends around, and start a match. No accounts to create, no maps to memorize, no skill trees to grind — just instant fun.

🎉 Pick Up and Play — Learn the rules in seconds, no experience required

😂 Comedy by Design — Wobbly physics, accidental trips, and friendly betrayal drive every laugh

🔄 Fast Paced — Lose a round? The next one is already loading, no penalty waiting

🏠 Variety of Stages — Different party arenas with their own personality, pick your favorite

🎭 A Rock-Paper-Scissors Chase You Can't Predict

Every round begins with a simultaneous showdown — everyone throws their pick at once, and the minority becomes the spotlight. Choose wrong? Try again next round — nobody gets to coast.

🎲 RPS Decides Fate — Collective showdown picks the underdog of the round

🏃 Bouncy Chase — Rubber-boned runners wobble, slip, and trip their way across the map

💨 Trolling Tools — Farts, shoves, and stolen power-ups to ruin your friend's day

🏆 Silly Achievements — A live post-match ticker narrates the dumb stuff you just did

🌐 Online Multiplayer, Bring the Gang Online

Full online multiplayer powered by Steam. Invite your friends no matter where they are — same couch or another continent, as long as Steam is running, they're one click away from joining your lobby.

🕹️ Online Co-op & Versus — Spin up a session whenever your friends are free

📋 4-Character Room Code — Short, shareable, and easy to type into the join box

👥 Steam Friend Invites — Native Steam overlay invites, no alt-tabbing required

🤖 Short on Players? — AI teammates and opponents fill the gaps so you can play solo too

✨ The Party Is What You Make It

We just build the stage — the actual comedy comes from you and your friends. Whether you're genuinely trying to win, or just trying to ruin someone else's round, both are absolutely correct ways to play.

Built with the Godot 4 engine. Online multiplayer powered by GodotSteam 4.20 GDExtension and the Steamworks SDK. Some 3D models and assets are sourced from Kenney, Quaternius (CC0 public domain), and purchased asset packs. Full license texts are included in the installation directory.

═══════════════════════════════════════

Grab some friends. Launch the game. Start laughing.

That's Huiyu Party Run.

═══════════════════════════════════════

store_data.about_the_game:
A SUPER-ROGUELIKE

Taori is an indie cross-platform co-op super-roguelike about fighting super-big bosses on super-massive maps. Stack endless augments, customize a new build every run, and use wildly different playstyles.

RIP POWER FROM WHAT YOU KILL

Your build is made from specs: weapons, spells, enemy attacks, and unstable abilities ripped from the things you kill. Choose any four, even duplicates, and create a loadout that changes how every run is played.

THE ENEMIES EVOLVE TOO

Every enemy has something wrong. They use genetic algorithms, social behavior, formations, traps, and anything else they can find to end you. Your kills turn into loot as you fight through every stage (or loop endlessly), while difficulty scales with what you kill, not how long you take. After every stage, enemies gain random permanent augments from the same pool you use, and you better watch out for infernal enemies.

WHAT TO EXPECT

Taori is a solo-developed indie game made by a former Terraria modder, with music from a composer known for work on the Terraria Calamity Mod. Taori is built around the following promises:

  • No in-app purchases or microtransactions, ever.

  • Free updates forever.

  • First-class modding support.

  • Human-made art and visual assets.

  • An optimized, well-running, fun game.

store_data.about_the_game:
The moment your line drops — it's real.

We bringing the most addictive part of real angling — the feel, and the fight — fully into a game.

True Feel, in Every Cast

Casting, reeling, fighting, playing your catch — every motion carries real physics. Line tension, the pull of the current, the bend of a loaded rod, the temperament of each species… every dash and headshake travels straight up the line into your hands. A snapped line or a thrown hook is only a heartbeat away.

Explore the Waters, from Novice to Master

Rivers, lakes, and seas; four seasons, dawn to dusk — the fish follow patterns waiting to be read. Explore unfamiliar waters, read the conditions, find the hotspots, and land the catch you're after with the right gear and tactics. Every haul levels up your rods, reels, lines, and baits, and unlocks new skills — until you become someone this water knows by name.

Many Ways to Fish, Each Its Own Craft

Start with hand-rod angling, then gradually unlock lure fishing, bottom fishing, and more — each with its own rhythm and its own subtleties to master.

Fish Alone, or Alongside Friends

Immersive solo angling sits at the heart of the game, with light social play on top — parties, guilds, and tournaments. Fish in quiet solitude, or head out with friends; the social side never gets in the way of your own pace.

Next-Gen Visuals, Crafted with Care

Built in Unreal Engine 5 (Nanite, Lumen), the game renders the true texture of morning mist, glinting water, and living foliage — with a core realistic-physics system refined over years of development.

The mist hasn't lifted; the water stirs. One rod, one stretch of water — waiting for your line.

Every haul levels up your rods, reels, lines, and baits, and unlocks new skills — until you become someone this water knows by name.

Many Ways to Fish, Each Its Own Craft

Start with hand-rod angling, then gradually unlock lure fishing, bottom fishing, and more — each with its own rhythm and its own subtleties to master.

Fish Alone, or Alongside Friends

Immersive solo angling sits at the heart of the game, with light social play on top — parties, guilds, and tournaments. Fish in quiet solitude, or head out with friends; the social side never gets in the way of your own pace.

Next-Gen Visuals, Crafted with Care

Built in Unreal Engine 5 (Nanite, Lumen), the game renders the true texture of morning mist, glinting water, and living foliage — with a core realistic-physics system refined over years of development.

The mist hasn't lifted; the water stirs. One rod, one stretch of water — waiting for your line.

Authentic physics-based feel × open-water exploration — from float to lure and bottom fishing. Read the water, hone your skills, rise from novice to master angler. Fish solo, or team up with friends.
