store_data.about_the_game:
Design circuits. Build worlds. Watch what happens.

Rawbugs is a freeware homage to Robugs (1992) by Brad Heide — an Atari ST classic where tiny robots fight for survival using hand-wired logic, not scripts. You place gates, radars, thrusters, and guns on a grid, connect them together, save your design, drop robots into an arena you sculpted, and press play. Populations rise, starve, shoot, and reproduce. There is no campaign and no score — the game is the experiment.

What you can do

  • Circuit Editor — design robot brains from logic components; in-game help on every part

  • Arena Editor — paint walls and food, place teams, lone wolves, and racial species; tune death modes and optional exhaust damage

  • Live simulation — pause, track a single robot, restart, or edit a circuit while the arena still runs

  • Stock library — dozens of classic 1992 robots and playfields plus new Rawbugs examples (Bio3, Truce, Exhaust, Gangsta, and more)

  • Custom saves — your own .RB and .PF files; sync across PC and Steam Deck via Steam Cloud

Linux and Steam Deck

Rawbugs is built for Linux and SteamOS (native, no Proton). Keyboard and mouse (or trackpad on the Steam Deck). Fullscreen from the in-game menu or launch options. Player manual inside the game (Credits → Player Manual) if needed.

Credits

In gratitude to Robugs (1992) — Brad Heide.

Rawbugs is an independent recreation by Shimpinomori; not affiliated with the original author.

Free to install. Have fun designing worlds.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build together. Fall together. Unless...

Counterweight is a social deduction game where the deception is physical. Your team has one job: stack blocks and raise a tower to the target height. But one of you is the Saboteur, placing blocks just badly enough, nudging at the worst moment, and eliminating other players.

Every fallen block brings the whole team closer to losing. Every fallen block is also a clue.

How it works

  • Take your turn. Grab a block from the quarry, carry it up, and place it wherever you dare: clean and boring, or bold and risky.

  • Watch everyone. Who re-rolls their blocks? Who's always nearby when something falls ? Who's been holding that tribute all game ? And who's making players disappear one by one...?

  • Accuse. Put a suspect to sleep and call a vote. Guess right and the tower is safe. Guess wrong and you've kicked a friend for nothing. The Saboteur thanks you.

An arsenal of beautiful bad ideas

Items spawn across the island all match long: jetpacks, sleep darts, butter, cages, smoke bombs, a gun that shouldn't exist in a building game... and a hidden kit of Saboteur-only tools that the rest of the team can't even see. No two rounds play out the same.

The Tribute Altar

The builders' insurance policy : gather tributes, place them on the altar, and forge the Impostor Detector. One scan, one truth. The Saboteur can stall it by hoarding a tribute... if they're willing to be seen holding it.

Death is not the end

Kicked out or killed? You return as a Phantom, free to float around and watch the chaos you can no longer prevent with other phantoms.

Features

  • Online multiplayer for 3 to 8 players : invite friends straight from Steam or share a join code

  • Hidden saboteur, suspicious friendships

  • Physics-driven tower building where every block placement matters

  • 20+ items, from helpful to hostile to purely comedic

  • Proximity voice chat to scheme quietly, panic loudly

  • Full controller support, including Steam Deck

  • A solo sandbox for practicing your placements (and your sabotage)

store_data.about_the_game:
WALLOP is a fast, replayable 3D bullet-heaven roguelike. You're the Pizza Hero, last delivery on Earth, fighting through endless swarms of food-themed monsters. Your weapons fire on their own — you focus on movement, dodging, and the choices that turn a shaky start into screen-clearing carnage.

AUTO-COMBAT, BIG CHOICES

Position and dodge while your arsenal fires automatically. Every level-up is a fresh pick — stack pizza tosses, orbiting wheels, chain lightning, fireballs, ice cones and more into a build that snowballs out of control.

GEAR UP

A dozen weapons plus armor and tomes to mix and match. Hunt for synergies, evolve your kit, and watch the horde melt.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Six heroes, each with a unique starter weapon and playstyle — the balanced Pizza Hero, icy Frost Baker, tanky Oven Knight, speedy Crust Runner, sharpshooting Anchovy Archer, and elusive Stealth Slice.

ARENAS & BOSSES

Three distinct arenas, each with its own look and three escalating boss tiers — from the Sauce Slinger to the final Warlord. Clear an arena to unlock the next.

CHALLENGES

12 handcrafted challenge runs with twists — glass-cannon runs, speed kills, no-damage survival, and character-specific gauntlets.

PERMANENT PROGRESSION

Earn Slices and unlock characters, weapons, and permanent boosts. Every run makes the next one stronger.

PREMIUM ON STEAM

No ads. No microtransactions. No pay-to-win. Buy it once, unlock everything by playing — that's the deal.

Smash. Survive. Snowball.

store_data.about_the_game:
Time is coming apart. You wake in a clock tower with no memory of who you are or how you got here — only a pocket watch, still warm in your hand, an empty room, and a letter in your master's careful script: time is fracturing, and you are the one who must gather the broken moments back, one piece at a time. So you step out into a world that has stopped making sense.

Freeze Line is a hand-crafted action-puzzle built around a single, deadly-simple power: freeze the moment, line up your move, and dash through everything that wants you dead. No fluff, no filler — just you, a held breath, and the one clean line that carries you to the other side.

Freeze & Dash

Halt time. Drag to aim. Release, and slip through the gap no one else can see — between the swing of a clockwork blade, past the reach of a living vine, across the hush beneath the ice. Every screen is a small, sharp puzzle you solve at the speed of a heartbeat. Easy to pick up. Ruthless to truly master.

Echoes of Broken Time

The longer time stays broken, the stranger your hold on it becomes. One by one, you learn to bend the frozen moment into new shapes:
  • Leave a ghost of yourself behind and walk two paths at once.
  • Split off a shadow that takes the killing blow meant for you.
  • Freeze a lethal thing solid and simply stroll across it.
  • Tear a rift open beneath an enemy and cast them out of the moment entirely.
  • And, when the end demands it, bring the pocket watch's final judgment down on something that should never have moved.

Gather the Shards

Leave the tower and cross a world coming undone. A rainforest shrine slowly swallowed by living vines. A fortress sealed in black ice, where the cold still keeps voices that should have gone quiet long ago. Buried ruins under the desert, where the sand whispers your own name back to you. Every place hides a shard of broken time. Every room is placed by hand — no procedural filler, no wasted steps. And every road ends with something that guards its shard to the last. Some of those things were people, once.

The Truth at the Tower

Carry the shards back to the one who set you on this road. What waits for you there rewrites everything that came before — the task you were given, the shards you bled for, even who you thought you were. And the last turn of the story is not fixed: what you choose, and what you chose long before you understood it, decides how time finally comes to rest.

A Story Told Twice

Nothing here is only what it looks like. A line of dialogue, a locked door, a face behind the ice — the details you walk past on the way out mean something else entirely on the way home. It's a game built to be finished, and then seen again with clearer eyes.

Made With Respect

  • Every room placed by hand, every secret earned — no filler, no dark patterns.
  • Full keyboard & mouse or controller support (Xbox / DualSense).

Sideline to Sideline Football is a football dynasty management simulation built for fans who want the full GM experience — not just the highlights.

You control everything. Scout and draft prospects with real depth — spend scout points to reveal hidden attributes one by one, study combine measurables, tag targets on your board, and find the hidden gems buried in the late rounds. Navigate a full offseason: re-sign your own free agents, compete in open free agency, manage your salary cap, make trades with CPU GMs who have their own personalities and agendas, and cut your roster down through a realistic preseason training camp. Then call every play yourself when the season starts, or simulate and manage from the sideline.

DYNASTY DEPTH 

Full 32-team league with unique franchise histories, rivalries, and pre-generated legends • 12-season pre-built league history gives your dynasty a living, breathing context from Day 1 • Owner goals, patience meter, and GM contract pressure — your seat is never safe • Franchise Legacy system tracks your dynasty's all-time achievements and tier progression • Season Challenges add optional hardcore modifiers: cap cuts, teardowns, Iron GM mode

FULL OFFSEASON WORKFLOW 

Re-sign your own free agents before they hit the market — negotiate multi-year deals under a real salary cap with dead money, signing bonuses, and guaranteed amounts • Open free agency lets you bid on CPU players competing with other teams • Trade with 32 CPU GMs who counter-offer based on their own personality, team needs, and draft pick valuations • NFL Scouting Combine view before draft day — all measurables public, grades still hidden • Spend scout points to reveal hidden attributes — bust risks and hidden gems lurk in every class • Tag prospects directly from the Combine screen: Target, Monitor, or Avoid • Draft class strength panel and Positions of Need analysis guide your board strategy • 280 prospects per class with college profiles, recruit star ratings, and prospect stories

Built for the dynasty sim fan who wants depth, strategy, and a franchise that feels like it actually exists.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hockey, if the players were wobbling balls of goo.

Blobkey is a fast, physics-y arena brawl-sport: aim, dash, and slam the puck home while your blob slings goo everywhere. Time a check just right and watch a rival burst in a shower of slime. Easy to pick up, chaotic in a full 3v3 lobby, and built for couch yelling and online grudge matches alike.

Dash, check, splatter

  • Momentum combat: charge your dash and crush opponents with a well-aimed body-check. The bigger blob wins the collision; the small ones pop.

  • Stick pokes: flick the puck loose and harass the carrier.

  • Hold:  Hold the puck to stop the puck movement shortly.

  • No ties: deadlocked games go to sudden-death overtime where the next goal wins.

Seven neon arenas

  • Neon Arena: the classic glowing rink.

  • Beach: sunset on the sand, palms, and a side game of blob volleyball.

  • Snowy Pond: aurora skies, pines, and a snow cannon that erupts on every goal.

  • Soccer Pitch: wide open and fast.

  • Cosmic Dome: a floating platform among planets and green nebula clouds.

  • Cyber City: a futuristic vibrant city.

  • Neon Desert : a sunset desert with glowing cacti.

Play your way

  • Solo vs tunable CPU opponents and teammates.

  • Couch chaos: up to 6 players (3v3) on one screen.

  • Online: invite friends with a code or Steam invite. CPUs fill any empty slots.

  • Cross-platform: Windows, macOS, and Linux players all play together.

  • Mix it up: bring couch friends online with you in the same match.

  • Coming Soon: Unranked matchmaking + Ranked Matchmaking

Make it yours

Deck out your blob with accessories, goo trails, and over-the-top goal explosions, pick your team colors, and let it all sync across your machines with Steam Cloud. All set to a pumping synthwave soundtrack.

Grab a friend (or five). Drop the puck. Get gooey.

store_data.about_the_game:
How Strong Is Your Football Knowledge Really?

Two Clubs One Player is a fast-paced and competitive football trivia game based on real football careers.

Two clubs appear on the screen in each round. Your mission seems simple, but it is harder than you think: Find the football player who plays for both clubs before your opponent.

Thousands of football players from the world's biggest leagues and clubs are waiting for you. Trust your memory, improve your speed and leave your opponent behind in every question.

Either compete against your friends online or improve yourself against artificial intelligence in three different difficulties. Every match is different, every question is a new challenge, and every correct answer brings you one step closer to victory.

5 Unique Game Modes

  • Classic Mode
    Two clubs are shown. The first person to find the football player wearing the jersey in both games gets the point.

  • Mystery Mode
    Clubs are opened one by one. Guess the hidden football player with the fewest clues and give the correct answer before your opponent.

  • Team Competition
    A football player is selected. Try to write down all the clubs he played for throughout his career.

  • Mixed Letters
    The football player's name is shown in mixed letters. Solve the correct name before time runs out.

  • Football Tic-Tac-Toe
    Find the right football players on a 3×3 board of clubs to capture the cells and complete the series of three.

Highlights

  •  5 competitive modes offering completely different gameplay

  •  Online multiplayer matches with your friends

  •  Easy, Medium and Hard AI rivals

  •  Super League, Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1 and many more leagues

Every match is a new football story, every question is a new challenge.

Invite your friends, test your football memory and prove who is the best football trivia master.

What if you could go back 10 years — could you get rich in the stock market?

The year is 2015. All you're given is some seed money and a newspaper. Over the next 10 years, you get exactly one investment decision per year. If you knew back then what the headlines were saying — could you rise to become the Ant King?

Ant King is a 10-year investing challenge rebuilt from real stock movements and the actual news of each era. Read the paper every year, pick the stocks that will rise, buy and sell, and see your final rank after a decade. The rules are simple — but the market will test you.

Key Features

  • 10 years, one choice — A simple, addictive loop: grow your assets with just one investment per year on your way to becoming the Ant King

  • Real data, real news — Stocks and headlines built from actual price trends and the events of each year (split-adjusted)

  • 3 markets to conquer — 🇰🇷 Korea · 🇺🇸 USA · 🇯🇵 Japan, each with its own flow and market leaders

  • What's your rank? — Ant grades and achievements based on your 10-year performance, plus the reveal of each stock's true identity

  • Endless Mode — A challenge that continues beyond the 10 years

  • Korean / English support — one run takes just a few minutes

You may know the past — but the future is still your call.

The year is 2015. All you're given is some seed money and a newspaper. Over the next 10 years, you get exactly one investment decision per year. If you knew back then what the headlines were saying — could you rise to become the Ant King?

Ant King is a 10-year investing challenge rebuilt from real stock movements and the actual news of each era. Read the paper every year, pick the stocks that will rise, buy and sell, and see your final rank after a decade. The rules are simple — but the market will test you.

Key Features

  • 10 years, one choice — A simple, addictive loop: grow your assets with just one investment per year on your way to becoming the Ant King

  • Real data, real news — Stocks and headlines built from actual price trends and the events of each year (split-adjusted)

  • 3 markets to conquer — 🇰🇷 Korea · 🇺🇸 USA · 🇯🇵 Japan, each with its own flow and market leaders

  • What's your rank? — Ant grades and achievements based on your 10-year performance, plus the reveal of each stock's true identity

  • Endless Mode — A challenge that continues beyond the 10 years

  • Korean / English support — one run takes just a few minutes

You may know the past — but the future is still your call.

COVID, the AI boom, meme-stock mania — real events swing your returns. 5-minute runs, multiple endings. Korea & US markets, in KO/EN.

store_data.about_the_game:
It's 42°C. You have no air conditioning, because you live in Europe. You have a remote job, a useless fan on the way from GreedCo, and 14 days to survive in a Paris apartment that has become an oven. Good luck.

Europe Heatwave Simulator is a survival game about the one thing Europe was never built for: heat. No AC. No mercy. Just you, a laptop, a landlord who won't reply, and 14 days standing between you and the end of the heatwave.

Manage your body and your dignity at the same time. Drink, eat, sleep, use the bathroom, all while joining work calls you cannot afford to miss, in an apartment that is now legally a sauna. Open the windows during the day and you cook. Leave them open at night without a mosquito net and you wake up covered in regret.

Survival means logistics. Order a fan off GreedCo and pray it arrives before you do something stupid. Out of stock? There's always FleaBay, where scalpers will gladly sell you a €9 fan for €240. Either way, check your doorstep fast, because the only thing hotter than the air outside is your neighbor's interest in your packages.

This is not a game about heroism. It's a game about being a europoor with a thermostat that doesn't exist, trying to make it to day 14 without losing your job, your sanity, or your last bottle of lukewarm water.

FEATURES

  • 14 days of escalating misery. The heat climbs, the events get dumber, and survival gets pettier

  • Keep your remote job alive while quietly dying at your desk during yet another mandatory call

  • Shop your way to survival on GreedCo and FleaBay, if your order survives the doorstep

  • The window dilemma: bake by day, get devoured by night. Choose your suffering

  • Mosquitoes don't care about your plans. No net, no sleep, real consequences

  • Authentic PSX-era visuals, every polygon sweating just like you

  • Distinctly European problems: no AC, no help, no escape, just vibes and dehydration

No air conditioning. No backup plan. No leaving until day 14.
Welcome to summer in Europe.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bitten by a zombie, but I want to live! Survive by any means necessary!

This story begins when a fully prepared survivalist gets bitten by a zombie.

Scavenge and secure various supplies to perform first aid and extend your survival time.

Combine ingredients to create stronger medicine or craft essential survival tools.

First and foremost, staying alive is your top priority.

However, you can't drop your guard just because you bought yourself a little time.

Zombies are still roaming outside right now, and you can be sure that some of them have already caught the scent of your blood.

A 7-day journey alternating between day and night.

During the day, scavenge the inside and outside of the apartment for supplies, craft various items, and extend your survival time.

At night, you must fend off the endless hordes of zombies swarming your shelter.

Keep this in mind: the only thing that matters is that you survive, no matter what.

A narrative shaped by your choices and actions.

The flow of the story shifts depending on what you choose and the outcomes you achieve.

The items you craft, the high scores you set in computer games, and whether or not you uncover countless hidden elements—it all matters.

Every action consumes 'time'. And time is never infinite. Make your choices, and accept the consequences.

Uncover the secrets of the world and face the truth.

Why did he become a lone survivalist?

Why is he staying in this place?

...Why on earth is he fighting so hard to stay alive?

Uncover the secrets of this small world and step closer to the truth.

Your journey awaits.

"...through each crystal-like shard

I see countless unfamiliar faces

...Who am I?"

The cosmos is vast, and the stars are silent. Within this emptiness woven by the laws of physics, what secrets remain unheard? When beings from different dimensions cross paths, what new destinies will unfold?

Septenary is an action game that blends retro vaporwave aesthetics with a mysterious cosmic narrative. You are a “Celestial Scholar” recruited by the Royal Observatory Foundation. Wielding a specially crafted Decree Ruler, you must venture into The Dipper Realm, sever the Baleful Stars that have possessed the celestial lords, and perform celestial exorcism—restoring fortune and peace to Earth.

  • Satisfying Slash Action – Slice through waves of Baleful Stars and feel the pure thrill of destruction.

  • Global Leaderboards – Compete for high scores and challenge players around the world.

  • Vaporwave Atmosphere – Immerse yourself in a retro-futuristic visual and audio style that feels both dreamy and profound.

  • Diverse Challenges – Test your judgment, perception, and reflexes across meticulously crafted levels.

  • Unforgettable Encounters – Meet unique characters, shoulder the mission to protect Earth, and ponder the meaning of “loneliness” and “self” along the way.

Deep in the starry sea, your answer awaits.

store_data.about_the_game:
General Description:

An anthology of action and slice-of-life short stories following a group of Alchemists, navigating brutal fights and the messy reality of living alongside each other.

Story Synopses:

  • The Wolf and the Sheep - The group are participating in the Philosopher's Exam, with the goal of winning the tournament to have a meeting with the Philosopher to get closer to a Philosopher's Stone. They have a plan of how to easily win, but their individual goals may cause that plan to go horribly wrong...

  • Girls' Night - On the 4th of July, and growing tired of dealing with the boys and growing bored of the current city they're residing in, Ignis approaches Gyne and asks to have a "Girls' Night out". They go out into the city to have some fun before the fireworks begin, but a strange, dangerous group interrupts them...

  • Boys' Night - While Ignis goes off to visit her family, Gyne gets kidnapped by a group of bounty hunting Alchemists. Tyrell and Dane go on a short journey to find Gyne and free her from the bounty hunters, but it's questionable how Gyne was even kidnapped in the first place or whether if she even needs their help...

  • I'm so 🜖🜄🜆🜳🜀 - After a very heated argument between Ignis, Dane, and Tyrell, Ignis storms off to challenge one of the leaders of the Sun alone, against the better advice of the boys.

Key Features:

  • 4 standalone short stories set within a larger world.

  • Multiple branching paths and endings.

  • Slice-of-Life character moments along side intense action scenes.

  • Unique and Original magic system woven into the narrative.

  • Original anime-styled artwork by Valesti (@nibhelung) and Wott (@Csr_ap07).

  • The option to switch Visual Novel reading style between Adventure (modern) and Novel (classic) mode.

store_data.about_the_game:
Day by Day: Tokyo Student Diary is a pixel-art survival life simulation game about the everyday life of an international student in Japan.

After arriving in Tokyo, you'll start from scratch and face the realities of studying abroad. Find a place to live, keep yourself fed, learn Japanese, earn money through part-time jobs, manage your time, and take care of both your physical and mental well-being as you work toward your goals.

Every day offers only a limited amount of time. Will you spend it studying in the library to prepare for exams, or work at a convenience store, café, or Chinese restaurant to pay your bills? You can also cook, work out, visit hot springs, meet new people, and create your own story in the streets of Tokyo.

The game combines time management with survival mechanics. Hunger, sleep, mood, study progress, hygiene, and money all interact with one another, meaning every decision has lasting consequences. Studying hard may unlock better job opportunities, while staying up too late, living under constant stress, or running out of money can make life increasingly difficult.

As you progress, you'll unlock new locations, jobs, events, and relationships. Random events, unique character traits, and meaningful choices ensure that every playthrough offers a different journey and multiple possible endings.

Features

🎓 Experience the authentic daily life of an international student in Japan.

🏙️ Explore Tokyo freely, visiting schools, libraries, convenience stores, cafés, Chinese restaurants, gyms, city offices, and more.

💼 Take on part-time jobs to earn money and pay your rent and living expenses.

📚 Study Japanese, improve your skills, and build a brighter future.

🍱 Cook, shop, do laundry, rest, and manage every aspect of student life.

📊 Balance hunger, sleep, mood, study, hygiene, money, and other survival stats.

🎲 Enjoy random events, unique character traits, multiple progression paths, and high replayability.

🌸 Immerse yourself in charming pixel-art visuals and a warm, relaxing soundtrack that captures the atmosphere of Tokyo.

In a city full of opportunities, no one will decide your future for you.

Will you stay focused on your dreams and work hard?

Will you get distracted by entertainment and miss your exams?

Or will you discover your own way of living in Tokyo, one choice at a time?

Your study abroad journey begins today.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Shadow City

Citadels: Shadow City is a strategic turn-based card game of city-building, hidden roles, and deception. Set in a dark fantasy medieval world, players compete to become the Master Builder by constructing the most impressive and wealthy city before their rivals.

Trust No One

Each round, players secretly draft a character role-such as the cunning Spy, the wealthy Guildmaster, the ruthless Inquisitor, or the unpredictable Alchemist. Your chosen role grants you a powerful special ability to gather extra resources, protect your districts, or completely sabotage your rivals.

But beware-other players are also hiding their true intentions! You must deduce who drafted which role, outwit your opponents, and strike at the perfect moment.

Build Your Empire

Use your hard-earned gold to construct various districts in your city. Balance your economy by building Trade markets, Religious abbeys, Military fortresses, and Science academies. Be the first to build 8 districts to trigger the end of the game, but remember: the ultimate winner is the player whose city has the highest total value and best category synergies!

Key Features

  • Hidden Roles & Bluffing: Draft from a unique roster of custom characters every single round. Adapt your strategy on the fly.

  • Strategic Economy: Balance gathering gold with drawing new district cards to stay ahead of the competition.

Welcome to the Shadow City

Citadels: Shadow City is a strategic turn-based card game of city-building, hidden roles, and deception. Set in a dark fantasy medieval world, players compete to become the Master Builder by constructing the most impressive and wealthy city before their rivals.

Trust No One

Each round, players secretly draft a character role-such as the cunning Spy, the wealthy Guildmaster, the ruthless Inquisitor, or the unpredictable Alchemist. Your chosen role grants you a powerful special ability to gather extra resources, protect your districts, or completely sabotage your rivals.

But beware-other players are also hiding their true intentions! You must deduce who drafted which role, outwit your opponents, and strike at the perfect moment.

Build Your Empire

Use your hard-earned gold to construct various districts in your city. Balance your economy by building Trade markets, Religious abbeys, Military fortresses, and Science academies. Be the first to build 8 districts to trigger the end of the game, but remember: the ultimate winner is the player whose city has the highest total value and best category synergies!

Key Features

  • Hidden Roles & Bluffing: Draft from a unique roster of custom characters every single round. Adapt your strategy on the fly.

  • Strategic Economy: Balance gathering gold with drawing new district cards to stay ahead of the competition.

Will you rise to power, or will your empire crumble in the shadows?

store_data.about_the_game:
Merge to evolve. Place to conquer.

Merge Parade is a formation-based auto-battler set on a 5×5 grid. Buy monsters, merge them into stronger evolutions, and arrange them in a winning layout using powerful adjacency passives. Combat plays out automatically — your only job is deciding who stands where. One smart placement can turn the tide.

Core Gameplay Loop

  • Buy monsters from the shop
  • Place them on your 5×5 grid
  • Merge neighboring units to evolve them
  • Watch the auto-battle play out
  • Spend the gold you earn to field an even stronger army next fight
Battles end fast — about a minute at normal speed, just 20 seconds at top speed. Perfect for a quick session, easy to lose hours in.

From a Tiny Slime to a Mighty Dragon

Goblins, slimes, plants, undead, demons, elementals, dragons, constructs, beasts — nine cute monster tribes with dozens of monsters to collect. Follow recipes to merge them and watch small units evolve into towering powerhouses. Chain a few humble slimes all the way up to a colossal dragon lord and feel your army truly grow.

Formation Is Everything

Every unit has passives that depend on where you place it: boost the attack of adjacent allies, shine alone in a corner, weaken nearby enemies, and many more. As the fight unfolds, columns build up stacks of burn, freeze, and shield — push a stack high enough and it erupts in a powerful burst that can flip the whole battle.
Stacking strong units isn't enough. Who stands next to whom, and which column they hold, decides the fight.

One Run, Fifteen Battles

A roguelite run is fifteen battles, with a boss waiting at 5, 10, and 15. Lose a battle and you spend a life to take on that same battle again; run out of lives and the run ends. Clear all fifteen to conquer the run.
Even a defeat teaches you something — new units, new recipes, new matchups. Every run sharpens your strategy. Once you've mastered the basics, six escalating difficulties stand between you and the true ending.

Grow Stronger Between Runs

You earn score every run — win or lose — and spend it on permanent upgrades: more starting gold, extra lives, a bigger bench, and stronger attack and HP. Every session leaves your army a little mightier than the last.

A Small Goblin with Big Dreams

Meet Gobsby, a small-town goblin with grand ambitions, and Nick, a chatty little mimic-book who narrates the journey. With only a handful of monster friends at his side, Gobsby sets out for the distant Demon Lord's castle. Recruit allies, crush rivals, and watch your tiny gang swell into a marching army — a long, eccentric parade across the world.

Features

  • Tactical 5×5 grid formation combat
  • Dozens of monsters and merge recipes to discover
  • Adjacency passives and column bursts that flip the battle
  • Fast auto-battles — just 20 seconds on top speed
  • Roguelite runs across six escalating difficulties
  • Permanent upgrades that carry between runs

Take command. Set your formation. March your army to victory.

FLESHFORGE is a gothic body-horror roguelike where you build a creature from scavenged parts — then watch it fight.

STITCH YOUR HORROR

Attach arms, heads, organs, and hides to a living torso. Each part brings stats, attacks, and elemental damage. Position matters — limbs need connections, organs boost what they touch.

MASTER THE FIVE ELEMENTS

Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Void — stack elemental thresholds to unlock devastating ailments: Bleed, Ignite, Frostbite, Shock, Decay.

Six creature classes (Beast, Undead, Demon, Construct, Elf, Human) unlock powerful combo bonuses at 4- and 6-piece thresholds. Mix or specialize — your call.

SURVIVE THE GAUNTLET

Fight through three acts of escalating enemies. Shop for parts at the Butcher. Upgrade at The Slab. Face brutal Elites and massive Bosses. Die, learn, rebuild.

BETWEEN RUNS

Salvage parts from fallen horrors. Dispatch retired creatures to harvest resources. Unlock new parts and push harder omens for greater rewards.

KEY FEATURES

  • Deep body-building: 100+ unique parts across 6 classes and 5 elements
  • Deterministic combat simulation — plan your build, watch it execute
  • Synergy system with class thresholds, element thresholds, and verb combos
  • Roguelike progression with meta-upgrades between runs
  • Omen system — choose your difficulty multiplier for risk/reward
  • Daily Challenges with seeded runs
  • Endless Mode after victory

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Introduction: Legend of Southern Tomb Raiders

Core Game Concept

Legend of Southern Tomb Raiders is a vertical-screen casual stage-clearing game that combines tomb-raiding adventure and tower-defense shooting. Centered on the theme of southern tomb raiding, it integrates gameplay of fending off tomb guardian hordes, collecting antique treasures, and character progression. Easy to pick up, it delivers highly satisfying stage-clearing thrills.

Game Background

Countless rare treasures lie hidden in ancient underground tombs. All kinds of tomb corpses and guardian monsters surge endlessly, coveting the secrets and valuables buried deep within. As a heir to the southern tomb-raiding lineage, you must defend the tomb entrance and repel wave after wave of monsters. While holding your ground, gather antique resources, unlock powerful weapons and secret arts, venture into deadlier tomb levels step by step, and unearth lost millennium-old tomb-raiding relics.

Core Gameplay

1. Tower-Defense Shooting Stages (Core Combat)

Adopt a vertical-screen one-handed shooting control scheme. Each stage features a defense countdown, with monsters charging from multiple paths at the top of the screen. Behind a wooden fence defense line, you can fire guns manually or automatically to eliminate foes.

Swarm after swarm of monsters storm your position, and huge damage numbers pop up when enemies are defeated. With a ×2 damage boost, mowing down hordes delivers an incredibly satisfying experience. There is a diverse roster of foes, including swarms of minor monsters and elite tomb guardians.

Your defense fence has a total health pool (starting at 3000 HP). Monsters breaking through the fence drain its health, and the stage ends in failure once health hits zero. You must strategically combine firearms and skills to hold the line.

2. Weapon & Combat Skill System

Upgradable Firearms

Equip and upgrade a variety of firearms such as submachine guns, each with limited ammo for sustained combat fire. Clear stages or visit the shop to unlock stronger guns with improved fire rate, damage, and magazine capacity.

Tomb Secret Arts

Unlock exclusive spells via the shortcut bar on the right side of the screen, including flame bursts and spirit blade projectiles. These area-clearing abilities wipe out dense monster swarms in one hit, pairing with gunfire to deal massive group damage.

Stage Reward Mechanism

Three tiers of treasure chests are awarded per stage based on remaining defense fence health:

  • Basic Clear Chest: Unlocked if you survive the stage before the fence health depletes, grants basic gold coins and crafting materials.

  • 50% HP Chest: Awarded when the fence retains over 50% health at stage completion, contains rare progression materials as bonus loot.

  • Perfect Full HP Chest: Earned by defending the fence without taking any damage throughout the stage, yields top-tier antiques, gun fragments, and abundant diamonds.

Abundant Welfare System

The game offers numerous free rewards, letting players enjoy full content without spending real money:

  • New Player Gift Pack: Claim a powerful starter firearm, large amounts of diamonds and gold coins upon first login.

  • Daily Surprise Egg: A free daily draw to win rare gear and progression resources.

  • AFK Online Rewards: Collect supplies simply by staying logged in; resources also accumulate while offline.

  • Weekly Pass, Quests & Leaderboards: Daily quests and weekly passes supply steady resources. Compete against other tomb raiders on the leaderboard for exclusive ranking rewards based on stage progress.

store_data.about_the_game:
Final Table is a single-player No Limit Hold’em game about learning the game, building better habits and putting your poker decisions to the test.

Use Guided Play and Coach Mode to learn how to think through a hand, understand the maths behind your decisions and review your mistakes after each pot.

Train specific skills with lessons and drills, then take what you have learned into Career Mode, where there is no coach at the table and every decision is yours.

No real-money gambling. No microtransactions. Just poker strategy, practice and improvement.

Features

Career - A ladder of Sit & Go events with rising blinds, real payouts and a bankroll to manage.

Guided Play - Let the coach guide you through the thought process for each hand, helping you decide what matters before you act.

Coach Mode - Cash tables at heads-up, short-handed or full ring, with live grading, a hand review after every pot, and reads on your opponents.

Lessons - Short interactive lessons, each paired with a drill.

Drills - Focused puzzles on reading hands, counting outs, estimating equity and pricing calls.

Hand history - Every hand replayable street by street, with the coach's verdicts attached.

Opponents - Face bot archetypes from Rookie to Maniac, each with different tendencies you can learn to spot and exploit.

Options - Four-colour deck, adjustable pace and an optional decision clock.

Weave through dense curtains of bullets while strategically toggling between Light and Dark polarity to switch between stripping clothes and blasting enemies — a core system inspired by the legendary Ikaruga, where every shot demands precise judgment and timing.

Polarity Switch System
In Light mode, your bullets phase through enemies and hit clothing, gradually stripping the outfits off each character. Switch to Dark mode and your fire targets enemies and Bosses instead, with wingman firepower boosted by 1.5x. Mastering the flow between both modes is the key to clearing stages and chasing high scores.

Rich Content
12 distinct selectable characters, each with two stages — from casual wear to a deeper challenge, culminating in a multi-phase Boss fight. Destroying clothing groups drops wingman pickups; bring up to 3 wingmen into battle for coordinated firepower.

Deep Scoring Systems
A combo system (up to 255 hits) delivers massive score multipliers — the higher your combo, the more forgiving the timing window. Hit score milestones to earn extra lives. At stage end, remaining lives and energy convert into bonus points. Three difficulty levels (Easy / Normal / Hard) cater to players of all skill levels.

store_data.about_the_game:
Deli Simulator is a simple market and deli management game where you run your own small shop.

In the game, you order products, carry delivery boxes, stock your shelves, and wait for customers to shop. With the money you earn, you can buy new shelves, upgrade your store, and slowly grow your business.

This game was not made by a large studio. It is a project created by a small team with limited resources but a lot of passion. The game may still feel rough and early in some areas, but the core gameplay loop is already in place: product ordering, shelf stocking, customer flow, sales, shelf placement, and store upgrades.

Our goal is to keep improving the game over time and turn it into a richer, more enjoyable, and more alive simulation experience. We want to add more products, better visuals, sounds, employee systems, more store upgrades, and small details that make the shop feel more complete.

If you enjoy small business management games, or if you simply want to support independent developers, buying this game would truly help us. It may not be a perfect game right now, but every purchase gives us the motivation and opportunity to keep developing it.

Build your own deli shop, fill your shelves, welcome your customers, and become part of a small business growth journey.

store_data.about_the_game:
Become an Underwriter and Decide the Fate of Maritime Insurance Contracts.

Blue Sign is a point-and-click simulation game where you assess the risks of maritime insurance contracts and decide whether to underwrite them.

In the fictional port city of Lissebra, you will work as an underwriter for an insurance company.

An Age When the Sea Opened the Future

The Age of Sail promises wealth, glory, and a radiant future.

Exotic spices, silk, minerals, and rare goods fill the harbors, while new ships arrive and depart from the docks of Lissebra each day.

But the sea does not always bring romance.

At times, waves swallow entire vessels. Familiar routes lead ships onto hidden reefs.

As maritime trade flourishes, more people are forced to face the dangers of the sea. A successful voyage can bring a shipowner great wealth—but a single accident can take everything away.

Eclon Insurance Company offers them a contract to share the losses they may suffer at sea: maritime insurance.

Risks Laid Out Across Your Desk

Applicants will come to your desk with information about their vessels and plans for the voyage ahead.

Examine the documents they submit. Review each case against the underwriting criteria. Make a decision based on the facts before you.

Moments That Demand Your Judgment

Not every decision can be made objectively.

Documents of uncertain authenticity, rumors, and the trustworthiness of those before you—information beyond any written guideline—will test your judgment.

The Consequences of Your Signature Return

Every applicant arrives with a story of their own.

Experience the aftermath of your decisions, and discover what becomes of the people whose contracts passed through your hands.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gods of the Grid is a match-3 roguelike RPG set in the world of Greek mythology. Swap runes to attack, heal, raise shields and channel the powers of the gods, then push deeper into nine dungeons of monsters and bosses. You only get one life per run: fall, and the journey resets, but the legend you build carries on.

MATCH RUNES, COMMAND THE BATTLE

Every swap matters. Skulls strike your foe, hearts heal you, shields grant armor that soaks damage before your health, and coloured runes bank mana for your spells.

Line up four runes to blast a whole row and column, or five to wipe an entire colour, and either one earns you an extra turn. Chain cascades for bigger combos and higher scores. Every enemy also hides an elemental weakness and resistance, discovered as the fight unfolds, so knowing your foe matters as much as your build.

BECOME A DEMIGOD

Begin each run as the child of a god, one of six demigod classes with a distinct playstyle, some available from the start and others earned at the Temple.

Every level-up you choose one of eighteen boons to shape your build, including build-defining ones that change how you play rather than just raise a number, and you claim powerful relics from bosses and merchants. Thirty-four relics span damage, defense, mana, healing and devious skull-synergy effects.

CONQUER THE DUNGEONS

Nine themed dungeons stand between you and Olympus, each ending in a boss who telegraphs a devastating special attack and enrages at half health.

Enemies have distinct traits and elemental resistances, so every fight reads differently. Between battles you take the road: heal at a Shrine, gamble with the Oracle, claim gold at an Altar, or spend it at the Merchant. Choose Normal for a balanced run or Hard for a tougher fight and a score bonus.

RISK IT ALL, EVERY RUN COUNTS

When you fall, the run ends and the dungeons relock, but your feats (56 to earn) are kept forever and you earn Favor to permanently unlock new classes and relics at the Temple.

Climb the global leaderboard, or take on the Daily Challenge: the same seeded boards for every player, with its own daily ranking.

FEATURES

  • Roguelike runs with permadeath and persistent meta-progression

  • Six demigod classes, choose a boon from a pool of 18 (including build-defining ones), and more than 30 relics for varied builds

  • Nine dungeons, telegraphed boss specials, distinct enemy traits, and per-battle elemental weaknesses/resistances to discover

  • Normal and Hard difficulty modes

  • Global leaderboard and a daily seeded challenge

  • 56 feats to earn and a Temple to spend Favor on permanent unlocks

  • Crafted pixel art and a soundtrack that shifts between map, battle and boss

Match. Cast. Conquer. The gods are watching.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lockey

Lockey is a 2D top-down action roguelike where you wield a key to seal enemies that have rejected death and press deeper into the kingdom.

Break Through the Lock Kingdom

Humanity rejected death and transformed into locks that can never be closed. You enter the Lock Kingdom to seal them away.

Travel from the kingdom’s underground depths into the castle, sealing the soldiers and knights who guard the king. Grow stronger through battle and make your way toward the heart of the kingdom.

Seal, Don’t Kill

Enemies have a Seal Power gauge instead of health.

Build Seal Power with basic attacks and Engraving Skills, then seal enemies once their gauges are full. When several enemies become sealable at the same time, use Chain Seal to dash between them and seal them in rapid succession.

Sealing enemies grants experience and fills the shared Engraving Gauge. Once the gauge is full, use one of your equipped Engraving Skills to change the course of battle.

Choose a Different Path Each Run

Choose your next route and target reward from the node map in each chapter. The stages you encounter and the direction of your growth will change depending on the path you take.

Entering a node takes you into a stage where the arrangement of rooms and routes to explore changes each time. Clear combat rooms, find the room containing your chosen reward, and locate the passage to the next stage.

Some stages contain special objectives that offer an additional reward. Complete the objective to receive the reward from your chosen node one more time.

Build Your Run with the Rewards You Find

After reaching an item node’s reward room or sealing a boss, choose one item from a random selection.

Collecting the same item again raises its rarity. Effects gained at previous rarities remain active while new effects are added, so the items you choose to stack will shape the direction of your build.

When you level up, you can strengthen one of your equipped Engraving Skills. Develop the greatsword’s powerful close-range attacks or the staff’s ranged attacks, and shape a fighting style that suits you.

When you fall in battle, your chosen route, items, levels, and Engraving upgrades are reset. On your next run, choose a different path and set of rewards to create a new build.

store_data.about_the_game:
UNLOAD is an interception-focused, top-down shooter where your ammo is your life. Intercept lethal bullet hell from all directions to reload, pushing through extreme, razor-thin crises. Stand against the cybernetic bosses dominating the city and execute your justice.

Your Ammo is Your Health

The remaining rounds in your magazine represent your very life force. Every time you pull the trigger against an enemy, you drain your own health. Deplete all your ammo, and you face imminent death. Will you willingly sacrifice your life to destroy your foes, or hold your fire to survive? In the midst of relentless combat, every second demands a strategic decision. Embrace the risk and unleash explosive firepower—experience the true essence of 'high risk, high return.'

Intercept Barrages to Turn the Tide

The enemy bullet hell pouring in from all sides isn't just a threat. Perfectly intercept incoming enemy attacks! Any barrage you intercept is instantly converted into your life force and offensive power: your ammo. The lower your health gets in extreme situations, the more you must willingly dive straight into the heart of a deadly bullet hell to survive.

Hardcore Boss Rush in a Lawless Mechanical City

A cold dystopia stained with neon lights—this city has already fallen into the hands of massive mechanized syndicates. Forget about tedious battles against small fry. Analyze and destroy the weak points of giant mechanical bosses boasting overwhelming firepower and ruthless screen-filling patterns. It's time to execute your own justice in this corrupted city.

And records that were never erased.

Move between a browser, cult websites, chats, emails, file explorer, photos, notes, and an organization chart program to gather scattered clues.

Organize suspicious individuals by name and role, and find the real connections buried among false information.

Exploration through the monitor connects with everyday life in the real world. Time passes, days go by, and your choices affect the ending.

Restore the records someone tried to erase, and reach the truth behind a case that was meant to disappear.

store_data.about_the_game:
CityExplorer is a simulator that allows you to freely explore photorealistic 3D urban spaces—recreated using PLATEAU, Cesium OSM, and Google 3D Tiles—from a drone's-eye view. Featuring a real-time day/night and weather system reflecting actual weather data and sun positions, AI-guided regional information panels, and POI (Point of Interest) markers for restaurants, tourist spots, and public facilities, this tool can be used for everything from pre-travel research to virtual sightseeing.

CityExplorer - Gameplay & Practical Use Guide

From virtual exploration to practical utility, there are many ways to enjoy CityExplorer.

Chapter 1: Gameplay & Entertainment

1-1. Virtual Travel & Sightseeing

CityExplorer is the ultimate virtual travel tool, allowing you to fly over and explore cities around the world from the comfort of your home.

store_data.about_the_game:
Command any war. Build any battlefield.

About Frontlines is a turn-based strategy game where the battlefield is entirely yours to shape. Every map, every unit, every rule of engagement, you decide. The result is a strategy game with no fixed borders: your imagination sets the scenario, and the system adapts to fight it.

Total creative freedom

Draw the map. Design the unit. Set the doctrine. About Frontlines hands you the tools to build the exact battle you want to fight, down to terrain, unit stats, and the rules that govern them. No battle plan is off-limits.

One system, every era

At launch, About Frontlines ships with a WWII scenario — tanks, infantry, artillery, and battlefields. But the engine underneath doesn't care what century you're fighting in. Once the tools are in your hands, WWI trenches, Napoleonic lines, Roman legions, Vietnam jungles, or wars that haven't been fought yet are all within reach. If you can imagine the battle, you can build it.

Play your way

Face off against AI to sharpen your tactics, challenge a friend directly, or jump into online matchmaking to test your strategy against the world. Two commanders, one battlefield, no distractions.

Clean design, deep strategy

The interface and map style are minimal by design. Underneath that simplicity sits a system built to scale with whatever you throw at it, from a small skirmish to a fully custom scenario built from scratch.



Key features

  • Multiple ways to play: vs. AI, vs. friends, or online matchmaking

  • WWII at launch, with the full scenario-building toolset included

  • Build your own units, maps, and scenarios: any era, any theme, any imagination

  • Clean, minimalist design: a battlefield that's easy to master and adapts to every scenario

  • A game that grows: built to expand through new scenarios over time

store_data.about_the_game:
PSYCHE features a unique second person mechanic, where your play space is mirrored above you, and you can fire at enemies at the mirrored play spaces to deal more damage to the enemies that seek to shatter you.

Dodge enemies, watch your feet and carve an exit in first person, before switching back to second person to handle the unsettling number of enemies still chasing your tail.

Mastering your spatial awareness and target priority, as well as your movement skills is key to completing a run through your PSYCHE.

------------------------------

Backflip, frontlip and bunnyhop around your environment to outpace the surreal manifestations of the dream. Let your Moon charge it's beam to fire at the ground, giving yourself a leap of pace and escape tricky situations, or add a little flair to your latest attempt at a PB.

------------------------------

Compete for high scores, see your run stats and optimise, can you find a strategy that dwarfs all others? Learn to use the Roil mechanic to maximise your score and carve your own strat through the PSYCHE.

------------------------------

Review your gameplay, or others! With the replay system, you can find methods to optimise, or steal strats from your peers, to push your score further. Or just use it as a screensaver. Either/or.

store_data.about_the_game:
Turbo Era Boss is a single-player motorsport management game inspired by the wild turbo era of 1980s Grand Prix racing.

You are not the driver. You are the team boss.

Build your team, manage limited credits, develop the car, choose suppliers, handle sponsors, prepare race weekends and make strategy calls from the pit wall. Every decision matters: power, reliability, tyre wear, fuel, weather, driver form and race timing can turn a promising weekend into glory — or disaster.

Take control across qualifying, race setup and race day. Read the weather, react to changing track conditions, manage tyres and boost, plan pit stops and protect both cars through a full season.

Key features:

• Manage a retro 1980s-inspired racing team

• Create your own team or take control of an existing fictional constructor

• Develop chassis, engine, tyres and factory capacity

• Hire and manage drivers with different strengths, form and potential

• Balance sponsor pressure, prize money and development costs

• Prepare qualifying runs with risk, tyre choice and car setup

• Make race-day calls for tyres, boost, fuel and pit strategy

• React to rain, drying tracks, tyre wear, reliability issues and incidents

• Play a full single-player season with long-term progression

Turbo Era Boss is about pressure, timing and survival in an age of boost, risk and ambition.

The cars are fast. The budgets are tight. The sponsors are watching.

Welcome to the pit wall.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mind Over Dice is a turn-based roguelike where dice are not just randomness — they're your primary resource. Enemies reveal their intentions before you act. You see who they're targeting, what spell they're casting, and where they're about to strike. Your task is to outplay them by distributing the rolled dice among your heroes.

🎲 Dice — Your Main Tool

At the start of each turn, you roll three dice. Rolled ones? That's not a verdict. That's a perfect combo! Every turn will throw new challenges at you. But you'll handle it. Right?

⚔️ Heroes with Character and Weak Spots

You have 10 heroes at your disposal. Each is a unique class with their own story and survival style. Each hero has 9 different spells. Warrior, mage, priest, hunter, shaman, paladin, someone, rogue, druid, and of course the cheeky gnome developer — they're all under your command. Well, except the last one.

Heroes unlock as you progress, and you decide who to bring on your next expedition.

👁️ Expeditions — The Core of the Game

The world is divided into a dozen thematic acts. Each has its own atmosphere, music, and monsters. In each act, a random map is generated, always ending with a boss.

Every fight is a small chess match where your main tool is dice. And you're the one in control. Probably.

At the start of a turn, enemies reveal their plans: who they'll attack, what spell they'll use. You see it all — and you build your defense. Stun the shaman about to cast a curse? Shield the hero the trolls are targeting? Or strike first so the enemy simply... doesn't get a turn?

There are also elite monsters, camps, shops, secrets, cards, artifacts, luck, ally support, and even... FARMING! No, no. Not what you think.

🔁 Your Progress — Not Just in Battles

The game remembers your victories. New heroes, new acts, new artifacts, new skins unlock. But the real progress is you becoming a better player. You start to feel when to take risks and when to play it safe. That's Mind Over Dice. Mind over dice. Mastery over randomness.

✨ Key Features

  • 🎲 Dice as a tactical resource — assign rolled values to your heroes.

  • 🧠 Transparent enemies — they show their moves before you act. Well, almost all of them.

  • ⚔️ 10 heroes with unique spells — from warrior to psychologist (oops, wasn't supposed to say that).

  • 🔁 High replayability — every run has a new map and new decisions.

  • 🃏 Hundreds of artifacts and achievements — collect, unlock, experiment.

🎮 Who This Game Is For

  • For those who want to relax in the evenings. Spoiler: it might not work.

  • For those who love tactical puzzles and are used to winning. Spoiler: it might not work.

  • For those who play more than just AAA games. Spoiler: you'll be screaming "AAAA" a lot.

Mind Over Dice is a challenge to your patience, wit, and willingness to take risks. There's no such thing as "bad luck" here. Only "I chose the wrong face."

Total playtime: 30-80 hours.

store_data.about_the_game:
SLYTHE is an arcade shooter roguelite where you steer an ever-moving snake of heroes — each with their own attacks, passives, and classes. Inspired by auto-battlers: stack heroes of the same class for powerful class bonuses, buy copies to level them up, and build a snake that clears the arena on its own — if you steer it right.

Between arenas you play the economy: hire from the shop, bank gold for interest, ban the heroes you never want offered again, and shape a build from 80+ passive items with run-warping effects. Every sixth arena throws an elite at you; arena 25 holds the final boss. Beating it is where SLYTHE starts, not where it ends.

Gameplay

  • Your snake never stops moving — steer it with keyboard, mouse-follow, or gamepad (two stick modes)
  • Your heroes attack automatically when enemies are near
  • Combine heroes of the same class to unlock unique class bonuses
  • Clearing arenas grants gold — spend it, or bank it and earn interest
  • Buying copies of the same hero levels them up; at Lv.3 they unlock special effects
  • Ban heroes from the shop to sharpen your odds — build control is the real weapon

Beyond the win

  • True endless mode — difficulty keeps scaling for as long as you survive
  • Loop past arena 25 with a run-defining relic each time around
  • New Game+ tiers stack lasting difficulty for veteran builds
  • A global all-time leaderboard — names, avatars, and your rank right on the main menu
  • Custom runs with game-twisting modifiers when you want the rules bent

Features

  • 50+ heroes, each with unique attacks and passives
  • 15+ classes granting stat boosts and modifiers to your snake
  • 80+ passive items with run-warping global effects
  • Elite fights, a final boss, and rotating arena themes
  • 41 Steam achievements, from first blood to the ones we won't spoil
  • Post-run stat breakdowns for the theorycrafters
  • Full controller support with rebindable inputs, native on Steam Deck
  • An interactive tutorial that teaches steering in your own control scheme
  • A pumping synthwave soundtrack driving every wave

About This Game

Pirates Life is an online multiplayer pirate adventure where every player has their own account, builds a personal island, joins crews, explores a vast world, and creates their own pirate legacy.

Create and customize your own island by placing buildings, docks, decorations, workshops, and other structures to make it truly your own. Gather resources, craft equipment, and design the perfect pirate hideout.

Explore a world filled with unique islands, hidden treasures, quests, resources, and dangerous enemies. Search for buried treasure by digging at marked X locations to uncover valuable crates filled with coins. Spend your coins on buildings, decorations, equipment, ships, and other upgrades.

Create or join a Crew to adventure with other players. Work together to complete quests, defeat powerful enemies, collect treasure, and explore dangerous islands.

Communicate with the community using the Public Chat. Meet new players, recruit crew members, trade, or simply chat while exploring the seas.

Looking for action? Enter PvP and battle other players on land and at sea. Fire your ship's cannons, sink enemy vessels, board rival ships, and fight to protect your treasure or claim theirs.

Key Features

  • Fully online multiplayer experience.

  • Create your own player account and save your progress.

  • Build and customize your own island.

  • Explore a world filled with unique islands.

  • Hunt for buried treasure by digging at marked X locations.

  • Find treasure crates containing valuable coins.

  • Spend your coins on buildings, decorations, equipment, ships, and more.

  • Create or join a Crew with other players.

  • Public Chat to communicate with players around the world.

  • Gather resources and craft equipment.

  • Fight enemies and challenging bosses.

  • Engage in PvP with ship-to-ship combat and player battles.

  • Discover hidden secrets and continue expanding your pirate adventure.

Whether you choose to become a legendary explorer, a fearless pirate captain, a skilled builder, or a treasure hunter, Pirates Life offers an online world where your adventure never ends.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the distant ancient era, a legendary mage obtained knowledge of the creation laws from another world and mastered powerful magic capable of destroying heaven and earth. In order to open up his own new world, he ruthlessly destroyed countless nations. The dragon race and giant race joined forces to fight him for thousands of years, ultimately sealing him in the dark demon domain. The giants and dragons guarded the barrier with their flesh and blood, strengthening the seal.

However, as long years passed, the guardians gradually corrupted, leaving only piles of dry bones. The sealing barrier weakened accordingly. The mage's remnant soul and evil thoughts attached to the bones, transforming into the terrifying Skeleton Demon God, constantly releasing corrupting particles to further weaken the barrier...

To save the continent on the verge of destruction, the protagonist is summoned by a mysterious power and embarks on an epic journey to the Skeleton Demon Domain to eliminate the Skeleton Demon God.

Game Features

  • Immersive Visual Feast: Excellent lighting and pixel art perfectly combined to create an ultimate atmosphere and deep immersion. Every frame is as exquisite as an oil painting.

  • Rich Weapon and Magic System: Multiple weapons and magic can be freely combined to unlock a vast array of combat combinations and create your unique fighting style.

  • Original Epic Soundtrack: Multiple custom shocking songs that enhance the story's appeal and world immersion.

  • Diverse Level Design: Rich and differentiated levels with intricate mechanisms, full of challenge and fun. Every exploration brings fresh surprises.

  • Exquisite Narrative Presentation: High-quality cutscenes and profound storytelling immerse you in this thousand-year legend of the Demon God.

What Was That?! is a cozy-spooky roguelite deckbuilder where you play as a household pet exploring a home after dark.

When the humans fall asleep, the house changes. Everyday objects become mysterious encounters. Some become friends. Others become enemies.

Explore different rooms, investigate strange objects, and face bizarre enemies inspired by things every pet knows — cardboard boxes, tangled yarn, robot vacuums, and more.

Build your deck, manage your Stress, and trust your instincts to survive until morning.

Features

  • 🃏 Build a unique deck during every run.

  • 🏠 Explore a home full of mysterious encounters.

  • 😺 Every object can become either a reward or a threat.

  • 🌙 Cozy atmosphere mixed with light suspense.

  • 🔄 Procedurally generated runs with different choices every night.

store_data.about_the_game:
Are you ready to explore the freedom of being a rubber duck? 🦆

Step into a peaceful, physics-based world where ducks slowly rain down from the sky. Mayhem Duck Simulator is the ultimate plastic duck simulator experience, designed for those who want to spend a calm day as well as those looking to stir up some serious trouble.

You aren't just a regular duck; you are the master of the pool! ✨

Key Features

  • Relax or Wreak Havoc: Whether you want to sunbathe and drift peacefully on the water or use your special abilities to turn the pool upside down, the choice is yours in this unique plastic duck simulator.

  • Unique "Special Ducks": Discover special ducks, each with their own unique powers!

    • Dragon Duck: Breathe fire! 🔥

    • UFO Duck: Abduct other ducks into the sky! 🛸

    • Wizard Duck: Grow your friends to massive sizes! ✨

    • Magnet Duck: Attract a flock and go on a road trip! 🦆

  • Rescue and Collect: Find the special ducks trapped behind iron bars, rescue them, and add them to your pool. Every new duck means a new type of chaos in your plastic duck simulator collection!

  • Customize: Take control of every duck, give them custom names, and grow your collection.

  • Sit Back and Unwind: No quests, no timers, no stress. Watch them drift like a screensaver on your second monitor while you work, or hop in during your coffee break to stir things up!

This game is perfect for you if:

  • You are looking for a fun plastic duck simulator that lets you escape from tedious quests and complex mechanics.

  • You are looking for a "relaxing" game that still lets you indulge in occasional madness.

  • You enjoy hilarious, physics-based sandbox fun. 🦆

There is a "relaxing" mode... but how long it stays relaxing depends entirely on your creativity! 😏

In Mayhem Duck Simulator, you will either find peace or create pure chaos. The choice is yours! ✨

store_data.about_the_game:
Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers

Bon Voyage!
Welcome to the world of Forturia!

In this world, every voyage is guided by the dice.

Forturia is a fantasy world inspired by the 16th-century Age of Exploration. You take on the role of a young captain leading a small trading company, traveling from port to port across the globe, buying and selling goods, opening up unknown seas, and taking on royal missions from your kingdom.

But you are not the only one seeking fortune on these waters.
A colorful cast of rival captains is also sailing the world, each driven by their own ambitions.

Which route will you take?
Which ports will you trade in?
Will you prioritize royal missions, or chase a chance at a massive profit?

Every choice you make can change the course of your destiny.

A Different Grand Voyage, Woven by Dice Every Time

Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers is a new kind of seafaring strategy game that blends board game movement, trading, strategy, and adventure.

Roll the dice to travel along sea routes, then buy and sell trade goods in ports around the world. Read the market, stack up profits, grow your fleet, and aim to become the greatest trading company in the world.

With maps that change every time you play, market prices that shift constantly, and rival captains competing for the same opportunities, no two voyages are ever the same.

A Free Voyage Across the World

A vast ocean awaits, filled with countless ports, trade goods, and undiscovered routes.

Discover new waters, expand the world map, and build your own ideal trade routes.

Sometimes storms will throw your plans into chaos. Sometimes unexpected fortune will smile upon you. Every voyage creates a new story.

A Party Adventure to Enjoy, Laugh, and Compete With Others

The world of Forturia is not only for solo players who want to take their time and plan carefully.

With online and local multiplayer, it can also be enjoyed as a party game that is easy to play with family and friends.

“If only I had one more space, I could have completed my royal mission!”
“You sold at that port? I wasn’t ready for that!”
“You’re using that item now!?”

Unexpected twists created by the dice, combined with the mind games between players, make every session feel like its own drama.

Luck alone will not bring victory.
But even the best strategy can be laughed away by the goddess of dice.

Because no one knows who will win until the very end, every voyage is filled with cheers, groans, and laughter.

It is a new seafaring party game where everyone can gather, compete, and have a great time.

A Story-Rich Campaign Mode and an Endlessly Replayable Versus Mode

Enjoy a story-rich campaign mode filled with meaningful encounters and journeys across the world, as well as a randomly generated versus mode where you can freely play against COM opponents or friends.

Roll the dice that decide your fate, trade from port to port, and outmaneuver rival captains.
Lead your trading company to glory in a fantasy world inspired by the Age of Exploration.

There Is More Than One Path to Victory

Build a vast fortune.

Complete more royal missions than anyone else.

Monopolize rare trade goods.

Explore the world and open up new sea routes.

What kind of captain you become is up to you.

Luck alone is not enough.
Strategy alone is not enough.

Only the captain who can master both fortune and judgment will become the ruler of Forturia.

Now, raise your sails.

Beyond the trade routes no one has yet discovered.

Development Staff

Developer: FUJIYAMA ENTERTAINMENT
Director & Original Concept: Shunsuke Katsumata
Character Design: Shu-chun
Sound Design: Soma

Brought to you by a small development team of four to five people.
We hope everyone will have a great time playing it together.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mini Mayor: 12 Years is a city-building and management sandbox game where you build a city, manage its budget, and survive the world of politics.

You become the newly elected mayor and govern the city for 12 years.
Build roads, develop residential and commercial districts, expand education, public safety, healthcare, and industry, and guide your city toward growth.

But being a mayor is not just about building a better city.

As elections approach, you must make promises to your citizens.
During your term, you can choose whether to keep those promises or ignore them.
You can spend the budget on the city’s future, or use your position to pursue personal wealth and political gain.

You may become a great mayor who serves the people.
Or you may become a politician who talks about prosperity in public while quietly filling your own pockets behind the scenes.

Your choices will change the direction of the city, the reactions of your citizens, and the outcome of your political career.
In the end, the ending you reach will depend on what kind of mayor you chose to become.

City Building and Management
Place residential, commercial, industrial, and public facilities while managing the city’s population and finances.

Politics and Elections
Choose campaign promises, manage public approval and party support, and win elections to stay in power.

Aim for Three Consecutive Terms
One term is not enough. Hold on to power for 12 years and successfully win three terms as mayor.

Choices with Different Consequences
Choices made for the city, choices made for political survival, and choices made for personal gain will all lead to different results.

Multiple Endings
The ending will change depending on what kind of city you built and how you used your power.

Will you build a great city,
or will you build a great fortune for yourself?

The choice is yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
🏆 The Birth of a "New Strategy Triangle Reversi"!

Experience an unprecedented take on Reversi, using triangular pieces where "two" pieces fit into a single square!

The traditional "take the corners" strategy is completely shattered, marking the dawn of a brand-new intellectual battle.

Developed with passion by Japanese solo-developer Nakamura, experience a revolutionary title that will change the history of Reversi!

🎮 【CONCEPT】 A Digital Brain Battle in an 80s Cyber Space

The stage is a cyber world hacked by an AI virus.

Immerse yourself in retro-futuristic, 80s cyberpunk-style sounds and visuals as you take on the challenge to save the world from this digital threat.

⚠️ 【NEW RULE】 Original Rules That Defy Convention

The biggest appeal of this game is that the pieces are "right isosceles triangles." This creates an entirely new layer of strategy where conventional wisdom no longer applies.

① Two Pieces per Square!

Each square is divided by a diagonal line, allowing up to two pieces to be placed in a single square. The orientation of the pieces (combinations of 4 directions) will drastically shift the tide of battle.

② Sandwiching is Only Vertical/Horizontal! 【No Diagonals ❌】

While the basic rule of sandwiching and flipping opponent pieces remains, the triangular structure makes diagonal sandwiching absolutely impossible! Dominating the vertical (up/down) and horizontal (left/right) lines is the ultimate key to victory.

💎 【SPECIAL】 Your Comeback Partner: The "Bit"

When more than half of the board is filled, the crystal "Bit" on the right side of the screen awakens!

By clicking it, you can activate a powerful skill to "transform an enemy piece into your own" just once per game.

However, using it comes with a high-risk, high-reward twist: an enemy counterattack will grant your opponent two consecutive turns immediately after. Knowing exactly when to use the "Bit" will decide your fate!

🖱️ 【FEATURES】 Smooth Gameplay & Multiplayer

* Intuitive Controls: Perfect for beginners! The game progresses simply by intuitively clicking, fully supporting both mouse and controller.

* Hint Feature: "Translucent hint pieces" automatically appear where you can place a piece, helping you get used to the new rules instantly.

* Local Multiplayer: Enjoy heated battles with friends or family on a single screen!

🎵 【SOUND】 Premium All-8-Bit Audio!

From the background music to the sound effects and jingles, all 30+ tracks featured in the game are created entirely with retro 8-bit sounds!

Composed exclusively by up-and-coming professional composer Koko-Watt, these ultimate chiptune tracks will fully immerse you in the 80s cyber space!

store_data.about_the_game:
🎂 Welcome to Cake & Bake! 🍰✨

Step into the warm, fresh-out-of-the-oven world of Cake & Bake! Welcome to a peaceful baking simulator where you will create colorful cakes for your adorable and sweet customers. Choose your ingredients, use various kitchen tools, and craft the desserts of your dreams — all inside a heartwarming, cozy bakery!

🧑‍🍳 Bake the Flavor Step-by-Step

Take your customers' orders and step up to the counter. Master every recipe, from classic sponges to multi-layered, colorful birthday cakes. Mix the batter and set the oven to the perfect temperature. Thanks to all the decoration and baking steps, preparing each cake turns into a delightful and rewarding experience!

🛒 Explore the Town Market

The most delicious cakes are made with the freshest ingredients! When you run low on supplies or need exotic fruits for a special recipe, drop by the charming market in town. Stroll through the aisles, add the freshest strawberries, highest quality chocolates, and colorful sprinkles to your basket. Proper shopping is the first secret to a perfect cake!

🍓 Let Your Imagination Run Wild

Frost your cakes exactly how you want, and decorate them with adorable cream figures, fresh fruits, and glossy glazes. Creating visual feasts that will charm even the pickiest customers is entirely up to your creativity!

🧼 A Sweet End-of-Day Closure

After a busy and flavor-packed day, it's time to prep your bakery for tomorrow! Clean up the counter at the end of the day, wash the mixer bowls, piping bags, and trays in soapy, bubbly water, bringing a sparkling order back to your bakery. Washing the dishes and cleaning the kitchen will turn into a deeply peaceful and satisfying ritual that makes you forget all your tiredness!

🌸 Peaceful Atmosphere and Adorable Graphics

Every corner of Cake & Bake is filled with sweetness and a cozy style. No time limits, no rush, no stress. This peaceful atmosphere will make you forget the outside world as you decorate your cakes or imagine the aroma of a cake fresh out of the oven, all accompanied by relaxing background music.

Key Features

  • 🥣 Interactive Kitchen Tools: Actively use mixers, ovens, piping bags, and many other kitchen utensils.

  • 🍰 Colorful Cakes: Prepare sponges, pies, and custom-designed cakes for your customers.

  • 🛍️ Adorable Market Shopping: Visit the town market to handpick and purchase the freshest and most colorful ingredients for your cakes.

  • 🎨 Sweet and Soft Visuals: A completely "cozy" visual style with a heartwarming color palette that is easy on the eyes.

  • 🎵 Relaxing Music: Peaceful melodies to help you unwind after a busy day.
