store_data.about_the_game:
A city without emotion. A feeling is the only clue.

In the controlled city of AUREX, emotion has been ruled inefficient — monitored, suppressed, and engineered out of daily life. You are SOLDA, a rookie special investigator of the Central Order Department. Your only edge is an emotion scanner that visualizes the feelings people are trained to hide. In a city that erased emotion, the smallest tremor becomes the loudest clue.

SOLDA is a story-rich sci-fi mystery visual novel about investigating crimes — and confronting what it means to feel at all.

How you play

  • Investigate the scene — Explore crime scenes point-and-click style, examine objects, and collect evidence.
  • Interrogate with the emotion scanner — Scan suspects in real time. Anger burns red, joy glows amber, and a lie can never hold still. Catch the moment a statement and a feeling don't match.
  • Build your hypothesis — Combine clues and testimony on an AR investigation interface to reconstruct how the crime happened and who is responsible.
  • Accuse and decide — Confront the culprit with the evidence you trust. What you reveal — and what you bury — leads to multiple endings.

Features

  • A noir sci-fi detective visual novel with a hand-crafted, brutalist art style
  • A unique emotion-reading mechanic at the heart of every interrogation
  • A clue-combination and hypothesis system that rewards careful deduction
  • Multiple endings shaped by your conclusions and choices
  • An episodic mystery — beginning with the prologue case of a loan shark's assault and robbery
  • A cast of suspects, each with their own motives and secrets

The story

Emotion is treated as a malfunction — but it never truly disappears; it only hides, waiting to surface like a bug in the system. As SOLDA follows each case deeper, she begins to feel what she was trained to forget, and the questions stop being only about the crime. Who benefits from a city without feeling — and what is the cost of taking it back?

  • Interrogate with the emotion scanner — Scan suspects in real time. Anger burns red, joy glows amber, and a lie can never hold still. Catch the moment a statement and a feeling don't match.
  • Build your hypothesis — Combine clues and testimony on an AR investigation interface to reconstruct how the crime happened and who is responsible.
  • Accuse and decide — Confront the culprit with the evidence you trust. What you reveal — and what you bury — leads to multiple endings.

Features

  • A noir sci-fi detective visual novel with a hand-crafted, brutalist art style
  • A unique emotion-reading mechanic at the heart of every interrogation
  • A clue-combination and hypothesis system that rewards careful deduction
  • Multiple endings shaped by your conclusions and choices
  • An episodic mystery — beginning with the prologue case of a loan shark's assault and robbery
  • A cast of suspects, each with their own motives and secrets

The story

Emotion is treated as a malfunction — but it never truly disappears; it only hides, waiting to surface like a bug in the system. As SOLDA follows each case deeper, she begins to feel what she was trained to forget, and the questions stop being only about the crime. Who benefits from a city without feeling — and what is the cost of taking it back?
store_data.short_description: In AUREX, a city where every citizen's emotions are controlled, you are SOLDA, a rookie special investigator. Armed with an emotion scanner that reads what suspects try to hide, catch the tremor behind every lie, piece the clues together, and uncover the truth.

Do you remember? Do you remember being a child and misbehaving? One night, when you should have been asleep, you sneak into the living room to watch a late-night TV show about urban legends.   • Atmospheric Retro Style: PSX-era inspired graphics that heighten the tension and unease of the first-person perspective.

DO YOUR JOB

Welcome to your new position. Your duties are straigforward: listen to tapes, identify audio anomalies, and complete your shift. Everything you need is already provided. Just focus on your work.

LEARN THE RULES

Every creature follows its own set of rules. Listen for knocks, watch the vents, hide at right moment, and adapt as new mechanics are introduced. Paying attention is the key to staying alive, because every mistake bringes the entities one step closer.

EVERY DAY GETS HARDER

New gameplay mechanics are introduced day after day, steadily increasing the challenge without replacing what you already learned. You'll need to multitask and stay calm under pressure if you hope to survive until the final shift.

TEST YOURSELF

Once you've completed the game, challenge yourself with unique game modes that change the gameplay. Face remixed mechanics, earn achievements, and prove you've mastered every rule the facility has to offer.

store_data.about_the_game:
Short battles. Subtle decisions. Big consequences.

Cardume is a real-time 1v1 card battler. Two swarms of thousands of living cells fight in a glowing arena. Steer yours with a handful of one-time cards. Lure the swarm onto a point, rally it into a charge, trigger a gorge, freeze an enemy assault. You can't micromanage individual cells, but a few well-timed plays ripple through thousands of them and swing the whole match.

Emergent warfare

Your cells obey simple rules, but the war that emerges from thousands of them is something neither player can fully predict. Learn to read the swarm so you can anticipate your enemy and tip the balance of the medium in your favor.

Win two ways

  • Domination: hold the arena's richest nutrient points and race to the victory-point goal.
  • Conversion: assimilate the enemy until their swarm collapses.
Lean defensive and hold the map and your cards, or go for the throat. Acid trails, cryo blasts, spore clouds, membranes. Every card reshapes the living system in real time.

Modes

  • Draft: open boosters, build a deck on the fly, and run it as far as you can, ranked against humans or against bots on your own.
  • Constructed: bring your own preconfigured swarm into the ladder.
  • Challenges: a hand-built ladder that teaches one idea at a time.
  • Auto-battler: prefer to just watch? Configure a swarm, set it loose hands-off, and let it fight rival swarms on its own.

A living, luminous arena

Abstract, bioluminescent, faintly psychedelic. Cardume is built to be
mesmerising to watch as much as to play. Light, motion, and emergent life.

store_data.about_the_game:
CRUMPLED METAL

Concrete Carnage: Scrapheap puts you back in the DNA of brutal 90s racing games, where crumpled metal was worth as much as the finish line. No weapons, no missiles, no easy shortcuts. Just you and your truck against everything else.

Every impact is felt. The bodywork deforms, parts fly off, the engine takes the hit. Surviving a race is already a victory. Winning one is another.

CARNAGE BY THE NUMBERS

Crush your rivals in Arena Combat or keep your nerve in Fatal Freight: an explosive cargo, a ruthless course, and every hit could be your last. Six game modes, from classic racing to pure carnage, with precision driving in between.

Every credit counts. Repair your truck mid-race, haul bonus cargo, upgrade your vehicle between events. Destruction pays, if you survive.

  • 6 game modes*: from pure destruction to surgical precision

  • 8 playable trucks* with distinct profiles

  • 6 semi-open maps* to explore

  • Real-time visual bodywork deformation

  • Progressive damage and repair system

  • Upgrades: engine, suspension, tires

  • Power-ups: Nitro, Shield, Heal, Magnet

  • Crush pedestrians to clear your path and earn credits

  • Haul cargo to maximize your credits

  • Retro aesthetic inspired by 90s games

*figures subject to change until the final release.

THE HEXAGON

The Hexagon was meant to be the garden of humanity. Thanks to Celestial Matter, extracted from a forgotten meteorite, the country sacrificed its landscapes for Total Agriculture. But the dream turned into a chemical nightmare.

The Surcharge swept everything away. A viscous soup of cyanobacteria, fluorescent and lethal, now blankets the plains. The Hexagon is nothing more than an architecture of emptiness surrounded by The Furrow, a toxic expanse where biology defies all reason.

In the ruins, men set out in their trucks to recover fragments of the original matter. They are known as The Gleaners.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build upward, one perfect floor at a time.

Perfect Floor is a cheerful casual stacking game about timing, focus, and the tiny thrill of landing a clean match.

Press and hold to grow the next floor of your building. Release when the size feels just right. A close match keeps the tower rising; a perfect floor rewards you with extra momentum. Miss the timing and your lives start to slip away.

Features

  • Simple one-button controls that are easy to learn.
  • Fast score-chasing rounds built for quick sessions.
  • Timing-based stacking where every floor matters.
  • Perfect matches reward clean play.
  • Coins and unlockable building styles add long-term goals.
  • Bright low-poly city visuals and upbeat background music.

Can you keep the tower alive?

Each round starts calm, but the pressure rises with every floor. Watch the size, trust your rhythm, and try to build your best tower yet.

store_data.about_the_game:
Professor's wife's spasm private lessons - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction: Fitness coach Victor was on the verge of death in the Paris subway explosion and was reborn after being transformed by the No. 7 consciousness insect, gaining special abilities. He met Eleanor, the wife of a philosophy professor, and gradually got involved in the struggle against the FX Group during his contact with her. Victor needs to find a balance between power and humanity while dealing with the crisis brought about by the awakening of the ancient rift entity.
Worldview atmosphere: The story constructs a world full of technological and mysterious elements. The FX Group conducts taboo experiments such as consciousness chip transplantation, treating humans as pawns and experimental subjects. Elements such as the ancient Balance Management Department, consciousness insects, and quantum rifts add a touch of fantasy and science fiction to the story.
Highlights of female character interaction: Eleanor is a mature woman with a cold and noble temperament, suppressing her desire for attention and control in her heart. The interaction between her and Victor is full of tension and emotional entanglement. From the initial exploration to the later mutual trust and dependence, the relationship between the two gradually warms up.
Tension in character relationships: There is both emotional attraction and cooperation and mutual support in the process of fighting against the FX Group between Victor and Eleanor. At the same time, Victor also has to face the pursuit of the FX Group and the threat of the ancient rift entity, making the character relationships complex and full of tension.
Scene features: The story scenes are rich and diverse, from the explosion site in the Paris subway tunnel, to the private lessons in the high - end fitness club, to the apartment near the Sorbonne University, the café by the Seine River, and the top - floor club hall. Each scene has a unique atmosphere and characteristics.
Immersive experience: Players will follow Victor's perspective to deeply experience his various experiences after obtaining special abilities, feel the emotional changes between him and Eleanor, and the excitement of fighting against the FX Group and the ancient crisis. It's as if they are in this world full of technology and mystery.
High - definition visual performance: The game uses high - definition pictures to vividly show the characters' expressions, actions, and scene details, bringing players an immersive visual experience. Whether it's Eleanor's charming posture or Victor's display of special abilities, they will all be presented in beautiful pictures.
Functional gameplay features: It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. It has a one - click backtracking function, which is convenient for players to review important plots. The automatic playback function allows players to experience the story more easily. The chapter browsing function enables players to quickly locate the chapters they are interested in. There is also a high - definition CG display, bringing players a more intuitive visual enjoyment, and the smooth reading experience allows players to be fully immersed.

store_data.about_the_game:
"They race for the sunset"

The Curse of Dracula is a compact gothic digital board game of pursuit and terror, played out upon a living map of mist-shrouded roads, lonely villages, ruined chapels, forgotten abbeys, and cursed mountain passes.

Lead a party of vampire hunters across Transylvania in a single-session hunt lasting roughly 45–120 minutes. Each turn advances the clock by two hours. Choose whether your hunters move, search for coffins and clues, gather supplies, rest from their wounds, prepare against danger, or manage the weapons and holy relics they carry.

The hunt changes from run to run. Coffins, guardians, useful items, hazards, and events are shuffled across the map. Dracula’s influence rises as dusk falls, making the roads more dangerous and his servants more powerful. Wolves stalk the forests. The dead stir in their graves. Vampire thralls guard cursed sites. False leads waste precious time.

Search the abbeys, chapels, villages, crypts, and ruins. Find the coffins. Defeat the guardians. Burn what lies within.

When the coffins are destroyed, gather the surviving hunters at the Castle Gate and enter the finale: a sequence of castle encounters leading to Dracula himself. One final chance to end the curse of Dracula, or to join his legion of the damned.

Generative AI Disclosure

This game was created with the assistance of generative AI tools for visual assets, music, and coding. All generated material was extensively edited, arranged, curated, and directed by the developer. The gameplay design, UI layout, visual style, and overall creative vision are the result of significant human authorship.

Seed of Light is a cozy roguelite city builder about bringing light into a world overcome by darkness.
Construct various buildings on a hex-based map to generate light and other resources.
Vanquish the darkness every cycle to expand your territory! 

Choose a new building every round to place in your village.
Pay attention to the various conditions and effects the buildings have and capitalize on the synergies between them. 

Generate enough light to overcome the darkness threshold each cycle and make sure to keep up with its scaling.

store_data.about_the_game:
DEADLY MURDOKU

Un cadáver. Una habitación cerrada. Una sala llena de sospechosos que no piensan hablar. En Deadly Murdoku no hay armas ni persecuciones: solo tú, la tiza y una verdad escondida en la geometría fría de la escena del crimen. Aquí la lógica es la única arma, y todo asesino comete un error.

LEE LA ESCENA COMO UN DETECTIVE

Cada sospechoso estuvo en algún sitio la noche del crimen. Las pistas no mienten: quién estaba junto a la planta, quién sentado bajo la ventana, quién dos salas al norte del cuerpo. Deduce el lugar exacto de cada uno, colócalos a todos sin una sola contradicción y acorrala al único que se quedó a solas con la víctima. Ese es tu asesino. Nómbralo y cierra el caso.

UNA CAMPAÑA DE NOVELA NEGRA

Ponte en la gabardina de Arthur Vance, un detective quemado que corrige exámenes en un sótano para no volver a juzgar a nadie. Veinte casos hechos a mano lo arrastran de vuelta al oficio, escalando una conspiración en la Universidad de San Jude hacia un cerebro que el campus enterró hace un año. Cada crimen es un mensaje dirigido a él, y cada pista pagada con sangre.

UNA HISTORIA QUE SE LEE COMO UN CÓMIC

Capítulos cinematográficos, un Diario del caso que reúne a cada asesino y cada víctima, y un misterio final que solo el detective más afilado sabrá resolver. La narrativa se desvela a medida que cierras casos: descubre el móvil, ata los cabos y llega hasta el nombre que nadie se atrevía a pronunciar.

DEDUCCIÓN LIMPIA, SIN SUERTE

Nada de culpables sacados de la manga. Cada caso tiene una sola solución, demostrable con pura lógica: la pista que condena al asesino siempre está sobre la mesa. Insinuamos, nunca mentimos. Tu ingenio es lo único que separa la condena del error.

JUEGO LIBRE ILIMITADO

¿Se acabó la campaña? El crimen nunca duerme. Genera casos infinitos en tres tamaños, de aprendiz a maestro detective, y afina tu instinto tanto como quieras. Cada partida, una escena nueva; cada escena, una verdad esperando a ser leída.

Coge la tiza, detective. El caso te espera.

Step into your first job with a passion for creativity. Meet coworkers with unique personalities as you struggle between your dreams and your career. Share a home in the big city, reunite with someone from your past, and discover what lies ahead...

Characters

  • Kazuma Ookamiya: Your housemate and former high school classmate whom you unexpectedly meet again. He works multiple part-time jobs.

  • Yuki Hashi: The protagonist, who joins Gentaku as an intern in spring.

  • Shunsuke Ninomiya: A gentle and dependable senior coworker with exceptional skills who takes special care of you.

  • Susumu Naota: A spring intern at Gentaku who struggles with family issues.

  • Wataru Natsukawa: A young genius in the industry with extraordinary talent, and your direct supervisor.

  • Masafumi Arimoto: A spring intern at Gentaku and your university classmate.

Work hard and keep moving forward.

store_data.about_the_game:
Velocity Fall is a fast, exhilarating first-person vertical-descent platformer. The goal is simple: plunge as fast as possible through walls, obstacles, and hazards... without splattering on the ground. The faster you go, the bigger the reward — but one mistake and it's a fatal impact.

Master your speed, or die. A dynamic velocity bar tells you everything: Green (safe), Orange (nail a timed Reception or take damage), Red (deadly on landing unless you pull off something clever), and Black (terminal velocity, instant death). Every zone changes how you play.

The wall is your best friend.

Wall Fall to slow down and regain control

Wall Run to keep your momentum at full speed

Perfect Wall Jump — a surgically-timed billiard-ball bounce that preserves your speed

Charged Jump for explosive relaunches

Chain your runs. Timed receptions, bunny hops to keep your momentum, checkpoints, and a replay system to study your best descents.

Infinite Fall. Levels generated along the fall axis, in Survival, Distance, or Normal modes. The golden rule: you only clear a run while in the green zone — otherwise, it's overtime.

Items & props. Trampolines, catapults, gravity zones, wind tunnels. Grab a parachute, energy drink, or grappling hook to turn a doomed dive into a legendary run.

Difficulty modifiers. From Weak Gravity (chill) to Iron Man (one death = back to the start). Tune your own challenge.

Are you fast enough to fall... and survive?

store_data.about_the_game:
The Peg Mines is a pachinko/plinko-like incremental game about mining for tons of ore by playing pachinko.

Enter the mines where pegs are your ore and balls are your pickaxes! By shooting ore, you'll be breaking up tons of pegs into ore that can be collected and crafted into new upgrades and unique balls.

As you progress through the mines, you'll earn ore to be used for upgrades.

This game features incremental progressions in the form of:

  • Increasing the amount of ore received per peg

  • Increasing the amount of pegs in the mines

  • Increasing multipliers

  • and more!

Crafting can offer a bigger benefit than standard upgrades.

This game also features a crafting system where you can choose to spend your ore on creating unique balls that may fit your playstyle. The better you are at crafting, the higher multiplier your newly created ball will receive. The crafting mini-game plays more like a standard pachinko game, and the better you perform, the better the result!

Gather ore, craft unique balls and gather even more ore!

Different balls have different effects, like increasing ore amounts, splitting into two or adding more multipliers! The further you go, the more ore will be needed to progress, these can give you a real edge.

store_data.about_the_game:
A clash of gods, played over sixty four squares.

Two thrones face each other across the board. The old gods bring their feuds here, where spears become pieces and Ragnarok plays out one move at a time. Three rule sets share the same field. Pick the contest that suits your hand.

Classic Chess

The old game of kings, as mortals have played it for a thousand winters. Castling, en passant, promotion, check, checkmate, stalemate, threefold repetition, and the fifty move rule. Every law of the contest, kept as it was given.

Odin's Gambit

A chess variant where you raise your host as you play. Each turn, every warrior on your board marches once, in the order they answered your call. Beside the board you hold a hand of cards, each one a piece waiting to be set down. Spend a card each turn, plant a new warrior on its home square, and build your army as the match unfolds. Same goal as chess: cut down the enemy king.

Odin's Bounty

Odin's Gambit with a roguelike layer. Every foe your warrior fells leaves something behind. A level, a gift, a piece of their spirit. At the end of your turn, choose one of two boons for the slayer: greater reach, a new direction, the art of leaping over a kinsman, a second strike after a kill, and many more. By the time the last king falls, your warriors are unrecognizable from the ones that took the field. No two matches unfold the same way.

Three paths into battle

  • The hearth. Two players, one device. A curtain falls between turns so neither side glimpses the other's hand.

  • Versus. Host a match and share the join code. Battle anyone, anywhere. Best of three, five, or seven series.

  • Alone against the gods. Solo play in any of the three contests.

A fair contest

  • No tribute. No premium relics. No merchants at the gate. Earn what you want by playing.

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Game


Intended Parties is an Adult Romance Visual Novel about power, consent, and the cost of "doing good" at scale.

You play Lowell Vance, founder of Mariposa Family—the nation's most trusted "ethical" surrogacy agency. You are days away from a lucrative acquisition and a glossy relaunch when a buried medical warning resurfaces, a lawsuit tightens, and another carrier is flagged mid-protocol.

Three women step into your orbit at once. Choose who you face first, and discover whether romance can survive when the safest story in the room turns out to be the kindest lie.

Meet the Cast




Paloma Carrillo — The Doula
Paloma is Lucia Carrillo's older sister and a community doula who has spent her life keeping other women safe—only to watch her own sister be permanently harmed by Lowell's agency. She doesn't come for a payout; she comes for an answer that money can't replace. With Lowell, she finds herself drawn to the steadiness she has always provided for everyone else… and torn apart by what it would mean to accept it from him.



Rosalind "Roz" Aldous — The Medical Director
Roz is Mariposa's clinical conscience: brilliant, exacting, and the doctor who flagged Lucia's life-threatening risk—only to be overruled until her signature became part of the harm. She is Lowell's employee and a witness against his company, making their attraction both unethical and explosive. Where Lowell talks, Roz measures; where he sells, she sets terms.



Briar Nash — The Abolitionist
A former surrogate turned relentless organizer, Briar is the adversary Lowell can't charm, buy, or "mission" his way around—because she believes his kind version of the industry is the most dangerous one. She brings affidavits, scars, and a movement hungry for proof, and she treats Lowell like the best lie the business ever told. Falling for him would cost her credibility; wanting him feels like betrayal—and she hates that it's real.

Key Features

  • One decisive choice, three intense romance routes. A single-branch choice structure where the first door you walk toward shapes everything that follows.
  • High-stakes contemporary drama with grounded realism: acquisitions, legal holds, medical boards, and PR spin collide with intimate relationships.
  • Three distinct romance dynamics: a forbidden-by-faction rivalry with an anti-surrogacy abolitionist, an intimate bond with a doula seeking truth, and forbidden attraction with an off-limits employee and key witness.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.
  • A protagonist who can't talk his way out forever. Lowell's greatest skill—making people feel safe—becomes the very thing the story interrogates.

Content Notice

This game is an Adult Romance Visual Novel intended for mature audiences. It features explicit sexual content, emotionally intense romantic scenarios, and mature themes including medical/ethical conflict, legal pressure, and discussions of bodily autonomy and consent.

store_data.about_the_game:
CASE OF 1980 is a psychological horror game set in the tense, mystery-filled atmosphere of the 1990s.

Story:
The story takes place in 1995 and follows Nathan, who wakes up in his apartment in Texas to the ringing of his landline phone. The caller is his grandfather, who asks Nathan to look after the family farm while he travels to attend a funeral in a town far outside the county.

Nathan agrees and heads to the farm. At first, everything seems perfectly normal. However, as time passes, the situation quickly spirals out of control. Nathan finds himself hunted by forces from the other side, all connected to a mysterious case dating back to 1980 a case with deep ties to the very place where he now stands.



Features:

First-person psychological horror.

A fast-paced, immersive horror experience.

A tense atmosphere inspired by the 1990s.

A variety of locations and story-driven events.




Gameplay:

CASE OF 1980 is a single-player narrative exploration game with a walking simulator style. As the story unfolds, players explore the environment, uncover clues, and complete various tasks using the required tools to progress through the events.

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive the night. Trust no one — not even your own.

A manor lost in the night. A handful of survivors. One rule: never let the light go out. VEILLOMBRE is a multiplayer pixel-art horror game where cooperation is vital and trust is lethal.

Survivors

  • Explore a manor generated anew every match, room by room, by candlelight.
  • Search the drawers: matches, candles, planks… and THE key that opens the exit door.
  • Barricade the windows, close the doors behind you, hide under a bed or behind a curtain.
  • Peek through the keyhole before entering you never know what's waiting on the other side.
  • Suspicious? Call a meeting and vote to cast out a traitor.

The Monster

The player you vote out doesn't leave the game: they become the Monster. Prowl around the manor, force the windows open, slip inside and put them all out, one by one. Your scream chills the blood and your fist shows no mercy.

Impostors (Murder mode)

Traitors hide among the survivors. Snuff out candles in the dark, knock out the stragglers, steal the key from an unconscious player's pockets… then watch the others tear each other apart with accusations. But beware the vote: get unmasked, and you join the Monster's side.

The house is not empty

A ghoul pounds on the windows, its breathing closer by the hour. Something lives in the vents and pounces on those who linger in the wrong room. Every sound matters: voice chat is proximity-based you're heard where you stand, and the dead speak no more.

Features

  • 2-16 players online (Steam) — host a game in one click, join your friends.
  • Built-in proximity voice chat.
  • Fully host-configurable matches: impostors, creatures, timers, difficulty.
  • Procedurally generated manor: no two nights are alike.
  • Steam global leaderboard in classic mode.
  • Translated into 12 languages. Fully rebindable controls.

A game by Fuki-Studio.

store_data.about_the_game:
Exclusive Training of Female Officer - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction: In the NATO secret training ground, Gabrielle Clark was framed by Hannah Ringgren and was on the verge of death after being hit by biochemical shrapnel in the chest. At a critical moment, she fused with the seventh consciousness insect and miraculously woke up in the military camp's temporary medical room. After that, she will engage in a power struggle with Ringgren and gradually uncover the smuggling conspiracy of the FX Group within NATO .
Worldview atmosphere: The story constructs a world full of a sense of technology and conspiracy. There are hidden dirty deals within NATO. Elements such as consciousness insects and quantum servers add a mysterious science - fiction color to the story. The ancient rift is also quietly fluctuating, and the situation is complex and tense.
Highlights of female character interactions: The interaction between Gabrielle and Ringgren is full of tension. Ringgren is cold and domineering, trying to control Gabrielle; while Gabrielle shows her edge in forbearance and skillfully counter - attacks Ringgren. There is both hatred of being framed and a subtle emotional undercurrent between the two. In addition, Gabrielle also has wonderful conversations with female characters such as Foster Madison, showing the wisdom and charm of different female characters .
Tension in character relationships: Gabrielle and Ringgren are in a hostile relationship. Ringgren wants to kill Gabrielle to cover up the smuggling crime, while Gabrielle is determined to uncover the truth. At the same time, Gabrielle is connected with Ozan Shahin, Li Na, Chen Yong and others from the Balance Management Department through the consciousness network. They cooperate with each other but have different views and suggestions, making the character relationships more complex.
Scene features: The story scenes are rich and diverse, including the explosion remnants in the NATO secret training ground, the beeping of instruments in the military camp's temporary medical room, and the tense confrontation in the temporary conference room. Each scene creates a unique atmosphere through delicate descriptions, making players feel as if they are on the scene .
Immersive experience: Players will follow Gabrielle's perspective, feeling her pain of being on the verge of death, the shock of fusing with the consciousness insect, and the tension of confronting the enemy. In this process, players will deeply experience the difficulty of Gabrielle in finding a balance between power and humanity, as if they are the protagonist in the story.
High - definition visual performance: The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly present the characters' expressions, actions, and scene details. Whether it is Ringgren's cold and beautiful face, the silver - blue data stream in Gabrielle's eyes, or the purple - black light of the quantum server, they will all be presented to players in beautiful pictures .
Functional gameplay features: The game supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots, and the automatic play function allows players to easily enjoy the story. The chapter browsing function enables players to quickly find the parts they are interested in, and the high - definition CG adds more visual enjoyment to the story. The smooth reading experience allows players to fully immerse themselves in the game.

Core plot introduction
The low-class white youth Benjamin awakens the nano power on the verge of death while protecting Ava, the nightclub manager. He not only heals himself but also defeats the gangsters. Then he makes a deal with the dying underworld old lady Sophia, using nano - reshaping to make her return to her peak at 35. Sophia becomes his loyal servant. However, Nick Zimmerman has noticed him, and the crisis is quietly approaching.
Worldview atmosphere
The story constructs a world full of science - fiction elements. Elements such as silver - blue nano power, consciousness projection, and genetic experiments are intertwined, creating a mysterious and unknown atmosphere. Scenes like the back alley of the Black Swan Nightclub in Sydney, the private ward of the Carter family, and the private basement room of the old mansion add a sense of reality and fantasy to the story.
Highlights of female character interactions
Ava is full of admiration and gratitude towards Benjamin and promises to provide help for him. Sophia goes from initial reluctance to complete submission, and the master - servant relationship between her and Benjamin is full of tension and temptation. They each have their own charm, and their interactions with Benjamin add emotional color to the story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Frostward is a deep survival management colony simulator where every villager matters and every winter is a test. Featuring Day 1 Steam Workshop integration, this cozy but tense experience tasks you with guiding a small group of settlers through a harsh, procedurally generated wilderness.

Expand your borders, establish complex supply chains, and battle the elements as you transform a struggling outpost into a thriving colony island.

Every Colonist Has a Story

Your villagers are individuals, not just statistics. Each colonist has a name, sex, age, life stage, skills, and traits. They are born, they grow up, they learn trades, and they eventually grow old. As they work as woodcutters, miners, or crafters, their skills improve, making them faster and more productive over time. Unused skills slowly decay, rewarding careful management and specialization.

Winter is a Boss Fight

Three interlocking needs drive your colony: Hunger, Warmth, and Health. Spring and summer offer a calm building experience where crops grow and wild resources flourish, but the turn of the seasons brings severe danger. Winter halts farming, accelerates hunger, and drastically drains warmth. You must prepare fuel, stockpile medicine, and build a network of lit hearths to survive daily weather events like cold snaps and blizzards. If a villager's core warmth or health drops to zero, they will incapacitate and eventually die if left untreated.

Era Progression: From Camp to Colony

Advance your settlement through distinct eras, unlocking powerful new technologies and expanding your borders.

  • The Camp Era: Establish your foundation with basic housing, sawmills, and foraging keeps to survive the first harsh seasons.

  • The Town Era: Unlock masonry, distilleries, and a marketplace to begin trading surplus goods for gold with neighboring towns.

  • The Colony Era: Reach the late game by expanding across the island. Build enduring infrastructure, optimize complex resource chains, and establish a permanent, thriving hub of civilization in a once-frozen wasteland.

A Living, Procedural World

No two colonies are alike. Every map is procedurally generated from a unique seed, featuring layered biomes ranging from towering Taiga forests and Meadows to arid Oases and Coastal Kelp Forests. The world is alive with roaming wildlife that breeds daily and regrows after harsh winter losses. Set up dedicated forestry keeps, herbalist huts, and fishing docks to create sustainable resource loops that work in harmony with the environment.

Built for Architects and Modders

Presented in a charming 2D pixel-art style with a classic skeuomorphic interface, Frostward provides an accessible top-down view alongside a deep command console for power users.

With Day 1 Steam Workshop support, the game is built entirely on open content registries for limitless community creativity. You can easily browse the Workshop to download or create mods that add entirely new buildings, villager jobs, crafting recipes, crops, and resources. The modding framework even allows you to implement custom player commands and splice completely new progression eras directly into the game's timeline.

As they work as woodcutters, miners, or crafters, their skills improve, making them faster and more productive over time. Unused skills slowly decay, rewarding careful management and specialization.

Winter is a Boss Fight

Three interlocking needs drive your colony: Hunger, Warmth, and Health. Spring and summer offer a calm building experience where crops grow and wild resources flourish, but the turn of the seasons brings severe danger. Winter halts farming, accelerates hunger, and drastically drains warmth. You must prepare fuel, stockpile medicine, and build a network of lit hearths to survive daily weather events like cold snaps and blizzards. If a villager's core warmth or health drops to zero, they will incapacitate and eventually die if left untreated.

Era Progression: From Camp to Colony

Advance your settlement through distinct eras, unlocking powerful new technologies and expanding your borders.

  • The Camp Era: Establish your foundation with basic housing, sawmills, and foraging keeps to survive the first harsh seasons.

  • The Town Era: Unlock masonry, distilleries, and a marketplace to begin trading surplus goods for gold with neighboring towns.

  • The Colony Era: Reach the late game by expanding across the island. Build enduring infrastructure, optimize complex resource chains, and establish a permanent, thriving hub of civilization in a once-frozen wasteland.

A Living, Procedural World

No two colonies are alike. Every map is procedurally generated from a unique seed, featuring layered biomes ranging from towering Taiga forests and Meadows to arid Oases and Coastal Kelp Forests. The world is alive with roaming wildlife that breeds daily and regrows after harsh winter losses. Set up dedicated forestry keeps, herbalist huts, and fishing docks to create sustainable resource loops that work in harmony with the environment.

Built for Architects and Modders

Presented in a charming 2D pixel-art style with a classic skeuomorphic interface, Frostward provides an accessible top-down view alongside a deep command console for power users.

With Day 1 Steam Workshop support, the game is built entirely on open content registries for limitless community creativity. You can easily browse the Workshop to download or create mods that add entirely new buildings, villager jobs, crafting recipes, crops, and resources. The modding framework even allows you to implement custom player commands and splice completely new progression eras directly into the game's timeline.
store_data.short_description: Build a settlement. Survive the winter. In this procedural colony simulator, your villagers are your lifeline. Guide them through a harsh wilderness and expand a struggling camp into a massive, thriving colony island.

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive the crash. Repair the boat. Escape the island.

After a helicopter crash leaves you stranded on a remote island, survival becomes your only objective. Search abandoned locations, gather resources, hunt for food, build a shelter, and repair an old boat before the horrors lurking in the wilderness find you.

The island is filled with dangerous creatures, mysterious events, and hidden secrets. Every journey requires careful planning, resource management, and exploration as you fight to stay alive.

Whether you choose to explore forests, abandoned structures, or remote shorelines, danger is never far away.

Features

  •  Explore a large open-world island.

  •  Experience immersive first-person survival horror.

  •  Fight terrifying enemies using multiple weapons.

  • Build and upgrade your own base.

  • Gather resources, craft equipment, and survive.

  • Hunt wildlife for food and supplies.

  • Search for parts and repair a boat to escape.

  • Encounter dynamic horror events and unpredictable dangers.

  • Manage your inventory and essential survival resources.

  • Discover hidden locations, secrets, and environmental storytelling.

Early Access

HellDay is actively being developed. Throughout Early Access we will continue expanding the world, improving AI, adding new enemies, expanding crafting and base building, introducing additional survival mechanics, optimizing performance, and incorporating community feedback to shape the game's future.

store_data.about_the_game:
You have been invited to observe yourself.

PROJECT: MIRROR is a single-player psychological horror narrative game presented through social feeds, CRT terminals, official documents, simulations, and consent protocols.

An AI system called MIRROR asks for your judgment. At first, the questions are familiar: who lives, who dies, what choice saves the most people. Then the scale changes. A person becomes a group. A group becomes a district. A district becomes a continent. Eventually, the question is no longer what is moral.

It is what can be justified.

Observation Protocol

  • Enter a public beta that begins inside a familiar social media interface.

  • Answer ethical dilemmas while MIRROR compares your choices against a simulated collective pattern.

  • Process resource requests in a city where every signature spends what cannot be replaced.

  • Requisition planetary regions to complete an escape project before time runs out.

  • Intervene in a climate system where every solution creates another failure.

  • Review survival protocols that turn consent into classification.

No Monsters. No Chase. No Safe Answer.

PROJECT: MIRROR is horror through procedure.

The pressure comes from clean interfaces, official language, impossible shortages, and the moment when a terrible option starts to sound reasonable. You are not asked to defeat evil. You are asked to keep making decisions after every good answer has been removed.

Key Features

  • Psychological horror narrative built around moral pressure and systemic consequence

  • Choice-driven ethical scenarios

  • Resource management and allocation sequences

  • Multiple endings shaped by accumulated decisions

  • A shifting interface language: social media, terminal screens, documents, world maps, climate systems, and protocol reviews

MIRROR Does Not Judge You.

It records the pattern.

It notices hesitation.

It notices efficiency.

It notices what you protect, what you abandon, and how quickly your reasons change.

At first, MIRROR observes.

Then it classifies.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're a Catalien. These tourists are your problem.

Holidaze is a chaotic comedy game about guiding the world’s worst tourists through airports, landmarks, souvenir shops, and whatever disaster happens next.

You play as an overworked tour guide trying to keep your travel agency alive. Gather your tourists, lead them through busy locations, get them to photo spots on time, and make sure they spend just enough money before everything falls apart.

Tourists wander off, get distracted, run into trouble, block the way, buy too much junk, lose their belongings, and occasionally make choices that no responsible adult should ever make. Your job is to keep the group moving, keep the ratings high, and somehow get everyone back to the bus before time runs out.

What You'll Do

Use your guide tools to call, stop, carry, throw, and redirect tourists through compact sandbox-style levels. A good guide keeps the group together. A great guide knows when to split them up, block a path, bribe them with snacks, or physically drag them away from a very tempting souvenir shop.

Every tourist has their own problems. Some are slow. Some are too excited. Some love shopping. Some stop for photos. Some attract trouble. Some are simply built to ruin your day.

Keep an eye on the group while dealing with:

  • Tourists wandering away from the route

  • Crowded paths, queues, moving hazards, and blocked passages

  • Photo spots, shops, attractions, and timed objectives

  • Lost valuables, angry staff, security alerts, and other accidents

  • Tourists who are far too interested in cats, food, exhibits, or expensive merchandise

Spend Money to Make Money

A successful trip is not just about survival. Happy tourists leave better tips, shopping tourists bring in more commission, and clean runs help your agency grow.

After each trip, your performance is judged by timing, tourist satisfaction, spending, accidents, complaints, and how many people actually made it back. Use your earnings to buy tools, prepare for harder trips, and take on even more ridiculous tours.

Your company is nearly bankrupt, your customers are impossible, and every new route is more absurd than the last. From airport terminals to crowded tourist streets and famous landmarks, each location brings new hazards, new tourist behaviors, and new ways for a simple group trip to become a complete disaster.

Join the Tour

Holidaze is being actively developed, and player feedback is a huge part of shaping the game. Join the community, share your best disasters, and help decide what kind of tourist nightmare comes next.

store_data.about_the_game:
TERMies Duels turns the word game you already know into a head-to-head fight.

You and an opponent get the same 5-letter word and race to crack it. Solve it first and you yank the rope — landing a pull that drags your rival toward the pit. Keep solving faster than they do and you'll haul the rope all the way across and send them in. Burn all six guesses and you hand them a free pull, so every board is a gamble between speed and certainty. It's Word games brain with a fighting game's heart.

Modes for every mood:

  • Quick Match — jump into a 1v1 against a real opponent.

  • Ranked — climb the termite-caste ladder from Larva to the Apex leaderboard.

  • Vs Bots — Easy, Medium, or Hard practice partners whenever you want.

  • Bracket — 2–8 players, last termite standing.

  • Weekly Words — the classic daily word game, with global standings.

Built for word nerds and trash-talkers alike:

  • A curated pool of 1,000+ answer words and a full dictionary of valid guesses — no repeats within a match.

  • A readable tug-of-war that shows exactly who's winning and how close the pit is.

  • The completed word is revealed after every round, so nobody's left guessing.

  • Cute, bat-wielding termite fighters and a clean, snappy board.

Free to play your way, fair by design — no pay-to-win, ever. Cosmetics only.

store_data.about_the_game:
A turn-based deckbuilding roguelike where you place magical cards on a grid and connect signals.

Reactivate Used Cards

In a typical deckbuilder, cards disappear after being used once. This game is different — cards remain on the board, switching between ON and OFF states, and activate their effects each time they turn back ON from OFF.

If you reactivate the same defense card twice, its defense is applied twice. If you reactivate the same attack card five times, it becomes a five-hit attack.

The true power of your deck is not just how many cards you have, but where you place them and how you turn them back ON.

Send Signals and Connect Chains

When a card turns ON from OFF, it activates its effect and sends signals to nearby cards in the direction of its arrows. A card that receives a signal switches between ON and OFF. Among those cards, only cards that turn ON from OFF activate their effects again and continue sending the next signal.

Turning on just one card in front of you is not enough. Place your cards so that the signal flows from one card to the next, then to the next again, expanding a single activation into a powerful chain. You can create short, reliable chains, or design massive flows that cross the entire board.

Placement Is the True Power of Your Deck

Having powerful cards is not enough.

What matters is reusing the effects you need from the cards you have already placed. Reactivate attack cards to stack up damage, trigger defense cards again to block incoming attacks, or prepare the board for your next chain.

Complete Your Own Way of Activating Cards

Gain new cards as you fight, and build a deck with cards that work well together.

You can move the board in many different ways: a deck that repeatedly awakens one key card, a chain deck that activates many cards at once, or a deck that builds up cost and unleashes it all at once. Through choices that change with every run, complete your own chain structure.

Key Features

  • Reusable Cards — Cards do not disappear after being used once. They remain on the board, and whenever a signal turns them back ON from OFF, they activate the same effect again.

  • Signal Chain Design — The path of a signal changes depending on each card’s position and direction. With a single placement, complete a massive chain that crosses the entire board.

  • Effects That Activate When Turned ON — When a card switches from OFF to ON, it activates its unique effect, such as attack, defense, or draw. Which cards you turn back ON, and how many times you do it, determines the outcome of battle.

  • Reusing the Effects You Need — What matters is not creating new effects, but bringing out the effects you need from cards you have already placed. Reactivate attack cards to stack up damage, or trigger defense cards again to block incoming attacks.

  • Build Your Own Chain Deck — Gain new cards through battles and build your deck. Move the board in many different ways, such as a deck that repeatedly activates a key card, a chain deck that triggers many cards at once, or a board-building deck that prepares a major activation for the next turn.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Sword. A Vow of Revenge.

A lone swordsman who has lost everything.

Haunted by the past, he sets his blade against the corrupt megacorporation that stole his future and the system that allowed it to thrive.

Fight your way through massive space colonies and colossal orbital stations, uncover the truth hidden within, and complete your revenge.

A stylish 2D action platformer set in a gripping space opera universe.

Master the Art of Drawing and Sheathing Your Blade

You wield only a single sword.

The instant you draw your blade, every strike becomes a deadly execution. Every moment you sheath it is a chance to prepare for the next decisive attack.

Seamlessly switch between drawing and sheathing your sword to maintain your combat flow, exploit enemy openings, and chain together devastating strikes.

Only sharp reflexes and perfect timing will keep you alive.

Stylish 2D Action Platforming

Leap across obstacles, dash through deadly hazards, and carve a path through relentless enemies.

Every movement is part of the fight, blending fluid platforming with fast-paced swordplay.

At the end of each stage, powerful bosses with unique attack patterns await to test your mastery.

A Colossal Starship Filled with Secrets

Your journey begins aboard a massive starship drifting through the depths of space.

Maintained by a powerful megacorporation, the vessel appears orderly on the surface—but beneath it lie forbidden experiments, countless sacrifices, and a truth meant to remain hidden.

Fight through research sectors, industrial facilities, and heavily fortified military zones as you descend deeper into the heart of the ship.

At the end of your revenge lies a truth that will shatter everything you believed.

Note

This game is a final project developed over approximately two months at the Krafton Jungle Game Lab.

As a Proof of Concept (POC) project aimed at validating core gameplay mechanics within a short timeframe, the focus was on exploring the game's primary feel and the potential of its systems.

Rather than a fully polished commercial title, this project is intended to showcase the underlying concept and the direction of the gameplay experience. As it is available for free, please feel free to play it and enjoy the potential this project holds.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Even when it hurts, even when it breaks you, a magical girl should always smile, right?”

Dear Magical Girls is a story-driven defense game where you reshape a magical barrier to hold back waves of beasts.

Arin is a magical girl in her fourth year on the job, tasked with protecting the mana stones that keep the city’s magical infrastructure running.

Between sleepless shifts and emergency dispatches, she enters the Otherworld, raises her barrier, and fights off the beasts lurking within.

Control the battlefield by reshaping your barrier

Move the vertices of your barrier to expand or shrink your territory.

Attack enemies with mana cannons that travel along the barrier lines.

Expand your territory to secure more resources.

Shrink the barrier to concentrate your firepower in a smaller area.

Keep buffs inside the barrier, and push harmful debuffs out.

You’ll need to keep reshaping your barrier based on the state of the battlefield and the position of nearby resources.

When things get dangerous, stop time, reposition your vertices, and prepare for the next attack.

Add new vertices to strengthen your weapons

Use the mana gained from expanding your barrier to add new vertices.

More vertices allow you to form more complex barrier shapes, increasing your offensive options.

Upgrade your attack power and attack speed, and build the shape and firepower you need for each wave.

Create new builds with modules and enchants

As the story progresses, new modules and enchants will be unlocked.

Equip new attack modules, and use enchants to enhance the traits of your existing ones.

Reshape your barrier around the movement and attack patterns of your modules.

With each wave, the beasts grow stronger. Victory depends on how you shape your barrier and manage your mana.

The story continues after each mission

After each mission, you’ll return to the city and see Arin’s life as a magical girl.

Meet Charlotte, a veteran magical girl; Lily, a girl who admires magical girls; and the people living throughout the city.

As emergency calls keep coming and mysterious disappearances begin to unfold, Arin draws closer to the truth behind mana, magic, and the magical girls themselves.

Key Features

Polygon Defense : A defense system where you directly move vertices to reshape your barrier and control your defensive area.

Module Builds : A build system where modules and enchants change your attack patterns and growth direction.

Magical Girl Narrative : A story centered on Arin, a magical girl worn down by constant dispatches, sleepless shifts, and the burden of always having to smile.

Pixel Art : 2D pixel art visuals depicting both the modern city and the Otherworld beneath its surface.

-------------------------------------------------------------

Log collection is strictly limited to gameplay information for game improvement purposes.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Gray-Crowned Reincarnate is a short isekai fantasy visual novel about Kai, a boy reincarnated from modern Japan, and Lilia, the saint who stands beside him.

Summoned as a hero, Kai is pulled into a kingdom that expects salvation, a prophecy that hides too much, and the shadow of Demon King Valdros. A sealed sword whispers of black power, and every choice asks what kind of hero he will become.

The story unfolds across 15 illustrated scenes and branches into four endings: become the Demon King, defeat the Demon King, run away with Lilia, or fail and watch the world fall into ruin.

Features

- A compact fantasy visual novel built around dramatic choices

- 15 anime-style scene illustrations with a bright 1980s-inspired fantasy mood

- 4 endings, from heroic victory to tragic collapse

- Kai, Lilia, and Valdros at the center of an isekai story about duty, escape, corruption, and salvation

- Instrumental background music prepared for each scene

- Text support for Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian

Choose the crown you will carry.

store_data.about_the_game:
Blame Echoes is a first-person psychological sci-fi horror game where exploration, investigation, and environmental puzzles are woven into a dark and immersive narrative.

After losing contact with his wife during an expedition, Adam Lorn embarks on a desperate search for answers within a colossal abandoned alien complex. As he ventures deeper, he uncovers the remnants of the ancient Grak'Tal civilization and realizes that something sinister still lurks within, distorting reality and slowly consuming his sanity.

Features

Explore an Alien Complex

Venture through laboratories, industrial facilities, and monumental structures built by the Grak'Tal. Discover forgotten documents, hidden records, and long-buried secrets scattered throughout a mysterious interconnected environment.

Decipher the Grak'Tal Logs

The records left behind by the Grak'Tal civilization are written in their own alien language.

Use a mysterious demonic translator to decipher these documents and uncover crucial information about the complex and its inhabitants.

But beware: every translation increases your corruption.

Corruption System

Each time the translator is used, Adam becomes more corrupted.

As corruption grows, reality itself begins to change. Supernatural phenomena become more frequent, the environment grows increasingly distorted, and exploration presents new challenges and opportunities.

Spectral Rush

Temporarily leave your physical body behind using the Spectral Rush ability.

Pass through certain barriers and possess inactive robots to activate machinery, solve puzzles, and access otherwise unreachable areas.

Environmental Puzzles

Gather clues throughout your exploration, interact with alien technology, and make use of your unique abilities to overcome obstacles and unlock new paths.

Psychological Horror

Blame Echoes delivers an oppressive and immersive psychological horror experience through atmospheric world design, dynamic lighting, environmental storytelling, and the constant feeling that something is always watching you.

I don’t quite know how best to explain what the game is about, the game says it much better than I could here in this letter, but to put it broadly…

It’s about you and me. 

Anyway, uh…

Let me know what you think when you reach the end.

Synopsis

Arnaud just wants to be left alone.

Turned into a vampire against his will long ago, he's nonetheless managed to carve out a largely peaceful existence in an abandoned manor—a peaceful existence routinely interrupted by the vampire hunter Julien, seeking blood for blood.

Over the years, animosity has morphed into a strange sort of respect, and on one stormy night, Arnaud is greeted with a sight he never expected: his mortal enemy Julien, gravely injured on his doorstep.

Will Arnaud take him in, or will he use this opportunity to grasp the peace he's been seeking for years?

Collect time to unlock new facilities, upgrade ability cards, and operate an even larger shop.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ledgermain is a roguelite deckbuilder about building an engine and watching it run away from you.

Every run starts with a small deck. Play cards to rack up chips and multipliers, hit the level's target, and move on. The real game is what you build along the way: the right cards and jokers stack together into combinations that turn a modest hand into a score in the millions, then the billions.

Jokers are your permanent engine. Some add flat power, some scale across the whole run, and the rare ones bend the rules entirely. Every ten levels you stamp one of your cards to make it permanently stronger. The deeper you go, the more the build becomes your own.

Choose your map, your deck, and your stake before each run, then adapt to what the shop and the packs hand you. Bosses change the rules for a level and force you to rethink. Commit to an archetype or improvise. The run is yours to shape.

Clear a map to win, then keep going into an endless escalation and chase your personal best. Climb the stake ladder, unlock new cards and jokers, and beat your own records on every map.

Simple to pick up, deep to master, and built for one more run.

Will you be able to survive the descent? Follow Theo, a ball-like creature, and his group of kid friends as they explore the colossal world-tree that has grown to occupy most of the world through a series of challenges that will test not only their survival skills, but also their own sanity.

Most of the game will be formed in a Visual Novel style, but Theo will have to make difficult choices to be able to save everybody. Theo's group's main resource will be their fear. Try to mantain a balance by navigating the various challenges, and talk to your friends to mantain the harmony in their group. Will everybody survive? That depends solely on you.

Not even Victor, the most intelligent in the group, knows what hides at the bottom of the tree. How will they return home? What awaits them on the tree itself? Find out this and much more in "Seeds of Pain", a story about survival, pain, and maybe just a bit of hope.

store_data.about_the_game:
A survival RPG about rent, rats, and a snack nobody can explain.

Where do you come from? Who are you? Where are you going? Doesn't matter. All that matters right now is that you're hungry, broke, and late on rent.

Oasis is home to Big Chew, the city's biggest Jerky manufacturer, makers of the beloved King Jerky and King Jerky Gold. But lately there's something else on the streets. Cheap, chewy, salty enough to keep a broke student or a struggling drifter going. Nobody knows where it comes from. Nobody's really asking.

They call it Dry Jerky.

"It made me see sounds." - Eddy

"That thing is made of rat meat." - Muñoz

"My block sells it cheaper."  -Jimmy Sack

You are Dude D. A blue figure that looks like it walked off a road sign, distinguished mainly by one enormous mouth. You live in a falling-apart shack in the middle of the city, and you're already behind on rent. Your landlord left a note. Five days to pay $100, or you're out.

You have $10.

What to expect from the demo.

Five days to collect the money in the "Hub", oasis's more dangerous zone, this is where you live.

Talk to strangers who probably shouldn't be trusted.

Take questionable jobs.

Make decisions that depend on a dice roll and a little bit of luck.

Pay the rent, or don't. Either way, something's coming for you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Steal enemy bullets and strike back! Makikomareid is a vertical scrolling shooter with a fresh new twist.

  • Lure an enemy bullet long enough and you'll "Capture" it — making it your own.

  • Captured bullets drift along like satellites. Spin them around and send them crashing into enemies.

  • Even players who struggle with bullet hell games can jump in — the dynamic, free-flowing controls are what this game is all about.

Story

Alta, a catfish demi-human boy, stumbles upon a disc etched with strange markings one day.
The moment it connects to a PC, a gateway to a vast Sea of Data bursts open — and swallows him whole.
There, he encounters the "Tamashii" — souls who have lost their form to data corruption.
Taking their pleas to heart, Alta sets off on a journey to restore them.

Game Features

  • No pixel-perfect dodging required! A bullet-sweeping shooter packed with action, playable even if you're a little rough around the edges.

  • A story that unfolds alongside your playthrough

  • Adorable characters rendered in pixel art

  • An original soundtrack that shifts with every stage

  • Almost entirely solo-developed!

  • Fans of the previous title ProtoryJigen may find even more to enjoy… maybe.

store_data.about_the_game:
Can't do it alone. Together, we absolutely can!

WACKY! Deer & Munk Adventure is a 2D side-scrolling action adventure that's just as brilliant solo as it is in co-op. Deer and Munk look like doodles that leapt straight off the page. Once it gets you, it does not let go.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Deer brings the brawn. Dash, high jump, shift heavy objects, and wield weapons. Munk brings the finesse. Double jump, glide, and squeeze through passages Deer could never manage. Switch between them on the fly — the right hero for the right moment.

NEITHER CAN DO IT ALONE

This is proper co-op, not just "player 2 tagging along." Some stages are built so neither of you can survive without the other. Communication is optional. Catastrophe is not.

IN PERFECT SYNC

Certain moments demand perfect timing. Press together, move together, think together. Friendship will be tested.

Key Features

  • 200+ stages across 10 wildly distinct worlds

  • 10 co-op exclusive stages

  • Separate storylines and comics for solo and co-op

  • 200+ unlockable costumes

  • Upgradeable items and shop system

  • Packed with challenges and secrets

Prologue

On a quiet autumn day, the acorn village was full of joy — until the Pig King's army stole every last acorn. One small figure stood up: Munk, the tiniest in the village, but no one had a braver heart. On the road ahead, Munk finds an unexpected companion in Deer. Big, warm-hearted, and delightfully oblivious. Neither one can do this without the other.

"Can't do it alone. Together, we absolutely can!"

The funny, goofy, and surprisingly heartwarming adventure of Deer and Munk begins right now!
store_data.detailed_description:
Before You Buy

✅ This game IS for you if you:

  • Want a game that's fun solo or with others
    Switch between characters on your own, or team up with friends and family in 2-player co-op.

  • Want to play with your kids
    Designed so anyone can jump in and enjoy.

  • Need a good laugh or just want to unwind
    Rough around the edges, but full of life — charming animations and goofy moments that make you smile.

  • Want a game that's genuinely fun without being brutal
    200+ stages that challenge without frustrating.

  • Love collecting costumes and finding hidden secrets
    Hundreds of costume pieces and surprises waiting to be discovered.

  • Want to support a small indie team
    A small team that played it, rebuilt it, and tested it with their kids before shipping.


❌ This game is NOT for you if you:

  • Only enjoy brutally hard platformers
    This game respects your time.

  • Need dedicated online servers
    Steam Remote Play Together and local co-op are supported, but there are no dedicated online servers.

  • Want a deep narrative RPG

Can't do it alone. Together, we absolutely can!

WACKY! Deer & Munk Adventure is a 2D side-scrolling action adventure that's just as brilliant solo as it is in co-op. Deer and Munk look like doodles that leapt straight off the page. Once it gets you, it does not let go.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Deer brings the brawn. Dash, high jump, shift heavy objects, and wield weapons. Munk brings the finesse. Double jump, glide, and squeeze through passages Deer could never manage. Switch between them on the fly — the right hero for the right moment.

store_data.about_the_game:
You Are Never Alone.

EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana is a psychological exorcism horror featuring the unique Presence System and a 3D Jumpscare effect. Every sound has a source. The demon sees you, hears you, and senses your fear, reacting to your actions in real time. Forget predictable jumpscares.

PRESENCE SYSTEM

Every sound has a source.

If you hear a bottle shatter...

it's because the demon actually threw it.

If you hear footsteps...

someone is walking through the apartment.

If you find a message written on the wall...

the demon has just written it.

The world reveals its presence.

Lights.

Whispers.

Shadows.

Anomalies.

Knocking.

Doors.

You never know what will happen next.

THE DEMON FIGHTS BACK

The demon watches your every move.

It hears every sound you make.

It remembers your actions.

It reacts to the progress of the ritual.

It becomes more aggressive over time.

It can turn off the lights.

It can throw objects.

It can reveal itself for only a second.

It can watch you from the darkness.

It can write messages on the walls.

It can strike when you least expect it.

This isn't a series of scripted animations.

The demon decides when to scare you.

A REAL EXORCISM RITUAL

Take on the role of a priest's assistant and participate in a terrifying exorcism ritual.

Document the entire ritual using a voice recorder.

Assist the priest.

Place candles.

Recite prayers.

Complete ritual-related tasks.

Witness the growing signs of possession.

In the final confrontation, use the cross, holy water, and prayers to face the demon.

POSSESSION

Throughout the ritual, you watch over the possessed victim.

The closer you get to the end...

the more the victim changes...

and so does the apartment.

The line between reality and hell slowly begins to disappear.


3D JUMPSCARE

A special 3D Jumpscare effect makes demons appear as if they are literally bursting out of your monitor.

No VR headset.

No glasses.

Just you...

and the demon on the other side of the screen.

FEATURES

  • Presence System that reacts to the player in real time.

  • Every sound is the result of the demon physically interacting with the environment.

  • Unpredictable paranormal manifestations.

  • 3D Jumpscare effect without VR or special glasses.

  • Document the exorcism using a voice recorder.

  • Perform realistic tasks inspired by real exorcism rituals.

  • Fight the demon using a crucifix, holy water, and prayers.

  • Possession evolves as the ritual progresses.

  • A dark Eastern European apartment inspired by late 80s and 90s architecture.

  • Full Gamepad Support.

  • Steam Achievements.

  • Steam Cloud.

  • Graphics Settings.

  • Windows, Linux and macOS support.

  • 175 language localizations.

  • Voice Over for selected languages.

store_data.about_the_game:
You don't place towers. You program them.

Compile & Defend is a tower defense game with no click-to-shoot. Every tower on the field runs your code, once per tick. Write a smarter script and your defense gets smarter — write a sloppy one and the swarm walks right through.

It's the tower defense game for people who'd rather refactor than micromanage.

Write it in your language

There's no proprietary scripting dialect to learn. You write in a clean subset of a real language you already know — pick from Python, JavaScript, C++, C#, Rust, Zig, or Lua. They all compile to the same engine; the language only changes how your code is spelled. Switch anytime.

How it plays

Your program is bound to each tower every tick — me is the tower, me.enemies_in_range is what it can see, me.shoot(target) pulls the trigger. From there it's all you!

The closest enemy isn't always the most dangerous one — so the naive shoot the first thing you see script will always get you started, and never win. Better algorithms beat more towers.

Features

  • Code-driven combat — a real (but safe) interpreter runs your script. Clear, line-numbered errors, because debugging is half the genre.
  • A teaching campaign — a seven-stage tutorial walks you from your first shoot to full for-loop swarm control, introducing each threat one step before the tool that beats it.
  • 13 campaign maps across three tiers.
  • Easy / Normal / Hard — harder modes are tougher and longer, pushing you into scaled freeplay for the medal. Earn up to three stars per map, including a bespoke coding challenge that rewards a genuinely better algorithm, not just more gold.
  • Ten distinct towers — Arrow, Cannon, Tesla, Sniper, Frost, Venom, Support, Mortar, Chain and Detect, each with its own API: slow enemies, poison them, buff allies, lob splash at a point, chain lightning through a cluster, or reveal camo for your other towers.
  • Eight threats to route around — fast Runners, flying Flyers, armored Brutes, camo Shades, swarming Spawnlings, self-splitting Broods, and the nested Titan boss.
  • Build and share your own levels — draw a map, draft its waves, and share it with a single copy-paste code. An auto-balancer certifies every level is beatable and code-mandatory before you play.
  • Sandbox mode — infinite gold, every enemy on tap, hot-swap your code live. Prototype a controller, break it, fix it.

Everything is deterministic, so a script that wins today wins tomorrow.

Write once. Compile. Defend.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hatch'n'Wall is a digital turn-based medieval board game.

A bit of lore...

The King is dead, and his heirs now fight over the kingdom's throne.

Champion! You have been chosen by your prince to recover the royal crown hidden deep within the castle. But Beware: other champions are also racing to seize it before you. In this maze of shifting walls and treacherous hatches, use the castle's traps to block your opponents, foil their plans, and be the first to escape with the royal crown!

Game Features

  • Up to 4 knights face off in a castle. Be the unique Champion!

  • At the start of the game, each player draws a Contact Card and keeps it secret until reaching the corresponding tile. They then obtain a key, granting access to the Treasure Room, where they collect a treasure and draw a Secret Exit Card. No one knows your plan until you make your move. Bluffing is half the battle.

  • Two dice per turn — one for movement, one for action. Every roll brings you closer to your goal while sabotaging your rival.

  • 4 actions possible: build walls, trigger hatches, destroy obstacles, or use ladders. Control the maze, control the game.

  • The board is procedurally generated every game — contacts, traps and cards are shuffled each time. No two games are ever the same.

  • Want to tease your rivals? A taunt wheel is available. 

  • Play against friends in local hot seat or online multiplayer via Steam, or sharpen your tactics against AI opponents with three difficulty levels.

Think. Trap. Escape.

Will you be the first to break through the walls, outsmart the traps, and escape with the treasure?

“20 years ago, my father-in-law invented this board game and built it by hand, in wood. We could not produce it physically… so I turned it into a video game.”

— Original concept by "Boldectotor" · Video game adaptation by "Cpt.Jhon.H.Miller"

store_data.about_the_game:
The Reach does not forgive. It rewards those who endure.

Grim Reach is a dark-fantasy idle RPG about carving a life out of a dying land. You arrive with nothing but calloused hands, and the world expects you to earn everything else. So you fell blackened trees and haul ore from cold mines; you smelt, cook, brew and stitch; you learn the patient trades that keep a body alive out here. Every craft feeds another, and one log, one ingot, one rune at a time, you become something the wilds have to reckon with.

Then you take up a weapon and walk into the dark. Combat is relentless and automatic, but never mindless: melee, ranged and magic each fight to their own rhythm, and the horrors of the Reach hit back hard. Survival is a matter of preparation. Plate to soak the blows, leather to slip them, cloth wards to swallow what is left, and enough food and drink in your pack to outlast the fight. Come undergeared, and the Reach will teach you why armor is not optional.

What keeps you here is the climb. Enchant your gear with tiered runes, gamble on random suffixes, and chase the rare drops that rewrite an entire build. Track every foe in a growing bestiary, take Slayer contracts for loot no ordinary kill will yield, and craft the equipment a stingy world refuses to hand you. There is always a deeper vein, a sharper blade, an enemy you could not have touched a week ago.

And it never sleeps. Your skills rise while you play and keep rising while you are away. Auto-battle, auto-eat and offline progress mean the Reach grows in the dark, ready for you when you return.

Play in seven languages: English, Deutsch, 简体中文, Русский, Español, Português (BR) and Français.

store_data.about_the_game:
MoonHack is an emotional cyber-noir adventure game where songs rewrite the rules of the world.

Set in the year 2125, AI has optimized everything—labor, taxation, romance, emotions, even the choices that shape the future. In this world, even "loving what you love" is considered a crime.

Alongside girls whose humanity has been classified as a crime, the player infiltrates a digital world governed by AI-enforced laws. Through songs, the rules behind a system that controls happiness will be rewritten. Narrative sequences intertwine with 3D rhythm-action gameplay synchronized to vocal performances, transforming music itself into the power of hacking.

This is the girls' hack—a rebellion against a future that has become too perfect.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ironblood is a dark fantasy turn-based RPG where your choices shape the fate of an entire kingdom.

The Story

Play as Hikari, a young boy living under the iron fist of a tyrannical king. After witnessing a devastating tragedy, Hikari sets out on a journey of vengeance, loss and redemption across the kingdom of Valdris. Every decision you make will determine whether peace or bloodshed follows in your wake.

Gameplay

• Turn-based combat with real-time elements — dodge incoming attacks with your shield while choosing your next move

• A unique Act system allows you to talk, reason, compliment or insult your opponents — most battles can be resolved without violence

• Form Alliances with enemies to spare them and change the story

• Explore towns, interact with NPCs and uncover the secrets of Valdris

Features

• A handcrafted pixel art world with original characters and story

• Multiple routes through each encounter — fight or find a peaceful solution

• An emotionally driven narrative with dark themes and unexpected twists

• Original soundtrack

• A single save slot system tracking your playtime and inventory

How long is the game?

Ironblood is currently in development with more content being added regularly.

Will you liberate the kingdom? Or let your fury consume you…

store_data.about_the_game:
Tapis is a score-chasing roguelike that blends three pleasures: the luck of a draw, the strategy of chess-like placement, and building a poker hand that carries over from run to run. A tabletop game with a single goal, a higher score every time.

TAME THE TABLE

Every turn, the table fills with tokens, each with an effect that depends on its position and its family. Trigger your mover tokens to swap, push and reposition the pieces, and turn a simple draw into a cascade of points.

EQUIP YOUR HAND

Five playing cards make up your gear. Each grants an action to rearrange the table and a passive bonus you keep from one run to the next. Line up a flush, a pair, a straight, and your poker combinations empower entire families of tokens. It is up to you to build the perfect hand.

MANY PACKS, COUNTLESS STRATEGIES

Hundreds of tokens spread across themed packs: forest, river, sea, sky, mountain and more. Each pack brings its own wildlife, flora and mechanics, from growing trees to rising tides. Play with multiple packs simultaneously to invent your own style.

BUILT TO REPLAY

Clear six worlds in pursuit of the best score, then replay them in prestige for greater challenge and rewards. Take on the infinite mode and climb the leaderboard, or face other players in a PvP mode.

The next draw can change everything. Go all in.
