store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Market at Moonfall is a medieval fantasy market-management game where every merchant you welcome brings new opportunities—and potentially new dangers.

By day, you interview unusual sellers, review their goods, weigh their risks, and decide who deserves a place in your growing market. A friendly baker might bring steady income and earn the town’s trust, while a mysterious relic dealer could offer greater profits at the cost of attracting something far less welcome after sunset.

Once you have chosen your merchants, the market is yours to shape. Place and upgrade stalls, build paths, add decorations, improve your equipment, and prepare defenses before night arrives. Your layout matters. A poorly protected seller can become an easy target, while a carefully planned market can survive even the most dangerous attacks.

When darkness falls, the consequences of your daytime decisions come looking for you.

Fight alongside your defenses as monsters enter the market, target your merchants, damage stalls, steal gold, and threaten everything you have built. Repair the damage, collect your earnings, strengthen your character, and prepare to make even harder choices the following day.

Your sellers are more than sources of income. They have different personalities, traits, relationships, loyalties, requests, and rivalries. Supporting the right merchants can create powerful combinations, but ignoring their needs may cause tension—or convince them to leave your market entirely.

Build Your Own Market

Arrange stalls, roads, lighting, decorations, and defensive structures to create a market that is both profitable and capable of surviving the night.

Choose Who You Trust

Interview a rotating selection of merchants and investigate their paperwork, rumors, behavior, and merchandise. You can review every applicant before making your decision, but choosing nobody will damage the town’s confidence in your leadership.

Defend Your Decisions

Different sellers attract different threats. Prepare for charging beasts, thieves, ranged attackers, armored monsters, cursed creatures, and larger assaults as the campaign progresses.

Grow Stronger

Upgrade your weapons, armor, health, movement, market operations, defenses, and seller capacity. Earn gold and Renown to shape your playstyle and prepare for increasingly dangerous nights.

Manage a Living Roster

Complete seller requests, improve loyalty, discover rivalries, form beneficial partnerships, and decide which merchants are worth protecting when space becomes limited.

Talk to the Duck

A duck wanders the market during the day.

Sometimes it says something kind.

Sometimes it knows things it should not know.

Talking to it is optional.

Probably.

Build a market worth visiting. Protect it from what follows. Decide how much danger you are willing to invite through the gates—and whether the extra profit was really worth it.

4918850.name: Lord of Lords: Dawn of the King

store_data.about_the_game:
When the hunt is over, the hound is thrown away. He learned that in the Amazon.

Lord of Lords: Dawn of the King is a dark fantasy visual novel adapted from the 475-chapter Korean web novel epic Lord of Lords by Wolwoon — an official adaptation commissioned by the original author.





Chansung, 27, is the legendary platoon leader of the Blue Dragon Battalion, Korea's most secret special forces unit. An orphan who clawed his way up from the streets, he trusted only two things: his men, and the chain of command.



Then a reconnaissance mission deep in the Amazon turns out to be a death trap — set by his own commander. One by one, his men give their lives to keep him breathing, and Chansung learns exactly what happens to a hunting dog once the hunt is over.



At the edge of death, an otherworldly being makes him an offer — and he falls through a rift between dimensions.



He awakens in a world of Gates — a brutal ecosystem where "Gaters" earn points, conquer gates, and fight for standing among demons, elves, dwarves, and monsters. And Chansung carries a trait almost no one has ever held: Lord — the power to bind the strong to his name.



Betrayal made him a stray. The Gates will make him a king.



  • The original saga, reborn as a game — Not a novel pasted onto a screen: an official adaptation, restructured and paced for play, told through character staging and expressions, 100+ illustrated CG scenes, and an original score of 60+ music, ambience, and sound cues.
  • Choices carved into your Chronicle — Decisions at major turning points quietly shape your route, trust, and reputation. Every major resolve is recorded in your Chronicle — and together they decide which of the multiple endings your story reaches.
  • Light LitRPG progression — Points, gates, traits, and named companions, systemized straight from the novel's own rules.
  • A dark lord's tale — Betrayal, survival, revenge, and conquest. No power without a price.
  • Premium and complete — A single-purchase, single-player experience. No gacha, no stamina, no microtransactions.




Chansung — The Betrayed Soldier
Orphan, soldier, legend of the Blue Dragon Battalion — and a hunting dog discarded by the men he served. In the world of Gates he holds the near-mythical trait Lord, the power to make the strong kneel and rise with him. Calm, blunt, and merciless to traitors, he rebuilds from nothing: first a squad, then an army, then a throne.


Celline — The First Companion
An elf-blooded archmage of Gate E-398, and the finest magic user of her world. She is the first to swear herself to Chansung as his companion — her magic carries his earliest battles, and her quiet, unwavering devotion becomes something he never expected to have again: someone to protect.


Baljak — The Strongest Vassal
A Hero-grade ogre of Gate E-318 who all but conquered its ogres, trolls, and elves alone. Four meters of scarred muscle, magic-resistant hide, and a club the size of a tree — bound and named by Chansung, he becomes the most terrifying weapon in his lord's arsenal. He cannot speak, but he never misunderstands an order.


Keirin — The Guide
A Great General of the demon king Satan, and the reason Chansung's second life begins at all. On a whim — or something more — she pulls a dying soldier from the edge of death and sends him through the Gate with a guidebook and a priceless activation talisman. Capricious, unbothered, and strangely fond of one particular human.


Arpetia — The Administrator
The demon administrator of neutral Zone 216, where new Gaters come to register for their point dispensers. Devastatingly beautiful and casually sadistic, she treats overeager rookies as entertainment. The man who withstands her allure without flinching earns something far more dangerous than her wrath: her interest.



From a discarded soldier to the beginning of a true lord. Play the story as it was reborn for the screen, make the choices that matter, and take the first step toward the throne.

Wishlist Lord of Lords: Dawn of the King — and be there when the Gate opens.

content_descriptors.notes:
Lord of Lords: Dawn of the King is a dark fantasy visual novel with mature themes. The story includes betrayal, war, revenge, political violence, death, and survival under extreme circumstances.

Violence is depicted mainly through text narration, sound effects, and non-explicit artwork. Players may encounter descriptions of combat, killing, blood, bodily injury, corpses, battlefield deaths, and emotional trauma related to the loss of allies.

There is no explicit sexual content, no depiction of sexual assault, no drug abuse, no real-money gambling, and no online user interaction.

store_data.about_the_game:
Start unknown. Earn every booking. Build your legacy.

Pro Wrestling: The Ascent is a single-player professional wrestling career simulation where you create a wrestler and work your way through the wrestling world one opportunity at a time.

Begin with no reputation, no regular bookings, and no guarantee that a promoter will remember your name. Train your skills, manage your body, accept the right work, and prove you can be trusted when the pressure is on.

There is no fixed path to success. A great match can lead to repeat work, stronger opponents, title opportunities, and bigger promotions. A poor performance, missed booking, injury, or bad decision can slow your career down just as quickly.

BUILD YOUR CAREER

Shape the wrestler you want to become.

Develop your physical ability, ring craft, wrestling style, promo work, and presence across a detailed skill system. Build yourself into a technical worker, an explosive high flyer, a hard-hitting brawler, a reliable all-rounder, or a performer who can command the room before the bell even rings.

Your strengths influence the opportunities you receive. Your weaknesses can become the difference between getting another booking and being overlooked.

BOOKINGS

Promotions do not book wrestlers just to fill a card.

Review offers, decide which opportunities to accept, and learn what each company expects from you. Every promotion has its own culture, standards, priorities, and approach to wrestling.

Some bookers value safe, dependable workers. Others want athletic spectacle, crowd reactions, strong personalities, or wrestlers who can deliver under pressure.

Earn repeat work, move up the card, and prove you belong in bigger matches.

IN THE RING

Matches are more than a result screen.

Enter live match situations where you must make key decisions as the match develops. Read the crowd, work with your opponent, manage your body, and decide when to play it safe or take a bigger risk.

The pre-match brief matters. Once the bell rings, you need to trust your instincts, keep the match together, and deliver when it counts.

Your choices can affect the crowd, your physical condition, the outcome of the match, and the way the promotion sees you afterwards.

FINANCE

Wrestling is a career, not just a performance.

Track your match pay, bonuses, travel, training, gear, and recovery costs as you build a sustainable life in the business.

Spend your earnings on new ring gear, vehicles, homes, recovery equipment, career services, and long-term investments. Improve your quality of life, strengthen your presentation, recover more effectively, and potentially build toward owning your own promotion.

Bigger opportunities can bring better money, but they also bring greater pressure, tougher opponents, and higher expectations. Every purchase matters, and how you manage your earnings can shape the direction of your career.

MAKE YOUR NAME

The wrestling world is not one ladder. It is a network of promotions with different styles, standards, champions, and opportunities.

Learn who runs each company, understand what they value, see where you stand, and find the promotions that suit your style. Some are proving grounds for hungry new talent. Others expect polished workers who can be trusted in meaningful spots from the moment they arrive.

Build your reputation, earn contender status, chase championships, and become a wrestler promotions want to build around.

Start unknown. Work your way up. Make every match count.

store_data.about_the_game:
The world is going dark, one light at a time.

There were twelve lights in the world. One day, the first went out — and only then did we realize something was extinguishing them, one by one. You are the master of a guild standing at the edge of that dying world. Recruit the desperate, send them into the abyss, and hold back the end for one more day.

Guild's Requiem is a dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelike that fuses tactical card combat with guild management. Every expedition is a gamble: the heroes who march into the dark may not come back.

Command a party. Master the cards.

  • Party-based card combat — Lead your guild master plus a party of heroes, each with their own deck and role: warriors, mages, clerics, rogues and more.

  • Chain your combos — Stack hits on a single target to trigger Chain bonuses (Chain x3 = +50% damage). Read the enemy's intent and set up the perfect turn.

  • The Focus gauge — Your party shares a Focus meter. Spend it card by card, then unleash a finisher that consumes it all.

  • Four independent cost pools — Every fighter grows their own resources each round. No shared economy, no single point of failure.

Run a guild on the brink.

  • Recruit 10 unique heroes, each with a signature card pool and story.

  • Build and upgrade 4 facilities — Training Hall, Smithy, Infirmary, Dormitory — to strengthen every future run.

  • Manage the cost of survival — Wages, injuries, and permadeath. A hero left wounded too long is gone for good.

  • Grow your master from Level 1 to 5 within a single run, choosing new cards as you level.

Descend, again and again.

  • 215 cards to discover and combine across every hero and the common pool.

  • 42 enemies and bosses with distinct intents and threats.

  • 18 divine relics that reshape your strategy.

  • Endless Dungeon and Daily Challenge modes for those who want more.

  • Challenge Modifiers to crank the difficulty and prove your mastery.

Every light you lose brings the requiem closer.

Painterly dark-fantasy art, a somber score, and a world quietly ending around you. How long can your guild hold the dark at bay?

Fully playable in 7 languages: English, 한국어, 日本語, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Español, Português-BR.

You've reopened a shuttered little diner on the edge of a harbour town that's seen better days.

The boats still go out. The lights mostly stay off. But there's a plot next door, a counter with a few stools, and a town that's forgotten the quiet magic of being cooked for. That part's up to you.

Harbourlight is a cozy farm-to-table diner sim. Spend your days however you like. Whatever you gather becomes the night's ingredients, cooked by hand in your kitchen, for one guest at a time.

Grow, raise, and catch your ingredients

Turn the plot next door into a harbour-side allotment. Plant and water crops through the seasons, raise animals, or head down to the harbour to fish when you need something from the water. Whatever lands on the plate, it came from your own hands.

Cook every dish by hand

No menu, no recipe cards to click. You cook the way a cook does: real ingredients, real amounts, added by hand. And the kitchen knows food: chop tomatoes and coriander with a little chilli, and it recognises a pico de gallo. Simmer mackerel with tomato, onion and stock, and you've made a fisherman's stew.

Every dish is a real one, made the way it's actually made. Cook by feel, and the kitchen meets you halfway. Every ingredient carries a taste across eight pillars: sweet, salt, sour, bitter, umami, heat, fat, and aroma. So does every guest. Tailor each plate to whoever's at the counter: a splash more acid, a pinch of heat, a little more fat to round it off. Get it right and they light up.

Get to know the regulars

The same faces start coming back. Their stories open up slowly, over quiet evenings at the counter. The better you listen, the better you cook for them.

Learn to read what someone's really hungry for before they say it.

Bring the town back to life

The harbour town wakes up around you. New townsfolk arrive as word spreads, and they each bring new ingredients to grow, new dishes to learn, and new skills to help shape your corner of the town.

As the town grows, your farm and kitchen grow with it, and the little diner you scraped together becomes somewhere people walk to.

Play it your way

Just want to cook, listen, and enjoy the evenings? That's the whole game. There are years of stories waiting at the counter. Want to chase a perfect plate, reading taste profiles, dialling in every gram, sharpening your craft night after night? That's in there too. The depth is there if you want it, and out of your way if you don't.

Harbourlight is a solo project, still in development, with a playable demo coming later this year. If this sounds like your kind of evening, wishlist and follow. It's the best way to keep up, and it genuinely helps a one-person game get seen.

store_data.about_the_game:
You lost your job and your home. Now all you have is an old camper. Just as life couldn't get any worse, the zombie apocalypse begins. After isolating yourself for weeks, consumed by depression and anxiety, something inside you snaps. If the world wants you dead... make it regret trying. How long will you survive?

  • Survive by managing Hunger, Thirst, and HP. Eat, drink, heal, or die.

  • Fight zombies using collectible Battle Cards as weapons.

  • Loot and craft gear, supplies, and equipment to extend your survival.

  • Grow your character through an expanding Skill Tree.

  • Buy stronger gear and Battle Cards to improve your chances.

  • Permadeath, reaching 0 HP ends your run.

  • Every run is unique with randomized characters, events, and loot.

  • Explore a much larger world filled with diverse environments, locations, and meaningful choices.

  • Discover more content with new items, NPCs, enemies, weapons, and gear added over time.

  • Build / Place small structures to interact with.

  • Uncover the story through character backgrounds and world lore.

  • Japanese and other languages may be added going forward.

  • Additional content will be introduced over time as the game evolves through community feedback and ongoing development.

store_data.about_the_game:
GROW YOUR OWN MONSTER!

MONSTERGOTCHI

is a virtual pet game inspired by the 90s and the FMV genre.

  • Raise a pet-creature by feeding them in your attic! 🍎

  • Feed them whatever you find while exploring the streets! 🍽

  • Or strictly follow the pet's orders 🤔. The choice is yours. The consequences are, too 😁

  • We have few types of pets! 🐱

  • What breed you get depends entirely on your choices and diet management! 😋

Be careful—it wants to eat!!! 🥹

....

Well... It has been a couple of weeks since you moved into your new house, but you still haven't checked the attic. Well, now is the time. However, you can't possibly imagine what you are about to see.

There is a strange, vintage computer up here... and...

What is that thing lying beneath the gap in the roof?

The strange vibrating goo on the floor...


Whatever it is, you won't be sleeping peacefully anymore. You begin hearing ominous voices. It's like it's this thing on the floor. It's giving the orders to you. It's calling for you. It has a wild, desperate craving. It needs your help. To grow. You can't resist. Your feet move on their own, drawing you back to the attic stairs...


Well.

GOOD LUCK.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hao You Ultra Evolution Game Description

Hao You Ultra Evolution is a casual vertical auto-battler tower defense title with simple gameplay, letting you enjoy satisfying horde-slaying action without complicated controls.

Step into a fantastic adventure realm, where dozens of unique heroes await summoning and collection. Brute warriors, magic spirits, sorceresses, dragonlings and more each wield distinct damage and crowd-control abilities. You can spend diamonds to refresh the hero shop mid-battle, build custom lineups to set up defensive lines, and fend off endless waves of skeletons and monsters. Clear all ten enemy waves to claim generous stage rewards.

Your adventure never grows stale. Progress through sequential main stages starting from basic level 1-2 to unlock harder challenges. Additional game modes including tower climbing, wish pools and daily quests are also available. Collect heroes, unlock relic and insignia systems to permanently boost your team’s attack and defense stats, while full artifact sets grant permanent combat buffs.

This game is entirely free-to-play. During Early Access, we will keep refining the experience by gathering player feedback. We may add new content over time, such as randomized roguelite secret realm dungeons, artifact collection galleries, multiplayer co-op and more, alongside regular updates featuring new monsters, heroes and stages. Watch the game evolve alongside you, and grow stronger effortlessly during your casual downtime!

store_data.about_the_game:
Play with a classic 4-player crew, or adjust the match settings and crank the chaos all the way up to 12 players. You have full control over the heist: customize match times, rounds, total extraction vans, run modifiers, difficulty, loot rules, and more to create your perfect custom lobby.

Steal valuable items, sabotage your rivals, and escape with the biggest payout before security shuts everything down. Just remember: if you haven't extracted yet, nothing you stole is truly yours.

Explore a sprawling shopping mall filled with unique stores, valuable loot, security cameras, and unpredictable crowds.

Grab small valuables for quick escapes or risk everything on massive haul items worth thousands. Bigger loot means bigger rewards but everyone can see what you're carrying.

Stealing an item doesn't make it yours.

Every valuable must be loaded into an extraction van before you can leave the match. Once you extract, everything inside the van is automatically sold.

The player who last carried an item before extraction receives the money.

Why steal from the stores when you can steal from the competition?

Use utility items like Stun Guns, Paintball Guns, Door Blockers, Rope, and more to interrupt escapes, ambush other players, and take their loot before they can extract.

Sometimes the fastest way to get rich is letting someone else do the hard work first.

Every match becomes more dangerous over time.

Commit crimes, trigger alarms, attract security, and raise the mall's heat level. As security escalates, police become more aggressive, making every trip to the extraction van increasingly risky.

Decide when to cash out or push your luck for an even bigger score.

Dynamic run modifiers, changing store layouts, and unique events constantly reshape the mall. Every round forces you to adapt to situations like:

• Procedural Layouts: Randomized loot placement and shifting store variants keep you on your toes.

• Power Outages: The lights and security cameras go down. It's harder to see, but easier to steal.
• Black Friday: The mall is flooded with aggressive shoppers and massive crowds.

Everything you successfully extract becomes Blood Money, your permanent lifetime score.

Blood Money also generates Clean Money, which can be spent between rounds on utility items without affecting your leaderboard ranking.

Build your loadout, unlock Steam achievements, earn new character skins, and compete to become the richest thief.

Create your own maps, gameplay mods, and custom experiences using the official modding SDK.

The game supports BepInEx modding from day one, with example projects, export tools, and creator resources available through the community Discord and GitHub.

Build new maps, add new mechanics, or create entirely new ways to play. The tools are ready for creators who want to expand the world of Idiots Stealing Things.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are no hero. You're a wandering mercenary, a frail human being on the road. Coin is always short. Your body breaks a little with every encounter. Your mind frays. And your name is forgotten faster than any mouth can speak it. Each card is a single event, and all you can do is answer it — left, or right. One simple swipe turns the course of this life.

Body, mind, gold, and renown. Four things keep you alive, and the same four kill you. These are not meters to fill. Let any one hit bottom and it ends — and let any one climb to the very top and it ends just the same. Poverty is a death, but so is too much wealth; a forgotten name is a danger, but a name grown too large draws another blade. There is no safe ending. Survival is not raising any single thing — it is holding all four in a precarious middle.

Your choices are not forgotten. A signet ring pressed into your hand, a debt left unpaid, a seal you could not bring yourself to break — past decisions linger as marks, opening later events and, at the last, deciding what kind of person you were. The same card reads differently depending on what you've come through. Small events weave together into a single story inside one short life.

At the end of every road waits the chill. Seeping in from the edges of the world, this cold does not stop at killing. It erases who lived and what they did — it erases the very fact that they were here at all. Death is an ending, but oblivion is a deeper one. When a life is over, no score remains — only a single line: how it will be remembered, or whether anyone will remember it at all.

There is one thing you never lose in death — what you've come to know. Branches you'd never seen, endings whose conditions escaped you, forks you should have taken another way. So you begin again. This time, dodge the last contract. This time, gather coin but keep the name. This time — die differently.

Features

  • One swipe is the decision — each card a single event, answered left or right. Not a hero's saga, but a roguelite about enduring the short life of one wandering mercenary.
  • Symmetric pressure — body, mind, gold, and renown end your run whether they run dry or overflow. A high number is no safety; it's another way to die.
  • Choices that are remembered — every decision lingers as a mark, becoming a condition for later events and endings. The same card reads differently depending on who you've been.
  • Story woven from small events — tangled webs of card chains and flags surface within a run, threads like the signet ring of a fallen house.
  • Endings as meaning, not score — a conclusion isn't a scoreboard but a single line laid over one short life.
  • Short runs, accumulating knowledge — even in death, the endings and chains you've seen pile up in a codex that carries your next life farther.
  • Warm sepia woodcut, bold clean ink — a shadow-heavy dark fantasy beneath a chill that erases everything.

The Journey

THE UNREMEMBERED unfolds across five chapters. It opens at the world's outermost edge, where struggles over power fill the foreground and the chill is still only a distant rumor, and it descends chapter by chapter into a heavier cold — until not only who lived, but the fact that they lived at all, is erased. In the deep shadows of warm sepia woodcut, live a life that will not be remembered.

A free demo is available — play the opening chapter for yourself.

  • Symmetric pressure — body, mind, gold, and renown end your run whether they run dry or overflow. A high number is no safety; it's another way to die.
  • Choices that are remembered — every decision lingers as a mark, becoming a condition for later events and endings. The same card reads differently depending on who you've been.
  • Story woven from small events — tangled webs of card chains and flags surface within a run, threads like the signet ring of a fallen house.
  • Endings as meaning, not score — a conclusion isn't a scoreboard but a single line laid over one short life.
  • Short runs, accumulating knowledge — even in death, the endings and chains you've seen pile up in a codex that carries your next life farther.
  • Warm sepia woodcut, bold clean ink — a shadow-heavy dark fantasy beneath a chill that erases everything.

The Journey

THE UNREMEMBERED unfolds across five chapters. It opens at the world's outermost edge, where struggles over power fill the foreground and the chill is still only a distant rumor, and it descends chapter by chapter into a heavier cold — until not only who lived, but the fact that they lived at all, is erased. In the deep shadows of warm sepia woodcut, live a life that will not be remembered.

A free demo is available — play the opening chapter for yourself.
store_data.short_description: A king is dead with no heir. In a capital where four houses sharpen their blades over an empty throne, you are a wandering mercenary looking for work. Left or right — one swipe decides a life. A dark-fantasy, choice-driven roguelite where, whatever you do, in the end you will not be remembered.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ember Camp Knight

Ember Camp Knight is a fast and snappy quarter-view 2.5D pixel art action roguelite.

Jump in anytime for quick, satisfying action — think of it as a "popcorn flick" you can play.

Each run takes about 5–10 minutes. Death is never the end — your progress stays. Regroup at camp, then descend deeper.

■ Punchy Quarter-View Action

Face your enemies in fast-paced combat. Dodge, dive in, and unleash a flurry of attacks. Every floor brings new enemies — reading their patterns and breaking through is the key to survival.

■ Three Paths of Progression

  • Run-based passive skills — Pick 1 of 3 each time and build a different run every playthrough

  • Permanent trainer skills — Learn a technique once, keep it forever

  • Persistent gear upgrades — Enhance your weapon, armor, and potions with upgrade materials

Permanent progression that survives death, and fresh roguelite builds every run — working together.

■ A Dungeon That Changes as You Descend

Forest, lava, snowfield — conquer a 4-layer themed dungeon, each floor with its own atmosphere, enemies, and music. Every layer spans 5 stages, and at the deepest point, the final boss awaits.

■ A Camp Inside the Dungeon

Between battles, catch your breath at a campfire deep underground.

  • Merchant — Buy potions and supplies

  • Blacksmith — Upgrade your weapons and armor

  • Trainer — Teach you new techniques

  • Girl — A child who tends the campfire

■ A Story Beyond the Action

Beneath the flashy combat, a quiet story flows on.

Why was the dungeon built, and why does the knight descend?

The answer awaits you, in the depths far below.

■ After the Credits

Take on Hard Mode, where enemies hit harder and swarm in greater numbers. Stack up permanent upgrades and chase your perfect build.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Z-Sector

The world has fallen, and you are humanity's last line of defense. Z-Sector is a high-octane, wave-based zombie shooter designed for those who crave intense action, strategic progression, and cooperative chaos.

Key Features

  • Strategic Wave Combat: Survive relentless waves of zombies. Each wave grows more difficult, forcing you to adapt your tactics and master your environment to stay alive.

  • Earn and Upgrade: Every zombie you eliminate earns you precious coins. Use your hard-earned currency to purchase powerful weaponry, tactical gear, and life-saving upgrades between waves.

  • Cooperative Survival: Team up with friends to dominate the leaderboards. Coordinate your defense, cover each other's backs, and combine your skills to survive longer than anyone else.

  • Global Leaderboards: Prove your dominance. Compete against players worldwide to reach the top of the global leaderboards. Only the best survivors will claim the ultimate high score.

Customize Your Arsenal

Survival isn't just about aim—it's about preparation. Visit the shop between rounds to unlock an arsenal of firearms and tactical equipment. Whether you prefer a fast-firing submachine gun or a heavy-hitting rifle, choose the loadout that fits your playstyle and maximize your damage output.

Join the Fight

Do you have what it takes to clear the Z-Sector? Gather your squad, lock and load, and show the horde that humanity isn't going down without a fight.

Are you ready to climb to the top? See you in the Z-Sector.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Meow Star Archives" is a puzzle game that uses classic jigsaw mechanics to restore severely damaged memory archives of cats.

After completing their respective missions, the souls of the cats return to Meow Star to continue their lives, while their memories from before their return are entrusted to the Meow Star Archives for safekeeping. But a sudden cosmic storm has left some cats facing the fate of soul dissipation. As the Administrator, you must act quickly to restore the memory archives and prevent this tragedy from happening.

Every puzzle piece holds a fragment of love and memory. As you restore the archives, you’ll uncover the heartfelt stories of these lovely kitties before they journey back to the stars. Once all archives are successfully restored, you can unlock Challenge Mode! Come and give it a try!

Game Features

  • Simple Controls

    Just click the left mouse button to start the game – suitable for players of all ages.

  • Original Levels

    Over 40 original illustration-based puzzle levels – let adorable cats help relax your mind.

  • Soothing & Healing

    Soothing background music offers a relaxing audiovisual experience, making your puzzle-solving journey even more enjoyable.

store_data.about_the_game:
A new twist on the classic arcade concept!

Progress through levels to earn upgrades that will help you to get higher scores, progress further, and more!

But be careful! If you get a game over, you lose all of your upgrades!

Featuring three different modes that all have unique ways to earn upgrades and play the game!

  • Classic:

    The original way the game was intended to be played. Select from two random upgrades each level and try to make it as far as possible to get a high score.

  • Shopping Spree:

    Like classic, but instead the player is presented with an "upgrade shop" where they must spend coins in order to acquire upgrades. Each level, the player is guaranteed to earn one coin, but more may be found in each level!

  • Bricksanity:

    Different than the other modes, Bricksanity has no upgrades. Additionally, more bricks of greater strength are guaranteed to spawn after level 8.

Try to get the highest score possible and make it onto the leader-boards!

Additionally, unlock achievements to earn more skins and paddle colors! 

There are tons of different looks to try out, find what you like!

store_data.about_the_game:
A Revolution in Card-Based Duelling

Synemancy is all about choice. There is no static deck to draw your hand from - instead, conjure your cards from a choice of 3 options every time. Adapt your strategy on the fly to counter your opponent. React instantly with powerful spells, and prove you are worthy of victory.

Explore the World of Nolorus in Story Mode

Take up the mantle of the Seekers, and fight for the return of your sister from the clutches of the Warlock. Make difficult, meaningful choices that ripple throughout the world. Which of the 8 elements of magic will your morality align with?

250+ Cards to Discover

As a Synemancer, your mind is your shield, and your memories are your weapons. Each card is a memory of the places and magic you have experienced, which you can turn against your enemies. With so much of your essence on the line, you might forfeit more than just your pride if you were ever to lose a duel...

Multiplayer With No Limits

Take your skills online and compete with the best Synemancers around the world. Fight on an equal playing field with all cards unlocked, always. If you are sick of microtransactions, battle passes, grinding daily quests and pay to win mechanics, this is the game for you. Cosmetic rewards are earned, not bought.

There are no second chances in medicine.

LOOP SYNDROME is a medical suspense visual novel where you relive time to change fate.

Minato Asakura, a young physician, suddenly gains the power to rewind time after a tragic incident.

A failed diagnosis.
A life that couldn't be saved.
A single wrong decision.

You can always try again...

Or so you believe.

But every loop comes at a price.

As time repeats, reality itself begins to unravel.

Features

  • A suspense visual novel set in a realistic medical environment.

  • Branching storylines shaped by your choices.

  • A unique loop mechanic that lets you rewrite the future.

  • Authentic medical scenarios created by a real physician.

  • Multiple endings, including Bad, Good, and True Endings.

  • Interactive surgery and emergency treatment minigames.

Can you save every life?

Every choice matters.

Every mistake leaves a scar.

Because...

There are no second chances in medicine.

store_data.about_the_game:
[Spin the Reels, Expand the Universe]
"Space Lot" is a next-generation cosmic creation slot-builder that fuses the "luck" of slots, the "strategy" of roguelites, and the "overwhelming inflation" of incremental games.

You only have 3 spins left.
Before you run out of spins and trigger the "Big Crunch (Game Over)"—where the universe collapses—collect the required Stardust to level up your universe, refresh your spins, and keep the cosmos growing.

🪐 Key Features
☄️ A Diverse Cast of Symbols
Each symbol has its own unique ability: some multiply your score over time, some buff surrounding symbols, and others react to adjacent ones. Think about the synergies between symbols and craft your own unstoppable, high-inflation build.

🌌 Grid Expansion Up to 9x7
As your universe grows (levels up), the slot grid expands from its initial 3x3 size! Eventually, it will transform into a massive 9x7 cosmos, filling your screen with exploding numbers and scores.

⚛️ Rewrite Cosmic Laws via the Skill Tree
Spend "Dark Energy" earned during your runs to upgrade your Skill Tree in real-time. Not only can you boost spawn rates and base scores, but you can also dramatically evolve the very abilities of your symbols.

⏳ Permanent Upgrades: "Singularity"
Even if you face the Big Crunch, the Stardust you've gathered won't go to waste. Convert the remaining cosmic dust into "Neutrino" particles to unlock permanent upgrades on the progression tree.

store_data.about_the_game:
Raise the dead and wipe out the living in this Roguelite Tower Defense Auto-Battler! Discover ancient magic, build your fortress, and unleash an invincible army of monsters, outcasts, and depraved beings upon an unjust world.

Destiny lies in your twisted hands. Dawn After Death!

A Bit of Backstory

A mysterious magical artifact rests in your hands: the Trasgonomicon. Its impenetrable, leather-bound exterior has opened just for you, revealing an interior brimming with knowledge that promises enough power to reshape the entire world.

When the cover was lifted, the Book’s power seized time itself. It is alive, it knows things, and it will not allow you to fail or let itself be destroyed. If such a thing were to happen, it would return to the moment of its opening with a flick of its pages, giving you a new chance.

The magic emanating from the artifact uses what has died to give it a new purpose: it draws upon corpses. However, the trasg tribes cannot tolerate their necropolises being desecrated. Your plundering will not go unnoticed, and to fuel your quest for power, you’ll need to defend yourself. This is war. Fortunately, your future armies will come to you—in the form of their dead.

Game Cycle

The world into which you were born rejects and persecutes you. The resistance at your stronghold will be sufficient to withstand a few assaults, but eventually all your enemies will arrive… and there are thousands of them.

Survive round after round to advance through the story. The time will come when you must flee to other inhospitable lands to regain the element of surprise, but your advance will be unstoppable. Before each battle, you can strengthen your defenses by constructing or upgrading buildings, discovering powerful spells, and adjusting the composition and positioning of your army.

Perhaps one day the ultimate victory will come—the one that brings this cycle to a close, where the inevitable tomorrow is contested and decided.

Progression

Deep within the Book lie the Pages, key milestones in your reading progress. You’ll build your powers by choosing what to keep and what to discard, so you can continue reading the ever-changing contents of the Trasgonomicon.

Unlock new structures and ways to empower those under your rule to reach your ultimate power, and wipe out the tribes that pursue you for seeking to build a better world.

Fortress

On the battlefield stands the Tower, the heart of your fortress. Around it, you can construct buildings that unlock new functions. Some will provide a place to store blood or corpses, while others will aid the fortress’s defenses in the form of defensive towers, sorcery laboratories, or camps where you can train an army.

However, everything you build can be destroyed. If enemies reach the fortress, they will destroy everything in their path until they reach the Tower.

Making the most of your space and making strategic decisions will help you build a truly impregnable fortress.

Battles

By building war camps, you can recruit a variety of creatures who, in your service, will give their lives to protect your grand project. Each unit is unique and can turn the tide of battle if used at the right place and time.

Some charge into battle mindlessly, with nothing but death on their minds. Others have macabre tastes and choose their prey out of long-standing grudges or deep-seated hatred.

The enemy is equally tenacious. The defense of their dead and their sacred lands draws great warriors with unique techniques and their own preferences when it comes to destroying abominations and blasphemers. They will even try to snatch your precious loot: their freshly deceased bodies.

So, what are you looking at?

store_data.about_the_game:
Move. Level up. Survive.

Golden wheat fields, frozen tundras, molten lava, sinking desert sands, and the endless void — every arena has its own swarms, its own bosses, and its own dance with death.

Harvest Havoc is an auto-fire action roguelike. Your weapons lock onto the nearest enemy and fire on their own. You focus on dodging, positioning, and picking the right weapon-and-passive combos at every level-up to grow a build that's uniquely yours each run.

⚔️ Core Gameplay

🎯 Full auto-fire — 7 weapons + 9 passives all auto-target the nearest enemy. Your only job is to move.

⭐ Weapon evolution — Weapon Lv5 + paired passive Lv5 → evolution triggers, projectiles morph, damage explodes.

🌱 Companion crafting — Enemies drop parts. Plant 3 to build an auto-battling companion: Snowman, UFO, Volcano, Pyramid, Wheat Sprout.

🧙 6 playable characters — Ranger, Warden, Scout, Adept, Echo, Pyro — each with different starting weapons and talents.

🗺️ 5 Themed Maps + 1 You Paint Yourself

🌾 Wheat Field — First fight under golden ears, gentle onboarding.

❄️ Frost Plains — Icy floor slides you off course, one misstep and a wave of daggers hits you.

🔥 Lava — Scorched earth, higher damage and enemy density all the way through.

🌵 Desert — Quicksand slows you, route planning becomes life or death.

🌌 Void — Endless mode unlocked by clearing all 4 themed maps. A boss every 3 minutes. Chase your survival record.

🎨 Custom Map — 9 painting slots in the shop. Paint your own map, and it becomes the battle ground. Circular color wheel, 4 brush sizes, eraser — full toolkit.

💪 Permanent Progress, Runs Get Easier

Gold banks at run end. Title screen → Shop:

📊 7 permanent stat perks — HP, damage, haste, area, magnet, armor, movement

🎭 5 new characters to unlock

🗺️ 3 new maps to unlock

🖌️ 9 custom map slots + brush tools

No death is wasted.

🏆 22 Achievements

From "First Boss Kill" to "Shop Fully Cleared" — covering kills, survival, clears, endless, and custom maps.

🎮 Controls & Languages

⌨️ Keyboard / Gamepad / Mouse all supported

🌐 Simplified Chinese · English · Japanese fully localized

👤 Single-player, 5–20 minutes per run

Ready to cross wheat, frost, lava, sand, and void — and paint your own battlefield?

store_data.about_the_game:
LexiFront is an educational strategy tower defense game powered by English syntax.

Deploy words onto sentence slots to construct your defenses: nouns provide firepower, verbs activate the line, and adjectives and adverbs enhance its performance. Through combat, review sessions, and story-driven reading, you will build familiarity with word meanings, parts of speech, and fundamental sentence structures while fighting back corrupted enemies and uncovering the truth hidden inside English-language protocols.

Build Sentences. Hold the Line.

You do not deploy conventional towers. You deploy English words.

Nouns form the core of your firepower. Verbs bring the sentence—and your defenses—to life. Adjectives strengthen nouns, while adverbs enhance verbs. Place each word in the correct sentence slot and submit a functional sentence before your defenses can open fire.

Leave out an essential sentence element, and the entire line may shut down.

The enemy will not wait for you to finish thinking through the grammar.

Choose Your Words Before the Battle

Before entering each mission, you must select which words to bring from your vocabulary collection.

Every word has its own part of speech, deployment cost, attack range, attack speed, and support effects. Your selection will shape the pace and strategy of each defensive encounter.

Bring reliable, high-level words that you already know, or deploy unfamiliar words that you are currently learning. By using them under pressure, you can turn passive recognition into lasting knowledge.

Turn Learning into Action

The learning system in LexiFront is built around repeated use.

Instead of simply looking at a flashcard, you repeatedly engage with each word by selecting it, deploying it, placing it into a sentence, activating your defenses, and reviewing your mistakes.

  • A word’s meaning determines whether you can understand important information in the story and its protocols.

  • Its part of speech determines where it can be placed and what role it performs in battle.

  • Words with multiple grammatical functions require you to identify their specific use rather than memorizing a single vague translation.

  • Collocations, verb forms, and modification relationships are gradually introduced as combat mechanics.

  • Words you answer incorrectly or have not yet mastered return in later review sessions.

  • Frequently used words gradually grow into more dependable combat units.

LexiFront is designed as a game-based supplement for English vocabulary and introductory syntax practice. The more you learn through selection, deployment, experimentation, and correction, the stronger your defenses become in future battles.

Grammar Is Strategy

Syntax is not a separate test. It is part of the battlefield.

  • Without a verb, the sentence cannot activate.

  • Nouns determine the primary source and target of your attacks.

  • Adjectives and adverbs modify the efficiency of your defenses.

  • A period submits the completed sentence and places the defensive line into operation.

  • Later stages gradually introduce more complex syntactic relationships.

You are not expected to master every grammar rule in your first battle. Each new concept is introduced through direct combat feedback, allowing you to understand, test, and correct your strategic choices.

Enter a Corrupted World of Words

Chen Duye and several other teenagers from the real world are pulled into a digital realm known as the Lexical Frontier, a world whose order depends on language, documents, and recorded information.

The Third Continent has entered a state of contamination and quarantine. Streets are sealed by corrupted text, communications have collapsed, and the remaining archives and emergency systems contain English protocols that cannot be understood at a glance.

To survive, the group must build defensive lines while deciphering the information left behind by this world.

Here, learning a language is not a reward granted after battle. It is the ability to move closer to the truth.

Every word you understand may reveal a route, a warning, or a piece of evidence that was never meant to be found.

Long-Term Progression

Outside of battle, you can organize your vocabulary collection, review missed words, complete daily objectives, and develop the words you use most often.

Familiar words become more stable and dependable combat assets, while incorrectly answered words return in future review sessions.

This system is not designed to turn the game into a checklist of study tasks. It is designed to make sure that, when the next defensive battle begins, you genuinely understand the words at your disposal.

Key Features

  • A strategy tower defense game driven by English vocabulary and syntax.

  • Distinct combat roles for nouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs.

  • Defensive performance determined by sentence completeness, grammatical compatibility, and modification relationships.

  • Repeated practice of word meanings, parts of speech, and basic syntax through word selection, sentence construction, combat feedback, and mistake review.

  • Support for words with multiple parts of speech, collocations, verb forms, spaced review, and daily learning objectives.

  • Strategic battles shaped by word selection, deployment costs, positioning, and enemy mechanics.

  • Special enemies capable of breaking shields, charging, dragging units, consuming projectiles, splitting apart, and disrupting sentence structures.

  • A story built around the idea that understanding information is the only way to uncover the truth.

  • Vocabulary collection management, mistake review, daily objectives, and long-term word progression.

Go Jace FPS is a retro 2.5D arena boomer shooter built around fast movement, readable pickups, compact maps, and brutal medieval combat. It mixes old-school FPS pacing with modern Unreal Engine systems, giving players quick solo runs, co-op fights, bot matches, and LAN multiplayer battles. The game is focused on arena combat: learn the map, control pickups, keep moving, and take fights before your opponents do. Health, armor, ammo, weapons, and powerups are placed around the level, so survival depends on aim, routing, timing, and knowing when to push or retreat.

Game Modes

The current version includes solo play, co-op, Horde Mode, and LAN multiplayer using listen-server hosting. Players can set up matches through the in-game lobby, choose maps, configure teams, add bots, vote on maps, and adjust match rules.

Current match types include Free For All, Team Deathmatch, Hardcore Free For All, Hardcore Team Deathmatch, Co-op, and Horde Mode. Hardcore variants are more punishing and can include friendly fire settings for harsher matches, while Horde Mode focuses on wave survival, upgrades, and special powers.

Horde Mode

Horde Mode is a wave-based survival mode where players fight escalating groups of enemies while building their character between waves. The goal is to survive as long as possible, manage resources under pressure, and turn each run into a stronger build through upgrades and special powers.

Between waves, players can improve outfit items and shape their loadout for the next fight. Outfit item upgrading gives long-term structure to a run, letting players strengthen their character instead of relying only on weapons picked up in the arena.

Special Powers add another layer to survival. Players can earn and use powerful abilities that change how they handle crowds, recover from dangerous situations, or push through harder waves. Combined with weapon pickups, ammo, health, armor, and powerups, Horde Mode gives Go Jace FPS a survival-focused mode alongside its arena deathmatch and co-op modes.

Weapons, Pickups, and Powerups

The current weapon set includes a shotgun, Sub MG, and fists. Combat is built around short, aggressive fights where positioning and item control matter. Current pickups and powerups include health, armor, shells, 9mm ammo, Sub MG pickup, Quad Power, and The Ring. Item respawn speed can be adjusted by the host, and matches can be configured with or without powerups depending on the kind of fight players want.

Bots and Match Setup

Go Jace FPS includes CPU opponents that can be used for offline practice, solo matches, or filling multiplayer lobbies. Bots support multiple difficulty levels, including Training, Easy, Normal, and Hard, and include Classic and Modern AI style options. The lobby system supports map selection, ready checks, team setup, bot count, match duration, score limit, item respawn speed, and mutators. Hosts can tune the match before launch instead of being locked into one fixed rule set.

Maps and Arenas

The game includes multiple medieval and arena-style maps, ranging from compact dungeon spaces and castle halls to tight shipment-style combat layouts. Current enabled maps include arenas such as Krvava Rotunda, Grajska Dvorana, Dungeon Arena, Veliki Trg, Shipment Simple, Shipment 1519, Fire Pit, and Arena 3-Lane. Maps are designed around quick encounters, pickup routes, and clear combat spaces rather than long downtime.

Progression and Player Features

The game includes a local player profile with lifetime stats, level/experience tracking, match results, kill rewards, and achievements. Players can track kills, deaths, assists, wins, losses, multikills, kill streaks, and other combat milestones. Matches also include chat, kill feed, death recap, scoreboard/leaderboard views, spectator mode, and post-match flow.

Controls and Settings

Go Jace FPS supports keyboard/mouse and Xbox controller input. The game includes settings for sensitivity, controller aim assist, field of view, HUD options, gore level, audio, graphics quality, frame rate cap, resolution, and performance options. On compatible Windows hardware, the game can expose modern upscaling options such as DLSS and FSR, including frame generation support where available.

store_data.about_the_game:
SARA is a psychological horror game set during a series of late-night shifts inside a forgotten facility.

Complete your assigned tasks, monitor security systems, investigate strange occurrences, and uncover the truth hidden within the building's walls. As the nights progress, disturbing events begin to unfold and long-buried secrets start to surface.

Search for clues during your breaks, piece together the facility's dark history, and discover what really happened to Sara.

Will you survive all five nights?

Features

  • Five nights of psychological horror

  • Atmospheric analogue horror inspired by late 1990s horror games

  • Story-driven mystery revealed through clues and documents

  • Multiple paranormal encounters and jump scares

  • Interactive workplace tasks and CCTV monitoring

  • Hidden lore to uncover throughout the game

  • Single-player experience

Investigate the Truth

What began as a routine night shift quickly becomes something far more disturbing.

Strange figures appear where they shouldn't.

Documents reveal a history that was never meant to be discovered.

And somewhere within the facility, Sara is still waiting.

Mature Content Description

This game contains psychological horror, jump scares, unsettling imagery, and references to death and human experimentation. No graphic violence, gore, nudity, sexual content, or strong language is depicted.

store_data.about_the_game:
One unit. Two synergies. Zero take-backs.


ELEMENTORS is a creature-merge autobattler where every unit on your board counts toward two independent synergy axes at the same time: its creature type (Beast, Dragon, Insect…) and its element (Fire, Ice, Shadow…). 13 types × 13 elements, fully orthogonal — the same Dragon can anchor a Dragon build in one run and a Fire build in the next.

Your elements come from a die you built yourself


Before each run you forge a d12 elemental loadout: 8 faces you pick (repeats allowed), 4 rolled at random. Every round you roll two dice for free and stash the results — those are the elements you'll infuse into your creatures.

And here's the catch: applying an element is permanent. That bare Beast becomes a Fire Beast forever. Commit early for tempo, or hold your stash for the perfect unit — every infusion is a small, irreversible bet.

Merge, cascade, dominate


  • Buy creatures, position them on a 6-slot hex board — front, mid and back rows all play differently.
  • Three identical units auto-merge into a 2★. Three 2★ merge into a 3★ — and a single purchase can set off a cascade of merges.
  • Type synergies reward deep, merge-heavy commitment. Element synergies reward wide, flexible drafting. The best boards do both.

A run is a gauntlet


Survive 30 rounds of escalating opposition: PvE creeps, mini-bosses and mid-bosses with guaranteed item drops, team snapshots to outbuild, and a finale that decides the run. Fights are fast by design — no unit shuffling, no 3-minute stalemates. Win the run and keep going in endless mode until your trainer falls.

Bend the dice themselves


Boss drops let you rewrite your loadout mid-run: reforge a face into the element you need, duplicate your best face, reroll the random ones, or slot in a Wild Face that becomes anything. Your d12 at round 25 shouldn't look like your d12 at round 1.

Features


  • Two orthogonal synergy systems — every creature contributes to both
  • 13 elements × 13 creature types × 3 star levels
  • Pre-run dice building: your economy of elements is a build choice, not a shared pool
  • Permanent element infusion — decisions stick
  • Cascading auto-merges on a compact hex board
  • 30-round runs, bosses with item drops, endless mode after victory
  • Hand-crafted pixel art world

store_data.about_the_game:
Become more than human. Lose yourself doing it.

Meridian is a cyberpunk-noir RPG that runs on choices. You're a runner in a dying corporate city, taking the jobs nobody signs their name to — and how you take them is up to you. Talk your way through, sneak past, hack their network from a corner booth, or settle it on the grid in tactical, turn-based combat.

Build a runner your way — six classes, origins, traits, and a wall of cyberware — then roll the dice on skill checks, dive the net past its ICE, and live with the cost of every upgrade: more power, less of the person you started as. Six endings are waiting, and the city's been writing yours the whole time.

A note from me

I made Meridian alone. It's finished — a full campaign, start to end — but I'm not done with it. I read every review and every bug report, and I'll keep building on it based on what you actually want from it. Want to help shape where it goes? Pull up a chair. I'm listening.

store_data.about_the_game:
Light and darkness dwell within every human heart.
Light brings peace, while darkness stirs conflict.

Two contrasting protagonists

This story follows two boys, each with a different nature.
Glanz, a pure and gentle child of light, and Shade, a quiet boy who walks in shadow.
You may begin with either route, though Glanz’s is recommended for first-time players.

A story told like a picture book

Glanz, calm and kind. Luce, strong-willed and spirited. Tette, cheerful and innocent.
The heart of this game lies in the warm, charming interactions between these characters.
Enjoy their conversations as if you were reading a gentle picture book.

Simple controls and easy-to-understand systems

Move with the arrow keys, open treasure chests with Enter.
In battle, characters act when their gauges fill.
No difficult action mechanics or complex inputs.
If you played RPGs as a child, you can relax and enjoy this adventure right away.

A classic fantasy world

A peaceful rural village, a castle town at sunset,
a tiny witch’s house deep in the forest, a tower where night never ends…
Set out on an adventure through a cute and enchanting world.

Estimated playtime: around 6 hours

Difficulty: ★★☆☆☆

store_data.about_the_game:
WAR IS A MATTER OF ORDER AND MANEUVER. In Warlapse, victory isn't won by brute force — it's won by suffocating the enemy. Spraying bullets is amateur hour; the real art is dismantling your enemy's logistics from within.

CUT THE SUPPLY LINES, BREAK THEIR MORALE

  • Pockets and Supply Lines: Encircle the enemy from both flanks to seal them in, or sever their supply line, and their morale plummets to zero in moments.

  • Morale as Armor, Morale as Slaughter: In Warlapse, morale is your greatest defense. High-morale units shrug off attacks with minor damage, while broken units take devastating losses and melt away in seconds inside the killbox you've created.

7 AGES OF EVOLUTION, MULTIPLE WAYS TO PLAY

  • From Stone to Drone: Fight across 7 distinct ages, from the Stone Age to the modern era. Units don't just get stronger as they advance — new roles like armor penetration, range, and speed reshape the entire order of battle.

  • Campaign, Skirmish, and Age Progression: Carry your surviving veterans from battle to battle in Campaign mode, test your tactics in one-off Skirmish battles, or evolve seamlessly through every age in a single real-time battle in One-Shot mode.

INTUITIVE BRUSH-BASED COMMAND

  • Fluid Tactical Control: No clunky menus, no box-select drag-and-drop. Paint your selected units straight onto the battlefield to snap them instantly into the formation you want — line, crescent, or wedge — reposition them without breaking existing formations, or draw their advance routes directly.

  • Information at a Glance: High-contrast rings around your units tell you at a glance whose morale has broken and whose supply line has been cut.

NO AGE LIMIT: MOD YOUR OWN UNITS AND WORLD

  • Unlimited Sandbox: Design more than just maps and scenarios — build your own units from the ground up. There's no age limit: recreate historical battles, or build your own sci-fi armies set in the future.

  • Share with the Community: Export your custom scenarios, battles, and brand-new units as mods and unleash them on the community.

store_data.about_the_game:
Laika was a stray from the streets of Moscow. She became the first living being in space.

Matapacos lived outside a university in Chile. He became an icon of resistance, known across the world.

Boji rode the metro and ferries of Istanbul every day for months. An entire city fell in love with him.

They started with nothing. They weren't supposed to mean anything. They became legends.

Callejero is a roguelite shooter built around those dogs. You play as them. Nine characters. Nine real stories. The city still doesn't want you here.

Fight back.


THE LOOP

Roguelite action built on the DNA of Brotato and Balatro — tight timed combat, a deep card economy, and builds that start as nothing and snowball into something the game wasn't designed to survive.

  • 60-second stages. Hit your kill quota or the run ends. Simple. Brutal.

  • Pick 2 attacks from a random draw of 4, every stage — melee, ranged, or whatever the RNG gives you.

  • Shop after every stage. Buy cards. Build your engine. Make decisions you'll regret or treasure.

  • 8 levels to win. Then the ceiling disappears.

DEEP BUILD CRAFTING

Five card families. 150+ cards. The card system rewards creative thinking and punishes autopilot.

  • Tricks — permanently upgrade one specific attack. Stack copies to build identity. Four Protector cards stacked on Bite means four bleed stacks — that's 8× damage multiplier on every bleed tick. It doesn't stop there.

  • Name Tags — passive modifiers held throughout your run. Four slots (five with Rufo). Each card changes how the game plays. Running out of slots is a real problem you will eventually have to solve.

  • Treats — single-use consumables. Heal, double your coins, or lock in a permanent stat boost for the rest of the run.

  • Pedigree — rare, volatile cards that permanently reshape your run. The Husky: keep one Name Tag, destroy everything else. The Chihuahua: apply every Tricks upgrade you own to every attack simultaneously. One of these cards ends runs. The other can end the game.

Good Boy — shop upgrades that rewrite the rules. Cheaper cards. Better drops. Bigger rewards. Permanent for the entire run.

THE BUTTON

There's a button in every shop. $2 per press. Each press raises the danger level — permanently. Enemies get faster. Hit harder. Spawn more often.

You will have to press it. At higher levels, the kill quota is physically unreachable without it. The base spawn rate doesn't produce enough enemies. The math doesn't work. You must press the button.

The only question is: how many times can your build handle?


NO CEILING

Win level 8 and the run doesn't end. It gets harder.

From level 9 onwards, enemy HP and spawn density escalate at a steeper rate. The game isn't designed to be survived on raw stats alone anymore. You need a build. A specific, intentional, interacting build — the kind where everything you bought was pointing toward the same strategy.

A complete bleed build at level 9+: Bite with four Protectors (8× bleed multiplier), Plague Dog Name Tag (every attack bleeds), Deep Wound (double bleed duration), Chihuahua applying the bleed stack to all eight attacks at once. The Rat King's 700 HP dissolves in seconds.

Without something like that, level 9 ends runs. With it, you start asking how far you can go.

There is no designed ceiling. The only end is you.

ZOOMIES

Kill enemies to fill the bar. When it's full, press Space.

Every enemy on screen takes massive damage instantly. Then you dash ten times across the arena — gold and cyan blur, collision disabled, hitbox live on each dash. Pure chaos. The kind of moment that makes a clip.

The bar resets after every stage.

Unless you're playing Hachikō.

THE DOGS

Nine characters. Each one is a real dog — with an in-game biography based on their actual story, a unique passive ability, and an unlock condition that fits who they were.

  • Laika — A street dog from Moscow who became the first living being in space. No special mechanic. Just a very good girl.

  • Matapacos — Lived outside Universidad de Santiago, became a global symbol of resistance. Picks 3 attacks per stage instead of 2. Uses all of them.

  • Hachikō — Waited at Shibuya station every day for nine years after his owner died. Zoomies bar carries over between stages. It never resets.

  • Aloka — A stray from Sri Lanka who survived against every odd. HP never refills between stages — but gains +15 max HP for every stage survived.

  • Boji — Rode Istanbul's metro alone, every day, for months. Shop always shows one extra card. First reroll is always free.

  • ...four more unlockable characters. Each with their own story, their own passive, and their own reason to exist.

12 ENVIRONMENTS

Each level draws a random environment with its own enemy roster, boss, and modifier that rewrites the rules for all three stages. You never know what's coming.

  • The Street (Rush Hour) — Every enemy moves 20% faster. Urban foxes, street rats, pigeons. Boss: The Dog Catcher.

  • The Dumpster (Infestation) — Every kill has a 20% chance to immediately spawn another enemy. Raccoons steal your coins on hit. The modifier and the mechanic combine badly.

  • The Animal Shelter (Sedated) — Your max mana is cut 30%. The Warden runs the place as a cover for abuse. He's the most satisfying boss kill in the game.

  • Space 🔒 (Isolation) — Stage coin rewards cut 40%. Unlocks only after OG Laika — the final character, earned by winning a run with every other dog.

  • Eight more. Each one a different problem your build has to solve.

8 DIFFICULTY TIERS

The Collar system. Complete a run → unlock the next tier. Every tier stacks a permanent handicap on top of everything before it.

  • No Collar — base game.

  • Red Collar — you start every run without the Street Smart card, which normally gives free kills toward your quota.

  • Blue Collar — elite enemies no longer drop chests. Fewer mid-run rewards.

  • Diamond — all seven previous handicaps active simultaneously.

You choose your collar before the run. It stays with you.


FOR EVERY DOG THAT NEVER MADE IT HOME

These dogs are real. Their stories are real. The game exists because they deserved to be remembered in more places than a Wikipedia article.

We're committing a portion of every sale to animal rescue — we'll name our partner organisation before launch. Not a vague gesture. A specific commitment, on the record, at launch.

Wishlist Callejero now and we'll notify you the moment it launches.

store_data.about_the_game:
GRIM SIEGE

Grim Siege is a 1v1 strategic card duel set in a grim fantasy world. Raise your own tower to the skies — or crush your enemy's into dust. Every turn is a choice between defense, growth, and merciless assault.

⚔️ The Art of Siege
A wall stands before your tower — the enemy must break it first. Everything revolves around three schools of power:
🪨 Stone — defense, walls, shields
🩸 Blood — magic, statuses, and your tower
⛓️ Slaves — aggression and swift strikes

Manage your income, hoard resources and decide where to invest — but beware inflation: you can't hoard forever, tempo is king.

🛡️ Six Classes — Six Strategies
Every class plays completely differently: its own ability, strengths and weaknesses, signature school and upgrade branch.

  • Siege Master — the flawless besieger with no weaknesses

  • Plague Lord — rot and slow decay

  • Zealot Cultist — damages himself to empower his attacks

  • Warlord — swift onslaught and the first strike

  • Architect — defense that turns into tower growth

  • Dusk Baron — a predator who robs his enemy

🃏 Build Your Deck
Craft a deck around your class and playstyle — from an impenetrable defense to a ruthless rush. Hundreds of decisions, dozens of combinations.

🔥 Statuses & Combos
A deep effect system turns every turn into a puzzle: Rot, Veil, Silence, Chains, Shield, Spikes, Cleanse — apply them, combine them, and shatter your enemy's plans with counterplay.

🌐 Game Modes

  • Vs AI — multiple difficulty levels for solo play

  • Quick matches and ranked PvP — online against real players on a dedicated server (fair matches)

  • Private lobbies — invite a friend to a duel with an invite code

🚧 In Active Development
Grim Siege is built balance-first for competitive play. Ahead: new classes and cards, a visual overhaul and an interactive 3D UI, a story mode and new AI modes, plus two new 4-player modes — Chaos and 2v2. Jump in now and shape the game with your feedback.
store_data.detailed_description:
GRIM SIEGE

Grim Siege is a 1v1 strategic card duel set in a grim fantasy world. Raise your own tower to the skies — or crush your enemy's into dust. Every turn is a choice between defense, growth, and merciless assault.

⚔️ The Art of Siege
A wall stands before your tower — the enemy must break it first. Everything revolves around three schools of power:
🪨 Stone — defense, walls, shields
🩸 Blood — magic, statuses, and your tower
⛓️ Slaves — aggression and swift strikes

Manage your income, hoard resources and decide where to invest — but beware inflation: you can't hoard forever, tempo is king.

🛡️ Six Classes — Six Strategies
Every class plays completely differently: its own ability, strengths and weaknesses, signature school and upgrade branch.

  • Siege Master — the flawless besieger with no weaknesses

  • Plague Lord — rot and slow decay

  • Zealot Cultist — damages himself to empower his attacks

  • Warlord — swift onslaught and the first strike

  • Architect — defense that turns into tower growth

  • Dusk Baron — a predator who robs his enemy

🃏 Build Your Deck
Craft a deck around your class and playstyle — from an impenetrable defense to a ruthless rush. Hundreds of decisions, dozens of combinations.

🔥 Statuses & Combos
A deep effect system turns every turn into a puzzle: Rot, Veil, Silence, Chains, Shield, Spikes, Cleanse — apply them, combine them, and shatter your enemy's plans with counterplay.

🌐 Game Modes

  • Vs AI — multiple difficulty levels for solo play

  • Quick matches and ranked PvP — online against real players on a dedicated server (fair matches)

  • Private lobbies — invite a friend to a duel with an invite code

🚧 In Active Development
Grim Siege is built balance-first for competitive play. Ahead: new classes and cards, a visual overhaul and an interactive 3D UI, a story mode and new AI modes, plus two new 4-player modes — Chaos and 2v2. Jump in now and shape the game with your feedback.
store_data.short_description: Grim Siege is a 1v1 dark-fantasy card duel. Raise your own tower or tear down your enemy's. Six classes and a deep status system turn every turn into a puzzle of combos and counterplay. Take on the AI or other players in quick matches and ranked battles.

store_data.about_the_game:
CLOUDLYPSE is an idle companion that lives on your taskbar. A lone resistance hero runs and fights forever in a transparent strip, always on top — while you work, he survives.

The world fell

Corrupted machines took over Earth. There is no "game over": the swarm never stops evolving.

Enemies that truly mutate

Every wave of machines is generated by a genetic algorithm — threats change, adapt, and get deadlier with each world. No run is the same twice.

Threat Archive

Every machine you defeat gets cataloged. Collect, study, and track the swarm's evolution across generations.

## Progress without the grind

No active grinding: your hero fights alone while you do something else. Come back whenever you want to equip upgrades, evolve weapons, and see how far he's gotten.

Fair, no P2W

Closed economy, no real-money item trading, no pay-to-win. Cosmetics and convenience only — nothing that buys power.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

July 1996. You are Kevin, an ordinary 13-year-old boy living in a small town in the Northern Lakes region.

You wake up in the middle of the night, a message on your computer tells yout that your are stuck in the Deviation, a strange place where fear and reality collide. Your only way out: a device called the Zapper.

Why are you stuck here? What is happening? Start your journey and find out who's behind the eyes watching you.

Gameplay

Hop on your bike and freely explore the neighborhood and its surroundings.

Find the 7 Echo Bubbles scattered across the map. Each one is a location built around the core anomaly-hunting gameplay loop: enter, look around, spot what is wrong, use your Zapper, then get out. Repeat. Once an Echo Bubble is fully synchronised, move on to the next one.

When all Echo Bubbles are cleared, launch the final procedure to escape the Deviation... and discover what lies on the other side.

Key Features:

  • explore a quiet 90s neighborhood on a mysterious summer night

  • discover 7 unique locations filled with 80+ anomalies

  • uncover an underlying story through events, in-world documents, and environmental clues

  • experience 4 different endings depending on your actions

  • find secrets and easter eggs

store_data.about_the_game:
Every escape attempt is a new chance to do something smarter, funnier, or way more questionable.

Grab a spoon and start digging. Use a dumbbell like it was definitely part of the plan. Steal a key, unlock a cell, trick a guard, scan another prisoner’s face, or throw lunch at someone who probably deserved it.

This is a physics-driven VR sandbox where almost everything can be picked up, used, tossed, hidden, or turned into part of your escape plan. Explore the prison, find strange items, complete weird favors for your mysterious wall buddy, and discover all the ways your “perfect plan” can fall apart.

Maybe you sneak out like a genius. Maybe you start a prison-wide mess. Maybe a security camera spots you and sends you right back to your cell.

No big deal. Try again. Make a new plan. Make a worse plan. See what happens.

Escape, prank, fight, throw, crawl, and improvise your way through the dumbest prison break VR has ever seen.

store_data.about_the_game:
Climb to the top one jump at a time.

Slime Jump is a precision platformer where every leap counts. Charge your jump, aim carefully, and make your way through a vertical world filled with increasingly difficult platforming challenges.

A single mistake can cost you valuable time, so stay focused, master the controls, and see how fast you can reach the finish.

FEATURES

• Precision-based jumping mechanics

• Speedrun-friendly timer

• Steam achievements for fast completion times

• Relaxing original soundtrack

• Simple controls that are easy to learn but difficult to master

• Challenge yourself to finish in under 20, 15, 10, or even 7 minutes

Do you have what it takes to reach the top?

store_data.about_the_game:
XENOGARDEN

Xenogarden is a dark sci-fi strategy game where you control an alien swarm spreading across a hostile world.

Build synapse nodes, expand your living network, defend your core, and overwhelm human defenders before they cut your invasion apart.

You are not here to save the world.
You are here to take root.

Gameplay

Expand your territory by growing a network of alien synapses. Each synapse extends your control and opens new tactical options — but every exposed node can become a target.

Protect your core at all costs. If humanity reaches it, the swarm dies.

Leaders

Choose from different alien leaders, each offering unique bonuses, weaknesses, and visual themes. Whether you rely on thorns, poison, brood, crystal, or cold beauty, your leader shapes the way your invasion unfolds.

Features

  • Expand a living alien control network

  • Defend your core from human counterattacks

  • Unlock multiple leaders with distinct playstyles

  • Mix strategy, survival, growth, and swarm pressure

  • Play as the invading force instead of the human defenders

  • Atmospheric sci-fi horror with roguelite progression elements

  • Multiple victory and defeat screens based on your avatar

Development Notice

Xenogarden is still in active development. Gameplay, balancing, visuals, sound, and content may change before release.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Caramellia

A cozy creature-collecting RPG set in a pastel kawaii world made of sweets, cream-colored light, and magic. Explore, catch, and raise Dulcimals: charming creatures that evolve, fuse, and battle by your side. Light, relaxing, and full of charm.

🍬 Catch 100+ Dulcimals

Roam cotton meadows, candy forests, and jelly shores to discover a bestiary of over 100 unique creatures. Toss a Capsule, add them to your team, and complete the Dulcidex. Every Dulcimal has its own personality, stats, and rare Glaseado (shiny) form waiting to be found.

🔗 Fuse with Sugar-Link

Caramellia's signature mechanic. Combine two Dulcimals through Sugar-Link to create brand-new creatures with unheard-of moves and looks. Experiment, uncover secret fusions, and build a team no one else has.

⚔️ Sweet turn-based battles

Master the 12 Flavors, Caramellia's type system. Every Flavor has strengths and weaknesses: choose your moves wisely, press your advantages, and chain kawaii status effects in tactical turn-based combat. Easy to learn, with depth for those who seek it.

🗺️ Explore a living world

Travel across 14 distinct zones, each with its own biome, creatures, and secrets. A day-and-night cycle and a pastel weather system change which Dulcimals appear and how the world feels. Heal your team at the Sweet Spa and stock up at the Candy Shop.

🌱 Raise, evolve, and grow

Level up your Dulcimals, witness evolutions in dedicated scenes, and shape a team that's truly yours. Choose your protagonist and begin your adventure with your starter companion.

🌐 Play with others

Put your team to the test in online PvP battles, climb the competitive ranked ladder, and trade Dulcimals with other trainers to complete your Dulcidex.

🎀 Kawaii Pastel art style

Everything in Caramellia is built to comfort: chibi proportions, big sparkling eyes, rosy blush, mauve outlines, and a pastel palette polished down to the last pixel. A beautiful world you'll want to linger in.

Caramellia is a cozy game meant to be played at your own pace. Catch, fuse, explore, and relax.
