store_data.about_the_game:
Pitch the first tent. Build an outdoor empire

Camping Keeper is a management game where every camper is a little character living their own life: they arrive, queue at reception, settle in, take a shower, grab an ice cream, grumble when the restrooms are dirty… then leave a review that will make or break your reputation.

Guests bring their own home (tent, caravan, camper van) or rent a fully equipped lodge. A bare pitch earns little but costs almost nothing. Rentals earn big but demand investment and upkeep. Packed budget campground or upscale resort: you decide your campsite's identity!

A campsite that's alive

Every camper thinks, feels and follows their own desires. Families, retirees, young groups or backpackers: four guest profiles with conflicting expectations. The young partygoer wants noise and life; the retiree wants peace and shade. Put them side by side and you'll soon know it! Your campers tell you at a glance how well your site is running.

Placement is a real puzzle

A shaded pitch near the restrooms but away from the noisy pool is worth far more than a bare patch in the blazing sun. Cram them in for revenue, space them out for satisfaction. Every meter counts, and a single tree or hedge shifts a plot's value.

A living sky

Sun, rain, heatwave, storm: the weather sets the tone of the day. A downpour drives the swimmers away and fills the common room; a storm turns the paths to mud and threatens flooding; a heatwave sends everyone hunting for shade and a cold drink. Four seasons pace the year, and your campers adapt before your eyes.

Build your networks

Water and power don't appear by magic: run pipes and lines to your restrooms and pitches, place meters and hookups, treat waste water at the treatment plant, and watch for overload as your campsite grows.

Deep management, light mood

  • Staff: receptionists, cleaners, technicians, each with their own tasks

  • Cleanliness: overflowing bins, restrooms and pitches to scrub

  • Catering: four tiers, from vending machines to a full restaurant

  • Dynamic pricing: weekends, demand, occupancy

  • Leisure: pool, supervised swimming, water slide, campfires, barbecues, playgrounds

  • Rated, commented online reviews: they drive your reputation and your appeal

Reach for the stars

Guests pay a fixed fee on arrival: from there, it all comes down to the quality of their stay. Keep your facilities running, because broken equipment stays unusable until a technician comes to fix it. A happy camper leaves a review that builds your reputation, pushes up your star rating and brings in the next guests.

🚧 In development

Camping Keeper is in active development. Already on the roadmap: dedicated activities (dance nights, pétanque, kids' club), an eco-friendly label, pet management, security and gatecrashers, special groups, etc.

Coordinate the operations of various areas in Hesti and manage this grand hotel together with the staff.

movies.name: Widow Begs Me to Be Her Master

store_data.about_the_game:
Widow Begs Me to Be Her Master - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.

Core Plot Introduction
Victor was an ordinary mechanic. He accidentally overheard the FX Group's conspiracy of weaponizing consciousness in the garage and was persecuted. On the verge of death, he fused with the residual consciousness of Liu Zihua, the No. 7 Consciousness Insect, and started a new life. After waking up, he not only healed his fatal injuries but also gained powerful abilities. He began to investigate the truth of the incident, got into a complicated relationship with the Seville sisters, and confronted the FX Group, which was trying to break the order.

Worldview Atmosphere
The story constructs a world full of science - fiction colors. Elements such as weaponizing consciousness, nano - consciousness bodies, and tri - telekinesis are intertwined. The FX Group attempts to create the 'Asura' with the 'Singularity' and break the 'Haotian Order', bringing a huge threat to the world and creating a tense, exciting, and mysterious atmosphere.

Highlights of Female Character Interactions
The three sisters, Elif, Devne, and Alef, each have their own charm, and Victor's interactions with them are full of tension. Elif feels guilty towards Victor and has a secret desire. Under Victor's guidance, she gradually submits. After reuniting with Victor, Yang Muqing's former secret love is reignited, adding a different emotional color to the story.

Tension in Character Relationships
There are both emotional entanglements and interest associations between Victor and the Seville sisters. At the same time, he is in a hostile relationship with Hassan, Cruz, and others from the FX Group, with constant conflicts. The complex relationships between the characters make the story full of suspense and highlights.

Scene Features
From the old garage in Brooklyn, to the tragic car accident scene on the highway, then to the ward of the Elysium Clinic, the top - floor apartment of the Seville family, and the suburban studio in Stockholm, the scenes are rich and diverse. Each scene has a unique atmosphere and story, enhancing the authenticity and immersion of the story.

Immersive Experience
Players will follow Victor's perspective and delve into this world full of science - fiction and conspiracy. Feel his struggle on the verge of death, his growth after fusing consciousness, and his emotional interactions with the female characters, as if personally experiencing a thrilling adventure.

High - Definition Visual Performance
The game presents various scenes and characters in high - definition images. From the dim yellow lights in the garage, the details of the modified Maybach, to the exquisite dresses and charming postures of the Seville sisters, it can bring visual enjoyment to players.

Functional Gameplay Features
It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots, and the auto - play function makes the plot progress more smoothly. high - definition CG presents wonderful pictures to players, bringing a smooth reading experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cold female CEO offers her full loyalty - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction: In Lower Manhattan, New York, intern assistant Bowman was caught in a car accident trap while on a mission. On the verge of death, he merged with the mysterious consciousness 'No. 7' and gained special abilities. Leia Zimmerman, the chief strategic officer of the consortium, found him and invited him to cooperate in investigating the truth of the Zero Project, which hides secrets such as the ancient Haotian System and conscious insects.
Worldview atmosphere: The story constructs a world full of a sense of technology and mystery. The FX Consortium holds great power, and mysterious experiments such as the Zero Project and consciousness uploading are surging under the surface. The awakening of the purple - black rift adds more unknowns and dangers to the world.
Highlights of female character interactions: Leia is cold, mature, and has an unknown vulnerability despite being the chief strategic officer of the consortium. In her interactions with Bowman, there are both and suspicion, and trust is gradually emerging. The emotional collision between the two is full of tension. Meyer Mia is intellectual and elegant, and her appearance also adds more character relationships and emotional levels to the story.
Tension in character relationships: Bowman and Leia are in a delicate relationship of mutual testing while needing to cooperate. Bowman has to hide his secrets while showing his value, and Leia wavers between trust and suspicion. The involvement of Meyer Mia makes this relationship more complicated, and the tension between the characters continues to escalate.
Scene features: From the high - rise buildings in New York, hospital wards, to the consortium's headquarters office and riverside mansions, the scenes are rich and diverse. Every scene is full of details, such as the tense atmosphere in the office and the luxury and mystery in the mansion, which can make players feel as if they are in the story.
Immersive experience: Players will follow Bowman's perspective and delve into this mysterious world. In the interactions with Leia and others, they can feel the exciting plot development and experience the emotional changes of the characters, as if they are part of the story.
High - definition visual performance: The game uses high - definition graphics to delicately display the characters' expressions, clothing, and the details of various scenes. Whether it's the rainy street scene in New York or the luxurious decoration of the consortium's office, it can bring visual enjoyment to players.
Functional gameplay features: It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. It has a one - key backtracking function, which is convenient for players to review important plots. There are also functions such as automatic play and chapter browsing, providing a smooth reading experience. At the same time, high - definition CG also adds a lot to the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Boungeon is a block-breaker-inspired roguelite deckbuilder where you defeat enemies by bouncing magical projectiles around the battlefield.


As you explore the dungeon, you will collect a variety of magical projectiles, skills, and relics. In battle, your projectiles bounce off walls and enemies, carving out unpredictable paths as they strike your foes.

Battle with Bouncing Magical Projectiles

In combat, you launch magical projectiles and deal damage by making them bounce off walls and enemies.
Your strategy changes greatly depending on the types of projectiles you use, how many you fire, and the area they can affect.

Combine Projectiles, Skills, and Relics

By combining the magical projectiles, skills, and relics you find during your adventure, you can create a different strategy on every run.
Whether you strengthen simple attacks or build around special effects is up to you.

Explore the Dungeon and Challenge Powerful Foes

As you explore, you will encounter various types of nodes, including battles, events, shops, and rest areas.
Manage your limited resources carefully and take on the powerful foes waiting deep within the dungeon.

Story

A nameless monk sits down to meditate beneath a sacred tree in Neo-Osaka, only to discover he has been cursed by the Time Yokai. Helplessly, he tries to rid his body of the corruption — a curse on Time. He must track down and eradicate the Time Yokai so his own soul can be purified. The mechanics of his curse are punishing: as the monk moves, the world around him grinds to a crawl, but the moment he stops, the world tirelessly accelerates, moving faster and faster. Without rest, he must take on bounties to hunt down and vanquish Yokai to save himself. Survive relentless waves and bend reality as you make your way to the final confrontation to strike down the Time Yokai himself.

Gameplay Mechanics

Wall jumps

Ground slam 

Ground slam jump 

Rifle jump

And many other movement mechanics

Bikini sister-in-law is my human anchor

store_data.about_the_game:
Bikini sister-in-law is my human anchor - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.

Core Plot Introduction

On a snowy night in the old town of Montreal, Aiden Gagnon was in a car accident and suffered brain death while investigating the truth behind his brother's death. At a critical moment, the 7th Consciousness Insect reconstructed him into a super digital life form, endowing him with the ability to invade networks and rewrite probabilities. Aiden Gagnon went to the East Coast beach for a family gathering and reunited with his sister-in-law, Eleanor. Eleanor had been troubled by strange dreams for many years, and in her conversation with Aiden Gagnon, she revealed information related to Liu Zihua's Survivor Plan. However, there were unknown quantum signal fluctuations outside the beach, and it seemed that there were traces of genetic modification by the Fuchs Consortium approaching. Aiden Gagnon faced a difficult choice between strengthening his anchor relationship with his sister-in-law and dealing with the external threat.Worldview Atmosphere

The story constructs a world full of technological and mysterious elements. Concepts such as super digital life forms, consciousness insects, and the Survivor Plan are intertwined. There is a huge conspiracy hidden behind the biochemical experiments of the Fuchs Consortium. The conflict between the purple-black light and the silver-blue data torrent, and the awakening of the rift add a mysterious and tense atmosphere to the whole story.

Highlights of Female Character Interaction

After her husband's death, Eleanor, the sister-in-law, had been depressed and drunk. After seeing Aiden Gagnon, the emotions she had suppressed for many years gradually began to be released. In their interaction in the dressing room, she showed both dependence and longing for her brother-in-law, as well as guilt for the past. Aiden Gagnon gently guided her and helped her face her inner fears. The emotional communication between the two was delicate and touching.Tension in Character Relationships

The relationship between Aiden Gagnon and Eleanor, a brother-in-law and sister-in-law, was already sensitive. Eleanor's special feelings for Aiden Gagnon and Aiden Gagnon's need for Eleanor as a human anchor made their relationship full of tension. At the same time, the 7th Consciousness Insect in Aiden Gagnon's brain constantly reminded him to maintain a balance between power and humanity, which also increased the inner contradictions and conflicts of the character.

Scene Features

From the snowy streets of the old town of Montreal to the warm private beach on the East Coast, and then to the secluded dressing room by the beach, the scene transitions create different atmospheres. The cold and danger of the snowy night, the warmth and tranquility of the beach, and the privacy and ambiguity of the dressing room all provide a unique background for the development of the story.Immersive Experience

Players will follow Aiden Gagnon's perspective and delve into this mysterious world. Through interactions with the characters and the advancement of the plot, they will feel Aiden Gagnon's struggle between power and humanity, as well as the complex emotional entanglement between him and his sister-in-law. It's as if they are Aiden Gagnon themselves, experiencing all of this firsthand.

High-definition Visual Presentation

The game uses high-definition graphics to vividly show the characters' expressions, movements, and scene details. Whether it's Aiden Gagnon's helplessness on a snowy night or Eleanor's charming figure in a bikini, players can feel as if they are on the scene.Functional Gameplay Features

The game supports offline play, allowing players to enter the story world anytime and anywhere. The one-key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plot points. The autoplay function enables players to advance the plot more easily.The high-definition CGs bring a visual feast to players, and the smooth reading experience keeps players immersed in the game.

It's as if they are Aiden Gagnon themselves, experiencing all of this firsthand.

High-definition Visual Presentation

The game uses high-definition graphics to vividly show the characters' expressions, movements, and scene details. Whether it's Aiden Gagnon's helplessness on a snowy night or Eleanor's charming figure in a bikini, players can feel as if they are on the scene.Functional Gameplay Features

The game supports offline play, allowing players to enter the story world anytime and anywhere. The one-key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plot points. The autoplay function enables players to advance the plot more easily.The high-definition CGs bring a visual feast to players, and the smooth reading experience keeps players immersed in the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
The mountain is angry. Your beard is ready.

Deepforge Brawl is a top-down arena auto-shooter roguelite: your weapons aim and fire on their own, so every decision is about POSITION and BUILD. Kite the horde, grab the ore, and shape a run out of whatever the Forge offers between waves.

Six dwarves, six beards

Every class carries a signature Beard Power that charges in combat and unleashes on demand — the fuller the beard, the bigger the blast. Wall off the swarm with the Ironbreaker's orbiting bucklers, flood the floor with the Brewmaster's ale, or trigger the Prospector's Motherlode and watch the ore fountain. Plus: Ale Rage when you need to hit harder, Forge Dash when you need to not die.

  • 13 auto-firing weapons — merge duplicates to tier them up; every weapon EVOLVES at top tier
  • Burn, Chill and Shock the horde — combine afflictions to SHATTER frozen enemies or arc lightning through the pack
  • 14 enemy archetypes with real jobs: menders that sustain the swarm, drummers that harden it, sappers that mortar your camping spot, coin goblins that flee with your gold
  • 4 bosses, each with a pattern-flipping second phase
  • Six depths of escalating difficulty — then ENDLESS mode to see how deep your build really goes
  • The Runeworks: permanent meta-progression, opt-in curse pacts for the brave, and a Forge Hall full of trophies and cosmetics to earn

Runs that respect your time

Waves are 40 seconds. A run is 20 minutes. A "one more run" spiral is the whole evening. You always walk away with Runestones toward the next unlock, whether the Maw ate you or you ate the Maw.

store_data.about_the_game:
I’ve seen this before...

Liminull is a journey through liminal locations.

There are no monsters, no rush, and no direct path. Only you, empty spaces, muted sounds, strange details, and the feeling that all of this has happened before.

Explore four different locations:

  • An empty night office — workstations, corridors, glowing monitors, and rooms that are far too quiet.

  • A bright, colorful suburb — green hills, an empty town, strange objects, and places that feel like they are missing people.

  • Pools — neon water, tiles, reflections, inflatable toys, and a familiar damp silence.

  • A huge children’s play center — mazes, play zones, soft structures, and bright colors that slowly begin to feel wrong.

Each location has its own atmosphere, mood, and set of small interactive details. You can simply move forward and explore the space at your own pace, or you can stop, look closer, find secrets, solve puzzles, or complete optional tasks.

You will be able to:

  • Interact with objects around you

  • Search for hidden items and solve puzzles

  • Complete tasks

  • Blow soap bubbles

Who is this game for?

Liminull is for players who enjoy dreamcore and liminal space aesthetics.

It is a journey through places that feel too familiar to be accidental.

Places you have already seen.

Or almost remembered.

store_data.about_the_game:
"There was order once. We were promised it would last. The promise is the oldest lie."
— inscription found in the ruins of the First Cathedral

Theocide is a competitive tactical card battler where deckbuilding meets turn-based tactics. Your cards don't just resolve — they take the field. Every minion you summon becomes a piece on the battlefield, and every step, flank, and trade decides which general is left standing.

WHERE CARDS MEET THE BATTLEFIELD

Fight across a 9x5 battlefield where positioning is everything. Wall off your general with Provoke, strike from range, slip past the front line with Flying, or dive the enemy general and dare them to answer. Your general is on the board too — a fighter in their own right, armed with a signature Bloodbound Spell that shapes your entire gameplan. Outplay your opponent square by square: the first general to fall loses.

FIVE FACTIONS, ONE BURIED TRUTH

The world of Therion is at war, and no one in it is lying — they're just all wrong about each other.
  • The Theocracy — the empire of faith and iron order, certain that absolute control is the only thing holding back the Abyss. Disciplined ranks, healing light, and infantry that fight as one.
  • The Veiled Hand — heretics and necromancers who spread creeping shadow across the battlefield and treat death as a resource.
  • The Elven Conclave — the architects of war-magic, chaining spell after spell to wake dragons no other people could hold.
  • The Orc Clans — the desert's last survivors, marching north with an army's spine and nothing left to lose.
  • The Sanguine Courts — the vampire aristocracy, evolving their broods with the patience of things that no longer fear time.

DRAFT YOUR POWER MID-MATCH

At set turns, both players draft an augment — choose one of three permanent upgrades that bend the rest of the match around your plan. The same deck never plays the same way twice, and reading your opponent's draft is a skill of its own.

CLIMB THE LADDER

Ranked matchmaking pairs you by skill and tracks your rise from Bronze to S-Rank. Study full replays of finished matches to see both sides of every decision — including the hand your opponent was hiding.

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION

Win online matches to earn gold, spend it in the market, and crack open mystery crates of new cards. Salvage your spare copies and craft exactly the card your next deck is missing.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY

  • Learn the ropes in a guided tutorial built on a real match.
  • Practice against an AI that plans whole turns ahead — without ever peeking at your hand.
  • Add friends, chat, and challenge them to direct duels.
  • Share one machine in local hotseat mode.

Every match is resolved on the server — the same rules for everyone, every time.

store_data.about_the_game:
This Game Has Zero Sportsmanship

Overview

KasMind is a 1v1 competitive game like no other — one where you compete entirely through taunting. Landing a hit only creates an opening. It won't win you the match. The real winner is whoever seizes that opening and taunts their opponent into the ground. In most competitive games, taunting is a taboo move. Here, taunting is literally how you win. Yeah, we know. Ugly, right?

Simple to Learn, Surprisingly Deep

  • Just 4 buttons to move, attack, and taunt — pick it up in seconds

  • Land a hit to knock your opponent down

  • Taunt them while they're down

  • Taunt them again the moment you create distance

  • Get desperate and taunt out of pure spite as the clock runs out

  • 30-second rounds, best of 3 wins the match

Simple rules, deep decision-making: do you taunt the instant you land a hit, or hold back and create space first? Can you read your opponent's next move before they make it?

A Cast Full of Personality

Movement speed, attack range, attack speed, taunt recovery time — every character has different stats and their own unique taunt lines. Find the one that matches your playstyle.

Multiple Ways to Play

  • Vs. CPU: Choose from 3 difficulty levels

  • Local Multiplayer: Gather a friend around one screen for some heated trash talk

  • Online Multiplayer: Taunt players from around the world

store_data.about_the_game:
The Undead Are Taking Over Tha Block

The neighborhood is under attack, and the only thing standing between the Zombies and your Home is a crew of wild, specialized THUGZ.

Thugz VS Zombies is a cartoon row-defense action strategy game where you place defenders, build cash, unlock new characters, upgrade your squad, and survive increasingly ridiculous zombie waves. Every stage introduces new threats, new tactics, and a boss fight with its own personality.

Build Your Crew

Choose from a roster of unique THUGZ, each with their own role:

  • Ranged attackers who blast Zombies from across the block

  • Melee bruisers who charge forward and scrap face-to-face

  • Defenders who hold the line when things get ugly

  • Passive support THUGZ who generate cash or help your crew stay alive

  • Special units with turrets, fire, shotguns, buffs, and more

Earn cash during each wave, buy more plots, replace old placements, and upgrade your favorite THUGZ to hit harder, survive longer, and fire faster.

Fight Bigger, Weirder Bosses

Every stage builds toward a boss battle. These are not just bigger Zombies with bigger health bars. Bosses move differently, summon helpers, launch special attacks, stun, rush, retreat, and force you to change your strategy.

Survive Earl the Bowler, Badder Bunny, Dead Weed, the Z-Triplets, and the final nightmare herself: MomZom.

Use Special Abilities

Some Zombies drop special abilities that can turn a bad wave around:

  • Drive By - call in a car that rolls through and fires into the Zombie field

  • Freeze Friends - slow the entire Zombie side with icy backup

  • Cash Heist - drop a huge cash bonus when you need it most

Store abilities, spend them at the right moment, and keep the block alive.

Play Solo or Local Co-Op

Play through the campaign alone or team up in local co-op. In co-op, both players defend one larger Home with separate cash pools, separate plots, and shared pressure. Communicate, share cash, and hold both sides of the block together.

{Local Co-Op requires a connected gamepad for the 2nd player)

Fight a Friend in Local Versus Mode

Your friend thinks he can manage a crew better! Prove it! Gather your THUGZ and go one-one VS a friend in local Versus in split-screen mode! Protect your Turf while demolishing there's.

{Local Versus requires a connected gamepad for the 2nd player)

Replay, Upgrade, Survive

Cleared stages can be replayed to earn better scores, experiment with different THUGZ, and prepare for harder fights. Choose your difficulty, build your strategy, and see how long your crew can keep the neighborhood standing.

store_data.about_the_game:
Soul is a dark 2D metroidvania set in a Japanese techno-fantasy world where science, chi energy, and demons exist side by side.

You play as a scientist searching for a path to immortality, only to become caught in a catastrophe that disrupts the balance between the human world and the demon world. Time begins to fracture, people grow older and younger, and demons lose their minds. To uncover what happened, you will explore a futuristic city, unlock new abilities, return to familiar places, and push deeper into dangerous locations.

The core feature of the game is death as part of exploration. When your body dies, it remains in the human world, while your soul enters the spirit world. store_data.about_the_game:
THE LAST SPONK ENERGY CAN IN THE WORLD

You are the night guard at your local copper factory. Boring job, dead end town, nothing ever happens... except your factory is sitting on the LAST Sponk Energy can left on Earth.

And three Sponk addicted junkies want it BAD.

SURVIVE FROM 12 AM TO 6 AM

Every night, Motan, Grigore and Foca will do whatever it takes to break into your office, get their hands on that can, and leave you with nothing. You get a tiny office, two doors, some lights, a wall of security cameras, and a battery that is absolutely NOT your friend, that btw its an UPS from nJOY xD. Everything you do drains power, and when the power dies... you are not alone for long.

  • Watch the cameras - track the junkies room by room. The cameras won't tell you who's where. You have to look, and you have to listen.

  • Slam the doors - a closed door keeps them out, but it eats your power fast.

  • Flick the lights - peek into the doorways to catch someone standing right next to you.

  • Manage your power - you start every night at 100%. Doors, lights and cameras all drain it. Hit 0% and it's over.

Every one of them hunts differently. Grigore comes down the left. Foca comes down the right. And Motan? Motan does NOT wait his turn , take your eyes off him for too long and he sprints straight for your door, because he is a sneaky bastard hunter and your worst nightmare that ever existed.

THERE IS NO FINAL NIGHT

Every night is 5% harder than the last. The junkies get faster, thirstier and smarter, and the game never stops throwing nights at you. No ending. No victory screen. No "you won." There is only the next night.

So how long can you last? :3

FEATURING

  • Endless, escalating survival horror - every night is harder than the last

  • Three relentless enemies, each with their own way of hunting you down

  • Loud jumpscares and intense strobe and flashing effects (you have been warned!!!)

  • Full controller support, built and optimized for Steam Deck (some additional button mapping required, see in game controls for more informations i.e r4, l4, r5, l5)

  • An unhealthy amount of Sponk Energy drinks

store_data.about_the_game:
A new puzzle. Every day. In a place that feels like home.


Puzzle Cottage is a calm, hand-made collection of fourteen daily logic puzzles wrapped in a warm, hand-drawn cottage. Every morning brings a fresh board for each puzzle — and every board is solvable by pure reasoning, never guessing. Pour a coffee, settle in, and think.

Fourteen puzzles, each its own little ritual


  • Weave — untangle a lattice until every strand sits just so.

  • Forage — fill the grid so every row and column balances, with no three-in-a-row.

  • Garlands — gently pull the strings until nothing crosses.

  • Chime — balance the hanging beams so every arm rings true.

  • Streams — branch one source so water reaches every tile.

  • Picross — read the clues and paint the hidden picture.

  • Bramble — draw one unbroken trail through every tile, winding past the brambles to hit the numbers in order.

  • Bloom — tap to open the flowers until the whole garden is in bloom.

  • Nectar — pour between jars until each holds a single colour.

  • Vines — connect every pair of buds without the vines ever crossing.

  • Verse — trace the hidden words through a web of letters.

  • Starlight — place the stars so no two touch, one to every row, column and region.

  • Carom — slide and chain the balls to pocket them all.

  • Quilt — sew the grid into perfect rectangular patches.

Logic, never luck


Every daily board is verified to have exactly one solution you can reach by deduction alone. You'll never be forced to guess and check — if you're stuck, there's always a next move waiting to be found. A gentle, optional hint will teach you why, not just spoil the answer.

The perfect warm-up


Athletes stretch. Thinkers solve. Ten minutes of pure deduction wakes up exactly the muscles your next session runs on — reading patterns, planning ahead, holding a plan in your head while the pieces move. Make Puzzle Cottage the ritual before the strategy marathon or the ranked queue, and arrive sharp.

Genuinely good for growing minds


Because no board can be brute-forced, every solve is a real act of reasoning — and reasoning is a skill that compounds. Kids who play learn to look before they leap, break a big problem into small certain steps, and trust their own thinking. Completely family-safe: no ads, no chat, no purchases inside the game, no violence — and every word in the word puzzle is chosen to be safe for young readers.

Tend a cottage that grows with you


Behind the puzzles lives a cozy little world that changes as you do. The light shifts from dawn to dusk, weather drifts by, the seasons turn, and friendly animals wander the lawn — pet them, feed them, and watch your cottage fill with the comforts you earn just by playing.

Built for the long haul


  • Three difficulties — from a relaxing warm-up to a proper brain-stretch.

  • Streaks & stats — keep your run alive and watch your best times fall.

  • A calendar of past days — missed yesterday? Replay any day you like.

  • Steam leaderboards — a daily board for every puzzle and difficulty.

  • Years of fresh boards — hand-tuned generators and curated puzzle pools mean a genuinely new challenge every day.

Calm by design


No timers shouting at you, no ads, no energy meters — just you and a quiet puzzle. Play one a day, or lose an afternoon to the whole cottage. Comfortable, colourful, and kind.

Plays your way


  • Full controller support — designed to be cozy on the couch and great on Steam Deck.

  • Accessibility built in — colour-safe palette, reduce-motion, and larger-text options.

  • Offline & single-player — your daily puzzle is always there, no connection needed.

Pull up a chair. Today's puzzle is waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
In 7 Devil’s Deals, you play as Paul, a sinner condemned to hell after death. There, Lucifer offers him one last gamble: win and be reincarnated... or fail and remain chained for eternity.

Each game is defined from the very start: the weapon you'll wield, your initial upgrades, the sin you'll face, and even the curses you'll carry are all determined by fate.

Break through the rings of the Seven Deadly Sins, defeat hordes of enemies, and gather powerful upgrades to survive until the final showdown.

Each ring of hell is a unique world. An ecosystem designed to punish, tempt, and destroy you. Seven sins. Seven environments. Seven reasons to die again and again... until you learn how to survive.

FAST-PACED COMBAT

Throughout your journey through Hell, you'll carve a path through countless enemies using unique weapons imbued with the power of the Seven Deadly Sins themselves. Master both ranged and melee combat as you fight for your redemption.

PLAY YOUR CARDS

Harness Mini Luci's deck of cards—a collection of powers beyond mortal comprehension that will help you forge a path through Hell.

Some cards will passively alter your fate, while others unleash powerful abilities on command, allowing you to break limits, defy death, and cut through the chaos when all hope seems lost.

BETWEEN CHANCE AND DESTINY

Hell is chaotic, and your attempts to conquer it are no different.

Nothing is ever fair here. You don't choose how you fight—the chaos itself decides your weapons, your blessings, and the Sin you'll have to face. Every run creates unpredictable combinations that force you to adapt, improvise, and survive with whatever fate deals you... or burn trying.

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY

Every death is a lesson. Every run is a new opportunity.

Turn the souls of your fallen enemies into powerful permanent upgrades that will help you push further with each attempt in your fight for redemption.

How many lives will it take?

store_data.about_the_game:
THE STORY

The megacity runs on data the way it once ran on oil — and whoever controls it controls everything. You're a courier. Not a hacker, not a spy: just someone who carries information by hand, because every network here has long since been compromised.
This delivery was supposed to be routine. It wasn't.
The cargo you're carrying turns out to be something else entirely — and within the hour, both the corporation and your own client are hunting you down. There's nowhere to hide but the underground, a place usually closed to outsiders. You're taken in by the leader of one of the lower-level factions — a man with no obvious reason to risk his people for a courier he's never met.
The longer you stay close to him, the clearer it becomes: he has a reason. It's tied to the cargo itself — and possibly to what the corporation has been doing to this city for years.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

- Multiple romance routes with different characters, each with its own ending and explicit scenes.
- The tension of forced trust: intimacy born from shared danger, not scripted convenience.
- 18+ content woven into the story — a natural consequence of risk, dependence, and lost control.
- A mystery of stolen cargo and corporate conspiracy, unraveled gradually through investigation and choices that shape the ending.

store_data.about_the_game:
Perdido na Mina is a compact 2.5D arcade game about survival, reflexes and score.

You control a miner lost in an unstable gold mine, where boulders roll, platforms disappear and each level becomes more dangerous. Run, jump, climb ladders, collect gold, grab the key and find the exit before the chaos takes over.

The idea is simple, direct and frantic: survive as long as possible, chase a better score and master the rhythm of the mine.

The mine does not change. It gets worse.

With each new level, space becomes tighter, safety disappears and the boulders become an even greater threat. The challenge is not about exploring a huge world, but about resisting the growing chaos inside a short, polished and intense arcade experience.

Key features:

• Compact arcade gameplay focused on reflexes and survival

• 2.5D gameplay with stylized 3D visuals

• Gold collecting and score system

• Level progression with increasing difficulty

• Platforms, ladders, rolling boulders, key, door and pickaxe

• Quick, direct runs focused on self-improvement

Perdido na Mina is a small, honest and complete experience. Affordable, frantic and made for players who enjoy trying again to do better.

ABOUT THIS GAME

When the ticket prices for the 2026 World Cup skyrocket beyond anything a normal fan could ever afford, two unlikely heroes — Pollito, the fearless little chick, and Xiang Xiang, the gentle but competitive panda — decide the world deserves a tournament everyone can enjoy. Their solution is simple: Create a brand‑new World Cup… run entirely by animals.

Beastly Soccer is an over‑the‑top arcade soccer brawler inspired by classics like Kunio‑kun and Super Mario Strikers. Cute creatures, chaotic arenas, elemental super‑shots, and nonstop action come together to create a wild, unpredictable version of the beautiful game.

Choose one of 10 Beastly captains, each with unique abilities and devastating Super Shoots, and represent any of the 48 national teams that qualified for the real 2026 World Cup. Fire spirals, electric volleys, icy curveballs, explosive bomb shots — every match is a spectacle.

FEATURES

🐾 10 Playable Beastly Heroes Each captain has their own stats, playstyle, and special moves. Master their abilities to dominate the field with style.

store_data.about_the_game:
ChessWorlds is a single-player tactics game where the pieces are alive and the board is a place you travel through. Your pieces climb hills, drop off ledges, and fight across terrain that has real impact on tactics. You win by reading the board and putting together an army whose pieces cover for each other.

I am building this because I have loved chess variants for years (Chess Evolved Online was my favorite for a long time), but I always wished I could make my own pieces and fight across a world instead of a flat grid. So that is the game.

The terrain is a weapon

Enemies hide in the bushes, there is a danger to fall in lava, water floods tiles and still-water freezes whatever lands in it. A tsunami's wake can wash a whole row of pieces out of place. Mechanical lifts rise and drop and change who can reach what. And a Blight creeps in from the edges of the map and eats it out from under you if you are too slow.

Every piece still moves the way it does in chess, but the battlefield has height now. A piece can climb one tile up to reach a square, and the knight jumps, so it climbs two. Standing above an enemy lets you strike downhill, and standing on a ledge means someone can shove you off it.

Four realms, four new chess worldviews

You play a king whose kingdom fell in a single night. You wake up outside the ruined walls with no army left, and you set out to build a new one. Every realm you reach fights differently.

Humans, the classic pieces you start with. On a 3D board you can face any direction, so I gave the pawn its moves mirrored to every side.

Elves live in the forests, hide in cover, and strike from a distance.

Dwarves are tough warriors, shove enemies off ledges, and forge shields to weather a charge.

Mermaids reshape the field with water and drag your pieces out of position.

Constructs are clockwork. They stack on top of each other into stronger forms and queue up actions that go off a few turns later. They are is inspired by Gungi from Hunter x Hunter.

In the endgame, you will fight the Demons that took over the human kingdom.

Between battles you head back to the hub and spend what you won at the Guild shop, hiring new pieces into your army.

Design your own pieces

This is the part I am most excited about. There is a visual, block-based workshop where you build your own chess pieces out of the same blocks the game's own pieces are made of. You snap together how a piece moves and what it does, watch the preview update as you go, then hit [b]See it in action[/b] and drop it into a test battle to try it out.

Where the game is at

I am making this in the open and it is still growing. If it looks like your kind of game, wishlist it and follow me in this journey. It honestly helps a lot.

store_data.about_the_game:
Driverless Desire


When Wayfarer's flagship robotaxi strikes and drags Reyna Solano—an overnight home-health aide legally in a crosswalk—Chief Safety Officer Cormac Quade realizes the disclosure he signed helped turn a woman's death into "acceptable risk." Federal probes are closing in. A city hearing looms. An expansion is shipping the same flawed build. And three women are converging on him—each holding a different piece of the truth he helped bury, each offering a romance shaped by confession, complicity, and the cost of finally telling the true cause.

An adult romance visual novel about the cost of "acceptable risk."

Meet the Cast




Talia Herrera — The Operator
A 25-year-old remote-assistance operator, Talia is one of the hidden humans propping up "autonomy"—and the one the company has chosen to blame. Sharp, funny, broke, and scared underneath the bravado, she's pressured to sign an NDA that would book a dead woman's night as her "missed takeover." Her route is a romance built on consent, power, and proof: whether the man with the signature will spend her like the company expects, or stand beside her when she refuses to be disposable.



Orla Kelleher — The Commissioner
The city's transportation commissioner, Orla holds Wayfarer's operating permit—and the power to suspend the fleet in public daylight. Years ago, she and Cormac shared a life rooted in public safety, until he left for equity and the argument ended them; now she demands the true cause before she brings the gavel down. Dry, formidable, and unwilling to soften the one decision she cannot soften, Orla is a second chance that may only exist long enough to be lost again.



Marit Sundberg — The Engineer
Wayfarer's principal perception engineer, Marit built the system that decides what the car sees—and she's the one who flagged the edge case before it killed someone. She's Cormac's closest colleague: a slow-burn intimacy forged at whiteboards and late-night diagnostics, now poisoned by the question of who stayed quiet and why. Off the clock, she keeps homing pigeons—living navigation she doesn't have to debug, and a private world she doesn't let in lightly.

Key Features

  • Three romance routes, three moral collisions. Choose who Cormac faces first—the operator being scapegoated, his former love turned regulator, or his closest engineer—and watch the story branch into distinct, high-stakes relationship dynamics.
  • A tense, procedural techno-thriller backdrop. Federal investigations, discovery demands, acquisition pressure, and a live "pull the fleet or don't" countdown keep every intimate moment shadowed by consequence.
  • Explicit adult content in every route. Each of the three romance routes contains explicit adult scenes with its love interest.
  • A modern theme about "acceptable risk." The story examines how institutions turn harm into tolerances—and what it costs to stop protecting the narrative and start protecting people.
  • Endings with residue. Whether you rebuild, choose duty, or burn it down to testify, the game refuses easy absolution—because you can't patch your way back to a life already lost.

Content Warning

This game is an adult romance visual novel featuring mature sexual content and adult themes, including romance with power imbalance dynamics, workplace and political pressure, and story elements involving an off-screen fatal traffic incident discussed in dialogue and documents. Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
I believe that a love for play is often human nature, and games generally have a strong positive role in actively motivating us to learn scientific knowledge.

What kind of world is the world we live in? Our compulsory education experience once lifted a corner of the veil on the scientific world for us.

The material world built from chemical elements, the evolution of molecular reactions, genes, cells, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species, biological evolution and biodiversity...

This scientific knowledge cannot be observed directly, yet it has subtly become the scientific common sense of modern people.

Learbgame attempts to build a scientific-knowledge-based version of Earth Online, using this knowledge as its foundation.

The game is still in a very early playable version, and in the days ahead it will continue to be updated and iterated.

As long as there is life, there is tinkering!

store_data.about_the_game:
Outlast the frontier. Bury the legend.

Frontier Survivors is a Western-themed wave-survival roguelike where every minute is a stand against escalating bandits, bug-swarms, ghosts, gunslingers, and the boss that's been hunting your trail for three days.

Pick from 15 Gunslingers, each with a unique active ability and starting kit. Use Showdown to drop bullet-time for 5 seconds. Use Tinkerer's Touch to upgrade your weapon mid-wave. Use Last Rites to revive once per run, but only when you're below 10 HP. The character you pick shapes the entire run.

Survive 20 waves across 12 hand-painted frontier biomes: cracked deserts, copper mines, autumn cornfields, frozen pine forests, and the boneyard where most runs end. Each biome has its own enemy mix, its own destructibles, and its own atmosphere.

Build your loadout from 100+ items across 6 set bonuses. The deeper you go, the more synergies break open.

Recruit your Posse: 48 spirits of the fallen who follow you between runs and grant passive bonuses. The right posse turns a slow run into a steamroll.

When you die, your WANTED poster marks the run: time survived, kills landed, biggest crit, gold earned. Save it, share it, or set it on fire and start again.

FEATURES

• 15 unique Gunslingers, each with active abilities

• 12 hand-painted biomes with distinct enemy rosters

• 100+ items across 6 synergy sets

• 48 collectable Posse spirits with passive bonuses

• 20-wave runs, roughly 15 minutes each, plus Endless mode

• Daily and Weekly bounties

• Full controller support

• Persistent meta-progression: Stash currency, character unlocks, heirloom collection

Built solo by MisterEoss. Made for people who lose a run, stare at the WANTED poster, and immediately hit Play Again.

Compose. Optimize. Relax.

Idle Harmony is an incremental music-building game where every note you unlock becomes part of a living composition. Build beautiful melodies, discover new instruments, optimize your musical loops, and watch your creations generate income—even while you're away.

Unlike traditional idle games, your progression isn't just measured in bigger numbers. Every upgrade expands your soundtrack, transforming simple loops into rich, evolving pieces of music that you can save and share.

Turn Music Into Progress

Experiment & Optimize

store_data.about_the_game:
— intercepted transmission fragment: "…the subject is awake. Begin the evaluation."

A place with no name

You wake up in a cubic room. Four doors, one per wall. No explanation — only a voice through the speakers, clinical and cynical, welcoming you to your "tests". To that voice, you are not a person. You are Subject 101.

Every door is a gamble

Behind each door: another room, identical at first glance. Some are safe. Others hide lethal traps or puzzles blocking the way. You can backtrack at any time — but traps never deactivate. Somewhere in the maze, there is an exit. No one will tell you where.

You are not alone — which might be worse

Other subjects wander the rooms. Some will help you. Others will lie to you, rob you, or sacrifice you without blinking. You decide who deserves your trust — and what happens to those who don't.

You are being watched

Every move is observed, logged, commented on. The voice judges you. The facility studies you. And the deeper you go, the louder one question becomes: what are these tests really for?

Surviving the tests is only the beginning

Because the facility doesn't just evaluate you — it houses you. Between trials, you're given a room, meals, faces that grow familiar. The other subjects live here — some have for a long time. You will sleep under its cameras, eat at its table, grow attached to people it owns. And the more normal this life starts to feel, the clearer one truth becomes: the comfort is part of the test, too.

What you do leaves marks

Spare or execute. Help or abandon. There is no morality meter on screen — but nothing is forgotten. How you cross the maze will determine the ending you deserve.

Features

  • A maze of cubic rooms to explore freely — push forward, backtrack, go around
  • Lethal traps and puzzles, always active, never forgiving
  • A dozen survivors: potential allies, guaranteed traitors
  • Between the tests, a life among the other subjects: a room, routines, bonds — and what they cost
  • An ever-present voice that comments, taunts and judges (full French VO, English subtitles)
  • Your moral choices matter: multiple endings based on how you play
  • A claustrophobic atmosphere: cold neon, half-light, silence that listens
  • As a bonus, 2-player local split screen (Versus races, Duo Survival) — requires a controller and a keyboard (or two controllers)

Inspired by paranoid sci-fi chamber thrillers (Cube) — a psychological thriller where the real question isn't "how do I get out", but "who will I be when I do".

We Don't Exist is still in active development — more content is on the way before release.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fake Snake is a grid-based logic puzzle game about two snakes, two different boards, and one shared sequence of moves.

Every command you enter controls both snakes. The puzzle is finding a plan that works on both sides at once.

Two Problems, One Solution

Each level gives you separate boards with different walls, goals, pickups, and paths. Move up, down, left, or right, then watch both snakes follow the same instructions.

A route that solves one board may destroy the other.

Plan First, Run Second

Queue your moves, edit the sequence, then press run. Fake Snake is about planning a solution before committing to it.

When the sequence starts, all boards play out together. If either snake crashes, the plan fails.

Twist The Board

Rotation pickups turn the board and change the puzzle mid-solution. Some pickups affect their own board, another board, or every board at once.

A good plan has to survive the layout changing under it.

Create And Share Levels

Build your own puzzles in the included level editor. Place walls, goals, snakes, rotation pickups, and switches, then test your solution directly inside the editor.

Validated levels can be exported and shared.

Features

  • Grid-based puzzle solving with shared input

  • Two-board and multi-board levels

  • Planning mode with editable move sequences

  • Rotation pickups that transform the board

  • Optional bonus goals and star ratings

  • Built-in level editor

  • Clean neon cyberpunk visual style

store_data.about_the_game:
Swap gems continuously, build combos, and use relics to push your score higher.

Puzzlogue is a roguelike match-3 puzzle game where you can continuously swap gems during a single move.

Plan your route within the time limit, create multiple matches, and combine combos with powerful relic effects to reach the target score.

A Match-3 Puzzle with Continuous Gem Swapping

Unlike traditional match-3 games, where you swap only two adjacent gems, Puzzlogue lets you move a selected gem continuously across the board during a single turn.

Plan your route carefully and create several matches before time runs out. The more combos you make, the higher your multiplier becomes, allowing you to earn even more points.

Combine Relics and Create Your Build

Relics provide a wide variety of effects. Some strengthen specific gem colors, some reward large combos, and others activate when gems are matched in particular shapes.

Study the properties of each relic, combine their effects, and build a strategy of your own.

Special Effects Change the Rules of the Puzzle

Some relics alter gem appearance rates, add special effects to gems, or even change the conditions required to create a match.

Focus on a single color, build around long combo chains, or aim for specific match shapes. The relics you choose will determine which strategies are most effective.

Shops and Stage Selection

As you progress, you can obtain new relics and consumable items from shops and stage rewards.

Choose your next stage from several options, each with different effects and rewards. Compare what your current build needs with the risks and rewards of each stage before deciding which path to take.

Clear the Stages with a Different Build Each Run

The relics, items, and stages available to you change with every run.

Combine the effects you find along the way and create a build capable of reaching the target score. Failure sends you back to the beginning, but each new run gives you another chance to discover different combinations and strategies.

Key Features

- A route-planning match-3 puzzle system with continuous gem swapping
- Score attack gameplay built around combos and multipliers
- Build creation using a wide variety of relics
- Special effects that change matching rules and board conditions
- Stage progression based on choosing between different effects and rewards
- Different relics, items, and strategies in every run

store_data.about_the_game:
The town is afraid of mirrors. Seven victims - each found seated in front of cracked glass. The press calls it the work of the "Mirror Killer". You are the investigator, and there are three faces in your file: Sonya, the pharmacist. Liza, her twin. And Mark - the perfect neighbor with the perfect smile.

INVESTIGATE

Sweep crime scenes with your flashlight: what the light touches is what you get. Every clue goes into your case journal - and without evidence, no one will let you point a finger.

INTERROGATE

Suspects lie. Catch the lie, present the right document, earn trust - or become the next name on the list. Hard evidence gates: you cannot accuse on a hunch.

SURVIVE

The nights belong to something else. Timed escapes, wounds, hunger, cold - and sanity that bends. When panic takes over, even the dialogue choices start moving under your cursor.

DECIDE

7 endings. The true one is not given - it is earned: the basement, the testimonies, the shard of a mirror. One wrong door is enough to die.

  • Flashlight investigation with "what you see is what it is" scenes
  • Case journal and strict evidence-gated interrogations
  • Survival layer: HP, bleeding, hunger, cold, sanity
  • Rare, carefully dosed scares - no jump-scare spam
  • 7 endings, 3 save slots, save points at your desk
  • Interface & subtitles: English, Russian, Korean, Japanese

store_data.about_the_game:
Dodge crowds by rotating your body and get on your train in time inside Japanese subway stations.

GAMEPLAY

  • Sprint through absurdly crowded subway stations

  • Rotate your body to fit tiny gaps

  • Optimize your path to get faster clear time

  • Compete in speedrun leaderboards

SPEEDRUN

Salaryman Simulator is built for speedrunning, with built-in timer and leaderboards.

Compete with friends and the world for the best time.

Can you be the fastest to run to the train?

MODIFIERS

  • Night Shift. Your eyes will be closing often, reducing vision.

  • Nomikai. Your screen will get wobbly because you are drunk.

OVERVIEW

You are an office worker who commutes to work by train every day.

You also like to sleep (who doesn't?)

Since you get up late, your last chance to get to work in time is the train departing in 60 seconds!

You don't want to be late, do you? You know the boss wouldn't like it...

There is a problem though... You are not the only office worker in town.

Stations are full of people, and if you bump into one, you need to stop and apologize, losing precious time.

Only the best salarymen know the art of running and evading other people.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build an esports empire from a single scrappy roster, and outsmart an opponent that actually thinks back.

FRAGLINE is an esports team management simulation where every call you make, from the draft board to the final round of a grand final, is answered by an opponent that adapts, learns, and punishes hesitation. This isn't a scripted ladder you grind through. It's a mind game against the other side, and they're reading you as hard as you're reading them.

An Opponent That Adapts and Fights Back

Most management games hand you a difficulty slider. FRAGLINE hands you an opponent: one that reads your composition, adjusts its tactics between rounds, and exploits the weakness you didn't know you had. Your own coaching decisions matter because the other side is genuinely reacting to them, not rolling dice. Beating a higher-rated team here feels like it should: like you out-thought someone.

Design Your Sets, Then Watch Them Play Out

Build your own set plays in the set editor: coordinated strategies, positioning, and executes that carry your team's identity. Then watch them come to life live, round by round, in a clean and readable 2D match view. No black-box "you won" screens. You see whether your set beat their read, and you see exactly why. This is where your coaching actually shows.

Build Your Team, Your Way

Every player has a full set of stats and a defined role, and none of them stand still: talent develops, peaks, and declines over time. The roster you build is a collection of careers you manage, not a static lineup. When you need fresh blood, scout for new talent and filter your search by role, country, or tournament to find the exact piece your team is missing.

Negotiate, Sign, and Prepare

Signing a player is a real negotiation, not a single click. First you come to terms with their club, then you sit down with the player to settle money and conditions, and the deal only goes through if your budget can carry it. Once they're in, the training and preparation screen is where you sharpen the squad and get them ready for what's coming.

The Portal: A World That Reacts to You

The scene is alive, and it talks. The Portal is FRAGLINE's in-game news feed, where every transfer, every locker room dispute, and every rumor ripples out across the world and lands on your players. Sign a controversial star and the headlines follow. Let tension build in the locker room and the speculation writes itself. Your decisions don't disappear into a menu. They become the story everyone is reading.

Shape the Game With Us

FRAGLINE is being built in the open, and Early Access is where it grows. Adding it to your Wishlist now means you're there from the first build: following development and helping steer the game toward its full release. Major updates are already on the road ahead; a full 3D match presentation mode, layered on top of the engine you're playing today, is one of them.

Wishlist FRAGLINE now to be first in when the doors open.

store_data.about_the_game:
DEFLECT, DON'T DODGE. SEND IT BACK.

Every bolt the enemy fires at you is a weapon waiting to be stolen. Catch it on your deflector and send it screaming back into the ship that fired it. DEFLEKT is a neon arena shooter about turning the entire screen's firepower against itself - one perfectly timed deflect at a time.

FIFTEEN ARENAS. FIFTEEN BOSSES. ZERO REPEATS.

Fight across 15 handcrafted arenas - from the Temple of First Light to the Final Throne - each with its own map, its own color, and its own music. At the end of every one: a unique boss with its own movement, attack pattern, and signature ability. Chargers, teleporters, bouncers, wall-casters, snipers. The late ones deflect YOUR shots right back - out-read them or get erased.

FIVE SHIPS. FIVE PLAYSTYLES.

Every hull shoots differently and carries its own super that charges from kills: the Violet Manta's deflect shield, the Cyan Razor's overdrive, the Crimson Raptor's shockwave, the Emerald Wasp's homing swarm, and the Gold Vanguard's radial nova.

THREE SOUNDTRACKS. YOUR MOOD.

Not like any other game: DEFLEKT ships with three full soundtracks and lets you switch between them any time, even mid-run. Pound through arenas on original vocal EDM anthems written about the game, lock in with an instrumental synthwave and darksynth score, or ride the classic arcade tracks DEFLEKT was born with.

BRING A FRIEND. OR FIGHT ONE.

  • SOLO - one ship against the endless swarm, chasing the high score
  • LOCAL CO-OP - two ships, shared lives, one screen
  • LOCAL VERSUS - deflect bolts back and forth until someone stops deflecting

BUILT FOR SCORE CHASERS

Combo multipliers, perfect parries, rank grades, and a run timer. Every level tracks your best. Full Xbox controller support and keyboard + mouse, with instant restarts that keep you saying one more run.

A GAME THAT GROWS WITH YOU

DEFLEKT still has a ways to go - and that is by design. Our developers are listening to how gamers want to see this game evolve, and every free update will be shaped by what you tell us.

Leave feedback on the official DEFLEKT website - the Visit the Website link right on this page takes you there - and you will physically see the game improve: new arenas, new ships, new modes, smarter bosses, whatever the community calls for.

Buying DEFLEKT is an investment: you are not just getting the game as it is today, you are getting every version it becomes. Tell us where to take it - and we will make it YOUR game.

store_data.detailed_description:
A tiny flock living on your desktop


Tiny Desktop Birds is a relaxing desktop companion game where little birds fly across your Windows desktop and gently become part of your daily screen life.

They may perch on application windows, rest near your video player, wander around your workspace, or simply fly by while you are working, studying, browsing, or taking a break.

Relax, watch, and enjoy


There are no battles, no pressure, and no complicated goals. Tiny Desktop Birds is designed to be a cozy, peaceful experience that stays with you in the background — like a small flock of living decorations on your desktop.

Watch them fly, land, idle, and interact with your screen in subtle ways. Sometimes they gather together. Sometimes one little bird quietly stays beside your window. They are here to make your desktop feel a little warmer, softer, and more alive.

Features


  • A cozy desktop companion experience
  • Little birds that fly around and perch on your desktop windows
  • Relaxing, low-pressure gameplay
  • Cute hand-drawn bird animations
  • Designed to run alongside your daily work, study, browsing, or video watching
  • A peaceful atmosphere for players who enjoy desktop pets, cozy games, and tiny living companions

Let these tiny birds bring a bit of nature, calmness, and charm to your everyday desktop.
store_data.short_description: Tiny Desktop Birds is a cozy desktop companion game where cute little birds fly across your Windows desktop, perch on app windows, rest near videos, and quietly keep you company while you work, study, browse, or relax.

store_data.about_the_game:
A rhythm game where you serenade elven women!

Play your heart out on the harp and win the affections of 15 beautiful elves across a sprawling fantasy city!

 

'Elf Girls Dig Bards' is a rhythm game wrapped in a storybook. You are a traveling bard sent to an elven city full of souls who've forgotten how to smile. You have one summer — ninety days — to play your music and, unlock their stories, their hearts and their... well, you are a bard.

 

Tap circles, ride sliders, and spin to the beat as suggestive lyrics set the mood and the artwork leaves less and less to the imagination. Every performance deepens your bond, earns you gold, and reveals a new side of the girl listening.

 

STORY

The High Bard opens a portal and gives you a simple mission:

 

"There's a city out there full of souls who've forgotten how to smile. You are a bard. Music is your gift. But being a bard has never been just about music. A bard brings joy by whatever means they can."

 

"You have one summer. Ninety days. Help them find their smiles — and then move on."

 

From the shy half-elf hiding by the fountain to the bratty princess behind the palace gates, each girl carries a story that only your music can unlock. A wallflower learning to sing again. A veteran reconnecting with her past. A duchess rediscovering how to dance. A songstress who wants to be known for more than her body.

SYSTEM

 

  • Play your harp to the rhythm: Tap, slide, and spin in time with the music. Every note you land sends harp waves through your listener, healing body and soul — and the better you play, the more she opens up to you. Progression artwork evolves as you play, transitioning through stages from clothed to... considerably less so.

  • 15 elven women across 5 city districts: Explore Moonlit Park, The Rusty Lute tavern, Market Square, Verdant Academy, and the Crystal Palace. Each district has three locations and three girls waiting to hear your song — from Aria the Wallflower to Coda the Princess.

  • 90 original songs: Six songs per girl, unlocked as your relationship deepens. Genres span dreamy lo-fi to hard rock, orchestral waltz to chaotic pop, Celtic folk to dark electronic. The lyrics? Let's just say they're not subtle.

  • A relationship worth building: Progress from Stranger to Soulmate across five milestone levels. Each milestone unlocks new songs, new dialogue, and new artwork.

  • 90 days, your way: Morning, afternoon, evening, night — four time slots per day. Girls appear at different places at different times. Choose who to visit, when to rest, and how to spend your summer. After the story ends, Freeplay mode lets you keep playing with no time limit.

  • A gallery to revisit: Unlock up to 450 progression images and all 90 songs in the Gallery. Browse by character, replay your favorites, and admire the art at your own pace.

store_data.about_the_game:
This isn’t just another boxing game — it’s a workout, a challenge, and a test of reflexes. Whether you’re training your speed, practicing defense, or just looking for a fun way to throw punches, Shadow Boxing delivers an experience that feels both physical and immersive.

Shadow Boxing uses webcam body‑tracking to turn your real punches, blocks, and movements into in‑game actions.

Key Features

  • Punch with Precision: Aim for the head or body — faster punches deal more damage.

  • Beware the Kicks: Opponents’ kicks hit harder than their punches, so stay alert.

  • Defend Smart: Raise your elbows above your shoulders to block incoming attacks.

  • Human‑like AI Opponents: 4 challenge boxers, each boxer fights with unique styles.

  • Accessible Gameplay: Designed for all players, with adjustable difficulty and clear manual.

store_data.about_the_game:
This game was created to support the female illustrator, MIN.

It is a project born from the hope that she will continue creating art.

A portion of the proceeds will be used to support her.

Love Line is a puzzle game featuring hand-drawn illustrations created directly on an iPad.

Solve puzzles as you follow the story of a man quietly in love.

To tell a story about placing your feelings into a letter and sending them to someone you love, we created the game around the concept of drawing lines across a sheet of stationery and connecting two hearts.

Whenever your line passes through a circle, the circle changes its shape.

It represents his wish for their hearts to become one.

A stage is cleared when every circle has the same shape and the line is successfully connected.

Each time you clear a stage, you unlock a new illustration.

Across 100 stages, you will gradually discover the feelings hidden in the man’s heart.

After completing the entire main story,

Alice’s Story will be unlocked, adding another 100 stages that reveal her side of the relationship.

Alice’s Story introduces a new obstacle: an eraser that removes the lines you draw.

Avoid the moving erasers and find a way to complete each puzzle while discovering Alice’s true feelings.

For players who want to focus entirely on the puzzles,

the game also includes a separate Arcade Mode featuring 100 additional stages.

The game also features unique characters called Blips, who try to stop you from drawing your line.

Each Blip represents an emotion that interferes with a confession of love, such as jealousy, envy, and sadness.

Draw a loop around them to trap and remove them, allowing you to focus on solving the puzzle.

Solve a wide variety of puzzles and enjoy a heartfelt love story.

A separate Storyboard Mode also allows you to revisit the story at your own pace while listening to the game’s beautiful original soundtrack.

Features

  • 100 illustrated storyboards

  • Two perspectives: his story and her story

  • 300 puzzle stages

  • A dedicated Storyboard Mode for enjoying the complete story

  • 13 original soundtrack pieces

  • My Letter Mode, unlocked by completing Arcade Mode, where you can write and preserve your own message of up to 100 characters

store_data.about_the_game:
My Highly Educated Sub: Female Dean - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core Plot Introduction
Late at night, in the library of St. Helena College, poor student Bastian accidentally discovers the confidential documents of the Fix Group and is brutally chased. At the moment of life and death, he fuses with the No. 7 consciousness insect and gains wonderful abilities. After that, he uses his abilities to approach literature professor Katya and psychological counselor Zoe, and at the same time catches the attention of Principal Bejahas. A storm is quietly approaching.
Worldview Atmosphere
The story constructs a campus world full of technology and mystery. The Fix Group is carrying out secret plans such as neural dust and human experiments behind the scenes, covering the entire campus with an atmosphere of danger and unknown. Elements such as quantum fusion and consciousness legions make this world full of science fiction and surreal colors.
Highlights of Female Character Interactions
There are wonderful interactions between Bastian and female characters such as Katya and Zoe. Katya is a Latin mixed - race professor with a hot figure and elegant temperament. Bastian can read her emotions, and a subtle affection arises between them; Zoe is an intellectual psychological counselor, but she hides suppressed desires in her heart. Bastian successfully opens her heart and makes her completely obedient.
Tension in Character Relationships
The relationships between Bastian and the female characters are not only full of emotional entanglements but also have a complex tension of being used and using. He needs to use the power of the female characters to fight against the Fix Group, and the female characters gradually fall into the emotional whirlpool during their contact with him. At the same time, his relationship with Principal Bejahas is on the verge of a showdown, and a confrontation is about to begin.
Scene Features
From the dim library, the campus alley in the rain, to the narrow dormitory, the warm psychological counseling room, and then to the high - class apartment bedroom, each scene has a unique atmosphere. The confidential documents in the library kick off the story, the chase in the alley makes people extremely nervous, the communication with the professor in the dormitory is full of ambiguity, and the psychological counseling room and the apartment bedroom show the characters' inner desires.
Immersive Experience
Players will follow Bastian's perspective and personally experience his thrilling encounters and emotional journey. In the game, players seem to be in that crisis - filled campus world, feeling various emotions such as fear, excitement, and desire together with the characters, with a strong sense of immersion.
High - Definition Visual Performance
The game uses high - definition pictures to delicately show the appearance, expressions of the characters and the details of the scenes. Whether it is Katya's charm, Zoe's intellectuality, or the campus buildings and apartment decorations, they are all vivid, bringing a visual feast to players.
Functional Gameplay Features
The game supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves at any time and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots, and the automatic play function makes reading smoother. The chapter browsing function allows players to freely choose the parts they want to read, and the high - definition CG presents wonderful pictures to players.

store_data.about_the_game:
Before you close the Iron Gate, decide who gets to stand inside it

Beneath the Iron Gate is a grounded post-apocalyptic interactive cinematic narrative. You play as Lu Chen, a former security systems engineer who turns an old cold-chain warehouse into the Black Box, a shelter built before the city goes silent and public order collapses.

The shelter is not the end. It is where the choices begin

Every supply run, every opened door, and every broadcast can redirect the route ahead. You will weigh food, medicine, fuel, water, reputation, and trust. A decision that looks correct tonight may become the cost you pay during the siege.

Evidence can hit harder than a weapon, if you survive long enough to use it

The Ark Society controls vaccine batches, registry systems, and broadcast channels. You will gather sample IDs, ledgers, access records, and witness testimony, then decide when to turn silence into proof. Revealing the truth can save people, but it can also bring the enemy to your gate.

Not every ally learns to trust you the same way

An emergency doctor, a supply-chain manager, a retired tactical officer, a radio host, a lab assistant, and the shelter's ordinary survivors all carry their own limits and fears. Trust is not just a reward meter. It is whether someone still stands beside you when the gate alarm starts.

Branches, bonds, and endings

The story follows resource, medical, broadcast, truth, siege, and relationship routes. Your choices affect supplies, character trust, public reputation, ruthlessness, and the final route. You can turn the Black Box into a cold fortress, or into a community still willing to open the door.

Features

  • Grounded post-apocalyptic interactive storytelling with still-frame presentation, subtitles, voice, and soft cinematic transitions.

  • Choice-driven route structure where resources, trust, evidence, and public reputation keep shaping later scenes.

  • Character bond routes built around alliance, boundaries, affection, and responsibility.

  • Multiple ending directions, including fortress survival, medical commonwealth, radio fireseed, and hidden truth routes.

  • A focused single-player experience about judgment, tradeoffs, and consequences rather than grind.

store_data.about_the_game:
—That clock had come to a quiet stop, still carrying someone’s memories—

A full-fledged mystery adventure that blends exploration and deduction

A murder has occurred at the mansion. Gather evidence, interview witnesses, spot inconsistencies, and use your own deductive reasoning to track down the true culprit.

Story

A Murder at an Isolated Mansion

Eli, a rookie detective, is invited—along with his assistant, Maki —to the birthday party of the eldest daughter of the Claude conglomerate.

But that night, someone is murdered.

All contact with the outside world is cut off, leaving only those involved in the case behind.

Who is lying?

Who is hiding the truth?

And what is the past hidden behind this case?

Gameplay

store_data.about_the_game:
Grab the sun. Burn the swarm.

You are the magnifying glass. Bugs skitter across the screen. Point, hold, and cook.

Track. Burn. Chain.

Your beam heats whatever sits under it. Drift, and it cools. Hold steady, and things start to smoke.

Bugs know what's happening. As they heat up, they panic — accelerating, jittering, breaking in every direction to escape the light. Catch one before it bolts and you ignite it. Ignite another before the combo bar empties and your multiplier climbs. Miss a beat and the chain snaps back to 1x.

It's simple. It's mean. It gets very fast.

Build a beam that breaks the game.

Every ignition earns Sparks. Every round ends at the upgrade tree. Push raw power, a bigger lens, hotter beam, faster cooldown or bolt on new physics entirely.

Make dying bugs explode, torching everything nearby. Split your heat ray toward the nearest survivor. Drag the beam to leave a burning trail across the field. Turn ignitions into spore clouds that choke the swarm and stop them cooling. Flash cyan-hot criticals that shatter bugs for bonus payouts and shake the screen loose.

Grab a mid-round drop and everything slows to a crawl, or your beam overcharges, or the whole screen ignites at once in a Solar Flare.

Bigger bugs. Bigger fires.

Score enough and the round meter maxes out. That's when the Tier Bosses arrive. 

Each one brings it's own challenge.

Beat one and you permanently unlock the next tier of enemies for every run after.

Three ways to burn.

  • Arcade — Climb the enemy tiers, break the bosses, build the loadout.

  • Hard — unlocked after you clear Arcade. The clock runs shorter and Sparks pay half. Bugs hit harder, move faster, run wilder.

  • Zen — every upgrade maxed, no timer, no consequences. A fully-powered lens and a screen full of bugs. Vaporize the swarm.

Fire Bug is a solo-built arcade game about the very small, very violent joy of finally catching that one bug that thought it got away.

Grab the sun.
