store_data.about_the_game:
BallSlop is a pooptastic multiplayer party game featuring custom-painted rolling balls, baby sphere hoarding, fart boosts, wall splats, and messy arena chaos.

Paint your own ball, roll around the arena, scoop up baby spheres, grow huge, slow down, charge up your dash and BALLSLOP other players into walls with a massive poopshoot. Or pukeshoot jumping fools out of the sky with a homing blast that decimates your opponents. Or just JUMP on them to squish them into a submission making a colorful mess all over the arena.

Bump your friends, splat them against a wall, and try to bank the most points before everything turns into a colorful disaster.

See which one of your friends you can make scream the loudest and who can't help but splat themselves.

JUMPS BUMPS and DUMPS.

Ballslop your friends and foes until you have to actually go to the bathroom yourself.

Paint Your Ball

Before the chaos starts, draw directly onto your sphere. Make a face, a mess, a family sigil, a terrible joke, or something suspiciously artistic. Your custom ball rolls into every match exactly as painted.

Sloppy Party Chaos

Every match can turn into a pileup of rolling bodies, paint trails, surprise effects, fart attacks, burps, splats, and ridiculous comeback moments.

Features

  • Custom paint-your-sphere system

  • Chaotic baby sphere collection

  • Multiple minigames to choose from

  • Attack others and Defend yourself with jumps, shots, and dashes.

  • Wall splats, bumps, jump squishes, and messy paint trails

  • Trap panels, boost strips, shields, vacuum pulls, pulse pushes, and other chaos

  • Single-player against computer controlled spheres and multiplayer party play

  • Built for online friend rooms and random matchmaking

QUICK 3-MINUTE MATCHES

Currently choose from three different minigames

Baby Rescue

Collect baby spheres from the arena and carry them back to your portal. The more you carry, the bigger and slower you get. Bank safely, or risk getting bumped, squished, splatted, or forced to drop everything. 

Baby Dash Pickup

Race through messy tracks while grabbing baby spheres, dodging hazards, hitting boost strips, triggering trap panels, and trying to cross the finish line before anyone else. 

Baby Blasters

Enter the battle royale armed with your handy dandy baby spheres. Goal: Obliterate all else in your path and rack up the most splats! Squish, pukeshoot, and poopcharge your enemies into oblivion.

store_data.about_the_game:
You answer an advertisement for a simple overnight job. Before leaving, the homeowner asks you to do just one thing:

"Take care of my heifer."

A strange way to talk about someone you love... Does anyone really call their girlfriend that?

Before leaving, he hands you a detailed schedule. Feed her at midnight. Bring her water an hour later. Prepare her bath. One instruction, however, appears over and over again:

Never enter her room.

At first, everything feels merely unusual. But one missed task, one careless mistake, or one moment of curiosity is enough to turn an ordinary night's work into an unforgettable nightmare.

Take Care of My Heifer is a first-person story-driven horror game that blends a tense atmosphere with unexpected events and dark humor. Follow the schedule, explore the house, uncover its secrets, and do everything you can to make it until morning.

Features:

• A short story-driven horror experience (about half hour).

• Complete your nightly tasks according to a strict schedule.

• Explore the house and uncover its hidden secrets.

• A tense atmosphere that slowly descends into madness.

• Dark humor that appears when you least expect it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the ultimate 2D platforming challenge!

This is a pure, reflex-driven 2D platformer that focuses entirely on skill and precision. No distractions—just a classic stickman, meticulously designed geometric levels, and the ultimate test of your gaming mechanics.

🎮 Gameplay

Take control of a stickman as you run and leap through a world filled with unknown dangers. Your objective is simple: learn the layout of the levels through trial and error, dodge every lethal trap along the way, and safely reach the checkpoint!

🌟 Key Features

  • Hardcore Level Design: Every ledge and every gap has been fine-tuned. To survive, you must master the exact timing and distance of your jumps.

  • Lethal Trap Matrices: Spikes, chasms, and sudden obstacles await. The terrain itself is your greatest enemy—one wrong move, and it's instant restart!

  • Minimalist Visual Style: Clean stickman animations and crisp lines allow you to stay 100% focused on your inputs and strategies.

  • Die, Retry, and Triumph: Build muscle memory through failure. The unparalleled sense of accomplishment when you finally hit that safe checkpoint makes every attempt worth it.

store_data.about_the_game:
AMERICAMAN is an unfiltered satirical narrative adventure where culture, politics, and American absurdity collide.

Don the cowl of America’s most bumbling patriot in an animated interactive cartoon inspired by classic adventure games and adult animation. Explore bizarre locations, interrogate eccentric characters, solve absurd puzzles, and navigate impossible social predicaments in a world where nothing is sacred.

THE HOSTAGE CRISIS AT BAAL BANK

Americaman finds himself trapped inside Baal Bank during a bizarre hostage situation orchestrated by his archnemesis: The Noticer.

A bomb has been rigged with an impossible condition, thrusting Americaman into an absurd moral dilemma where brute strength won’t save the day. To rescue the hostages, he’ll have to improvise, manipulate, and stumble through an escalating series of increasingly ridiculous solutions.

Talk to terrified civilians, suspicious staff, and eccentric personalities as you explore Baal Bank, uncover strange clues, and attempt to stop a catastrophe before everything goes violently wrong.

A SERIALIZED ADVENTURE

Americaman is released as a serialized adventure.

Each Episode is made up of multiple Chapters, with every Chapter focusing on a major self-contained crisis while building toward a larger story.

This release is Chapter One of Episode One: the opening hostage crisis at Baal Bank.

FEATURES

  • Point-and-click narrative comedy gameplay

  • Stylized animated cartoon visuals

  • Absurd dialogue and eccentric characters

  • Satirical storytelling and bizarre puzzles

  • Explore Baal Bank during an escalating hostage crisis

  • The opening chapter of the Americaman saga

    Featuring stylized cartoon animation, bizarre characters, satirical storytelling, and conspiracy-era Americana, AMERICAMAN plays less like a traditional game—and more like a lost adult cartoon.

store_data.about_the_game:
Vesper Station went dark six months ago.

Full crew complement — right up until the day they stopped logging. No distress call. No evacuation filing. Vesper Corp stopped talking about it.

Now it's your problem.

[hr][/hr]

A ROUTINE JOB


You're a veteran salvager with a ten-year career and a contract that should have been straightforward. Strip the hull. Pull the salvage. Go home.

But the deeper you go into Vesper Station, the clearer it becomes that nobody left — and whatever happened here is still happening.

The hooks by the door. Every single one still full. Nobody grabbed their gear on the way out.

Nobody left.

[hr][/hr]

SURVIVE THE STATION


Vesper Hollow is a top-down sci-fi horror roguelite set aboard a single derelict mining station. Every run takes you deeper into its failing corridors, where oxygen drains constantly, automated defenses patrol the dark, and the walls hold secrets that Vesper Corp buried for a reason.

  • Oxygen is your clock. Your suit leaks. Every second costs you. Manage your reserves, push deeper, and know when to extract.
  • Combat that demands respect. Security drones patrol in formation. Turrets scan methodically — and react instantly when provoked. Getting caught in the open is a death sentence.
  • A station with a story. Each run uncovers more of what happened on Vesper. Salvage logs, terminal fragments, and rooms that shouldn't exist tell the story of a corporation that optimized its workers into something worse than death.
  • Upgrades between runs. Salvage funds new equipment. Reinforce your suit, extend your oxygen capacity, and push further with each attempt.
  • One station. Infinite depth. Procedurally generated floors mean no two runs are identical — but the horror gets worse the further down you go.

[hr][/hr]

THE TRUTH IS DEEPER THAN THE SALVAGE


Vesper Corp called the project a success.

Zero turnover. Zero sick days. The shareholders were thrilled.

Nobody asked where the crew went.

[hr][/hr]

Vesper Hollow is currently in development. Wishlist now to be notified at launch.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cratebreaker: Wasteland Workshop is a post-apocalyptic progression game about turning junk into power, and power into survival.
You begin with almost nothing: a ruined workbench, a weak tool, a few crates dragged in from the wastes, and a shelter that barely deserves the name. Every crate you break open might contain scrap, old-world parts, military tech, strange relics, or something that should probably have stayed sealed.
At first, survival is simple. Break crates. Sell junk. Buy better tools. Break tougher crates.
Then the wasteland starts answering back.
Your workshop grows into a full operation: vehicles roll out on expeditions, factory lines turn salvage into components, radio signals reveal hidden opportunities, factions compete for your loyalty, bandits threaten your routes, and fragments of a forgotten AI system called EDEN begin to surface.
Every system feeds the next. Loot funds upgrades. Upgrades crack stronger crates. Stronger crates provide parts for vehicles. Vehicles unlock missions. Missions reveal new sectors. Sectors change prices, threats, weather, and rewards. The more you build, the more the wasteland notices.

Build Your Workshop

Turn a dead bench into a working post-apocalyptic machine. Upgrade manual tools, automation, cooling systems, raid tech, defenses, vehicles, and production lines. Manage heat, critical hits, crate durability, passive income, and long-term progression.

Break Crates, Recover Relics

Crates are the heart of the loop, but they are not just containers. They are fuel for the whole game. Smash wooden junk crates, military caches, corporate safes, cryogenic capsules, and stranger things. Collect common scrap, useful parts, rare electronics, epic relics, and legendary old-world artifacts.
Items can be stacked, sold, restored, displayed in the trophy case, used for crafting, delivered to factions, or consumed to build vehicles and upgrades.

Send Missions Into The Wasteland

Build civilian and military vehicles, then send them beyond the workshop. Civilian expeditions bring cash, crates, and supplies. Military raids bring weapons, chips, relics, and risk. Signal leads, faction jobs, and bandit operations expand the world beyond simple clicking.
Vehicles can return damaged, successful, unlucky, or carrying something far more valuable than expected.

Run A Factory

Raw salvage can become something greater. Craft reinforced frames, microchips, quantum cores, and other advanced components. Unlock production lines that generate passive income and keep your operation alive even while you focus on raids, radio work, or crate breaking.

Scan The Radio

The radio room lets you search the dead bands for distress calls, traders, military chatter, anomalies, and EDEN signals. Some transmissions offer rewards. Some unlock missions. Some sound like they were never meant for human ears.
Boosting a signal can improve the payoff, but the wasteland does not like being listened to.

Choose Your Factions

The old world is gone, but people still organize around hunger, fear, faith, and machines. Work with Metro Engineers, Wasteland Scrappers, Oasis Coalition, Signal Choir, and Ash Legion. Reputation unlocks bonuses, exclusive leads, and new paths, but supporting one group may create pressure elsewhere.
The workshop may be neutral at first. It will not stay that way forever.

Raid Bandit Strongholds

Bandit factions grow from desperate scavengers into organized threats. Prepare assaults, meet entry requirements, install raid tech, then attack enemy bases building by building. Gates, generators, loot shacks, towers, armories, and boss structures fall one target at a time.
Each destroyed faction weakens the wasteland’s threat network and opens new rewards.

Defend What You Built

Your success attracts attention. Raiders can strike the workshop, damage the base, and threaten your stored resources. Build barricades, traps, turrets, alarms, and defenses to hold the line when the wasteland comes knocking.

Explore A Changing Map

Travel through sectors such as stations, bunkers, rail yards, refineries, cities, labs, bandit territory, and contaminated zones. Each sector changes the economy, loot tables, mission rewards, route risk, and world conditions. Weather, threats, and events reshape the map as you progress.

Uncover EDEN

Under the crates, signals, ruins, and raids lies something older: EDEN, a buried reconstruction system from before the collapse. Its fragments are scattered through the wasteland. Recovering them unlocks lore, power, and a final question:
Do you rebuild the old world, sell what remains of it, control it, destroy it, or become part of it?
Cratebreaker: Wasteland Workshop is about building momentum from scraps, watching small systems connect into bigger ones, and turning a broken shelter into something mean enough to survive.
Break crates. Feed the machine. Decide what rises from the ruins.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hentai Elf Elaria is an adult game that combines the enchanting atmosphere of fantasy, the charm of elven magic, and engaging puzzles. Elaria is a graceful elf with long blue hair, a mysterious smile, and a captivating gaze. She lives far from the human kingdoms, hiding her secrets deep within ancient forests and powerful magic.

With each new level, you will get to know Elaria better. At first, she appears reserved and mysterious, but gradually reveals new sides of her personality. Every victory unlocks new illustrations, while her appearance becomes increasingly elegant and daring.

Game Features:

Two stages in every level:

  • First — a memory game where you match identical pairs of cards.

  • Then — a puzzle featuring Elaria, unlocked after completing the first stage.

Character progression:

  • Each new level unlocks new versions of Elaria, showcasing her beauty and elegance.

Plenty of content:

  • 24 levels in each mini-game — 48 stages in total with gradually increasing difficulty.

Additional:

  • Achievements for full completion.

  • Gallery to view all unlocked illustrations.

  • Three difficulty levels: Easy / Normal / Hard.

Hentai Elf Elaria is a journey into a magical world of elves, where magic, mystery, and beauty come together in an enchanting adventure. Will you uncover all the secrets of the mysterious Elaria?

store_data.about_the_game:
There is no flashlight.

There is no night vision.

There is only sound.

Every footstep reveals the world.

Every thrown object becomes a map.

But every sound also reveals you.

Strange whispers guide you.

Familiar places change.

The silence itself becomes threatening.

Are you discovering the world...

or has something already discovered you?

SEE THROUGH SOUND

Every sound reveals the world.

Then it disappears again.

Navigate complete darkness using sound.

Every action briefly reveals your surroundings.

FEATURE LIST
EVERY SOUND HAS A COST

Footsteps.

Thrown objects.

Echoes.

Everything helps you survive.

Everything helps them find you.

SILENCE IS NEVER SAFE

No cheap jump scares.

No scripted chase sequences.

Wake builds tension through paranoia, uncertainty and sound.

A WORLD THAT LISTENS

The environment reacts.

Silence changes.

Whispers lie.

Reality slowly begins to shift.

NOTHING CAN BE TRUSTED

Not every sound is real.

Not every voice tells the truth.

Not even your own perception.



Headphones are strongly recommended.

Wake is built around positional audio, and many gameplay cues rely on directional sound.


Wake launches as a complete single-player experience. Online co-op is planned as a free post-launch update.

store_data.about_the_game:
DIG INTO LIVING WORLDS

Every planet is a real sphere. Gravity pulls toward the core, so you can walk the whole way around it, then dig straight down through it. And digging is real: no scripted holes, just true mesh deformation. Every cave and tunnel you carve stays exactly where you left it.

Mine from crust to core

  • Break through rock into iron, then richer ore the deeper you go.

  • Hunt rare signature minerals hidden deep in every world.

  • Planets are finite. The closer to the core, the greater the danger and the reward.

Survive the descent

  • Oxygen drains while you are outside the ship. Go too deep and you won't make it back.

  • Core heat wears down your suit near the molten center.

  • The best minerals are always one step past safe.

Refine, upgrade, go deeper

  • Smelt raw ore into credits at your ship's refinery.

  • Upgrade your laser, oxygen, heat shield, and refinery at the Fabricator.

  • The best upgrades need rare minerals, so travel is part of the plan.

Fly between planets

  • Pilot your ship in full 6DOF flight, land on distant worlds, or warp across the system.

  • Your ship is a walkable base with live windows onto space.

  • Each planet is its own biome, with different gravity, atmosphere, and minerals.

Fight for the void

  • Pirate fighters warp in and hunt you in open space.

  • Fire down your ship's nose, drop their shields, and blast them into mineable wreckage.
store_data.detailed_description:
DIG INTO LIVING WORLDS

Every planet is a real sphere. Gravity pulls toward the core, so you can walk the whole way around it, then dig straight down through it. And digging is real: no scripted holes, just true mesh deformation. Every cave and tunnel you carve stays exactly where you left it.

Mine from crust to core

  • Break through rock into iron, then richer ore the deeper you go.

  • Hunt rare signature minerals hidden deep in every world.

  • Planets are finite. The closer to the core, the greater the danger and the reward.

Survive the descent

  • Oxygen drains while you are outside the ship. Go too deep and you won't make it back.

  • Core heat wears down your suit near the molten center.

  • The best minerals are always one step past safe.

Refine, upgrade, go deeper

  • Smelt raw ore into credits at your ship's refinery.

  • Upgrade your laser, oxygen, heat shield, and refinery at the Fabricator.

  • The best upgrades need rare minerals, so travel is part of the plan.

Fly between planets

  • Pilot your ship in full 6DOF flight, land on distant worlds, or warp across the system.

  • Your ship is a walkable base with live windows onto space.

  • Each planet is its own biome, with different gravity, atmosphere, and minerals.

Fight for the void

  • Pirate fighters warp in and hunt you in open space.

  • Fire down your ship's nose, drop their shields, and blast them into mineable wreckage.
store_data.short_description: Dig into fully destructible spherical planets and carve real caves from crust to molten core. Mine rare minerals, refine ore, and upgrade your suit and ship. Travel between worlds and fight pirates in open space. How deep can you go before your oxygen runs out?

store_data.about_the_game:
Bind the risen. Hold back the Hollowing.

The dead do not rest at the crossroad. Gather a collection of cursed souls, master the five strains of the Cross, and prove yourself across four complete ways to play — from lightning auto-battles to real-time castle sieges. One collection. Four games. Endless dark.

Hollowcross is a gothic-horror collectible card game where every card you own plays in every mode — so the deity you forge in one becomes a weapon in all of them.

Four games, one cursed collection

⚔️ Battler — Walk the Saga

Bind a warband of five and let them fight. Battles auto-resolve in a cinematic clash you can watch in 2D or 3D. March through the Warden's Saga — a sprawling story campaign of rising foes and dark truths — then test your warband against other Wardens on the Ranked ladder.

🎲 Gauntlet — Break the House

A roguelike draft. Pull cards from a shifting shop, merge duplicates into starred powerhouses, and out-survive an eight-warband lobby. Climb the purgatorial death-casino known as The House — all the way to its grinning croupier god.

👻 Souls — Duel of the Damned

Take the field yourself in a turn-based 1v1 of summons, strikes, and blocks. Spend your souls, hold the line with guardians, heal, hex, and pierce — and climb 26 tiers of the Gallows Spire to face the gentleman-ghost who waits at the summit.

🏰 Siege — Storm the Keeps

Real-time, three-lane castle warfare. Spend gold to deploy your host, push down the lanes, and raze the enemy keep before they raze yours. Guardians raise shields, mages hurl fireballs, hexers slow the advance — and whole castles get up and walk.

Master the Cross

Five strains devour one another — SPIRIT ▸ FLESH ▸ BLOOD ▸ STORM ▸ VOID ▸ SPIRIT. Strike into a strain you beat and hit 50% harder. Every card also carries a battlefield role — Guardian, Mender, Hexer, Mage, or Bruiser — so who you field matters as much as what.

Collect. Forge. Ascend.

  • 1,700+ cards across six rarities, from Common to the mighty Deity.
  • Fuse and evolve — feed duplicates to level your cards and evolve them into higher stars.
  • Earn the deities — complete each mode's story to claim its unique god card. They can't be bought or dropped — only earned.
  • Every mode levels on its own — its own progression, climb, and story — while your cards, shop, upgrades, and guild are shared across all four.

Play your way

  • Free to play.
  • 2D or 3D — swap the battlefield renderer any time.
  • Cross-platform — play on Steam or in your browser; your Warden follows you.
  • Guilds & community — found a guild, wear a tag, and climb together.
  • 64 achievements to hunt across the four modes.

The crossroad is open, Warden. What will you bind?

Numble takes the classic concept of "Wordle" and gives it a twist: numbers! Become a master codebreaker and crack the secret access codes! After each guess, the colors of the numbers you entered provide clues to the correct code. Do you have what it takes to crack them all?

Features

  • Crack secret number codes using logic

  • Multiple game modes

  • Endless mode with increasing difficulty

  • Fully customizable rules

  • Unlock colorful themes

  • Mouse, keyboard and controller support

Multiple Game Modes

Challenge yourself with a variety of game modes! Solve classic number puzzles with different code lengths, test your skills in an endless mode that gets progressively harder, or take on speedrun challenges where every second counts.

Customize your Rules

Use the Custom Mode to tailor the rules to your liking and create the perfect challenge: adjust code length, allowed digits, attempts, time and even more!

Crack Codes in Style

Unlock new color themes by solving codes and give your game a fresh new look!

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

After falling from their constellation, a pair of stars must journey from the depths of the earth back home, climbing upwards through new puzzle filled environments that will challenge them along their path to return to the stars.

Characters

An uneven dynamic - with Little Star having lost his light and needing to cower away in the shadows, they need Big Stars strength to push blocks, creating paths of shadows, to guide their little sibling safely to the other side. Use the swap button to switch between the two stars, finding uses for both, as you guide them through their journey.

Chapters

Ascend through four chapters - Cave, Forest, Sky and Space - each littered with unique handcrafted puzzles. Every chapter introduces new challenges, forcing the duo to combine their unique celestial traits to cross each obstacle together. 

Puzzles

Shadows are the key - push blocks, press buttons and twist dials to manipulate this grid based world and block light. Bite sized challenges with tricky solutions are neatly fitted within one screen to entertain both casual and dedicated puzzle fans.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your restaurant. Your crew. Rent's due at close.

Sizzlix is a co-op restaurant management sim for 1–4 players. Every day runs
9 AM to 9 PM: prep the kitchen, open the doors, cook and serve a growing menu,
then spend your profits on new machines — because tomorrow is busier, customers
are less patient, and the rent just went up.

🍔 A kitchen that works like a kitchen

  • 18 dishes — burgers with exact-order toppings, fries, pizza, ribs, tacos,
    salads, fried chicken, roast chicken, breakfast plates, coffee, milkshakes and more
  • Every station does its real job: chop boards chop, fryers fry, ovens bake —
    and anything left on the heat too long burns to a crisp
  • Multi-step recipes: chop the onion, fry the rings, plate the ribs,
    build the taco — with progress rings on every machine

🪑 Real service, not a hatch

Customers park outside, walk in, queue up, order — then take a seat at a table.
You (or a teammate on front-of-house) carry each finished dish to the right
diner before their patience runs out.

📦 Run the business, not just the stove

  • A back-office computer for ordering stock, setting prices, and turning menu items on and off
  • Supply trucks deliver real boxes — haul them in and organize your own storage cabinets
  • Buy 8 new machines (pizza oven, rotisserie, blender, ice cream machine...) to unlock new dishes
  • Rearrange your whole kitchen in manage mode — your layout is saved

👥 Co-op that actually shares the work

Host or join over Steam in seconds. Everything is shared — the till, the stock,
the orders, even the oven doors. Split the roles: one on grills, one plating,
one running the dining room, one bossing everyone around from the office.

⌨️ Your controls

First-person or third-person camera, full keyboard/mouse and gamepad support,
and every binding is remappable.

store_data.about_the_game:
You’re a freelancer drifting through a life that quietly envelops you. You work from home, sleep late, and order takeout—the days blur together, and you can’t even remember the last time you spoke to someone face-to-face. On a restless night when you’re bored and feeling a little lonely, you download a dating app called Spark, where people are saving up money. What’s the worst that could happen?

That’s where you meet Rin.

A conversation that started as an ordinary chat is taking an unexpected turn for both of you. Late-night text messages are turning into a real connection—effortless, honest, the kind you thought you’d never find again. You talk about everything and nothing. And in the midst of these conversations, loneliness slowly begins to fade away.

✦ “Fully voiced in 12 languages.”
✦ Multilingual support — as the game expands, you’ll be able to play in your preferred language.
✦ Introducing Spark, a dating app with realistic swiping, profile creation, and chat features — just like when you first met Rin.
✦ Mini-games integrated into the open-world game environment (cooking, preparing snacks, and more) offer the freedom to explore and unlock new dialogues and events.
✦ A live streaming system where you can watch Rin’s livestream alongside a real-time chat feed.
✦ Intense and passionate moments captured in high-quality, animated CG scenes.
✦ Instant “extra end” interactions shaped by Trust, Love, and Affection stats
✦ Rin’s evolving dynamics and the development of an intense, dynamic relationship over time
✦ Deep dialogue trees — get to know Rin through her streams, costumes, hobbies, meals, and dreams.
✦ And countless other surprises waiting to be discovered...

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE DEVIL'S CUT

In life you bet it all and lost. You died broke, buried in debt — and Hell has a special place for people like you. It's the Devil's Cut Casino: where every damned gambler ends up when the tab finally comes due. The Devil doesn't want your money. He wants a show. So you'll settle your debt his way — on the casino floor, gun in hand, against everything Hell throws at you.

WORK OFF YOUR DEBT

Fight through endless waves of demons and cash in your winnings to pay down what you owe. Climb the ranks floor by floor, drop the boss guarding each one, and the deeper you go the meaner the waves get — and the bigger the payouts. Clear your whole tab and you walk out with your soul. Die, and the Devil resets the meter.

SHOOT, RUN, GAMBLE

This isn't a stand-still auto-battler. Aim and shoot, run and dodge, and time your abilities to stay alive. Between fights, every upgrade is a bet — spin the slots for random rewards, double-or-nothing your loot at the wager tables, stack stats and buffs, and take cursed items for busted power with a catch.

PICK YOUR SINNER

Play as the casino's regulars — the damned who gambled their lives away, each with their own vice, their own kit, and their own debt to clear. Free one character's soul, then move on to the next tab.

THE HOUSE ALWAYS WINS

"lost my rent to a cartoon devil. would do it again." - a satisfied customer

store_data.about_the_game:
Forged Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder where you don't collect cards, you make them. Take up the hammer of a journeyman smith, gather ingots and recipes, and forge cards in your deck by hand: choose its effects, temper its power, and inscribe it with conditions that turn simple strikes into engines.

Forge Your Own Cards

Every card starts as a mold with open slots. Slot in Casts (what it does), set its Temper (how hard it hits) and Duration (how long it lasts), then etch Inscriptions that generate and spend Flux for bonus payoffs. Found a recipe for Burn? Pair it with Damage for a unique effect.

Outsmart, Don't Outdraw

Combat is simultaneous. You see the enemy's hand — but not the order they'll play it. Arrange your three cards into positions, lock in, and watch both sides resolve in lockstep. A well-placed Block blanks their opening blow; a Vulnerable at position one supercharges everything after it. Sequencing is key.

Every Run Is Yours

  • Explore random maps across 4 distinct biomes

  • 30 Casts across three smithing schools: aggression, protection, and attrition. Combinable into multi-alloy cards

  • Inscriptions that build lifesteal, executes, stuns, and combo engines out of simple parts

  • Over 100 items, mystery events, and boss-forged molds to bend each run around

  • Draft mode: build your starting deck one pick at a time

  • 15 stackable Masteries for escalating difficulty, plus an uncapped Endless mode

  • Fully seeded runs — share a seed, share the exact run

store_data.about_the_game:
Slash, Loot, Dive Again

DemonBlade Pixel: Hyakki Senkou is a 2D action roguelite about reading bullet patterns, collecting demon blades, and rebuilding your loadout between runs. Bring back materials and gear, sharpen your build, and dive deeper into the night.

35 Chapters Of Yokai Battles

The story spans 35 chapters with distinct yokai bosses, patterns, and stage gimmicks, from the Kappa Apothecary and Nekomata Thief to Raiju, Nurari, and the Kamaitachi brothers.

8 Playable Fighters

Choose from Yuki Kunoichi, Oni Samurai, Kappa Apothecary, Nekomata Thief, Raiju Lancer, Kitsunebi Onmyoji, Nurari Cursed Ronin, and Tengu Yamabushi. Each fighter changes how your demon blade collection comes alive.

Kimon Renrou And Challenge Bosses

Kimon Renrou is a layered boss-chain mode where encounters and rewards escalate as you climb. Post-story challenge bosses test your mastery of positioning, loadouts, and ultimate timing.

Solo Or Online Co-Op

Play alone or fight in up to 3-player online co-op. Character roles, weapon synergies, and shared survival choices matter when the screen fills with yokai fire.

AI Content Disclosure

Some in-game artwork, visual effects, backgrounds, and selected music were created with generative AI tools during development and then edited and reviewed by the developer. The game does not generate AI content during play.

4927140.name: Dice & Dare : A Push-Your-Luck Casino-Style Dice Roguelike

store_data.about_the_game:
Every roll is a dare.


Grab the dice. Feel the weight of the pot. Now make the only choice that matters: cash out and play it safe, or press your luck for one more roll and watch your winnings multiply... if you don't bust first.

DICE & DARE is a push-your-luck, casino-style dice roguelike about greed, nerve, and the perfect run that always feels one roll away. Every climb is freshly shuffled, every decision is yours, and the only way forward is to push further than you did last time.

Roll. Push. Bank. Or lose it all.

Easy to learn, ruthless to master. Roll your dice, score combos, and grow the pot. Then answer the question that never gets easier: bank it and lock in your points, or push to compound your haul against a rising chance to bust. The deeper you push, the sweeter the payout, and the closer the fall.

Build a machine of pure greed

Between rounds, spend your winnings and assemble an engine that bends the rules in your favor. Collect charms, relics, and wild jokers, unlock exotic scoring combos, and stack modifiers until a single roll erupts into a cascade of points.
  • Hundreds of build paths from a deep pool of collectible relics that reward wildly different strategies.
  • A living synergy board where you arrange your relics on a grid, cluster matching powers to make them resonate, and uncover hidden golden combinations.
  • Characterful colored dice that each carry their own scoring tricks, turning a plain handful of dice into a custom instrument of luck.
  • One-shot power cards held in reserve for the exact moment a run hangs in the balance.
No two runs build the same way. The magic is finding the combo the game never saw coming.

Face the challenge rounds

Just when your engine feels unstoppable, the table turns. Challenge rounds hit you with twisting rules that escalate the higher you climb, daring you to adapt on the fly. Bend your build around them, break through, and bank a bigger reward for your nerve.

An endless climb, built for "just one more run"

There is no finish line, only the next target rising in front of you. Chase your personal best, smash your own records on the local high-score board, and fight for a place on the global leaderboards. The run ends only when your luck does, and the only sensible response is to reach for the dice again.

Feel every roll

Chunky, tactile dice tumble across a rich casino table. Coins spill, combos burst, and a smooth-talking croupier calls your fortune as the tension winds tighter with every push. This is a game you feel in your gut as much as in your head.

Push your luck. Build your engine. Climb forever.
How far will you dare to push?

Key Features

  • Push-your-luck dice gameplay you can pick up in seconds and chase for hours.
  • Roguelike runs with freshly shuffled shops, relics, and challenges every single time.
  • Deep engine-building across hundreds of relics, synergies, scoring combos, and power cards.
  • An endless, escalating climb with local and global high-score leaderboards.
  • Rich casino-style presentation with satisfying dice, punchy sound, and a living table that reacts to your greed.

store_data.about_the_game:
You write the loop that fights for you.

In SIGABRT, fighting is programming. You build a while(1) loop out of code instructions, and it runs top to bottom every turn, fighting on its own. Winning means writing a better loop: pick the right edits, compile a build that lasts, and get deep enough to reach the kernel of a machine that's crashing around you.

Write the loop

Every edit is one line of code. Attack, block, overclock, malloc, reflect, leech. You arrange them and the interpreter runs the program for you. A forecast shows the next iteration before you lock it in, so winning comes down to how you build, not how fast you react. Change a single line and the whole battle plays out differently.

No run compiles the same

Every descent builds a new operating system to fall through, with room-clustered districts, hazards, and enemy castes that punish different builds. You draft edits and salvage relics into archetypes that actually play differently: heal-heavy, block walls, glass cannons, drain, or self-rewriting loops. What you end up with is never the same twice.

Descend a dying machine

You fall from /tmp through /proc, /dev, /net, and /var, down to /kernel. Nobody stops to explain any of it. The story is in the fragments you read and the districts you cross, and every boss you reach is a build that failed before you did. Somewhere at the bottom is a goodbye that was never finished. You are the newest attempt to get there.

Then leave for the Net

Compile a function and the endgame opens up: the Net. It's a boss rush against procedurally generated enemies, fought with a deck built entirely from the functions you've banked. It ends at a final boss you cannot kill, the Halting Problem, where the goal is to last as long as your build can and post a personal best.

Features

  • Programming as combat. You build a while(1) that fights on its own, and a forecast lets you plan each turn instead of gambling on it.

  • Roguelike deckbuilding. A deep pool of code edits, relics, and events, with six build archetypes that are all worth playing.

  • A procedurally generated OS. New districts, mazes, hazards, and enemy castes on every run.

  • Six biomes and a hidden endgame. Descend from /tmp to /kernel, then head out into the Net.

  • Four playable characters. Each starts with a different loadout, and you earn the next one by winning a run rather than grinding for it.

  • Drawn entirely in code. Every enemy and effect is rendered procedurally. No stock art, no asset packs.

  • Play it your way. Reduce motion, remap the controls, scale the UI, and set volume per channel.

Debug your code. Try one more time.

store_data.about_the_game:
DELVERS: Dragon's Hoard is a run-based party autobattler incremental. You don't control the heroes in combat - you assemble them, upgrade them on a sprawling skill tree, then send them marching into the depths where they fight on their own. The catch: Vigor is the only resource, and it only goes down. Every enemy hit and every step deeper drains it. When it hits zero the run is over, but the gold you hauled back is permanent, and it buys a party that reaches further next time.

Descend far enough and the biome turns against you: slimes give way to kobolds, then goblins, skeletons, and finally the demons and eldritch horrors of The Deep.

KEY FEATURES

  • Ten classes, one party. Knight, Berserker, Archer, Cleric, Wizard, Thief, Bard, Paladin, Necromancer, Warlock - each with its own range, cadence, and role. Hire them from the tree and watch the formation fight without you.
  • A 70-node skill tree with 9 keystones, 3 duo fusions that only unlock when two paths meet, and hidden nodes revealed as you push outward. Respec-free: the tree refunds anything it reforges.
  • Four elemental brands. Ember, Rime, Storm, and Acid turn ordinary hits into burns, chills, forks, and corrode stacks.
  • Dragon bosses every 10 depths, each with a cone-breath attack you must step out of - and a once-only Dragon Heart on first kill that funds heart-tier keystones like a second wind, a drake companion, and a dragon-slaying pact.
  • Potions and momentum, the only verbs mid-run. Three potions on a belt - Heal, Fury, and Dragonfire - plus a momentum system that rewards clearing a room without taking a single hit with escalating gold.
  • Made of pixels. Crisp pixel art, six biomes, dozens of enemy types.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your army doesn't sleep. Neither do your enemies.

You've staked a claim on a moon that everyone else wants too. Your outpost runs on autopilot, extracting what it needs to survive, but the real game is building an army, a war machine, and the intelligence to know exactly where to strike next.

MoonScape is a persistent strategy game about raiding, defending, and escalating. Every rival corporation on this moon is running its own operation. Your Radar array is what turns "we don't know what they have" into "we know exactly where to hit them." Profile enemy bases, read their strength before you commit, and decide whether that base is worth the losses. Get it wrong and your own base gets hit back, structures damaged and forced offline until they can auto-repair and resume normal operations.

Nothing pauses when you log off. Your War Room keeps producing units, your Research Lab keeps advancing whatever upgrade you queued, and rival bases keep deciding whether tonight is the night they come for you. Close the game mid-build or mid-siege and come back later to find out how it played out without you.

Building a competent force takes more than raw numbers. Research unlocks better units, stronger defenses, and casualty reduction that keeps your veterans alive across repeated engagements. Your War Room produces a growing roster:

Scout Buggies for reconnaissance:

Moon bikes for speed:

Drone ships a great all rounder:

harvesters to support the economy behind your war effort, and heavier assets like battle tanks, artillery pods, shield droids, and laser cannons once subtlety stops working. At the top of your arsenal sits your Titan, a singular war machine built in one of two specializations. Modules looted from combat range from common scrap to legendary gear, and can upgrade your Titan directly or strengthen your army instead.

Rival bases aren't identical. Radar intel reveals each one's attacking and defending composition before you commit, so you know roughly what you're walking into and can bring the right force for the job.

There's more to this moon than corporate territory, too. Excavation was supposed to be about resources and salvage. It doesn't stay that way for long. Something else lived here once, built things here, and isn't around anymore. Why does a moon this rich sit abandoned. What actually happened to whoever came before you. The deeper you dig, the less it looks like an accident.

Key Features

  • Persistent offline simulation. Your War Room, Research Lab, and every rival base keep operating in real time whether you're playing or not. Raids resolve, research completes, and threats escalate while you're away.

  • Build and specialize your army. Produce a full roster of units from fast scouts to heavy artillery, backed by a research tree that unlocks stronger gear and reduces casualties in the field.

  • Command a Titan. Construct a war machine in an economy or military specialization, then equip or upgrade it with modules looted from combat, or use that loot to strengthen your army instead.

  • Radar-driven raiding. Scout rival corporate bases, read their attacking and defending composition, and plan raids that exploit what you find.

  • Damage and recovery. A successful enemy raid can knock structures offline, forcing you to wait out an auto-repair before your base returns to full operation.

  • Dynamic incoming threat assessment. Live threat-level readouts from Low to Critical tell you exactly how outmatched, or safe, your base is at any given moment.

  • A mystery beneath the surface. Excavation turns up more than salvage the deeper you go. This moon wasn't always abandoned, and finding out why is its own kind of endgame.

  • Fully rendered 3D visuals. Every unit and structure is modeled in 3D and shown turntable-style, viewable from every angle. But the real graphics engine here is your imagination. Raids, sieges, and the fight for everything you've built play out in your head, driven by intel reports, threat readouts, and the models you've unlocked.

Welcome to The Thicket! 🌲 A post-apocalyptic visual novel where you are the only man in a world of wild, beautiful kemonomimi femboys! 🐾

Seven years after the collapse of civilization, you stumble into "The Thicket," a hidden settlement deep in the overgrown ruins of the old world. Half-dead and exhausted, you are taken in by six uniquely charming femboys with mysterious animal traits. But there's a catch: you are the first and only male they have ever seen! 😱

When a violent all-female raider faction called "The Reapers" begins closing in on your new home, your combat experience and tactical mind become their only hope. Over the course of 12 days, you must survive the wilderness, build up defenses, and most importantly... win their hearts! 💖

✨ KEY FEATURES ✨

  • 🦊 Six Unique Femboys: Meet Roxy the Alpha (Wolf 🐺), Chloe the Trickster (Fox 🦊), Stella the Healer (Deer 🦌), Luna the Shadow (Cat 🐈‍⬛), Ivy the Engineer (Snake 🐍), and Willow the Heart (Bear 🐻). Each has their own distinct personality, backstory, and kemonomimi traits!

  • 💕 Intimate Romance: Spend 12 thrilling days and nights in The Thicket. Build deep bonds, earn their trust, and unlock 12 beautifully illustrated, intimate encounters (2 specific NSFW scenes for each character!). 🥰

  • 🏕️ Survive & Protect: Defend your new found family against ruthless raiders, scavenge for resources, and uncover the secrets of a pre-collapse military bunker. ⚔️

  • 📖 A Gripping 12-Hour Story: Dive into a rich, immersive narrative filled with action, tension, heartwarming moments, and the beautiful theme of found family. 🌸

Are you ready to survive and find love in the wild? 🌿✨

store_data.about_the_game:
THE APOCALYPSE FITS IN A STRIP ABOVE YOUR TASKBAR

Idle of the Dead is a zombie-apocalypse idle RPG that runs in Windows taskbar. Your squad auto-battles endless zombie hordes while you work, browse, or play something else, and it keeps earning even while you're offline.

LEAD A SQUAD OF SURVIVORS

Command the bat-swinging Outlaw, the sharpshooting Scout and the life-saving Nurse. They attack, dodge, heal and unleash skills automatically,  you build the team, the team clears the horde.

A LOT OF CONTENT TO EXPLOREEEE

Four escalating difficulties (Outbreak, Collapse, Extermination, Apocalypse), each with 3 Acts and dozens of stages. A dozen hand-drawn biomes, from ruined suburbs to the burning depths of hell, with elite mini-bosses and a towering boss in every Act.

DEEP PROGRESSION

Every hero has its own skill tree with dozens of talents to shape your build. Unlock new survivors and mix-and-match your squad.

LOOT & RARITY

Hunt gear across seven rarities, from common junk to game-changing Uniques. Fill your stash and chase the perfect roll.

DDTANK-STYLE FORGE (0 TO +15)

Push your weapons up with gold and stones, luck stones raise your odds, protection stones hold your level when the risk gets real.

THE SYNTHESIS TERMINAL

Fuse items and shards in the Terminal to reroll rarity and craft what you need. Turn scrap into power.

YOUR LOOT IS REAL STEAM ITEMS

Unique drops become tradable items in your Steam Inventory, list them, sell them, or buy them on the Steam Community Market. Move gear both ways between the game and Steam. Your grind has real value.

FEATURES

  • Runs above your taskbar, plays while you work

  • Idle & offline progression

  • Multiple heroes, each with a full skill tree

  • 4 difficulties × 3 acts × dozens of stages, 12+ biomes

  • Elite mini-bosses + towering Act bosses

  • 7 loot rarities, sockets & sets

  • Forge (0→+15) & Terminal crafting

  • Tradable Unique items on the Steam Community Market

  • Steam Achievements

WISHLIST NOW AND SURVIVE THE OUTBREAK

store_data.about_the_game:
LIMINOID is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

store_data.about_the_game:
In The Normie Apocalypse, the world has fallen under a zombie apocalypse, where all of the normal people are turning into zombies! You work for an agency, which is trying to fight back against the zombie outbreak! Build you deck of wierdos and misfits to battle the zombies in combat in order to meet the quota for your agency each day! Do you have what it takes to go up against these green-skinned foes, or are you a NORMIE too?

You build your deck as you go along killing zombies, accumulating XP which is used to meet your QUOTA, and level up, allowing you to add new cards to your deck! There are 64 unique cards, and 48 unique treasures, making each run new and exciting! Each area lasts five days, and each day you have a QUOTA to reach, or it's game over! Don't forget the bloodthirsty zombies you're up against either, with over 25 unique enemies to fight! On your turn, you first play your CHARACTER cards, then stack them up with ITEMS to use in combat! There are three main STATS that the game uses: OFFENSE, which is the damage you deal on your turn, DEFENSE, which is how much you block against enemy damage, and MORALE, which acts as currency and your lifeline! If MORALE hits 0, it's game over, which is tricky, because every card you play uses MORALE! Can you manage your cards and deck well enough to stay up to date on your QUOTA, while also not falling victim to the zombies?

Re:Mori Knights is a colorful fantasy action roguelike built around fast hack-and-slash combat, magical upgrades, and replayable dungeon runs.

Fight through shifting rooms, defeat monsters, collect relics, and carve through enemies with fast, stylish combat built around tight movement, sharp timing, and satisfying combos. Each run gives you new powers to build around, new enemies to face, and new ways to push your combat style further.

Step into a vibrant fantasy world of knights, magic, monsters, and ancient relics.

Launch enemies into the air, follow them up with aerial attacks, slam them back down, parry incoming strikes, and finish fights with powerful abilities. The better you understand your moves, the more control you have over every encounter.

Find relics, weapons, upgrades, and magical abilities that change how each run plays.

Build around damage, defense, speed, aerial combat, parries, finishers, or powerful ability combinations. Every run gives you different tools, so you’ll need to adapt and experiment.

Rooms, upgrades, enemy combinations, and builds can change from run to run.

Each attempt helps you improve your timing, learn the combat, and discover stronger combinations. Win or lose, every run brings you closer to mastering your Knight.

Explore a bright fantasy world inspired by knights, enchanted ruins, magical powers, strange creatures, and lost kingdoms.

Re:Mori Knights is about style, skill, and adventure one run at a time!

store_data.about_the_game:
You keep a house that eats the things it holds.

It was here before you, and it will outlast you: a living house grown from a seed, that takes root where power

runs too deep and binds what cannot be killed. Tyrants, beasts, drowned gods — interred in its barrows, still

breathing, leaking the strength that made them dangerous. That strength runs to you now. You are its keeper.

Every power you bury makes you stronger. Every captive you hold strains against the dark a little harder. And

the longer you tend the house, the harder it becomes to say whether you are protecting the world from the

things in your yard — or simply farming them.

The Keeper's Path is a slow, atmospheric idle RPG about deep time, quiet dread, and the cost of power. There

are no quick wins here. You train your paths one at a time, choose your prey carefully, and watch the yard

glow as the bound feed you across hours and days. Then you abandon it all, carry what you've become into a

harder house, and begin again — stronger, colder, further from the person who planted the first seed.

What you'll do

  • Train forbidden paths of power — each one slow to master, each unlocking new prey to hunt and new ways to hold them.

  • Bind gods, monsters, and tyrants into your barrows, where they leak power to you for as long as the wards hold — and the strongest never stop trying to break free.

  • Hold the line against the dark. Power draws pressure. Pressure breaks bindings. A failed capture wounds you; a careless one frees everything you've caged.

  • Complete a deck of named legends — every card a specific being you must hunt down and bury to claim.

  • Ascend across ever-harder houses, carrying your whole self forward, climbing toward a godhood you may not deserve.

  • Be measured against other keepers — the boards track who has climbed highest, sealed the most, and gone deepest into the dark. A solitary game with a quiet, ruthless edge of competition.

Built to be left running. It plays while you don't. Progress accrues offline; the yard glows whether you're watching or not. Check in, make a decision, let it breathe.

For the patient, a climb measured in days. For the completionist, a deck of legends to bury one by one — and

boards that remember who has buried more. For the cold of heart, a road that bargains with what you've caged.

The path is solitary; the descent is not unwitnessed. Other keepers walk it too, and the dark keeps a record

of who has gone furthest.

There is a way to refuse the climb entirely. There is no way to keep your hands clean.

Custodian, or parasite? The house doesn't care. It only grows.

store_data.about_the_game:
A devastating earthquake shattered the land, awakening the dead from their graves. As chaos spread, survivors fled in every direction, becoming trapped in haunted locations overrun by the undead.

Explore abandoned villages, haunted forests, eerie farms, and other mysterious places. Search for supplies, rescue stranded survivors, gather resources, and upgrade your camp. Every location hides valuable loot, but also terrifying surprises.

As night falls, survive relentless waves of the undead while avoiding terrifying bosses, each with unique behaviors and frightening encounters. Some horrors cannot be defeated. Sometimes, your only option is to run.

Every choice matters.

Will you risk everything to rescue every survivor, or leave others behind to improve your own chances of survival?

Your decisions determine who lives, who dies, what events unfold, and which of the multiple endings you'll reach. Every playthrough offers new discoveries, unexpected scares, and different outcomes.

Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op as you explore, rescue survivors, strengthen your camp, and fight to survive until dawn.

Will you save everyone... or only yourself?

store_data.about_the_game:
ONE AT THE EDGE OF EVERYTHING

You wake up alone on a space station.
You do not remember who you are. You do not remember how you got here.
You do not remember why the station continues to drift through the endless void.
The only voice that greets you belongs to the station’s onboard AI.

She calmly explains the daily procedures, helps you restore the station’s systems, and assures you that the mission will end in one month — and that you will finally return home.

But the station is hiding things the AI never mentions.

KEEP THE STATION ALIVE

The station will not repair itself.
Search asteroids and drifting space debris for usable parts. Leave the station to perform dangerous repairs in open space.
Monitor oxygen, power, temperature, and airlocks. Any mistake could be your last.
Use gravity maneuvers to cross dangerous regions of space. The farther you travel, the harder it becomes to keep the station alive… and yourself.

SOMETHING IS WRONG

As you work, you begin to discover hidden recordings left behind by previous crew members.

Each new recording contradicts what the onboard AI has told you. Each one says the same thing.

No one goes home when the month is over.

THERE IS NOTHING OUT THERE.
ONLY YOU.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pull a time travel heist with your friends. Operate a makeshift time travel machine to traverse the timeline with 200+ buttons, then arrive at a time era, explore it, find the valuable, and steal it. Just don't get stranded and become part of the timeline yourself. 1-8 players.

  • You and your friends built a time machine - humanity's greatest invention. And you're using it to rob people who haven't invented police yet.

  • It's an online co-op game where you pile into a homemade time machine, with a wall of about four hundred buttons none of you fully understand. Pick a year, and go steal from it. Any year. All of them.

  • The time machine has just about 200 buttons and your friend is pressing all of them to find out what each one does.

  • So you drop into 1503 and lift the Mona Lisa off the wall while it's still just some painting nobody's heard of. You rob a pharaoh's tomb with the mummy still in it. You slip into 2009 and quietly mine a few thousand Bitcoin back when it's worth nothing - the only patient crime four idiots will ever pull off. You steal a dinosaur egg, which goes exactly as well as it sounds, because the mother is the size of a bus and she watched you do it.

  • And it just keeps escalating. You rob the Titanic - and you've got until the iceberg to get out. You clean out a cult in 1990 and take everything they own, which they were going to give away anyway. You jump to the future and steal an actual spaceship. Eventually you stop robbing history and start robbing fiction - yeah, you can go grab the Infinity Stones, and no, the big purple guy is not happy about it.

  • But here's the thing about a time machine: it leaves with whoever's inside it. So when the guards close in and the jump window starts to shut, your best friend is already in the seat - holding all the loot, watching you sprint - deciding whether to hold it and wait. store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the ultimate Wiener Rumble

This is a fast and chaotic first-person arena brawler where you have a special weapon that shoots different items and you use it to get other players out of the arena. Simple, right?

Different game modes

The game includes multiple game modes to keep things interesting and change up the action. Players can jump into a classic free-for-all where it is every sausage for themselves or team up with buddies in a last-team-standing match to see who survives the chaos. There is also capture the flag and other modes to try out, which completely change how the weapon is used and how players move around the maps.

Lots of arenas to fight in

You won't get bored of looking at the same place. The game features many different arenas to fight in and some of them make playing a lot harder. Players have to watch the opponents and sometimes the environment at the same time.

Customize your sausage

Every sausage can look exactly like the player wants. The game offers different outfits and accessories to customize the character and stand out in the middle of the battle. It is easy to show off some personal style while blasting other players off the screen.

Hunt for the secret legendary skin

For those who love a real challenge, there are multiple secret legendary skins in the game. Players can try to get them by opening mystery packs. It takes some luck and effort to collect them all, but wearing one is the perfect way to show everyone off in the arena.

store_data.about_the_game:
Quickie Takeout is a light-hearted Visual Novel where you play as an experienced worker at a chaotic fast-food joint. Between greasy orders, broken ice cream machines, and very questionable employee breaks, you’ll get into all kinds of trouble with your three very different female coworkers.

Meet your crew:

  • Sophie – The motherly manager who keeps the place (barely) running. Warm, caring… and surprisingly pent-up.

  • Riley – The chill stoner chef in the back. Laid-back, always high, and down for just about anything.

  • Emma – The energetic cashier. Bubbly, clumsy, and full of enthusiasm (in more ways than one).

Every shift brings new adventures: unexpected schedule changes, malfunctioning equipment, marketing brainstorming, customer complaints, and plenty of other ridiculous situations. The game features multiple scenes with girls, some light choice-driven dialogue variations, and alternate scene orders depending on your decisions.

While the story is mostly episodic-like and focused on fun, flirty, and explicit encounters, there’s a loose overarching plot about a local in-franchise competition: your place vs. everyone across town. Who can sell the most burgers… and who can get the most "employee satisfaction"?

Features:

  • Full voiceover, including the most explicit lines, moans, and breathing

  • 52 illustrations across several NSFW situations

  • Light choice system that changes dialogue flavor and scene progression

  • Humorous, low-stakes slice-of-life tone

  • Lewd fast-food workplace fantasies

If you enjoy shorter, straight-to-the-point NSFW Visual Novels packed with personality, humor, and plenty of heat, Quickie Takeout is ready to serve.

Approximately 2 hours for a single playthrough

store_data.about_the_game:
Knights vs. Dinosaurs is an isometric real-time action romp for solo heroes and online co-op teams. Grab a weapon, dive into the chaos, and show a world full of dinosaurs who's boss – fast, messy, and tongue firmly in cheek.

⚔️ Get Stuck In Real-time combat with sword, spear, axe and more. Dodge, strike, and mind your timing. Stand still and you'll heal – but who stands still with a T-Rex in their face?

🌾 From Farm to Depths Start on a sunny farm overworld: smash barrels and hay bales, collect chocolate coins, and find the way underground. Below wait procedurally generated dungeons – every run different, every floor deadlier.

🤝 Better Together Play solo or team up in online co-op. Clear dungeons together, revive each other after a fall, and topple bosses that'd crush a lone hero.

🎭 Six Heroes, Six Styles Pick from six playable characters – from the down-to-earth sword knight to some decidedly eccentric misfits. Each brings a unique weapon, stats, and fighting style.

🍫 Upgrade & Collect Spend your chocolate coins in the shop on permanent upgrades – more speed, longer reach, thicker hide. Collectible cards and bonuses carry over between runs.

At a Glance

  • Isometric real-time action, easy to pick up

  • Solo or online co-op

  • Farm overworld + procedural dungeons

  • Six playable heroes with unique weapons

  • Shop, permanent upgrades & collectible cards

  • Oddball bosses and plenty of humour

store_data.about_the_game:
The Ancestral Orb has returned. Will you be the one to control it, or the one to destroy it?

Immerse yourself in an epic action RPG where the fate of the world hangs in the balance. After centuries of fragile peace, the elemental balance has been shattered. Forgotten shadows stir across the realms and an ancient tyrant has awoken, seeking to gather the fragments of an artefact capable of rewriting reality itself: the Ancestral Orb.

You are Afri, a scholar residing in Ordvale, and together with Ardanas, your loyal protector, you must embark on a journey that will take you from the depths of the Church of Ordvale to the far reaches of Guildia to resolve the conflict.

Key Features

•    Turn-Based Combat System: Overcome your enemies in turn-based battles.

•    A World to Explore: Explore Guildia in search of secrets and abilities, solve puzzles and find all the orbs.

•    Deep Narrative: Join Afri, Ardanas, Rengarson and Bael’Set on this adventure and unravel all the secrets hidden within the Ancestral Orb.

•    Strategic Progression: From managing contracts in taverns to acquiring powerful ‘Ultimate Techniques’, every challenge will force you to strengthen your team and hone your skills to face the impending darkness.

The story continues...

The sacrifice of those who tried to prevent the disaster has been in vain: light and darkness have been reunited. Evil has returned and time is running out. The legend is not over, and the Ancestral Orb awaits its next bearer…

Are you ready to restore the balance, or will you let chaos consume the cosmos?

store_data.about_the_game:
Shelve the Potions! Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols, decipher cryptic notes, and uncover the correct shelf orders in a cozy organizational simple puzzle game.

The witch had to leave on urgent business. By the time you arrive for your very first day as her apprentice. Her mischievous cats have knocked every potion off the shelves, turning the workshop into complete chaos. To leave a good first impression, we might as well put them back up.

Gameplay

Each shelf is its own handcrafted puzzle with unique rules waiting to be discovered. Sort and organize over 2,000+ potions, learning how every order works through experimentation, logic, and observation.

Some puzzles can be solved at a glance, while others require finding hidden clues, using special items, or connecting information you've learned elsewhere in the workshop.

Whenever you feel stuck, Pet the magical cats, then ask them for hints. They'll point you toward missing potions, highlight important clues, or even reveal part of a puzzle's solution when you need a little extra help.

Features

  • 20+ handcrafted potion-sorting puzzles with unique rules to discover.

  • Organize and sort 2,000+ unique potions throughout the workshop.

  • Relaxing gameplay with no timers or penalties.

  • Cozy fantasy atmosphere inspired by witches, and alchemy.

  • Cute cats!

store_data.about_the_game:
You wake up somewhere familiar — maybe a hotel pool, maybe a waterpark corridor. But something's off. The tiles stretch on forever, the smell of chlorine burns your throat, and that once-familiar place has become a maze with no exit.

In POOLIMINAL, you're lost inside an endless network of interconnected pool rooms — a liminal space where every hallway resembles the last, yet none are truly the same. And somewhere deep below — in the dark, where the light can't reach — something is watching.

Key Features

🌊 Endless Poolrooms Aesthetic — Explore procedurally generated pool rooms bathed in yellowish fluorescent light, damp tile textures stretching into infinity. Each passage feels like reality dissolving a little further.

🖤 Thalassophobia-Driven Horror — No visible monsters, no cheap jump scares. The fear comes from the unknown depths: you can never quite see what's beneath the surface, only feel that something is moving.

🔊 Sound Design-Focused Atmosphere — Water ripples, distant muffled echoes, and the sound of your own breathing. POOLIMINAL relies on auditory tension far more than visual shock.

🚪 Interconnected Room System — Every room is somehow linked to the ocean itself: overflowing pools, leaking ceilings, staircases descending into deeper water. As you progress, you realize these spaces are part of something far larger — and far more real.

🧭 Disorientation Mechanics — No map. No compass. Just your instincts — and sometimes, your instincts will betray you.

Why POOLIMINAL?

If you're drawn to the unease of endless corridors, if you've ever felt that primal fear of not knowing what lurks beneath deep water — POOLIMINAL was made for you. This isn't a survival game. This is an experience of getting lost.

The water is waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Climb It Up is a vertical dungeon-climbing adventure built around movement, rewards, and co-op chaos.

Play solo or team up with up to 4 players as you climb a dangerous magical tower filled with broken bridges, hanging prison cells, unstable energy, corrupted enemies, treasure rooms, and deadly vertical paths.

Jump, climb, swing, fight, loot, and survive together — or fall because someone made one terrible decision.

CLIMB TOGETHER

Every floor is built around vertical traversal. Scale walls, leap between ledges, dolphin-jump across broken platforms, swing over deadly gaps, and climb through suspended dungeon structures as you push higher into the tower.

The goal is simple: keep moving up.

The problem is your friends.

CHOOSE POWERFUL REWARDS

Open reward totems and chests to change the way your run plays.

Choose movement tools, combat upgrades, and useful abilities that help you cross dangerous gaps, defeat enemies, reach hidden treasure, or save a run that is already going very badly.

Choose carefully. One reward can make the next climb easier. The wrong one can turn the whole team into a disaster.

SWING, JUMP, AND SURVIVE THE ABYSS

Use grappling hooks to swing across impossible gaps, recover from mistakes, reach distant ledges, or create completely new problems for everyone behind you.

Climb It Up is not just about reaching the next platform. It is about doing it under pressure, with enemies nearby, friends in the way, and the abyss waiting below.

FIGHT CORRUPTED ENEMIES

The tower is not empty.

Fight corrupted skeletons, magicians, and other enemies as you climb through broken prison floors, unstable archives, and dangerous chambers. Use melee weapons, ranged attacks, magic tools, and movement to survive each encounter.

Combat is not separate from climbing. Enemies attack while you are trying to move, jump, swing, and reach the next floor.

RISK IT FOR TREASURE

Some paths are safe. Others lead to treasure.

Search optional routes, open hidden chests, and decide with your team whether to escape safely or risk everything for one more reward. The best loot is rarely on the safest path.

BUILT FOR SOLO PLAY AND CO-OP CHAOS

Play alone and master the movement at your own pace, or bring your friends and turn every climb into a test of coordination, timing, greed, and trust.

One player can save the run.

One player can ruin everything.

Usually, it is the same player.

store_data.about_the_game:
Exo's CYOA is an LLM-driven choose-your-own-adventure game where you guide a party through dangerous places, talk to characters, inspect the world, collect gear, craft solutions, and push the story forward one instruction at a time. Instead of following a fixed script, you describe your next move and the game responds with new narration, changing world state, and fresh follow-up choices.

Explore connected locations, manage a party, handle inventory and quests, mix stealth, social actions, combat, spells, crafting, and environmental interaction, and let the game master layer consequences and follow-up opportunities onto each turn.

Your instructions, the game's actions

Your freeform instructions are automatically classified into structured world actions: moving, attacking, talking, inspecting, trading, crafting, stealth, party management, and more. Multiple actions can chain in a single turn — sneak past a guard, pick up a dropped key, and move to the next location all in one instruction. Alternatively, you can select a predefined action from the in-game menu for quick play.

Party & inventory management

Run a party of characters, each with their own attributes, skills, appearance, health, dynamic state descriptions, and personal backpack. Items can be picked up, dropped, used, and transferred between party members or traded with NPCs. Manage your gear, your team, and your resources across the world.

Quests that track themselves

Main and side quests with ordered objectives, each with their own progress and status. Quest status changes are automatically tracked as the story unfolds. You can check what you're working on at any time, pick up new objectives, or abandon old ones.

A world of connected locations

The world is a graph of interconnected locations with descriptions, ambient items, NPCs, and danger levels. Travel is governed by adjacency, you can only move where connections lead. Items and NPCs can carry over between visits, so the world persists and evolves as you interact with it.

Game Master

An autonomous LLM-driven game master runs after your turn to resolve world-side consequences: NPC reactions, pursuit, missed fallout, and quest developments. The GM can even take its own actions against the world: Enemies coordinate, allies react, and plans change without you triggering them. Toggle it on or off as you prefer.

Memory system for long adventures

A three-tier memory architecture keeps the story coherent over long sessions. A sliding chat window provides immediate context, importance-filtered summaries preserve key events, and a tag-based archive organizes everything by location, character, item, quest, and more. The game remembers what matters so it can build on it, without bloating context windows or wasting tokens.

Runs locally

The game ships with an AI engine that runs entirely on your machine, designed to work on an 8 GB GPU (Nvidia or AMD, see system requirements). No cloud dependency and no subscriptions needed

Export your adventure to PDF

Export your completed adventure as a formatted PDF in two styles: a full chat transcript showing all message types, or a clean book-style narration with only the story text. Optionally include a table of contents, memory summaries, and visited locations.

Content guardrails

A content filtering system operates at four layers: adventure setup, character creation, player input, and game output. Eight categories are blocked: minor exploitation, hate speech, self-harm encouragement, realistic gore, graphic death detail, suicide depiction, illegal activity, and adult-only sexual content. The filter allows romance, fictional conflict, dark themes, and fantasy violence while keeping hard boundaries around explicitly unsafe material. The game maintains a balance between creative freedom and responsible limits, because the storytelling depends on flexibility but also needs clear guardrails around harmful content.

content_descriptors.notes:
Exo's CYOA is an AI-driven adventure game where story events are shaped by player prompts and choices. Depending on the scenario, the game may include combat, peril, crime, frightening or dark story themes, emotional tension, and occasional mature language. Some generated stories may also reference sensitive topics such as alcohol or drug use, coercive situations, or other disturbing narrative elements.

Guardrails are used throughout the game to block explicit sexual content, sexualized content involving minors, realistic gore, graphic death detail, suicide depiction, hate speech, self-harm encouragement, and real-world illegal-activity instructions.

Players should expect mature themes and non-graphic violence, while explicit sexual acts, graphic gore, and depicted suicide are not permitted.

store_data.about_the_game:
You took a wrong turn. Your car broke down. You found a house with the lights still on. You sat down, and you turned on the TV. That was your first mistake.

The Wyoming Incident is a first-person psychological horror game from Veraxic Games, inspired by the infamous creepypasta of the same name.

SYNOPSIS

Something happened in this valley in 1982. The residents were gone overnight. The military never talked about it. The valley was never officially acknowledged. And whatever was left behind has been running ever since.

You didn't come here looking for answers. You just needed a detour. But now your car is dead, the town is empty, and the television is on. The broadcast has already started. The only question now is how much of yourself you can hold onto before it's done with you.

SURVIVE THE BROADCAST

The Wyoming Incident is built around one core threat: your sanity. The longer you stay in the valley, the more it costs you. Visuals distort. Audio warps. Your grip on what's real starts to slip. Find Therapy Tapes scattered throughout the valley to hold yourself together, because hitting zero isn't something you come back from.

EXPLORE A VALLEY FULL OF SECRETS

The abandoned valley is yours to explore freely. Dig through the remains of whatever life used to exist here. Find documents, letters, and journal entries left behind by people who came before you, and piece together what really happened. Nothing is handed to you. The story rewards those who look.

FACE WHAT'S INSIDE THE SIGNAL

Corrupted televisions are scattered throughout the valley, each one connected to a radio tower. Getting inside them is the only way to shut them down. Each TV pulls you into its own distorted minigame, different every time, and getting through it is harder than it sounds when something inside is trying to stop you.

CHOICES HAVE CONSEQUENCES

How you play determines how it ends. Your sanity at key moments, and the decisions you make along the way, lead to one of six distinct endings. Some of them are stranger than others. None of them are particularly comforting.

Content Warning: The Wyoming Incident contains strobing and flashing lights, themes of psychological horror, disturbing imagery, strong language, and content that may be distressing to some players. Player discretion is advised.

content_descriptors.notes:
The Wyoming Incident contains the following mature content:
Strong language is used throughout the game in protagonist dialogue and written documents. The game contains themes of psychological horror, paranoia, and mental health deterioration as core gameplay mechanics. Players will encounter a corpse (a character who died by suicide, whose body has been hanging for decades) and can find written letters describing their mental state leading up to their death. One of the game's six endings depicts a character implying they are about to take their own life through an overdose following a traumatic experience. The game also contains intense strobing, flashing lights, and persistent visual distortion that may be distressing to some players.
