store_data.about_the_game:
You are a fading ember, descending a collapsing tower. Every run is a fresh plunge into chambers teeming with shadow creatures — carve through the horde, forge a loadout from evolving weapons and passives, and push as deep as the dark will let you. Permadeath is harsh, but Skill Points and hero unlocks persist between runs, so every death makes the next ember burn brighter.

⚔️ Fight together — online co-op

Host a room and invite Steam friends straight from the overlay, or share a code. You fight one shared horde, your fire stacks toward the same kills, and when a friend falls you can revive them before the tower claims you all. Each player levels their own hero — bring your own build to the fight.

🔥 Build a run that's yours

  • 8 heroes, each unlocked by depth, with a distinct mechanic and skill tree — Wizard, Vampire (lifesteal + HP decay), Necromancer (minions), Pyromancer (burning trail), Stormcaller (auto static bolts), Chronomancer (time-dilation), Sentinel (hit-blocking bulwark), Reaper (Harvest stacks + Death Mark).

  • 19 weapons, each with a branching evolution — max a weapon, pair the right passive, and choose its evolved form. Bolts, orbital spikes, chain lightning, singularities, meteors, plague auras, turrets and more.

  • 11 passives that reshape how everything fires, stacks, crits, and leeches.

  • 10 relics — stacking in-run artifacts torn from elites and caches — and the Overcharge meter: fill it with kills and erupt in a screen-scouring nova.

  • A post-boss Supply Cache to spend hard-won shards, and a branching node map each biome band — pick your route: combat, elite, cache, or boss.

🌀 No two chambers play alike

  • Room twists ambush your route — SWARM floods, TITAN packs, elite patrols, FRENZY, and shard-drenched GOLD RUSH rooms — all paying up to triple rewards.

  • Affixed elites — Shielded, Volatile, Vampiric, Frostbound, Summoner — each telegraphed, each demanding a different answer.

  • 8 Trials: opt-in run curses whose reward multipliers compound — stack all eight if you dare (≈×8.6 the payout, if you live).

🏆 Goals worth grinding for

  • A 65-contract Challenge Board across 11 categories — every contract pays permanent Skill Points and shards, from first-blood milestones to sub-20-minute clears, one-weapon wins, and Ascended-difficulty conquests.

  • The Ember Forge: sink banked shards into 8 ranked permanent upgrades — including level-up rerolls.

  • The Daily Descent: one seeded attempt per day, same tower for the whole world, a rotating featured hero, daily & weekly Steam leaderboards, and streaks that stack contracts.

🗼 Descend the whole tower

  • 8 biomes (Crypt → The Void), each with its own terrain, hazards, and a generative score that quickens as you go deeper.

  • Biome bosses + a final boss, The Umbral Heart — beat it for the ending, then drop into Endless+ for ever-scaling runs.

  • 6 difficulty tiers (Normal → Ascended) with Mastery rewards — the ladder always pays.

  • 39 Steam achievements, full run reports, and global + daily + weekly Steam leaderboards with friends rankings.

🎮 Plays the way you want

Full gamepad + Steam Deck support — analog movement, dash & ability buttons, and a virtual cursor for every menu. Steam Cloud keeps your progress everywhere. Mouse, keyboard, and controller all welcome.

store_data.about_the_game:
You have bullets. You have enemies. Let the mayhem begin!

Lane Glitch is a fast-paced combat racing game where every run is a fight for survival. Drive a weaponized car through relentless highways, dodge deadly obstacles, destroy enemy vehicles, and create pure highway mayhem.

The road never stops — and neither does the chaos.

Choose Your Path

Each run takes place on a branching path map filled with different encounters. Choose your next level carefully and decide what challenge you want to face next.

Will you take on stronger enemies for better rewards?
Visit a garage to upgrade your vehicle?
Or prepare yourself for the next sprint ahead?

Every decision shapes your adventure.

Upgrade Your Ride

Between encounters you can improve your vehicle and adapt your strategy. Upgrade your weapons, enhance your firepower, and tune your car to survive the increasingly dangerous road ahead. 

Build the perfect machine for mayhem.

Face Powerful Bosses

At the end of certain sprints, powerful bosses await. These massive enemies bring a new kind of chaos to the highway and will push your vehicle builds to their limits.

Defeat them to continue your journey across the map.

Features

  • High-speed combat racing gameplay

  • A branching path map where every run feels different

  • Weaponized vehicles and explosive car combat

  • Challenging boss fights during your journey

  • Upgrade your car and adapt your build during each run

  • Fast, arcade-style gameplay focused on reflexes and mayhem

store_data.about_the_game:
Military Destruction

About This Game

Command real machines. Fight real physics. Win perfect operations.

Military Destruction is a physics-driven real-time strategy game set in today's flashpoints — from the Persian Gulf to the Russian frontier to the Venezuelan coast. Every jet, tank, helicopter, drone, boat, and missile is a real simulated machine. Nothing is scripted. When a guided missile overshoots because you baited its seeker into a hard turn, that's physics — not animation.

It's All About Oil

Every operation in the campaign revolves around one thing: oil. Wreck enemy production. Seize the wells. Defend your own. One mission is a pure offensive strike — level the installations on Kharg Island and get out. The next is a full skirmish: eight oil wells, two players, one map — take control or lose the war economy.

Operation-Based Campaign

This is RTS but also every mission is a military operation, and the story unfolds as you take command of the army to exert control on the region.

  • Receive your CENTCOM briefing: objectives, intel, rules of engagement.

  • Build your roster. Many operations deploy with a fixed force you hand-pick before wheels-up: 1 jet, 3 Apaches, 1 destroyer, 4 Abrams, 12 MANPADS, 16 infantry, 2 artillery, 2 Humvees. Choose wisely — that's all you get.

  • Some missions require you to control and secure oil installations. Build bases and use the oil to dominate the map. Command you army and conquer the map.

  • Execute with precision — every unit matters. Lose a squad, and you may have to mount a rescue operation to bring your soldiers home.

  • Chase the Perfect Operation: full objectives, zero losses. Your record follows you. The political cost of a failed operation may be too high in the public eye.

Your Eyes Are a Drone

There is no god-view. The camera is a physical drone flying over the battlefield. Hold a top-down orbit, dive low over the front line, chase a convoy — or lose it to a lucky hit, because yes, your camera can be shot down.

And there is no fog of war. Instead: a satellite map, your drones, and whatever your units can see. ISR is the game. If you don't have eyes on it, you don't know it's happening.

Firepower at Your Fingertips: F1–F12

Your most devastating assets live on the function keys — a strike system built for speed:

  • F1 — Air Strike. Every press scrambles a jet with a full bomb load. Six jets on the tarmac? Press it six times.

  • F2 — Artillery Barrage. Saturate the grid square with deadly long distance shelling.

  • F3 — Cruise missile. Precision cruise missile, launched from offshore with deadly impact.

  • F4 — Destroyer Cannon. Naval gunfire support on demand.

  • F12 — ABORT. Recall everything. Instantly.

Stack strikes, time them, chain them — or abort the whole package when the situation changes.

Real Physics. Real Machines.

Every vehicle runs on engineering-grade simulation:

  • Jets fly with true aerodynamics — lift, drag, stall, and inertia.

  • Helicopters answer to rotor dynamics, not waypoints.

  • Tanks and Humvees have suspension, momentum, and recoil with every shot.

  • Warships carry the mass and momentum of real vessels.

  • Missiles are steered by real PID guidance — fly evasively and mislead them, and they will miss.

The result: emergent, unpredictable battles where tactics and physics — not scripts — decide who wins.

Explosions Like No Other RTS

A dedicated explosion and VFX pipeline delivers destruction on a scale RTS players have never seen. Fireballs, shockwaves, secondary detonations — every strike transforms the battlefield, rendered in a sharp, distinctive visual style that makes every screenshot look like a war photo.

Your Units Talk Back

A military radio system inspired by the golden age of Command & Conquer: Red Alert — modernized and dialog-rich. Pilots call out bomb runs. Tank crews confirm targets. Squads report contact, request evac, and let you know exactly how the operation is going. The battlefield has a voice.

Three Theaters of War

Fight across three distinct biomes:

  • Desert — Gulf heat, oil fields, and open sightlines.

  • Soviet Summer — forests, rivers, and Cold War concrete.

  • Soviet Winter — the same front, frozen over. Snow changes everything.

Key Features

  • Story-rich, operation-based campaign built around the war for oil — with CENTCOM briefings and rescue missions

  • Hand-picked mission rosters or full base-building operations — both, like the classics did it

  • Physical drone camera and no fog of war: satellite imagery, drones, and ISR decide what you see

  • F1–F12 strike system: air strikes, artillery, Tomahawks, naval gunfire — and a full abort

  • Engineering-grade physics for every unit: jets, helicopters, tanks, Humvees, drones, boats, missiles

  • Missiles with real PID guidance that can be evaded and misled

  • Best-in-class explosion and VFX system with a sharp, distinctive art style

  • Dialog-rich military radio chatter on every unit

  • Three biomes: Desert, Soviet Summer, Soviet Winter

  • Base building, refineries, and oil control across land, air, and sea

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the ultimate game of social deception.

In Act Normal, survival isn't about being the fastest or the strongest—it's about being the most convincing. You are dropped into a bustling environment filled with AI bots, and your only goal is to disappear into the crowd.

The Thieves: Your job is to grab as much loot as possible while moving, pausing, and pathing exactly like an AI bot. One unnatural step or a moment of hesitation is all it takes to blow your cover.

The Guards: Your job is to observe. Scan the crowd, study the patterns, and root out the players who don't belong. It takes a sharp eye and a cold heart to spot the human hiding in the machine.

Perfect for Parties: Easy to pick up, impossible to master. The perfect game to test your friends' acting skills (and your own paranoia).

Viviette Dynamite is the leader of a Canadian street gang named "Chiptek." After a bank heist with her two lieutenants- Azealia Guies, and Destiny Nome- goes horribly wrong, she's sent to prison for 7 years. With the help of another imprisoned chemist- Lavender Jams-, the two escape, and discover that Chiptek has since faded from the underworld, and has been replaced with three more powerful gangs; Blood Sugar, Green Day, and the Lonely Machines.

With the help of her three Homies, Viviette sets off to re-establish Chiptek, and defeat the three rival families.

  • Play as Viviette, and her three Homies, each with unique playstyles.

  • Fight through waves of rival gangsters, engage in melee combat with cars, and excavators.

  • Lightning quick turn-based RPG battles where every decision you make matters.

  • Explore the Canadian New Frank City's Constellation Neighbourhood.

  • Hang out with your three Homies, each unique trainers, and side content.

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive the tides of Nalluer

The War of Nalluer is a top-down action roguelite. Enter the arena, face endless enemy waves, and grow stronger under pressure — every death is a step toward your next, deadlier build.

Four heroes, four playstyles

  • Warrior — High HP, steady melee damage, sword and arcane skills

  • Mage — High burst and crit, blizzards, freezes, portals, and arcane magic

  • Alchemist — Potions and poison DOT, fast attacks and strong sustain

  • Archer Queen — Rapid ranged fire, high crit, agile positioning

Four biomes, 37 stages

Start in the desert, then unlock grassland, magma, and snow as you progress. Each stage is a self-contained arena battle. Enemy density and boss difficulty ramp up as you push deeper.

Mid-run builds that snowball

  • Collect XP from kills and pick 1 of 3 upgrades on level-up

  • Dozens of active skills and passive upgrades across multiple rarities

  • Skills level up multiple times — spreads and ranges grow with each tier

  • In-run shops for key build pieces

Meta progression between runs

  • Soul shards and gold fund permanent talent trees

  • World map tracks your clear progress and unlocks new regions

  • Each hero has their own talent branch

Multi-phase boss fights

Face powerful bosses at the end of each chapter — charges, summons, ground spikes, fire rain, and more. Boss mechanics evolve as chapters advance, testing both your build and your movement.

store_data.about_the_game:
Toss Drop Smash Smash is a physics based arcade-ish game where you play as a mischievous teenager hurling objects off rooftops to wreak havoc on the street below. It's part sandbox toy, part score chaser and completely ridiculous and fun to play.

Start from your rooftop hangout and work your way up to towering skyscrapers, throwing everything you can get your hands on at the unsuspecting people below to score points. With each level, the stakes and the laughs get higher.

There are lots of ways to play. Chase the high score, go for the satisfying pedestrian antics, aim for maximum destruction, or just see if you can break the game outright!

Score attack is the main event, cause as much chaos before someone calls the cops to climb the online leaderboard and unlock Steam achievements along the way. Bring a friend into local co-op and split the screen, or drop into sandbox mode with a throwable spawner HUD, no authorities and no pressure, plus exclusive sandbox only throwables.

It's all about the smashing... glass that actually shatters, visual fx and controller feedback make impacts feel solid and fun. You can ragdoll right along with the pedestrians if you take a bad step off the roof.

The soundtrack comes from a lineup of local artists, including tracks from Skoddy Pimpin. With all sound and music running through Wwise to support punchy and responsive destruction sounds.

Toss Drop Smash Smash is being built by Double Meow Games, a father and son indie team. We're two developers making games together in our spare time. This game is our passion project, made because we love creating things together. We appreciate your support and hope you giggle as much as we do when playing the game!

We're running playtests and listening to player feedback as we head toward the release on Steam, so wishlist now to follow along!

store_data.about_the_game:
Emory Sinclair is Vessel's celebrated Chief Creative Officer—the visionary who promised synthetic performance would set artists free, and whose signature certifies that every generated likeness is consented. But Vessel's consumer platform, Muse, quietly traded safeguards for growth, turning down the very classifier meant to stop non-consensual generation—until an ordinary young woman, Sana Ferro, was rendered into intimate imagery she never agreed to, hounded for it, and lost forever.

Now, with regulators closing in, lawsuits clawing toward deletion-bound provenance logs, and an acquisition that demands silence, Emory is pulled into three dangerous romances with three women who each hold a different piece of the truth: a crisis strategist paid to bury it, a returned actress fighting to reclaim her own face, and the estranged co-founder who built the safeguards leadership gutted.

In a world where a signature can be weaponized into "yes," love becomes a pressure test—and the only thing Emory can't render is an honest reckoning.

Meet the Cast




Willa Kessler — The Co-Founder
Willa is Emory's estranged wife and Vessel's other co-founder—the engineer who built the consent architecture and provenance system that leadership later hollowed out. She left the company and the marriage on the same principle: Emory kept choosing the company's version of the truth over hers. Dragged back by deletion clocks and decisive logs, she holds the keys to what really happened—and her romance with Emory is a test of whether trust can be rebuilt when the old wound is still exact and sharp.



Catalina Vela — The Actress
Once an A-list star, Catalina was scanned for the prestige film that made Vessel famous—then watched her own likeness reused, repurposed, and sold into performances she never agreed to. store_data.about_the_game:
Your color is the key!

Take the role of Switch Blight, lord of all power plants and energy creation on the island of Ridgescar. Creating energy isn't just his job - it's a game! Use his powerful Switch Ball to change colors, directions, and more to increase your combo and destroy more bricks with each explosion. Speed is everything - shoot for S-Ranks and know that if time runs out... well, meltdowns are just part of the job.

Race your way through ten worlds themed around the history and future of energy — from Fossil Fuels and Windmills to Antimatter, Wormholes, and beyond. Every level is handcrafted, and every world brings new tricks to master!

Adventure Mode — tackle every level and chase S-ranks as each world presents its own challenges and unique mechanics, culminating in bosses that push your skill to the limits!

Gauntlet Mode — think you've mastered the game? Attempt to beat every one of 160 levels in order, earning bonus seconds for higher ranks to prevent a run-ending meltdown. Survive to the end and embody the heart of a speedrunner!

Play your way

Full keyboard and controller support. Junior Mode removes timers and fail states so younger or more relaxed players can take on every level at their own pace - and hey... sometimes it's nice to have infinite time to learn levels and mechanics so you can begin earning those sweet ranks!

store_data.about_the_game:
Master Stacker: Tower Trials is a physics-based 3D balance game about building towers that probably should not stay standing.

Place awkward objects onto a raised balance plate, study the lean, read the center-of-mass feedback, and commit to one more risky move. Every placement matters. A block that looks safe may shift the tower just enough to start a wobble, while a well-placed counterweight can turn a near-collapse into a save.

The rule is simple: if the tower falls, you lose.

BUILD, BALANCE, AND SURVIVE

Use assisted precision placement to position each piece before committing it to the physics simulation. Rotate blocks, planks, and other objects into place, then watch the tower settle under real physics.

READ THE TOWER

Master Stacker gives you tools to understand the balance instead of guessing blindly. Center-of-mass lines, stability indicators, ghost previews, and landing shadows help you judge whether your next move will stabilize the stack or push it closer to disaster.

PLAY SOLO CHALLENGES

Take on solo modes built around different stacking goals:

- Survive an endurance run

- Clear a fixed set of objects without collapse

- Build as high as possible

- Race the clock in speed stacking challenges

- Cozy sandbox to build whatever you like

OUTLAST YOUR OPPONENT

In turn-based online PvP, two players share one unstable tower. Take turns placing pieces, survive the wobble, and leave your opponent with a worse problem than the one you inherited. The player who makes the tower fall loses.

HEAD TO HEAD SURVIVAL

Battle online vs. other players in a survival endurance where the highest score wins.

BUILD WITH FRIENDS

Sandbox with a friend to build something cozy.

PHYSICS CHAOS, STRATEGY FIRST

Master Stacker is designed around readable physical 3d stacks, tense pauses, risky counterweights, last-second saves, and spectacular collapses. The pieces may be awkward, but the goal is always clear—keep the tower standing one more piece.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a hilarious, stress-relieving soccer survival sim full of wild ideas. Ditching complex traditional soccer mechanics like passing, shooting and tactical battles, it only retains pure, thrilling evasion survival gameplay. It’s super easy to pick up, so you can start a casual match anytime, anywhere.

The core goal of the game is straightforward: simply move your character freely around the pitch and protect your soccer ball from the crazy defensive foes scattered across the field. You’ll face all kinds of bizarre opponents: some charge straight at the ball with high-speed sliding tackles, others continuously spew disruptive exhaust fumes from a fixed distance, some alternate between chasing and retreating to cut off your movement, and swarms of minions will spawn to surround you layer by layer, creating chaotic, absurdly funny scenes.

Your only job is to dodge all incoming threats with nimble positioning, sudden stops, quick turns and looping kiting. No complicated controls are needed—just predict enemy paths and keep a safe gap to guard the ball. The challenge ends instantly once the ball gets touched by any foe; the longer you stay alive, the higher your score, testing your reflexes and kiting skills.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Sinful Hearts, you play as the priest of Santa Cecilia, a dying chapel in a village drowning in war, hunger, doubt, and sin. As the town’s faith begins to collapse, it falls to you to visit its people, hear their confessions, uncover their secrets, and decide whether to save their souls or take advantage of them. Blending RPG and visual novel storytelling with point & click investigation, branching quests, and unexpected genre shifts, Sinful Hearts is a dark fantasy story where every choice can heal, corrupt, redeem, or destroy.

The People of Santa Cecilia

  • Elira Vhalmont
    A lonely woman living at the edge of the forest, loved by the villagers but feared by those who know too much. Her story tests whether faith can comfort desire, or twist it into obsession.

  • Hollie Montenegro
    A young scavenger wandering the ruins of a fallen noble house. Behind her search for family lies the buried legacy of the Montenegro bloodline, and a secret that may change Santa Cecilia’s fate.

  • The Singer Family
    A grandmother and her two granddaughters whose farm blooms while the rest of the village starves. Their happiness seems like a miracle, but miracles in Santa Cecilia always demand a price.

store_data.about_the_game:
No weapons. Just the floor beneath your feet. Flip the panels to send enemies flying off the island — but whether it's an enemy or your friend standing on that panel... well, you'll find out after you flip it.

Simple to Play


Move and flip. That's it. Catch an enemy standing on a panel and flip it to launch them straight out of the arena. Stun enemies with a charge shot before flipping, or send several flying at once — behind the simple controls lies a deep game of positioning and timing.

Three Ways to Play


  • Solo — Battle through 8 stages and take down the boss waiting at the end.

  • Online Co-op — Survive together with your friends. Voice chat supported. But beware: the flip doesn't care whose side you're on. Accidentally launching a teammate? That's an official rule.

  • PvP — Rack up points by defeating enemies, then knock each other off until one player stands. Who takes MVP on the results screen?

Nostalgic, Yet Fresh


As you play, you might find yourself remembering the games you were obsessed with as a kid. We brought back that golden-age arcade feeling — rules you understand in seconds, but you keep coming back for one more round — and rebuilt it for modern online multiplayer. Alone or with friends, this is a game designed to make you say "just one more!"

store_data.about_the_game:
Inspired by the tactical shooter that defined a generation. Rebuilt for the next one. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

Twenty years ago, an elite squad redefined what it meant to lead a team into impossible odds. Now, the legend returns — bigger, deadlier, and more cinematic than ever.

Step into the boots of Lieutenant Commander, leader of an elite SEAL fireteam deployed across the world's most volatile flashpoints. From the snow-choked mountains of the Hindu Kush to the neon-drenched megacities of Southeast Asia, every breath you take could be your last — and every shot you fire could change the course of history.

FEATURES:

NEXT-GEN TACTICAL COMBAT — Experience pulse-pounding first-person gunplay built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5. Photorealistic environments, volumetric weather, ray-traced lighting, and Lumen-powered global illumination put you closer to the fight than ever before.

COMMAND YOUR FIRETEAM — Issue orders to three AI squadmates using an intuitive radial command wheel. Flank, breach, suppress, extract. Every call matters. Every life is yours to protect.

A GLOBAL WAR ON SHADOWS — A sweeping 12-mission single-player campaign penned by industry veterans takes you across five continents to dismantle a shadow network threatening to ignite World War III.

AUTHENTIC ARSENAL — Over 60 meticulously modeled real-world weapons, attachments, and gadgets. Modify your loadout for every mission, from silent infiltration to full-spectrum dominance.

MISSION-DRIVEN STORYTELLING — Iconic mission-briefing sequences, gritty radio chatter, and cinematic in-engine cutscenes deliver the atmospheric military authenticity that defined a generation, rebuilt for a new one.

THE LEGEND ENDURES — Earn your Trident across deepening difficulty tiers — from Recruit to Tier One Operator. Unlock veteran skins, classified mission files, and challenge modes that test even the most decorated player.

The Trident is yours. Earn it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the deep crust. Your shift has begun.

You are a remote biological operator assigned to an automated mining facility deep underground. The world’s oxygen is depleting, and your only directive is to excavate Trioxirane—a volatile, newly discovered form of cyclic ozone. It’s humanity's only hope, but the highly unstable magnetic field of the ozone destroys advanced electronics. That’s why you are here. Irreplaceable by technology.

Your job is simple: sit at the terminal, solve the grid, push the ozone blocks into the extraction chutes. But soon, you'll find yourself solving different kind of problems...

Every move has a physical consequence.

Triox is a claustrophobic indie horror game that blends retro 2D logic puzzles with tense, first-person resource management. What begins as a mindless corporate shift quickly descends into a desperate fight for survival against failing machinery and a hostile environment.

Core Features:

  • Deadly Interface: Pilot a remote pushing machine through classic, logic-based puzzle grids. But beware—every block you move, every wall you hit on the screen physically moves thousands of tons of metal around.

  • Tactical Panic: When the there's a short circuit or the pressure drops, the terminal goes dead. You must stand up, grab your flashlight, and manually interact with the 3D environment. Pull heavy physical levers, reconnect sparking wires, and reset the pressure valves before the machinery gets destroyed.

  • Analog Horror: A meticulously crafted, brutalist sci-fi atmosphere. Experience the dread of thick volumetric gas, rotating emergency lights, and the heavy, deafening sounds of industrial machinery groaning under immense pressure.

  • The O3 Threat: Trioxirane is highly unstable. Push it wrong, and it detonates, turning the air around you into toxic silica slag.

Everybody is counting on you. You're humanity's only hope for surviving.

Story

You return home to find your mother suddenly collapsing right before your eyes.

Use the objects around you to save her.

But don't waste time—if you hesitate, she won't survive.

You only have a brief window of opportunity.

Even if you fail, keep trying and discover the path to the happy ending.

At first glance, the story may seem heartwarming...

But never forget one important thing.

This is a horror game.

Objective

This is a Japanese horror puzzle walking simulator.

You can investigate only two objects in your surroundings.

Choose the wrong order, and your mother may never be saved.

Try as many times as you need, gather the clues scattered throughout the game, and uncover the truth behind this mysterious incident.

Features

  • 4 Different Endings

  • Ending List Available from the Title Screen

  • Estimated playtime: Under 30 minutes for experienced puzzle players.

  • Story-driven Japanese horror experience.

  • The truth may not be the happy ending you were hoping for...

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

ClassWarfare is a free story RPG about one new student trying to survive the first week at Dagu Academy.

Pick a race, class, talent, and starting path, then explore the island one day at a time. Train with classmates, take on strange errands, fight academy assessments, and decide who deserves your trust before the island asks for more than schoolwork.

Combat is turn based and party focused. Ready actions, status effects, class skills, racial talents, pets, summons, and recruited classmates all change what a good turn looks like. Outside combat, your route through the island decides who you meet, what you learn, and what you carry into the final days of the prologue.

The current Early Access version focuses on the Dagu Island prologue.

This prologue is designed as the opening chapter for the larger ClassWarfare story. When you finish, you can export a prologue save for future use.

Key Features

  • Create a student from multiple races, classes, talents, and starting builds.

    Recruit classmates with their own roles, personalities, talents, and combat identities.

    Fight turn-based battles with ready actions, status effects, skills, racial passives, and ultimate abilities.

    Explore Dagu Island across a timed prologue calendar full of events, secrets, and consequences.

    Hear original songs used for key story moments, including "The Stars" and "Lanterns Above The Sea."

    Complete a free prologue that can export your save for the future main game.

Lore

Long before Dagu Academy, the first rune taught mana to obey. What began as discovery became inheritance: a world where power could be shaped, people could be labeled, and class could become law. Across Adytum, nations now worship different parts of the same divine balance — life, order, and destruction — while old forces move beneath the surface. The prologue only shows the first crack: a school where students are told what they are before they understand who they might become.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Send Forth the Brave, you take on the role of an Adventurers’ Guild administrator. By combining the cards in your hand, you assemble teams to complete the commissions brought by your clients—all while dealing with negative reviews and their many special abilities.

The game blends deckbuilding with the process of organizing adventuring parties for guild commissions, offering a distinctive and satisfying experience.

When faced with a client’s request, you must:

— Place the right cards into your assignment folder. Weapons, items, soldiers, heroes… combine them into a team that meets the commission’s requirements.

— Cards require preparation time. Wait until the preparation rounds are over before sending your team on a mission.

— Assign your team to the commission. Once the job is complete, they will earn you gold and positive reviews.

— Ordinary soldiers and items can be reassigned at any time. Unique heroes, however, will only return to your roster after completing their assignments.

Complete commissions to earn gold and positive reviews:

Fulfill your clients’ strange and varied requests to earn gold and positive reviews. Different client types behave differently—some start leaving negative reviews from the very first turn, some reduce their rewards over time, and others may even try to poach your best team members… Carefully handle their tricks, deploy your cards wisely, assemble the right teams, and claim every coin and every positive review.

Choose the path you believe in:

Strength, Agility, or Wisdom? Each path grants different bonuses and attracts different heroes to your guild. Progress along your chosen path, raise your rank, earn respect, and unlock legendary heroes, weapons, and items!

Spend gold to expand your roster:

Hire new personnel and purchase new items and weapons from a variety of shops to build a powerful, well-rounded adventuring team capable of satisfying increasingly demanding clients!

Plan your schedule and build the finest Adventurers’ Guild:

Manage your days wisely! Opening for business is a solid choice, but there is much more to do: take part in random events, accept gifts, visit wondrous shops to expand your roster, and perhaps even encounter mysterious clients who may offer relics imbued with great power… A wide variety of events and paths await.

store_data.about_the_game:
Songs of Wasteland is a horror third-person shooter. You play as a lone hero Emma who wanders the wasteland which has no sign of civilization. Only terrifying monsters lurk in the shadows and underground. Shoot, explore, and survive, the future of humanity is in your hands.

A Terrifying World

It is an empty world on the surface, where have all the humans gone? However something terrifying lurks in the shadows and underground：twisted monsters look like humans, or, used to be humans.

The Lone Adventurer Emma

Emma is not a trained fighter, but she needs to learn how to protect herself when she walks out of that shelter, and becomes a fighter along the journey. Can Emma discover why the world becomes like this and eventually find the way to save the world? It is all up to you.

Abilities and Weapons Upgrades

During the journey, Emma will grow and will become more capable. New weapons, gears and upgrades will be discovered along the way.

Nostalgia for the Old World When the Humans Flourish

Sometimes old artifacts or pieces of old technology may be discovered on the wasteland. Emma can learn how the humans live in the old times.

Exploration and Collectables

Emma can collect decorative items and outfits by exploring the game world, and adventure in style.

Multiple Endings

The game features multiple endings based on player choice when progressing through the campaign.

store_data.about_the_game:
With simple controls—just cutting and planting grass—you guide your bunnies’ movements, and your goal is to increase their numbers as much as possible in this simulation puzzle.

Bunnies move on their own, and the paths they take change depending on how you place the grass.

Fetching water, watering the fields, harvesting carrots, and storing them in the colony will cause the bunnies to reproduce one after another. As your farming becomes more efficient, the pace of reproduction increases, and the colony quickly becomes lively.

However, the more bunnies you have, the more easily traffic jams occur, slowing their movement and reducing overall efficiency. Poor grass placement leads to congestion, so managing the flow like traffic control becomes essential.

Carrots in the colony are constantly consumed based on the number of bunnies, and when they run out, the bunnies start getting hungry. Before they become completely hungry and the game ends, how efficiently you can supply food and increase their numbers is the core of the game.

Each stage features different terrain and layouts, along with different target numbers to achieve. Clearing the target completes the stage, but you can continue playing and push the colony to its limits. Whether you finish or keep challenging yourself is entirely up to you!

Not everything tied down is an innocent little bird. store_data.about_the_game:
Ducks can fall in love too.

The only problem is that one day, that love was kidnapped by an eagle.

Don't Go Duck is an adventure about a small yellow duck leaping into the sky to rescue his beloved girlfriend. His opponent is the king of the skies: an eagle. Our hero is a duck. On paper, the matchup looks pretty hopeless, but this duck does not worry about numbers. After all, the dice are in charge of those.

Guide the duck through the clouds, across precarious platforms, and up a path that keeps climbing higher and higher. Do not let the cute face fool you. This duck is very serious about love, and gravity has absolutely no respect for that seriousness.

The goal is simple.

Climb up. Do not fall. Lead the duck down the right path and rescue his girlfriend.

Easy to say. As always, only easy to say.

A tiny, adorable duck’s very big rescue mission.

A dangerous road through the sky, annoying gravity, and a love stolen by an eagle.

After everything that lies ahead, will the duck be able to rescue his girlfriend? Let out one brave quack, and leap. Love does not wait, and eagles have no manners.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sudoku Atlas is Sudoku without the noise. No ads. No pop-ups. No accounts. No internet. Just you and the grid — from a gentle 4×4 up to a monumental 25×25. Buy it once, own it forever, play it offline on your terms.

One purchase. Every puzzle. Zero noise.

Sudoku Atlas is a premium, distraction-free Sudoku app built for people who
actually love the puzzle. There are no ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts,
and no tracking — the app never touches the network. You pay once and own the
whole thing, forever, fully offline.

From 4×4 to 25×25

Most Sudoku apps give you one grid size. Sudoku Atlas gives you eleven, spanning
a huge difficulty range:
  • Warm up on tiny 4×4 and 6×6 boards.
  • Settle into the classic 9×9.
  • Push into 12×12 and 16×16 for a serious session.
  • Take on the sprawling 25×25 when you want to disappear into a puzzle for an
    hour.
Every board is generated deterministically from a seed, so a puzzle always has
exactly one solution — and the same puzzle is genuinely the same puzzle, every
time.

Built for focus

  • Clean, minimalist interface that stays out of your way.
  • Pencil marks, one-tap undo/redo, and hints when you want them — never forced.
  • Your progress, settings, and statistics live entirely on your device.
  • No timers shouting at you. Play fast, or don't.

Play it your way

  • Mouse, keyboard, or touch — each one on its own is enough to play the
    entire game. Full keyboard control (arrow keys, number entry, pencil mode,
    undo/redo, hints) for desktop purists; complete touch control for 2-in-1s, touch
    monitors, and Steam Deck.
  • High-contrast theme for low-vision play.
  • Colorblind-friendly by design — color is never the only signal;
    shapes, borders, and underlines carry the same information.
  • Respects your system text size and ships a full screen-reader label
    tree.

Private by principle

Sudoku Atlas makes zero network requests. There is no analytics, no advertising,
and no crash reporting. Nothing you do in the app leaves your device. It's a
Sudoku game that treats "we don't collect your data" as a feature, not fine
print.

Who it's for

Whether you solve one 9×9 with your morning coffee or lose an evening to a 25×25,
Sudoku Atlas is the calm, permanent, respectful Sudoku app you keep coming back
to.

Harvest Together is a cozy farming game you can play solo or with up to 4 friends online. Start with a small plot; till the soil, plant seeds, tend your animals and sell your produce to turn it into a thriving farm, one field at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
All Hands is a Sci-fi Strategy RPG with Turn Based combat and a focus on relationship management with the Corporate Nations that rule the stars. Journey with your fleet through the universe dealing with the situations that present themselves, and face the reward or consequences of your choices.

Choose Your Patron

Select your starting patron from 7 Corporate Nations, each with their own ships, agenda, and expectations for your fleet and command. Travel the void with your fleet, honoring their requests in exchange for reward and renown, or defying them in pursuit of your own goals. Rise through the ranks of Command through loyalty, or gain title through acts of greatness or infamy.

Event Management

System events, Hostile events, Crew situations and Incoming communications. Participate in over 1000 unique events, randomly assigned to star systems as you travel, while balancing the potential benefit of participation with the possible problems it may create. Make allies and enemies by your responses, and by the orders you give your crew.

Build Your Fleet

Construct your fleet to your preference from over 50 unique ships, each with their own fire and movement pattern and statistics, to deploy on the battlefield when you decide the fight is called for. Buy, sell and scuttle ships from stations you encounter, while maintaining relationships with their owners to ensure access. Field ships with unique properties and special rules, or earn the use of legendary ships from allies gained. 

The Battlefield

Turn Based Combat on a unique grid based system. Deploy ships to the field with their own deployment range statistics to line up their firing arcs on enemy ships. Control the battlefield with considered movement for maximum weapons coverage, or pursue defensive tactics, firing and withdrawing beyond an enemies range. Earn the use of assistive measures to deploy in battle, shielding ailing ships from harm, or firing a barrage from your capital ship onto the battlefield. Use each ship in your fleet to its potential through strategy, for while a battle may be easily won, its cost in lives is a permanent mark upon your record. 

Diplomacy

Actions have consequences. Manage the adjustments to Corporate Relationships that result from your choices or inactions via more favorable acts on your part, or make enemies of nations and lose access to their stations and planets, at the request of others, or for reasons of your own. Aiding one party may anger another, and so you must decide where you stand. You command not just your fleet and crew, but your status and reputation across the stars.

Player Guided Difficulty

The difficulty of the game scales with your choices, relationships, and status. Lawful and Criminal acts are weighed in your interactions, as are those of Piracy. A commander who shows cowardice will be labelled as such, and a commander with no allies will swiftly meet their end.
store_data.detailed_description:
All Hands is a Sci-fi Strategy RPG with Turn Based combat and a focus on relationship management with the Corporate Nations that rule the stars. Journey with your fleet through the universe dealing with the situations that present themselves, and face the reward or consequences of your choices.

Choose Your Patron

Select your starting patron from 7 Corporate Nations, each with their own ships, agenda, and expectations for your fleet and command. Travel the void with your fleet, honoring their requests in exchange for reward and renown, or defying them in pursuit of your own goals. Rise through the ranks of Command through loyalty, or gain title through acts of greatness or infamy.

Event Management

System events, Hostile events, Crew situations and Incoming communications. Participate in over 1000 unique events, randomly assigned to star systems as you travel, while balancing the potential benefit of participation with the possible problems it may create. Make allies and enemies by your responses, and by the orders you give your crew.

Build Your Fleet

Construct your fleet to your preference from over 50 unique ships, each with their own fire and movement pattern and statistics, to deploy on the battlefield when you decide the fight is called for. Buy, sell and scuttle ships from stations you encounter, while maintaining relationships with their owners to ensure access. Field ships with unique properties and special rules, or earn the use of legendary ships from allies gained. 

The Battlefield

Turn Based Combat on a unique grid based system. Deploy ships to the field with their own deployment range statistics to line up their firing arcs on enemy ships. Control the battlefield with considered movement for maximum weapons coverage, or pursue defensive tactics, firing and withdrawing beyond an enemies range. Earn the use of assistive measures to deploy in battle, shielding ailing ships from harm, or firing a barrage from your capital ship onto the battlefield. Use each ship in your fleet to its potential through strategy, for while a battle may be easily won, its cost in lives is a permanent mark upon your record. 

Diplomacy

Actions have consequences. Manage the adjustments to Corporate Relationships that result from your choices or inactions via more favorable acts on your part, or make enemies of nations and lose access to their stations and planets, at the request of others, or for reasons of your own. Aiding one party may anger another, and so you must decide where you stand. You command not just your fleet and crew, but your status and reputation across the stars.

Player Guided Difficulty

The difficulty of the game scales with your choices, relationships, and status. Lawful and Criminal acts are weighed in your interactions, as are those of Piracy. A commander who shows cowardice will be labelled as such, and a commander with no allies will swiftly meet their end.

store_data.about_the_game:
Château Pluie: The New Cellar Keeper

You've inherited an old and mysterious vineyard, and with it, a cellar. As the new keeper of the family legacy, it's up to you to bring order to the chaos and restore the collection to its former glory.

Categorization

There are 1,600 bottles, each waiting for your touch. Every bottle has its own place, a specific section, from a specific country.

Each bottle also belongs to one of 5 categories that reflect its age and rarity, from common to legendary: Bronze, Silver, Sapphire, Gold, and Ruby. Ruby being the oldest and most precious of all.

Tools

You’re not alone in this mission. You’ll have the aid of an old notebook kept by the previous keeper, recording the correct placement for bottles from Italy, France, Argentina, and Spain.

You’ll also carry a wooden organizer, letting you hold bottles and check their category at a glance.

Key Features

  • Visual Satisfaction: Watch empty shelves fill with color and order. Every bottle placed correctly is a small, deeply rewarding click into place, a growing collection that feels as good to look at as it does to build.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: Rain taps softly against tall windows. The château breathes with quiet history, alive in every creak and shadow.

  • Cozy Mood: Gentle music, warm lighting, and the slow, meditative rhythm of sorting invite you to unwind. There’s no rush here, just you, the bottles, and the soft patter of rain.

Skills

As you advance, you’ll unlock new abilities to aid your work:

  • Insight: Reveal all bottles belonging to the same category.

  • Prediction: See exactly where a bottle belongs on the shelf.

BlockSouls is a surreal indie adventure set in a lonely brutalist city filled with strange places, hidden paths, and unsettling encounters.

store_data.about_the_game:
Board a train heading towards infinity, and make sure that the train doesn't stop (or don't).

LOCO is a multiplayer game of social deception, where your faith shapes the fate of the train. Players will have to complete tasks in time, while some of them are trying to stop the train in it's tracks.

Will you trust the passengers?

Killer For some reason you don't want this train to reach where its supposed to go. Betray your friends and stop the train dooming everyone to be stuck in the middle of a desert.

Smoker Being addicted to cheap tobbacco on a train going through the desert isn't really a good choice.

Technician You were tasked with keeping the train running with your team, unfortunately your team is nowhere to be seen. You are trained and experienced, use shortcuts to fix different problems. You must keep the train running as the only Technician on the train as it is your duty.

Veteran Retired sheriff going to another town for a new life, unfortunately your old days of law upholding still seems to go on. Make sure the people trying to cause problems are taken care of, by all means necessary.

Passenger Keep the train going and make sure you get rid of the ones trying to derail the train.

Features

Multiple Player Roles: Players will have a randomly assigned role every game.

Proximity Chat: In-game proximity voice chat.

Minigames: Every task is equipped with its own unique minigame.

Lobbies: Find and join public lobbies.

And most importantly THE LOCO

store_data.about_the_game:
It's night at the shrine. The lanterns are lit, the slots are warm, and your lucky cat is ready to work.

Maneki Mania is a kawaii fortune-shrine incremental with one rule: nothing pays while you rest. Pet the neko to earn koban and fill the fortune meter, then spin the charm slots for the jackpot. Pet, spin, repeat.

Pet for koban

Pet the cat with the mouse or the keyboard, both the same. Every pet pays out and charges the fortune meter a little more.

Spin the charm slots

A full meter spins the reels. Pairs, triples and the triple-koban jackpot each pay, with casino synth that swells the bigger you hit.

Collect ten lucky charms

Each charm is a relic on the upgrade tree with its own power and a stacking income bonus. The tanuki even pays interest on the round's haul.

Grow the shrine

Climb a 95-node upgrade tree, spin the Wheel of Fortune for talents, and raise shrine ranks that multiply everything you earn.

Mouse or controller. 31 in-game languages. You stop, it stops.

movies.name: Treasure Island: The Crimson Legacy Trailer

store_data.about_the_game:
Treasure Island: The Crimson Legacy is a dark adult visual novel about legacy, betrayal, desire, and the terrible price of buried truth.

Years after the events of the old voyage, Jim Hawkins believes the sea has finally released him. The Hispaniola is gone. Long John Silver is a memory. Treasure Island is a nightmare locked safely in the past.

Then a black chest arrives at the Admiral Benbow Inn.

Inside are a letter from Silver, a broken map, an old key, and the Crimson Compass — a strange relic pointing not toward gold, but toward a secret Flint never meant the world to find. When masked attackers burn the inn to the ground, Jim is forced back into the shadow of the sea, where old names still carry blood and every buried story has teeth.



His journey brings him into the orbit of dangerous women, each with her own power, secrets, and claim on the truth:

Anne Rackham, a beautiful and calculating smuggler queen who knows the cost of information.

Eleanor Livesey, a sharp-minded doctor whose calm hands hide a fearless heart.

Isabella Vane, a proud pirate captain who turns elegance into command.

Marina Silver, the wounded daughter of Long John Silver, carrying his lies like a blade.

Seraphine Vale, an aristocratic manipulator bound to a secret order.

Mireya Gunn, the wild guardian of Treasure Island and its older laws.

Together, they are pulled into a conspiracy larger than Flint’s treasure, larger than piracy, and far more dangerous than gold.

Across burning inns, hidden harbors, pirate masquerades, storm-torn ships, jungle ruins, ancient temples, and the Crimson Archive beneath Treasure Island, Jim must face the truth of what was really buried by Flint — and decide who deserves to control the history men killed to erase.

This is not a story about finding treasure.

It is a story about who owns the truth when empires, pirates, ghosts, and lovers all come to claim it.

Features:

A complete cinematic adult visual novel experience

A dark reimagining inspired by classic pirate adventure

Six main heroines with unique roles, personalities, and story presence

A single dramatic main ending with choice-driven dialogue flavor

Epic pirate, mystery, romance, and conspiracy atmosphere

Over 90 CG-style images including story, romance, and key cinematic moments

Steam achievements

Original dark nautical tone with mystery, betrayal, and legacy at its core

The sea remembers.

The compass has awakened.

And Treasure Island has not finished with Jim Hawkins.

store_data.about_the_game:
CHROME CIRCUIT is a top-down twin-stick roguelite set in a SoCal-vice cyber-dystopia. Blast through three districts of the undercity — one bullet, one cursed contract, one kill-streak at a time. Every run is a fresh build; every death buys your next upgrade.

Kills chain into combos, and combos pay. Keep the bodies dropping and your rewards multiply — XP, cash, and REP all scale up to 3x as the screen edges ignite from a cool blue simmer to a full rainbow GODLIKE inferno. Hesitate, and the streak dies with your bonus.

]SIGN THE CURSED CONTRACT

Sometimes the loot is wonky. When a cursed pickup triggers, you don't get to walk away — you sign one of two contracts, no refunds. +35% damage for nearly half your health? Double cash, but every grab spawns an enemy? Ten percent more damage... as long as you kill something every 12 seconds, [i]or you die instantly[/i]. The best runs are built on the worst deals.

BUILD MID-RUN

Every level-up freezes time and deals you three cards from a pool of cybernetic upgrades — hollow points, synth legs, subdermal plating, shock knuckles. Stack them however you like. Combine them with your class kit and whatever the contracts have done to you, and no two runs play the same.

FOUR WAYS TO RUN THE CIRCUIT

MERC — the all-rounder. Combat roll, adrenal surge, and a deployable gun turret that holds the line.

SOLDIER— 140 HP of battle-rifle discipline. Frag grenades, field dressing, and a suppressing burst that shreds everything in a cone.

ASSASSIN — fast, fragile, terrifying. Recon pulse reveals the whole map, Death Touch one-shots on contact, and SHADOWSTEP stops time itself while you pick your teleport.

PYRO— burn it all down. Napalm, fire, and area denial for players who think in cones.

More classes wait in the shop — spend the REP you earn from every run to unlock new operators, permanently.

THREE DISTRICTS. THIRTY ARENAS. ONE ENFORCER AT EVERY GATE.

Fight from the NEON DOCKS through the RUST WORKS and down into the TOXIC UNDERCITY. Each district has its own look, its own enemy mix, and a boss waiting at the end. Clear all three and you've beaten the circuit — this time.

FEATURES

[*]Fast twin-stick combat with dual-wield secondary fire — run two guns with independent triggers, mags, and reloads

[*]Kill-streak combo system with escalating reward multipliers

[*]Wonky Pickup contracts: 6 cursed, stackable risk/reward deals

[*]14 stacking level-up upgrades drawn as roguelike choice cards

[*]4 free starting classes + unlockable operators bought with REP

[*]Perception-based detection — enemies have to spot you before they swarm you

[*]3 districts, 30 arenas, distinct enemy mixes and boss fights

[*]Persistent progression: REP, unlocks, and 3 save slots

[*]Full controller support — playable start to finish on a gamepad

store_data.about_the_game:
Still Pines: Watchtower is a first-person psychological horror mystery set deep in a frozen forest. You play as Claire, a broke college student who accepts a temporary wildlife reporting job at an isolated fire lookout tower. What starts as a quiet winter assignment quickly becomes something much darker when Claire discovers the old logbook of the previous ranger, Halpern, who vanished years before.

Explore a semi-open snowy forest, follow trails through dense pine woods, search the watchtower for clues, and uncover what happened before Claire arrived. As the nights pass, the forest becomes more dangerous, the weather worsens, and something begins watching from the trees.

Players will investigate the environment, read logbook entries, manage visibility in the dark, use a flashlight to navigate, follow story objectives, and survive tense encounters while trying to understand the mystery of Still Pines.

- First-person psychological horror gameplay

- Semi-open snowy forest exploration

- Story-driven mystery about Claire and the missing ranger Halpern

- Isolated lookout tower setting

- Flashlight-based navigation in dark environments

- Environmental clues and logbook entries

- Objective-based progression

- Atmospheric weather, darkness, wind, and eerie sound design

- Cinematic intro sequence

- Single-player experience

Still Pines: Watchtower is designed for players who enjoy atmospheric horror, mystery, exploration, and slow-building tension.

store_data.about_the_game:
The stars went quiet, and no one is coming. So you begin.

A thousand years ago the Severance cut the Weave — the living lattice that let minds and ships cross the dark — and the galaxy fell silent, sector by sector. You are the Core: an ancient ship-mind, finally awake, on a hull that should not still be running. There's no crew left to give the orders. There's just the work, the long quiet, and a signal out past the wreck-fields that knows your name.

AETHERDRIFTER is a deep idle RPG in the Melvor / OSRS lineage — built to reward an hour or a glance. Set a discipline running and watch the numbers climb; come back to salvage hauls, charted stars, and the next thread of a real mystery. It keeps earning while you're away — bit-deterministic, honest offline progress, no fake timers.

Rebuild the Ark. Eleven interlocking skills feed one another in a single web: gather → refine → fabricate → fight → reclaim. Mine and salvage the dead fleets, refine raw matter into alloy, fabricate components, garden a hydroponics bay, chart a 217-hex starfield, and weave reclaimed Aether into power. Everything you make goes into the one thing that matters: your ship.

The ship is the spine. Climb the chassis ladder from a Scout Skiff to a world-sized Ark, fitting weapons, plating, reactors and drives into a real mass-and-power budget. Combat is ship-vs-sector — a damage triangle of kinetic / ballistic / aetheric, sustain economies, toggle-able Protocols, and multi-phase bosses — not a personal inventory of swords.

A story told in the margins. The Adventure Log threads a genuine arc and a recurring cast — traders, wardens, a hollowed courier, a Core like you but colder — through the idle loop. Nothing is lore-noise. It builds to The Long Dawn: a three-way choice at the heart of the dark with no clean answer, and a New Game+ that lets every rebuild be a different morning.

For the collectors. A browsable Codex, 100 laddered achievements, a four-faction galaxy with its own Senate and relics, a crew you bond with, and a hundred small mended things to find. 100% is reachable — and the game knows it. Original IP, a strict written voice, and cohesive bespoke art — a lived-in universe that reads as one authored thing. Plays full-screen on desktop and one-handed on a phone.

Wake the Core. Rebuild the Ark. Cross the long quiet the stars left behind.

  • Eleven interlocking skills — gather → refine → fabricate → fight → reclaim, each with a signature mechanic and a Mastery second axis.

  • Your ship is your character — Scout Skiff to Ark, real mass/power budgets, 100+ components, ship-vs-sector combat with a damage triangle and multi-phase bosses.

  • A real, ambient story — a genuine mystery and a recurring cast in the Adventure Log, building to the three-way Long Dawn ending + a New Game+ loop.

  • Honest idle — bit-deterministic offline progress; rewards a glance or a long session, never fake waiting.

  • Built for collectors — a browsable Codex, 180 achievements, factions + a Galactic Senate + relics, crew bonds, 100%-reachable completion.

  • Desktop and phone — a dense full-screen layout and a one-handed compact mode from the same save.

  • Unique sci-fi — original IP, a strict voice, bespoke art; awe and melancholy and stubborn hope, not generic grimdark.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a RTS strategy where grow and expand your empire around the map, harvest resources, and create a powerful army to destroy your enemies.

You can play with your friends, strangers online through steam multiplayer, or against enemy computers. Every 60 seconds, you are dealt a random selection of cards. These cards are to be placed down and used in the game. Cards can be anything from a worker that fishes food for your empire, an archer that can attack enemies from a far, a tower that attack enemies within a certain radius, a fireball that can shot against an enemy empire or explosive destruction, and much much more

Workers can gather food, cut woods, or mine gold (depending on the card you are drawn). You should plan according in terms of your future army you want to build, but also be taking into consideration the enemy units coming towards you, and the enviroment around you. If there is lots of trees, it might be a good idea to place LumberJack cards to cut lots of logs so you can place tower, buildings, and other defences for your empire.

You can control units individually, but select and commanding them. You can mode them around through the shadows, where your enemy cannot see, and flank accordingly. But if your enemy cannot see you in the shadow, that also means you cannot see the enemies in the shadows, so be sure to scout!

This game mixes strategy, management, and luck. Sometimes you made be dealt expensive cards you currently cannot afford, or somtimes you'll be dealt weak ealier tier units that dont make much of an effect at the current time of the game, You have to make what you have work, to create a strong and powerful empire to defeat your foes.

store_data.about_the_game:
You inherit a small kingdom at the edge of a wider world. Your father is dead. Your council is waiting. You have twenty four years and a young heir to raise before the crown passes on.

Reign one long story, quarter by quarter. Every four turns is a year. Every year brings weather, harvest, taxes, disputes at your door, and news from your borders. Choices ripple. There are no pure good or evil options. Every decision touches at least two systems: gold and grain, army and approval, trust and rumor.

Choose your queen. Choose your challenge. Six queens arrive with letters at the start of your reign. Each carries a hidden storyline, her own way of shaping the kingdom, and her own crisis in Year Twenty One if you leave her arc untended. The Spymaster and Explorer are the gentler paths. The Diplomat and Warrior demand more. The Steward and Treasury are unforgiving. Pick the one whose story you want to live.

Six advisors, one per quarter. Your council fills out as the reign begins. Your Diplomat carries messages across the map. Your Explorer opens the four cardinal paths and returns with the Founder's Stones. Your Spymaster plants towers and reveals what the pigeons will not say. Your Steward runs the town, your Treasury the coin, your Marshal the walls and the recruits. Send them where you need them. Listen when they come to you with something they cannot decide alone.

Raise your heir like a real person. Your heir is present from the first year, around seven years old. You choose which advisors train them. You watch them grow. Their assignments unlock real abilities on the board. Their choices about love, duty, and running away happen in front of you, and they are not on rails.

End well. The good ending is a ceremony. On the final day of the twenty fourth year you hand the crown to the person you raised. What the kingdom looks like on that day, and who your heir has become, is the reign you actually made.

One story. One reign. Yours. Fully voiced. No microtransactions, no live service, no separately sold content.

Starting a new life isn't easy. You just arrived in town and you’re already jobless, catfished, and completely broke. But every great story needs a little drama! It’s time to build your dream home, make lifelong friends, and uncover the town's deepest secrets. Your new adventure starts today!

store_data.about_the_game:
"You are such a good person... I know you will overcome this path with me. No matter how high or how difficult it gets, you won't give up. We will join hands and return to our sweet home, my home, together. Come on, start climbing... I am Eva. You're going to help me, aren't you? Watch the edge, honey..."

You are not alone on this uncanny path leading upward. Eva, the owner of that sweet, soft voice constantly echoing in your mind or ears, is your only guide in this vertical world. She has only one desire: to escape this bottomless pit and return to her "sweet home" above the clouds. And you are the one who will do it for her.

Watch The Edge Honey! is a psychological thriller-focused vertical climbing adventure that tests your nerves and patience. As you climb up under Eva's guidance, you will fight against gravity, your fear of heights, and most importantly, the manipulative pressure Eva creates in your mind.

Remember; a single wrong step will hurl you meters down. Eva is watching you, guiding you, and whispering at any moment

FEATURES

  • Precise and Challenging Parkour: A single misstep sends you all the way back to the very bottom—right where you started. Battle against gravity with your reflexes and your patience.

  • An Uncanny Atmosphere: The higher you climb, the more the visuals glitch, the environment warps, and the code begins to decay. It’s as if the game doesn't want you there... or perhaps the heights want you a bit too much.

  • A Warm Bond with Eva: On this lonely climb, Eva’s sweet and endearing attitude will be your greatest motivation. Carrying her to the top will transform over time into something much deeper than just beating a game.

  • Manual Save Points: There are no autosaves or checkpoint systems here. To preserve your progress, you must manually save at specific points encountered along the way. Failing to save in the right spot can cause a single mistake to swallow hours of hard work in a split second.

  • Watch The Edge: Below you lies an endless void. But no matter what happens, do not look back just keep climbing. Because the end of this road doesn't lead anywhere you know.

Insert the cassette, put your headphones on, and trust Eva. Once you reach the summit, everything will change. But remember: not every journey ends the way you expect it to. Watch the edge, because while the void below will reset you to the very beginning... what awaits you at the top is far more terrifying than falling.

  • Precise and Challenging Parkour: A single misstep sends you all the way back to the very bottom—right where you started. Battle against gravity with your reflexes and your patience.

  • An Uncanny Atmosphere: The higher you climb, the more the visuals glitch, the environment warps, and the code begins to decay. It’s as if the game doesn't want you there... or perhaps the heights want you a bit too much.

  • A Warm Bond with Eva: On this lonely climb, Eva’s sweet and endearing attitude will be your greatest motivation. Carrying her to the top will transform over time into something much deeper than just beating a game.

  • Manual Save Points: There are no autosaves or checkpoint systems here. To preserve your progress, you must manually save at specific points encountered along the way. Failing to save in the right spot can cause a single mistake to swallow hours of hard work in a split second.

  • Watch The Edge: Below you lies an endless void. But no matter what happens, do not look back just keep climbing. Because the end of this road doesn't lead anywhere you know.

Insert the cassette, put your headphones on, and trust Eva. Once you reach the summit, everything will change. But remember: not every journey ends the way you expect it to. Watch the edge, because while the void below will reset you to the very beginning... what awaits you at the top is far more terrifying than falling.

Your ship went down. Power is failing, the world outside is strange, and the only tool you have left is a farming bot. So you plant. Farmabot is a seasonal farming roguelike about growing a farm, defending it, and uncovering why you crashed here — before O.N.Y.X. does.

GROW & CROSSBREED

Every crop carries real genetics. Cross strains with Mendelian inheritance, chase rare mutations, and cultivate high-value hybrids. Each crop grows its own procedural skill tree of passive boosts and active abilities to unlock as you play.

SURVIVE THE SEASONS

Spring, summer, autumn, winter — each turns with its own weather, from clear sun to frost and storms that batter your fields. A living ecosystem of bees, ladybugs, birds, frogs and more visits the farm and shifts with the seasons.

DEFEND THE FARM

Farming is not safe here. Fight off waves of enemies in real time, survive the seasonal bosses that arrive with each turn of the year, and stand against the final boss: O.N.Y.X. Upgrade your bot's weapons, health, range and abilities to keep the fields yours.

RAID THE WASTES

Discover and raid territories beyond the farm for rewards, resources, and pieces of the story.

A ROGUELIKE RUN

Every run is seeded. Level up, spend upgrade points, and push deeper as the threats escalate — then start again, sharper.

A STORY TO UNCOVER

Recover memory crystals, watch the cutscenes they unlock, and make the final choice that decides how it ends.

BUILT FOR EVERYONE

Deep accessibility options — high-contrast and colorblind modes, large text, reduced motion, screen-reader support, and full keyboard and gamepad play.

store_data.about_the_game:
A living planet in your hands. Sculpt continents, steer winds and ocean currents, ignite the climate — then watch cities, nations, wars and whole civilizations grow on their own from the first tribes. A sandbox of climate, ecology and history in 2D and 3D.

You are not a ruler or a general. You are a force of nature.

Earth Simulator hands you an entire planet as your canvas. Raise mountain ranges and drop the seas, paint winds and ocean currents, warm and cool the climate. Then the world takes over: biomes settle by the laws of physics, rivers carve their beds, and life ignites on fertile ground.

The climate here is genuinely alive. Seasonal winds and monsoons carry moisture — windward coasts drown in rain while deserts sprawl in the rain shadow behind the mountains. Ocean currents warm some shores and freeze others. Reroute a current and a blooming coast turns to tundra, its people fleeing the advancing cold. Here, wind and water truly decide the fate of nations.

And those nations are a drama of their own. A handful of people grow into villages, cities and empires. They advance through technology, march from tribal life to the space age, build fleets, found overseas colonies, forge alliances and wage war. Famine and drought drive climate refugees, mighty empires fracture, and at the bitter end the most desperate reach for nuclear weapons.

Do you want order from chaos — or chaos just for fun? Both are yours.

KEY FEATURES:

• A LIVING CLIMATE. A real budget model: evaporation → wind-borne moisture → rainfall. Monsoons, rain shadows, ocean currents, ice sheets and the greenhouse effect — everything affects everything.

• CLIMATE DECIDES DESTINIES. Shift the winds or a current and watch nations migrate, famine strike, and empires rise and fall.

• FROM TRIBES TO THE STARS. Civilizations advance through six eras on their own: technology, economy, urbanization, diplomacy, wars, fleets, colonies.

• 2D AND 3D. An atlas map with animated winds and currents — or a full 3D world with era-based buildings, ships and traffic.

• MISSILES AND NUKES. A dedicated player tool and a fearsome AI "last resort." Spectacular blasts, radioactive fallout and nuclear winter.

• 6 SCENARIOS + SANDBOX. The Ice Age Challenge, the Great Flood, the Desert World and more goal-driven trials. Or total freedom with no rules.

• 23 STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS.

• RICH NATION & CITY PANELS: flags, growth charts, diplomacy, economy, mini-maps.

• TWO LANGUAGES: Russian and English, auto-detected on first launch.

There are no "correct" answers. Just you, the planet, and the consequences.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tac-Tums: DreamQuest is a pixel art action-platformer about dreams, courage, and perseverance.

When a young boy falls asleep, he awakens inside a magical world where he must rescue his beloved Yaya. To find her, he will travel through mysterious castles, deep abysses, towers, jungles, deserts, and other dreamlike places inspired by the landscapes and spirit of Venezuela.

During his adventure, he will discover the Tac-Tums: magical powers that allow him to transform, unlock new abilities, reach hidden areas, defeat enemies, and overcome obstacles. Each new form changes the way you move, fight, and explore.

But this dream is not just a bedtime story.

Tac-Tums combines classic 2D platforming with light action, simple puzzles, small progression elements, and carefully designed challenges that reward patience, precision, and coordination. The tone is warm and family-friendly, but the adventure will test your reflexes as you progress.

Learn new powers. Keep trying. Rescue Yaya.

FEATURES

• A cozy pixel art adventure with an emotional story.
• Explore dreamlike worlds inspired by Venezuelan landscapes.
• Unlock magical transformations, each with unique abilities.
• Classic 2D platforming with light action and simple puzzles.
• Small progression elements through upgrades and unlockable powers.
• Challenging sections that reward patience, precision, and coordination.
• Available in English and Spanish.
• Keyboard supported. Gamepad/controller recommended for the best experience.

ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

I am an orthopedic surgeon, 47 years old, with no previous programming experience, and the father of two wonderful children, ages 3 and 8. About 8 months ago, my oldest son asked me to make him a video game. With the help of modern artificial intelligence tools, many nights of learning, mistakes, and late hours, Tac-Tums: DreamQuest was born.

With this game, I wanted to pay tribute to the 16-bit and 32-bit pixel art adventures that shaped my childhood: platforms, colorful worlds, secrets, and challenges. Watching my son play it, finish it, and get excited about it made all the effort worthwhile.

I hope you enjoy this adventure and forgive its imperfections. I will keep working to improve it with each new version.

Thank you for playing.

4932480.name: Wartorn: A Visual Novel of the Ukraine War

store_data.about_the_game:
When the sirens start, what would you do?

Wartorn is a choice-driven narrative game about the people history usually leaves out — the civilian, the soldier, the neighbour, the friend — trying to keep their humanity intact when the world around them breaks apart.

There are no superpowers here. Only decisions. Do you take up arms, or protect those who can't? Do you stay and rebuild, or carry your story somewhere safe? Do you submit, resist, or simply survive? Each answer moves you along three quiet currents — conviction, compromise, and the will for peace — toward one of four distinct endings.

What you'll find

  • Four endings, many paths — your choices, relationships, and convictions decide where your story lands.
  • Weight, not spectacle — dilemmas with no clean answer, written to be sat with rather than "won".
  • People you'll remember — bonds you can nurture or lose along the way.
  • A mirror at the end — see how your choices compare, and what they say about you.
  • Playable in five languages — full text in English, 繁體中文, 简体中文, Русский, Українська.

Where your money goes

Wartorn is a charity release. 50% of the net proceeds from every copy are donated to humanitarian relief in Ukraine, through United24 — Ukraine's official fundraising platform, earmarked for humanitarian and medical aid. This game does not profit from the war — it raises money for the people living through it. When you buy Wartorn, you carry their story with you and you help.

About the subject

Wartorn is set during the ongoing war in Ukraine. It was made as an act of empathy and education — an attempt to let players stand, for a few hours, in shoes they hope never to fill. It does not glorify conflict. It asks what we owe each other when everything else is taken away.

Play at your own pace. Sit with the hard parts. There are no wrong answers — only yours.

4932580.name: 究極の選択の勇者の伝説

store_data.about_the_game:
Are you sure you want to press that choice?

`Last Choice Hero` is a choice-driven dark comedy adventure game about a boy chosen to be the hero, only to have his fate twisted by the very choices that were supposed to save the world.

The king calls you.

You set out to defeat the Demon Lord.

You gather allies, help people in need, and make the right choices.

...At least, that is how it is supposed to go. Unfortunately, the choices in this world are usually mean.

The action that looks right at first glance may lead to the worst possible ending.

A ridiculous option may somehow bring you closer to the heart of the story.

You may try to save the world and end up ruining someone's life instead.

Players progress through the hero's journey by reading short scenes, examining the screen, and choosing what to do next.

As you collect a long list of BAD ENDs, you will gradually move closer to the truth behind this world.

The main story has 16 stages.

There are 42 endings to discover.

The fun is not only in finding the correct answer.

It is also in watching what happens when you press a choice.

And in finding out just how awful the result can get.

The cast includes a hero, a queen, a golden slime, a black knight, an ice princess, a fire prince, a witch, a warrior, a goddess, and many other characters with dangerously strong personalities.

In a world that looks like a classic RPG, slightly dark, slightly stupid, and sometimes strangely lingering choices are waiting for you.

Beyond the main story, there are also post-clear elements such as an ending gallery, character collection, afterstories, and a survivor-style bonus mode.

This is not a game about saving the world in a clean, satisfying way.

It is a game where you press choices you do not want to press, witness endings you do not want to see, and still feel tempted to peek at the next option.

Hero.

Are you really sure about that choice?
