store_data.about_the_game:
You are currently trapped inside a phone booth.

When you pick up the receiver, the number “99” appears on the display, and a countdown begins.

From among the vast number of flyers covering the walls on all four sides, find and peel off two flyers with exactly the same design that aren’t overlapping.

You must remove all the flyers before the remaining credit reaches “0”; otherwise, you won’t be able to get out of here.

Removing a phone card hidden among the flyers will increase your remaining credit.

A Puzzle of Exhilaration and Frustration: “Peeling Off Flyers”

This is an intuitive yet highly strategic puzzle game where you peel off large numbers of flyers posted on a phone booth, grouping them by type or specific criteria.

Overwhelming Immersion! Live-Action 360-Degree Panoramic Backgrounds

The game features realistic live-action 360-degree videos as backgrounds. As you progress through the stages, different environments—from crowded scramble intersections to mountaintops where you can see a magnificent view of Mount Fuji on a clear day, and scenic spots offering panoramic night views—will transport you to where you’re meant to be, providing a deep sense of immersion.

store_data.about_the_game:
The door is locked. And as if by magic, you don't have the key.

You're in a room. The rest is up to you to figure out.

  • 30 standalone rooms, each with its own logic, its own mechanics, and an uncanny knack for making you doubt the obvious.

  • No hand-holding: just you, your eyes… and the regret of not looking a little closer at the wall right in front of you.

The answers almost never fall from the ceiling.

  • No inventory, no instructions to read: Just a Stupid Room is built around observation, logic, and experimentation.

  • Every room rewrites its own rules. Habits rarely serve you well here.

  • No genre expertise required — just a willingness to feel a little dumb from time to time.

If you enjoy puzzle games that mix logic, experimentation, and absurdist humor, you're in the right place.
— Nuci

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Coin & Steel

Forge your fortune. Fight dangerous enemies. Build a legacy.

Coin & Steel is a top-down fantasy RPG that combines blacksmithing, shop management, exploration, and action combat. Build a thriving business, forge equipment at your own anvil, complete quests, and venture into dangerous lands filled with monsters, treasure, and valuable resources.

Become the Town Blacksmith

Run your own blacksmith shop and turn raw materials into valuable equipment. Forge weapons, craft armor, complete customer orders, and build your reputation through the quality of your work.

Blacksmithing is more than selecting an item from a menu. Work inside your shop, use the forge and anvil, master the crafting process, and develop your skills as a blacksmith. Unlock new recipes, improve your equipment, and create increasingly powerful gear for your customers or your own adventures.

Run a Growing Business

Open your shop, manage your inventory, serve visiting customers, and complete contracts before their deadlines. Every weapon you forge and every successful sale brings you closer to expanding your operation.

Your ambitions do not have to end at the blacksmith shop. As your wealth grows, you will be able to invest in additional businesses, including a tavern and an alchemy shop. Build a network of profitable shops and become one of the most successful merchants in the region.

Leave the Forge Behind

The world beyond town is becoming increasingly dangerous. Orc soldiers and encampments have been sighted throughout the forests and swamplands, while other creatures and threats wait farther from civilization.

Equip weapons and armor made in your own workshop, then set out to fight enemies, complete quests, search for treasure, and gather materials that cannot be found in town. Everything you recover can help strengthen your character, improve your equipment, or grow your business.

Choose How You Will Build Your Fortune

Early quests guide your progress and gradually unlock new locations, opportunities, and greater freedom to explore.

Choose how to spend your time as the world opens around you. Master the forge, take on quests, explore dangerous lands, manage your growing businesses, or divide your time between them. A successful expedition can provide valuable materials for your workshop, while a profitable business can fund the equipment needed for your next adventure.

Spend Time at the Tavern

Take a break from the forge and visit the local tavern, where you can play two different card games. Test your strategy in an original fantasy card game created for Coin & Steel, or sit down for a game of blackjack.

Wager your gold, win extra money for your business, or risk walking away with less than you brought.

Features

  • Run your own blacksmith shop in a fantasy town.

  • Forge weapons, armor, shields, and other equipment.

  • Use your forge and anvil through an interactive crafting process.

  • Improve your blacksmithing skill and unlock new recipes.

  • Manage inventory, serve customers, and complete timed contracts.

  • Upgrade basic equipment into increasingly powerful creations.

  • Accept quests and gradually unlock new locations to explore.

  • Explore forests, swamplands, and other dangerous regions.

  • Fight orcs, monsters, and other enemies in top-down action combat.

  • Discover treasure, crafting materials, equipment, and hidden locations.

  • Equip your character with weapons and armor forged in your own workshop.

  • Invest in additional businesses and expand beyond blacksmithing.

  • Focus on business, adventure, or a combination of both.

  • Play an original fantasy strategy card game inside the tavern.

  • Wager your gold in tavern blackjack.

Forge powerful equipment.

Face the dangers beyond town.

Build your fortune and create your own legacy in Coin & Steel.

Coin and Steel is DRM free.

store_data.about_the_game:
♦ Battle and Tame Mechas ♦

Rogue Mechas once ruled the wilds, but now we fight back. Override their systems, seize control, and upgrade them into powerful war machines. From heavy siege units to agile fliers and resource harvesting rigs, each Mecha brings unique power to your fight for survival. Industrial types turbocharge your gathering, mobility units let you blaze across the wasteland at breakneck speed, and combat Mechas bring devastating firepower to suppress enemies and demolish fortifications. In a world shaped by steel and chaos, those who command the Mechas will rise.

♦ Two Worlds, Your Move ♦

Our revolutionary Dual-World system splits survival into two distinct realities. Drop into the Warzone where high-risk PvP means high-reward loot—take down rival survivors and steal everything they carry, but one death costs you the whole haul. Then teleport your spoils back to your Base World, a completely safe zone where you trade on the open market, upgrade your gear, and plan your next run. Risk it all for the big score or grind safe and steady? Your strategy, your survival.

♦ Explore, Build, and Defend Your Legacy ♦

Construct your base anywhere in your Base World, fortify it with walls and defensive turrets, and store your hard-earned loot. But survival isn't just about defense—team up with friends to design everything from a crude shelter to a sprawling steel fortress with automated defenses. Your base is your kingdom. Build it smart, or watch it burn.

♦ Dominate with Advanced Firearms and Tactical Combat ♦

Combat in the wild isn't just about firepower—it's about how you move, react, and strike. Combine unique firearms with tactical jetpacks for true three-dimensional warfare: hover above the chaos, dash through enemy fire, and deploy instant cover mid-fight for seamless attack and defense. Choose from a vast arsenal of weapons, each with distinct handling, attachments, and even unique abilities. Some high-tier guns come with built-in tech skills that can turn the tide of battle in an instant. With deep team tactics and high-skill mechanics, every firefight is a test of reflexes and coordination. Skill sets your ceiling. Teamwork seals the win.

store_data.about_the_game:
DUAT is a survival-horror game that dives deep into the secrets of ancient pyramids

that were untouched for centuries. Set in the golden sands of modern Egypt, DUAT

gives you no choice but to face what the ancient world tried to bury forever.

EXPLORE FORGOTTEN CHAMBERS

Giza Plateau, Egypt

Sun, sand and ancient relics. This is Giza. You’ve been hired to investigate a group of

people that went missing inside the famous pyramids after a reconstruction mission.

Find the missing crew, return the equipment, report, and go home. A simple job,

until you stepped inside.

SOLVE ANCIENT MECHANISMS

Beyond the Entrance

As you go deeper, you will encounter remnants of an ancient civilization, tombs, and

treasures. But not everything left behind was meant to be found.

Now you’re stuck in with nothing but a flashlight and something that will turn your

survival into an unbearable nightmare.

YOU ARE NOT ALONE

Under the Mask

The contractor pays well for this job, but that’s not the reason you’re here.

Your dad went missing 10 years ago on an expedition to Giza. The case was classified,

and the circumstances remain unknown. You spent those years finding and obtaining

remaining pieces of evidence. All of them lead to this place.

BREAK THE SEALS

Everything Starts Here

Find useful tools and relics, solve the puzzles to escape, avoid deadly traps and push

through the nightmare that turned into reality in a brand-new survival-horror experience.

SURVIVE THE DARKNESS

remaining pieces of evidence. All of them lead to this place.

BREAK THE SEALS

Everything Starts Here

Find useful tools and relics, solve the puzzles to escape, avoid deadly traps and push

through the nightmare that turned into reality in a brand-new survival-horror experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every Battle Is a Three-Hand Showdown

Forget traditional poker.

Handslayer is a single-player roguelike where every battle is fought with three poker hands instead of one. Carefully arrange your cards, predict your opponent's strategy, and outplay them in tactical PvE battles where every decision matters.

Master poker hands, adapt to each encounter, and discover countless ways to build the perfect strategy.

Master the Power of the Four Suits

Every card contributes to more than just your poker hands.

Collecting cards of the same suit unlocks powerful battle bonuses, allowing you to specialize in completely different playstyles.

♥ Hearts — Increase your Attack and gain Lifesteal to outlast your enemies.

♦ Diamonds — Focus on Critical Chance and devastating Critical Damage for explosive attacks.

♣ Clubs — Steal more Gold and earn additional rewards to grow stronger throughout your run.

♠ Spades — Strengthen your Defense and Block Chance to withstand even the deadliest bosses.

Will you commit to a single suit or combine them to create your own strategy?

Choose Ancient Artifacts

Power always comes at a price.

At the beginning of every adventure, you'll discover mysterious Ancient Artifacts that can dramatically reshape your run. Each artifact offers unique strengths, and often equally dangerous drawbacks.

Choose wisely, adapt your strategy, and uncover powerful combinations that can completely change the way you play.

Collect Powerful Relics

Discover relics that transform every battle.

From subtle improvements to game-changing effects, relics create endless opportunities for powerful synergies. Combine them with your poker hands, suit bonuses, artifacts, and skill choices to build strategies capable of overcoming impossible odds.

Every run offers new combinations to discover.

Forge Your Own Path

Unlock powerful nodes in a deep Skill Tree filled with meaningful choices.

Specialize in your favorite playstyle, strengthen your preferred suit, or experiment with entirely new builds. Every node has the potential to reshape your strategy, making each adventure feel unique.

No two runs are ever the same.

Features

  • 🂡 Unique three-hand poker combat unlike traditional poker games

  • ⚔️ Strategic PvE battles against challenging enemies and bosses

  • ♥♦♣♠ Four suit archetypes, each with unique combat bonuses and playstyles

  • 🗿 Choose powerful Ancient Artifacts with meaningful trade-offs

  • 💎 Collect relics and discover game-breaking synergies

  • 🌳 Deep Skill Tree with impactful build customization

  • 🗺️ Branching roguelike adventures with high replayability

  • 👑 Epic boss encounters that challenge your strategy

  • 🔄 Endless combinations of cards, relics, artifacts, and skills

Every planet produces troops. Drag to send them — reinforce your worlds with fleets, hammer your rivals with missile salvos, and take their homeworld before they take yours. Easy to learn in one match, nasty to master.

DEATHMATCH — a 10-minute blitz. Expand fast, strike faster, hold the most territory when the clock hits zero.

HEGEMONY — a 40-minute grand strategy match. Declare wars, sign pacts, guard your allies, run trade convoys, build forges and defense grids… and watch the Void tear a rift into everyone's plans.

2-4 player online matches with parties, invites and in-game chat. Steam and mobile players share the same servers.

Commanders are pure cosmetics — zero pay-to-win. Each one brings a signature arsenal: themed missiles, fleets, home worlds and impact effects. Collect rare planet skins from cases and dress the whole map.

Ranked matches, fleet rating, badges and a global leaderboard. Every win is earned — commanders never change the math.

SOLO RUN — an offline roguelite-style campaign: climb the levels, draft upgrades between battles, chase your best run.

store_data.about_the_game:
God does not play dice with the universe. They play with demons.

Gods Play Dice is a roguelite game where randomness is a bliss. We mixed dice-randomness with action roguelike mechanics to create a unique approach to RNG. In this game, you play as challengers, trying to survive in a dark, mysterious world filled with demons, creatures and dices. And your journey will be lead by faith. Literally!

Randomness

In this game, there is no guarantee that you will use your abilities. It's all determined by the dices. You assign your abilities to one of the 6 faces of your dices, and roll! If the corresponding face lands upwards then you can use your abilities. Also you will get stronger if you roll certain combinations of dices and unlock devastating synergies, and turn impossible fights into victories.

Every roll matters.

This doesn't just make every run different—it makes every single level unique.

At the beginning of each level, you'll receive five random dice, forcing you to rethink your strategy, adapt your build, and make the best of whatever fate has given you.

Dice Are Weapons

The dice aren't just your source of power—they're physical objects that exist in the world.

Throw them into a demon's face.

Hide behind them.

Push them into enemies.

Use them however you can.

The connection between physical dice and magical abilities creates countless opportunities for creative combat. Learning to manipulate both is the key to surviving this mysterious world.

Because god does not play dice with the universe.

They play with demons.

Features

  •  Unique dice-based ability system

  •  Fast-paced action roguelite combat

  •  Every level reshapes your build

  •  Endless combinations and powerful synergies

  •  Physics-based dice you can throw, push, and use as weapons

  •  Dark fantasy world filled with demons and mysterious creatures

Good luck,

You'll need it.

and Thank you for checking out my game!!!

store_data.about_the_game:
In most roguelites, loot is the reward. In SACRIFORGE, loot is fuel.

🔨 Forge one artefact

Feed every weapon, trinket, and cursed relic you find to the forge. Each sacrifice grows a single, ever-evolving artefact that carries your entire run. Every drop is a decision: wield it now, or sacrifice it for something greater.

🌑 Build around Keystones

Keystones reshape your whole build — poison, crit, bleed, reflect and more. Stack them, socket your artefact to match, and every fight is won or lost by the build you've assembled.

⚖️ Bind dangerous Pacts

Trade safety for power. Pacts hand you devastating upgrades at a price that can end your run just as fast.

🌲 Survive the cursed forest

Wind through a hand-built forest of merchants, blacksmiths, alchemists and ambushes toward the Gargoyle waiting at its end. Death is permanent.

📖 Grow between runs

Every run leaves something behind — lore for the Tome, and new paths unlocked by what you accomplish, never by what you grind.

Solo-made in Unity, shaped in the open with its community.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chemistry you can pour, burn, shake, and blow up.

Alembic is a falling-sand sandbox where the sand is the real periodic table.

Every element carries its true properties — melting and boiling points, density,

electronegativity, valence — and the reactions aren't scripted gimmicks. They

emerge from that data, the same way they do in the real world.

Drop sodium in water and watch it fizz and ignite. Grind aluminium in the

mortar, dust it over rust, and strike a thermite burn hot enough to weld. Wire

two different metals into a galvanic cell and light a bulb. Pile up enough

uranium and it goes critical.

Your window is a lab flask

Hold Shift and **shake the actual game window**. The contents feel every jerk

and stop: powders slam into walls, leap for the lid, and fold into each other;

liquids slosh, surge, and swallow whatever you stirred up. It's

not a minigame. It's the mixing tool.

Liquids that actually behave

Water finds its level — through pipes, under walls, around corners, like real

communicating vessels. Trap gas under a diving bell and the sea compresses it;

crack the seal and it erupts. Mercury is so dense that nearly everything you

drop in it floats back out.

Two looks, one keypress

Alembic ships with two liquid render styles. Flow is soft and luminous — smooth surfaces, depth-lit pools, every droplet part of one living body of liquid. Classic is the raw falling-sand look, every cell exactly where the simulation says it is. Same physics underneath, down to the pixel. Tap F6 to toggle, whenever the mood strikes.

A living encyclopedia

Everything you make gets recorded in the Codex — a periodic table, a log of

every reaction you've triggered, the dramatic phenomena you've witnessed, and

the tools you've earned. You start with a handful of elements; the rest of the

table unlocks as you hit real chemical milestones. It's a discovery engine

disguised as a sandbox.

Challenges

Want direction? Take on challenges — goals that range from gentle to fiendish:

evaporate a sea to recover its salt, forge a foundry of distinct alloys, reclaim

metal from its ore, neutralise an acid, grow a forest and then wipe it off the

map with a nuclear blast. Each has Bronze, Silver and Gold tiers.

Real phenomena

  • Combustion, oxidation and rust

  • Thermite reduction and brilliant metal flares

  • Flame-test colours across the metals

  • Galvanic cells, electrolysis, arcing high-voltage circuits and plasma glow

  • Radioactive decay, radioluminescent glow and nuclear criticality

  • Communicating vessels, diving bells, buoyancy — sink iron in water, float it on mercury

  • Alloys, amalgams, acid–base chemistry, distillation, glass etching, plant growth

Build, or just play

Stamp beakers, boxes, batteries and freehand wires. Heat, cool, vacuum, and

pipette. Turn the whole world's temperature, oxygen and gravity up or down.

Prefer a blank cheque? Flip on Sandbox mode and the entire table is yours.

The falling-sand sandbox that's actually chemistry.

store_data.about_the_game:
Loot Survivors fuses the addictive nature of a survivors-like with the deep itemization of a hardcore ARPG. Descend floor after floor, drown in loot, craft it into greatness, and see how deep you can go before one mistake ends everything.

⚔️ Survive the Floors

Enemies swarm from every direction while your equipped spells cast automatically. Position, kite, and melt the horde.

  • Endless descent — every floor is deadlier, faster, and richer than the last.

  • Timed survival, boss floors, and treasure runs keep the loop from ever going stale.

  • Elites and Floor Bosses hit like trucks — and drop like piñatas. Face down up to three bosses at once for the best gear in the game.

💎 Loot That Actually Matters

This isn't a stat bump — it's a full ARPG loot engine under the hood.

  • 10 tiers of rarity, from grey Junk to gold Legendary.

  • Powerful Uniques.

  • Every item rolls up to four modifiers — flat and percentage, across dozens of stats.

  • Millions of possible item combinations. The perfect drop is always one kill away.

  • Dive deeper for better odds: loot rarity scales with the floor, not your patience.

🎲 Craft, Gamble, and Break the Game

The real game begins after the drop. Bend items to your will — or lose everything to the dice.

  • Roll new modifiers onto your gear.

  • Remove the ones you hate.

  • Upgrade tiers with hard-earned gold to chase the perfect roll.

Every choice is a gamble. Every jackpot is yours.

🧠 Build a God, Not a Character

No wasted levels. No filler. Pure theorycrafting.

  • Pick a stat bonus from three rolled choices every single level.

  • Slot up to four active skills and level them into screen-clearing power.

💀 One Life. Everything on the Line.

Permadeath is real. Die once and you lose it all — every item, every level, every gold coin. The deeper your run, the more you have to lose... and the harder it is to walk away.

The loop that eats your evenings:

Descend → Survive → Loot → Gamble → Get stronger → Descend deeper.

One more floor. One more roll. One more run.

Loot Survivors is in active development. Wishlist now to be there the moment you can start the descent.

store_data.about_the_game:
Solve the word. Carry the letters. Keep the chain alive.

Guess is a calm, elegant word puzzle where every answer flows into the next. Reveal a word from its definition, then carry the letters you earned forward into a fresh challenge — an endless chain of vocabulary, one word at a time. Pick it up for five minutes or fifty; the chain is always waiting.

How It Works

Each round gives you a definition and a row of empty cells. Type your guess and press Enter. Get it right and your letters glide into the next word; get it wrong and helpful hints quietly unfold to guide you — so you're never truly stuck.

- Definition-driven clues — every word arrives with its part of speech and meaning, drawn from a dictionary of thousands of words.

- Progressive hints — examples, synonyms, and revealed letters appear the more you try.

- Skip when you're beaten — after a few wrong guesses, reveal the answer and move on.

Two Ways to Play

Endless Mode — Chain word after word for as long as you like. Build a streak, chase your best, and slowly work through the whole dictionary.

Daily Challenge — A single word chain shared by every player each day. Everyone gets the same puzzle. Come back tomorrow to keep your daily streak alive, tracked on a monthly calendar.

Track Your Journey

A dedicated Statistics page charts your progress: cleared daily challenges, average guesses per word, words answered, dictionary completion, and your most challenging word yet.

Key Features

- Relaxing, minimalist design — soft cream tones, clean typography, and gentle animations.

- Endless play and a shared Daily Challenge with streaks and a calendar.

- Progressive hint system so the difficulty always meets you where you are.

- Built-in lo-fi soundtrack with its own playback controls.

- Colorblind Mode — a game-wide blue/orange palette that keeps feedback clear for everyone.

- Accessibility options — reduce-motion and screen settings, with consistent keyboard-and-mouse navigation.

- Steam Cloud saves — your progress and streaks follow you across machines.

- Achievements for words solved and dictionary completion milestones.

Who It's For

If you love word games, quiet puzzles, and the satisfying click of a word falling into place, Guess is a cozy place to spend your vocabulary.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sling new worlds into orbit inside real photographs of the universe. Universalia is a zen physics game about gravity, patience, and the quiet joy of watching something you made keep turning.

Real skies

Every system lives inside a genuine NASA / ESA photograph: Webb's Pillars of Creation, Hubble's Sombrero galaxy, Cassini's backlit Saturn, the Apollo 8 Earthrise.

Gravity is the only rule

Slow meetings merge two worlds into one. Comets crater giants. A small world flown gently past a great one becomes its moon.

Fifteen handcrafted systems

Waltzing binary suns, a roaming black hole, rivers of stone, native worlds to protect, and a finale that asks you to hold everything together through the storm.

The music of the universe

store_data.about_the_game:
In Game Launch Simulator, you run a small indie game studio just starting out. The challenge is not only to “finish the game,” but to actually release it: developer registration, project planning, hiring, store page pre-review, approval, launch, discounts, community items, and follow-up marketing all affect your cash flow, wishlists, reputation, and sales.

Choose your game’s genre, theme, core concept, target audience, scope, and technical direction. You can make small casual projects to stabilize your finances, or gradually expand your team and take on mid-sized projects, even near-AAA ambitions. Gameplay, art, narrative, and polish all shape quality, while bugs, budget, team fit, and development time constantly pull against your plans.

Publishing is the heart of the game. Prepare titles, pricing, screenshots, trailers, language support, and store descriptions. Submit store pages for pre-review, watch platform events, sales seasons, festivals, awards, and competing releases. Are your wishlists enough? Should you offer a launch discount? Is it better to wait for the next event window? These choices directly shape your launch results.

You are not alone. Secretary Xia will point out risks and next goals at key moments. Publishers, media, curators, and showcases can bring opportunities, but also revenue shares, requirements, and pressure. When money gets tight, you can take outsourcing jobs for cash. To improve your next game, you can study competitors and build understanding of genres, themes, audiences, and market positioning.

After launch, the work is not over. Schedule discounts, run additional marketing, release community items such as avatar packs, animated wallpapers, badges, and emoticons, and respond to player feedback, localization requests, and long-tail sales changes. First-week sales are only the beginning. A good publisher keeps a game alive after release.

Features

  • Simulate the full indie game journey from planning, development, store page setup, and review to launch.

  • Configure titles, pricing, screenshots, trailers, language support, localization, and launch discounts to affect store appeal and wishlist conversion.

  • Watch a 10-year release calendar and choose launch windows around sales seasons, festivals, awards, and themed events.

  • Hire staff, upgrade offices, and balance cash flow, progress, quality, and bug risk.

  • Handle publishers, media, curators, showcases, and outsourcing jobs, then decide which opportunities are worth taking.

  • Study competitors to build knowledge of genres, themes, core concepts, and target audiences, improving your next release.

  • Continue operating after launch with discounts, community items, follow-up marketing, and reputation management.

  • Learn step by step with Secretary Xia, or choose free mode to unlock systems directly.

Making a game is only the beginning. The real challenge is getting it approved, listed, wishlisted, launched, and selling long after release.
store_data.detailed_description:
In Game Launch Simulator, you run a small indie game studio just starting out. The challenge is not only to “finish the game,” but to actually release it: developer registration, project planning, hiring, store page pre-review, approval, launch, discounts, community items, and follow-up marketing all affect your cash flow, wishlists, reputation, and sales.

Choose your game’s genre, theme, core concept, target audience, scope, and technical direction. You can make small casual projects to stabilize your finances, or gradually expand your team and take on mid-sized projects, even near-AAA ambitions. Gameplay, art, narrative, and polish all shape quality, while bugs, budget, team fit, and development time constantly pull against your plans.

Publishing is the heart of the game. Prepare titles, pricing, screenshots, trailers, language support, and store descriptions. Submit store pages for pre-review, watch platform events, sales seasons, festivals, awards, and competing releases. Are your wishlists enough? Should you offer a launch discount? Is it better to wait for the next event window? These choices directly shape your launch results.

You are not alone. Secretary Xia will point out risks and next goals at key moments. Publishers, media, curators, and showcases can bring opportunities, but also revenue shares, requirements, and pressure. When money gets tight, you can take outsourcing jobs for cash. To improve your next game, you can study competitors and build understanding of genres, themes, audiences, and market positioning.

After launch, the work is not over. Schedule discounts, run additional marketing, release community items such as avatar packs, animated wallpapers, badges, and emoticons, and respond to player feedback, localization requests, and long-tail sales changes. First-week sales are only the beginning. A good publisher keeps a game alive after release.

Features

  • Simulate the full indie game journey from planning, development, store page setup, and review to launch.

  • Configure titles, pricing, screenshots, trailers, language support, localization, and launch discounts to affect store appeal and wishlist conversion.

  • Watch a 10-year release calendar and choose launch windows around sales seasons, festivals, awards, and themed events.

  • Hire staff, upgrade offices, and balance cash flow, progress, quality, and bug risk.

  • Handle publishers, media, curators, showcases, and outsourcing jobs, then decide which opportunities are worth taking.

  • Study competitors to build knowledge of genres, themes, core concepts, and target audiences, improving your next release.

  • Continue operating after launch with discounts, community items, follow-up marketing, and reputation management.

  • Learn step by step with Secretary Xia, or choose free mode to unlock systems directly.

Making a game is only the beginning. The real challenge is getting it approved, listed, wishlisted, launched, and selling long after release.
store_data.short_description: GameLaunchSimulator is a text-based management sim about the full journey of publishing an indie game. Build your studio, plan new projects, prepare store pages, grow wishlists, handle reviews, release windows, publishing deals, and post-launch operations, then bring an unknown game to real players.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore a retro first-person dungeon

Dungeon Nox Exotica is a dark fantasy dungeon RPG built around fast, low-resolution first-person exploration.

You move through unexplored corridors yourself, step by step.

Find enemies, collect loot, return to town, and prepare to descend even deeper.

Let them fight, or take command

Battles move at a brisk pace.

You can let your adventurers follow their tactics automatically, or step in and command them directly when the situation calls for it.

You do not need to control every action.

But when one decision matters, you can make it yourself.

The way back is automatic

When danger rises, order your party to retreat.

They will follow the known route back toward safety.

The way down is an adventure.

The way back is handled for you.

The deeper you go, the more important it becomes to know when to turn back.

Loot, rebuild, and descend again

Equipment found in the dungeon can vary in power and properties.

Even the same type of weapon can become a valuable find.

After each expedition, review your loot, adjust your equipment, change your formation, and prepare for the next run.

Classes and Skills, Your Way

Build a party of up to five adventurers, with each character choosing from eight distinct classes.

Select your favorite abilities from each class’s unique skill set and customize every character to suit your preferred playstyle.

As your characters grow, they can further specialize by choosing one of two styles that enhance their class’s defining strengths.

Custom Portraits for the Characters You Envision

Character portraits can be imported from external image files.

Choose images that match your vision and create a party you will grow even more attached to.

Read the expedition log

Your expedition log records battles, traps, loot, and critical moments.

Why did you win?

Where did you take too much damage?

What did you bring back?

Read the record of each expedition and use it to plan your next descent.

The abyss is not just a dungeon

The deeper you go, the more the dungeon begins to change.

Forbidden power.

A wavering mind.

A dark fantasy labyrinth where strength and danger grow together.

Will you go one floor deeper?

store_data.about_the_game:
Defeat the necromancer and free the world from his evil!

Necromancer Idle: The Endless Drain is an Incremental/Idle game inspired by the RPG and Roguelite genres. Choose between three starting classes — Soldier, Ranger or Mage — and journey across a fantasy world while you improve your skills and grow more powerful.

Narrative

The protagonist is blessed with the ability of rebirth, and has been cursed by The Necromancer's curse. A curse that drains your life force, making him more powerful while it consumes your power. You will have to fight your way through each life until you find the way to end him and put a stop to the curse.

Progression and growth

Your stats increase as you practice them. By performing actions, you gain learned and innate experience in those skills. When you die, you keep the innate experience, which makes your character more powerful every time and progress faster, letting them reach further. In addition, by helping certain characters or performing actions you can mitigate the effect of the necromancer's curse. But you won't always be the one helping others — sometimes others will be the ones helping you.

Interact with your other characters

Throughout the story, you may run into other characters created by you, who will help you in certain fights or to overcome obstacles that are impossible for you, easing your access to rewards you could not obtain any other way.

Choose your strategy

You will find obstacles that are very hard to overcome the first few times you reach them. You decide whether to dig in and keep trying until you succeed, or leave them to complete when you are more powerful. Both routes will succeed, but one may be more efficient than the other.

Find ways to overcome obstacles

Some routes are inherently difficult for a class. You are not forced to take that route, but the hard route may hide a reward for your class. You can overcome the obstacles on these routes with the help of another character who has advanced far enough in the story, or by obtaining an item, skill or spell to get past that obstacle.

Earn the favor of the gods

You can earn the favor of each region's gods by praying at their temples to ease the effect of the necromancer's curse and gain their favor in the fight against that area's boss. You will need all the help you can get in your fight against The Necromancer.

Automate your progress

Necromancer Idle lets you set up a list of automated actions that will be automatically added to the action queue every time you enter a room, as long as you have already created that list. This way, when you die, your character will repeat those actions, doing them faster and reaching further, until they run out of actions to do upon reaching an unknown room.

Customize your panel

You decide which information is useful to you. Customize the game's interface to your liking. Enlarge the panels you want to see better, minimize the ones you don't want to see at all. You can rearrange every panel however you like.

Offline bonus time

While the game is closed, you will accumulate time in your offline time Pool, which you can spend by setting the game to x2 or x3 speed, so you don't lose a single second of progress. The Necromancer is not going to waste it, and neither should you.

Your goal

You must put an end to The Necromancer to break the cycle and rid the world of his evil. His influence spans the entire world, and people suffer under his oppression. But remember: to defeat him, growing more powerful is not enough. As he drains your power, he grows stronger too. Rebirth may not be enough — you may have to...

Reincarnate

Reincarnation is a prestige system in which you lose a good part of your game progress, but in exchange you gain other bonuses that speed up progression — making it easier to beat The Necromancer in your race to see who grows more powerful, faster.

Try it for free with the demo

The entire first chapter is available in the demo. Try it for free before deciding whether the game is to your liking. If you buy the game, you can export your demo progress and import it into the full game to keep your advance.

What to expect from the game going forward?

New chapters with unique bosses that will challenge each class. Defeat them to obtain exclusive materials at guilds, colleges and academies, and craft special items that boost your stats and open up new strategies. Some bosses will require specific items to defeat them: a Mirror Shield to deflect their attacks, tools to cauterize the heads you cut off the Hydra...

New characters such as the cleric, paladin, bard or thief, among others. You will be able to create these characters, choosing their names, and run into them along your adventure, overcoming difficult obstacles or obtaining things unique to you.

But perhaps defeating the Necromancer is not the end... you will have to find that out for yourself.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to The Outskirts

You wake up in a dense fog, standing in the middle of a desolate four-way intersection at the edge of town. You are trapped in an endlessly repeating neighborhood where the streets loop back on themselves, and the only way out is to pay close attention.

Observe and Escape

To progress, you must carefully inspect the quiet neighborhood and determine which of the four branching roads is the safe route. If a street feels wrong, turn back immediately and choose another direction.

Guess correctly, and time marches forward. Guess wrong, and the loop resets to midnight.

Gameplay Features:

  • Liminal Retro Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a moody, PSX-inspired world featuring low-poly geometry, dithered lighting, and heavy atmospheric fog.

  • Discover Over 40 Anomalies: From subtle out-of-place objects to unnatural structural shifts, the neighborhood is actively trying to trick you.

  • Survive Until Dawn: Successfully navigate the intersection 10 times to progress the night toward morning and break the loop.

  • A Test of Memory: A focused, casual exploration experience designed to challenge your observational skills and paranoia.

store_data.about_the_game:
Yōkai Hunter is a bullet-heaven survival roguelite set in a dusk-cursed Japan — pick a hunter, evolve their arsenal, and hold the line as the yōkai horde grows denser, faster, and hungrier with every passing minute.

――――――――――

A Weapon for Every Hunter

Every hunter starts with a signature weapon and a completely different way of playing — pair it with the right charm mid-run and watch it transform into a devastating evolved form, from ground-shaking area attacks to beams of pure spirit energy.

――――――――――

The Horde Never Stops Growing

Waves scale endlessly — clear one line of yōkai and three more take its place. Out-level them, out-build them, or get buried under the swarm.

――――――――――

Command an Army of Yōkai

Some hunters don't fight alone — bind demons to your will and let an ever-growing pack of summoned yōkai do the killing for you.

――――――――――

Corruption Has a Price — and a Reward

Slay the Corruption festering in each map's enclave to unlock a permanent, run-altering perk tree back at the shrine. Power always costs something.

Some doors, once opened, do not close.

store_data.about_the_game:
Color Cup Racing is a fast, chaotic marble motorsport game built around unpredictable races, colorful competitors, wild tracks, and broadcast-style championship action.

Pick your marble, build a field, predict the outcome, and watch the chaos unfold as racers battle through themed courses filled with boosters, hazards, tight corners, pileups, and dramatic finishes.

Every race tells a different story. A favorite can get buried in traffic. A longshot can make a late charge. One bump, one boost, or one bad turn can change everything.

Jump into a quick race, build a full championship, or start a career season and try to turn your custom marble into a contender.

Color Cup Racing supports races with up to 30 marbles, giving every event a packed-field motorsport feel with traffic, battles, breakaways, and surprise winners.

Create your own marble and take it through a season of races. Earn coins, gain XP, upgrade your racer, and climb the standings across a growing calendar of colorful tracks.

Career mode gives every finish meaning, whether you are chasing your first top 10, fighting for prize money, or trying to win the Color Cup.

Build your own championship schedule, choose the tracks, set the field, and watch the points battle unfold race after race.

The broadcast-style HUD, standings tower, race results, and season points make each event feel like part of a larger motorsport season.

Race through a growing set of creative tracks, from serious racing circuits to chaotic fantasy courses. Each track has its own look, flow, hazards, and personality.

Expect everything from canyon roads and street circuits to volcano islands, asteroid belts, food-themed tracks, stormy cornfields, and more.

Place fake-coin predictions before races and see whether your pick pays off. Win your predictions and earn coins to use in Career Mode to upskill your marble!

Features

- Fast marble racing with up to 30 racers

- Quick Race, Championship, and Career modes

- Custom marbles and career upgrades

- Broadcast-style race presentation

- Themed tracks with hazards, boosters, and spectacle

- Fake-coin prediction system

- Dynamic results, standings, and points battles

- Keyboard, controller, and touch-friendly controls

- Short, chaotic races built for replayability

Color Cup Racing is about the joy of watching tiny competitors turn simple physics, traffic, track hazards, and wild momentum swings into surprisingly dramatic races.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Knocking

Years ago, a YouTuber named Pisty "Ahmed", survived a bizarre and terrifying supernatural event. Since then, the phenomenon called "The Knocking" has escalated into a full-blown global crisis. Governments are trying to fix it, and specialized task forces have been deployed worldwide to investigate and stop it.

But for Ahmed, the nightmare is just beginning. The Knocking has returned for him, sucking him directly into a hell-like parallel dimension fractured into four distinct, punishing layers.

He isn't alone. Teaming up with a mysterious ally named Perm, Ahmed must traverse the depths of this nightmare, survive its horrors, and confront the dark entity that created this hellish realm.

Do you have what it takes to survive The Knocking?

Key Features:

  • Four Unique Layers of Hell: Journey through a fractured, multi-layered nightmare. Each layer presents a drastically different environment, atmosphere, and set of rules.

  • Ever-Changing Gameplay: Adapt to survive! The core gameplay shifts depending on which layer you are in. You will need to test your wits with complex puzzles, use stealth to avoid terrifying enemies, and test your reflexes in epic boss fights.

  • Unravel a Global Mystery: Discover the dark lore behind "The Knocking." What is this phenomenon that has baffled governments and special forces alike, and why was Ahmed pulled into it?

  • An Unlikely Alliance: You can't survive this alone. Work together with your companion, Perm, to navigate the deadly obstacles that stand between you and your freedom.

  • Confront the Creator: Fight your way to the very bottom of the nightmare to defeat the creator of this hellish world and find a way back home.

store_data.about_the_game:
Zombie Tag is a fast-paced multiplayer party game that turns classic tag into a chaotic zombie chase.

At the start of each round, one player becomes the zombie. The zombie is frozen for 10 seconds while the humans run, climb, and search for the best escape routes across a dangerous construction site. When the countdown ends, the hunt begins.

The zombie attacks humans to infect them and turn them into zombies. Every player who gets caught joins the zombie team and starts chasing the remaining survivors. The humans must run, parkour and survive until the timer runs out.

The construction site is filled with platforms, narrow paths, obstacles, and risky parkour routes. Humans can use the environment to escape, but running is not always enough.

Players can also use boxing gloves to push zombies or other humans and knock them down. Bear traps can stun opponents, change the flow of the chase, and create unexpected moments of chaos.

Each round becomes more intense as the zombie team grows. What starts as one zombie quickly becomes a dangerous horde. By the end, every player is either running for their life or hunting the last survivors.

Features:

  • Fast-paced multiplayer zombie tag gameplay

  • One player starts as the zombie while others try to survive

  • Humans who get caught turn into zombies

  • Construction site parkour with platforms, obstacles, and escape routes

  • Boxing gloves to push and knock down other players

  • Bear traps that stun opponents

  • Chaotic rounds where the zombie horde keeps growing

  • Fun, competitive party gameplay with friends

Run, jump, push, trap, and survive until the end.
If you are the zombie, hunt everyone down and bring them to your side.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hideout Heist is a cooperative game about infiltration, hide-and-seek, and a tense standoff between cunning intruders and a security guard.

You and your team find yourselves in a restricted area where a stash is hidden somewhere. Your mission is to find it, reach your objective, and avoid getting caught. But it’s not that simple: a security guard patrols the map, knows the area better than you do, and will do everything in his power to prevent you from entering restricted areas.

Navigate through various arenas, including service areas, dark corridors, streets, and plenty of places where you can hide, distract the guard, or take a risk for a quick escape.

The game revolves around dynamic co-op play: some players can distract the guard, while others search for passages, scout the map, or try to reach the hideout. Each round becomes a mini-story where the plan can fall apart in a second, and a random noise behind you can decide the outcome of the entire mission.

Features:

  • Cooperative infiltration with friends

  • A showdown between players and the guard

  • Maps with hideouts, detours, and cover

  • Tension and the risk of being spotted

  • NPCs, environments, and details that bring locations to life

  • Different roles and playstyles: stealth, distraction, reconnaissance, and bold rushes

  • The concept expands across multiple maps, each with its own layout and tactics

  • Work together, hide, improvise, and don’t forget: the guard is hunting you, too.

store_data.about_the_game:
Keep the wheels turning.

Caravan Survivors is an auto-battler crossed with an arcade scroller. Your caravan rolls down a deadly road while hired heroes and mounted turrets hold back the endless horde. Build your loadout, upgrade your caravan, hire heroes, manage your caravan's inventory, and haul risky cargo for profit. Survive the route at all cost.

Build your loadout on a grid
Everything that matters lives in your caravans grid inventory. Turrets, relics, hero beds, and cargo crates all take up space, and space is tight. What you fit determines which weapons fire, which fighters deploy, and how much gold you're hauling. Owning an item isn't enough, your chassis limits how much you can run at once, so every item is a trade-off.

Level up on luck
Killing enemies earns XP, and leveling up pauses the run to offer a choice of upgrades. Each one rolls a rarity: the luckier the roll, the stronger the buff, and upgrades stack as you pick them. Your build compounds over a route, then resets when you head back to town for the next contract.

Take the contract, run the risk
Between runs you return to the Town hub: buy and sell in the shop, upgrade your caravan, expand your chassis, and pick your next contract. Tougher contracts pay more but stack the odds against you: deadlier enemies, denser hordes, road hazards. Rare cargo raises the stakes further attracting even more enemies to your caravan.

Features

  • Auto-battling heroes with distinct classes and abilities

  • Grid-based, drag-and-drop loadout management

  • Find relics and place them in your inventory to modify nearby items with various effects

  • Luck-driven, temporary stacking level-up upgrades with a four-tier rarity system

  • Turrets across multiple archetypes: straight shooters, streams of frost, mortars, and more

  • Elemental damage and status effects: fire, ice, lightning, bleed

  • A Town economy of contracts, shops, licenses, and permanent upgrades

  • Risk-reward rare cargo that attracts enemies or curses your caravan

  • Route bosses, tougher enemies, and escalating road hazards that add modifiers to your runs

  • Full gamepad and Steam Deck support planned

store_data.about_the_game:
It started with a flyer someone dropped

Into a frozen job market, out of a third-rate university, with nothing going for him — that's Saeki, our protagonist, who picks up a shady flyer on his way home: "Detective's assistant — urgently wanted! No experience needed. High pay… possible, maybe?" The day he steps into the deeply suspicious Followspot Detective Agency, the breezy director hires him on the spot — and then promptly disappears. Left behind: a sharp-tongued senior assistant, Nao, and a steady trickle of small cases.

Not spectacle — people's reasons

No grisly murders, no grand conspiracies. What you solve here are the circumstances and truths of ordinary people. You work the streets, listen, and crack each case with a flash of insight — because behind every case there's a "why it had to be this way." A slice-of-society mystery where comic banter and quiet sorrow live side by side.

A retro-PC screen that draws itself

Line & paint — evoking the PC-88/98 and X68000 — recreates the look of old PC games where the picture is "drawn" onscreen from line art to color, restaged with a modern touch. Dusky teal and warm bulb-light echo the nostalgia of the early 2000s.

Features

  • 🖌 A screen that draws itself — retro-PC "line & paint" staging, from line art to full color

  • 🔍 Retro-style command selection — Look / Talk / Examine / Use-Show / Think / Move, then "Deduce" to name the culprit and the truth

  • 📟 An early-2000s town — arcades, coffee shops and back streets with a Shōwa afterglow; mood over spectacle

  • 📖 Prologue + 11 chapters — a seasonal anthology of self-contained cases

  • 💾 Comfortable ADV features — save anywhere (multiple slots), auto / skip / backlog / chapter select

Language notice

This game's text and audio are in Japanese only. There is currently no English localization, and future localization is undecided. Please consider this before purchasing.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE DOLLAR IS DEAD


2036. President Tump Jr, America’s first tree president, declares $TUMP the national currency.

Money is worthless.

It is now the pitchfork economy.

THE PITCHFORK ECONOMY


Pitchforks drop randomly from the breadline.

Trade them with comrades on billionaire GabeN’s marketplace.

Use pitchforks to increase your net worth to buy more pitchforks.

And lose them when another comrade inevitably raids you.

BUILD THE MOB


EAT THE RICH is a free-to-play class-warfare idle clicker with survivors combat and the soul of a 2004 MMO.

Start with one worker and one wooden pitchfork. Your pitchfork throws itself. Click to throw harder.

Recruit farmers, beggars, miners, blacksmiths, match girls, washerwomen, agitators, and other workers. Every recruit fights beside you and multiplies your pitchfork power.

One worker becomes a crowd.

A crowd becomes an economy.

MAKE A BUILD. BREAK A BOSS.


Stack weapons, tomes, and uncapped loadouts while the Breadline fills with enemies.

Throw bricks. Swing guillotines. Weaponize tax audits, tomatoes, union drums, Molotovs, picket signs, and bees.

Fight speculators, landlords, trust-fund kids, private-equity ghouls, central bankers, tech oligarchs, and billionaire bosses. Crack open their chests. Collect the remains of unimaginable wealth. Wear the monocles.

Every run ends.

Class war does not.

EAT THE RICH


Defeat bosses. Open chests. Grow your mob. Take everything that was taken from you.

Or don't.

ROB THE POOR


Other players have vaults. Other players have pitchforks. Most importantly, other players may be poorer than you.

Raid them.

Build your defenses. Protect your pile. Climb the leaderboard. Every victory makes you wealthier, and every bit of wealth makes you somebody else's rich—without ever letting you leave the Breadline.

The revolution has no moral alignment.

The leaderboard only sees net worth.


  • Click to throw pitchforks or idle while your mob fights
  • Recruit and grow a visible army of workers
  • Stack weapons, tomes, and uncapped loadouts
  • Fight satirical elites and billionaire bosses
  • Earn ranked death chests and collectible trophies
  • Raid rival vaults and defend your own
  • Farm tradable pitchforks through chests and seasonal drops
  • Keep and trade eligible finds through Steam Inventory
  • Unlock 100 Steam achievements

Eat the rich or rob the poor.

Become the 1% of the 99%.

store_data.about_the_game:
Magic... How many legends warn you never to read strange books aloud? How many tales begin with words that should have stayed unspoken? Our hero never believed in any of that. Then he spent three dollars at a flea market, read one little spell before bed — and woke up sharing his apartment with eight impossibly beautiful witches.

Bound by a century-old curse, the coven can't leave — and neither can he. But between the demon setting his kitchen on fire, the glamour witch haunting his candlelit parlor, and the sweet herbalist who keeps feeding him, being trapped has never felt so much like coming home. When the truth about the curse is revealed, the coven splits three ways — and only you decide whose side to take, whose plan to follow... and whose bed to share.

  • Eight bewitching love interests, each with her own magic, her own room, and her own secrets

  • Three dramatically different story routes — bold, tender, or clever. One choice changes everything!

  • A warm and funny story with a pinch of drama and a whole cauldron of charm

  • Multiple endings dictated by your choices — every path leads somewhere worth staying

  • Replay to uncover every route, every romance, and every spicy secret the coven is hiding!

  • Be ready for magical surprises!

  • Light a candle, curl up, and let the coven enchant you!

store_data.about_the_game:
Every card is an army. Warlords is a roguelite deckbuilder where your cards don't sit in a lane — they muster, march, flank, and die gloriously on a living battlefield. Draft themed packs, plan your deployment, slam End Turn, and watch the clash auto-resolve. Climb a branching map, break six act bosses, and take the crown — solo, or in online co-op with up to four warlords.


YOUR HAND IS YOUR ARMY

Cards don't play into a grid — you drag each one onto the field, and a squad of soldiers, a spell, a trap, or a siege engine springs to life right where you drop it. Wall a lane, flank the line, and let the battle resolve in real time.


STACK THE ODDS

Spells and status effects turn a losing clash. Rain meteors on a cluster, then stack
Poison, Bleed, Fragile, and Charm to melt the enemy line before your commander ever
takes a hit. 212 relics and an 18-potion belt bend the rules further, every run.


DRAFT YOUR WARBAND

At the start of every run you draft themed card packs — armored legions, spider
broods, walking bombs, con artists, love sorcery, splitting slimes, rising ghosts, hatching eggs — and together they become your entire card pool. Your commander is even
assembled from the packs you pick, so no two runs look or play the same.


BREAK THE BOSSES

Every act boss has a signature phase that flips the fight. Cut the Bone Hierarch to
half health and the dead rise; strike the Bloom-Margravine and the whole garden
erupts. Six bosses across three acts stand between you and the crown.


NO TWO FIELDS ALIKE

Fight across green frontiers, amber woods, volcanic scars, frozen wastes, and jungle
ruins — each arena with its own hazards and a battle-wide condition to fight over.


EVERYTHING IN THE BOX
  • ⚔️ 296 cards across 15 draftable packs — squads, spells, traps, siege engines, and persistent Powers
  • 👑 36 named enemy lords (six of them act bosses), each with bespoke units, tactics, and taunts
  • 💎 212 relics and an 18-potion belt to warp every run
  • 🗺️ 3 acts of branching maps — battles, elites, merchants, campfires, and 92 hand-written events
  • 🤝 Online co-op for 2–4 warlords — Steam invites, lobbies, and rich presence
  • 🏆 56 achievements and a compendium that logs every card, relic, and lord you meet
  • 🐿️ Uncle Jim

store_data.about_the_game:
Starspire Hunters is a side-scrolling Action RPG where you hunt monsters, collect and sell their loot, and unlock powerful upgrades as you climb a mysterious tower filled with bizarre biomes, deadly bosses, and secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Long before humanity's first breath, a colossal, otherworldly, and monolithic structure appeared in the realm of Velmoria. Once believed to be one of the greatest wonders of the world, its ancient doors have finally been opened, revealing a sprawling, reality-bending labyrinth filled with bizarre monsters, unique biomes, hidden secrets, and an unsolved mystery whose truth will change Velmoria forever.

Battle a plethora of strange, otherworldly creatures that roam the floors of the Starspire. Every floor introduces new enemies with unique quirks, and the higher you climb, the deadlier they become.

Gather valuable monster drops and sell them on the bustling Starspire Grand Market to earn Spirol, Velmoria's primary currency.

Mine ore deposits scattered throughout the Starspire, refine them into valuable bars, and forge stronger equipment and unlock more powerful upgrades to help you climb higher.

Spend your hard earned spirol to unlock powerful upgrades across six unique tech trees. Strengthen your abilities, expand your options, and prepare yourself for the challenges waiting higher within the Starspire.

Invented by the Hunters Guild's eccentric Professor A.E. Stooge after the government slashed their funding, the Junk-A-Tron transforms monster drops into bizarre novelty inventions. Sell your creations on the Grand Market for massive profits and fund your journey deeper into the Starspire.

Prove your worth to the Starspire Hunters Guild and choose from specialized Combat Classes, each with its own unique abilities and play-style. Gain powerful abilities that will redefine how you fight your way through the tower.

Every biome ends with a powerful, otherwordly boss encounter. The Sentinels guard the secrets of the Starspire. Defeat them to unlock new areas and uncover an origin beyond anything Velmoria has ever imagined.

Start as a young rookie and grow into the legendary hunter the Starspire Hunters Guild desperately needs. Brave the bizarre depths of the labyrinth, push past the uncharted sixth floor, and uncover the cosmic mystery looming over the Starspire. What is its true nature? The answers await within.

store_data.about_the_game:
Zereoton Hauntings 3 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Mateo who loves to investigate the various haunted locations in the US.

Mateo, the paranormal enthusiast, got a call from a family living in Kentucky who have been experiencing paranormal activity for the past few months and were concerned about the safety of their kids. The house was built during the early 2000s, and there have been no reports of deaths on that property to date. As a result, the family was confused and couldn't understand why the paranormal activities started occurring in their home.

The owner shared his experience with Mateo before the beginning of the investigation. He said that his son was so scared that he refused to sleep alone in his room because he saw a tall, black shadow man calling out his name every night. Initially, he didn't believe him until he too saw a tall, dark creature in the basement area of the home. The family completely stopped entering the basement area ever since that day. One day, his wife was sleeping in her bed and she felt her bed being shaken violently by an unseen force which woke her up from sleep. She got so scared that she had to immediately leave the house without a second thought and had to spend the rest of the night in her car. After the incident, she refused to stay in the house alone. The owner also reported hearing disembodied laughs and footsteps in the hallway area, and witnessing multiple floating orbs and shadow figures.

Finally, the owner decided to get in touch with Mateo so that he could provide him with some answers. You play as Mateo, the paranormal enthusiast, and will you be able to escape the haunted house safely?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire family house in Kentucky!
  • Come face-to-face with the unrest spirits!
  • Collect items like keys, golden ring, flower vase etc.
  • Avoid traps like fire, rotating blades, spikes etc.
  • Explore unknown spirit dimension!
  • Nearly half-an hour of paranormal investigation.

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Don't Go Near That Mansion."

A Japanese-style horror adventure game set in 1980s Japan.

Akane Kiryu, a member of her school's Paranormal Research Club, plans to investigate the abandoned Mogami Mansion as part of a club activity.

However, five years earlier, a mysterious disappearance occurred there, and ever since, the mansion has been feared as a place that no one should ever approach.

Terrified by the rumors, every other club member refuses to participate, leaving Akane and her close friend Yukari Kanzaki to investigate the mansion alone.

As they explore the silent, abandoned building, they encounter inexplicable supernatural phenomena and uncover numerous clues hidden within its walls.

Little by little, they begin to unravel the truth behind the mysterious incident that took place five years ago, as well as the dark secrets concealed within Mogami Mansion.

Every choice you make influences the story, leading to multiple endings.

Every choice you make shapes the fate of the two girls, leading to multiple endings.

What truth awaits within Mogami Mansion?

Game Features

  • A Japanese-style horror adventure set in 1980s Japan.

  • Explore the abandoned Mogami Mansion as Yukari Kanzaki and her friend Akane Kiryu.

  • A branching story with multiple endings determined by the player's choices.

  • Uncover the mysteries hidden within the mansion and reveal the truth behind the disappearance that occurred five years ago.

  • An immersive horror experience that combines exploration, suspense, and atmospheric storytelling.

  • Multiple Bad Endings, along with a True Ending and a Best Ending.

About the Steam Edition

Mogami Mansion R is based on the original version released for free on PLiCy and has been refined and optimized for Steam.

The Steam edition is intended to receive ongoing updates and quality improvements, providing players with an even better experience over time.

Currently, the game is available only in Japanese. However, we are considering adding English localization in the future.

The original PLiCy version will remain available as a free, award-winning release, while the Steam edition will continue to evolve through future improvements, feature updates, and additional content.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lie Guo Silent Exclusive Game Description

Lie Guo Silent Exclusive is an ancient Chinese imperial idle casual game focused on relaxed tap-and-idle progression. You can steadily accumulate wealth without constant manual operation.

Step into the shoes of an imperial official to advance your official career. Tap to obtain massive silver taels, with passive income generated every second to easily stockpile millions of taels in your national treasury. Level up your official rank continuously to unlock new gameplay modules, and reach a specific level to access exclusive content of the Emperor’s Paradise.

The game boasts an abundant progression system: climb official ranks via Promotion, expand your harem through Concubine Selection, and forge powerful Divine Artifacts to greatly boost your earnings. Five management systems — State Policies, Antiques, Imperial Gardens, Cities & Territories, and Realm Maps — become available as you progress, letting you govern your land and strengthen your dynasty.

Various bonus auxiliary gameplay accompanies your journey. Claim generous daily rewards via Daily Check-in, use Auto Tap to free your hands, and activate Multiplier Earnings with one tap to get rich fast. There are also fun mini-games including Generals Constellations, Instant Fortune, and Lucky Ring Toss, alongside a Rapid Tapper tool to simplify operations.

You can earn silver steadily even while offline. In your spare time, manage court affairs, expand cities, and collect rare antiques. Gradually rise from a minor official to an emperor ruling vast lands, and build a prosperous golden dynasty with laid-back idle gameplay.

store_data.about_the_game:
Did you ever think, 'I want to make my own spells'? Then this game is for you.

MSS(My Spell Shop) setting is in a fantasy world full of mana, mages, warriors, and monsters, where you're the owner of a spell shop and a mage.

MSS is about learning spell crafting and being creative with it. The crafting system has been built with creative freedom as the most important part of it, and it could be described as node-based programming(building with component pieces on a spell circle), where the nodes are spell components. The spell components themselves are bought from the components shop.

Every spell you make will be tested and given specs, and the customers(other mages) will buy your spells based on these specs and their preferences.

About the spell test:

The spells will be tested when created in 5 simulated fights that you will not see(behind the scenes), though there will be an option for an extra one for you to see, and there will be a 'fight area' tab for you to customize simulated fights and watch them.

Progression (basically a promise for official release):

At official release, each component will have a level, and you will have a level. Whether it's yours or the components' level, you will need 'Study Hours(SH)' to level up. SH will be primarily given based on actions in the game, with a little passive while playing (an anti-afk approach might be implemented).

When you have more money, you can buy new components, or a 'new location'(the next level) that has higher-level mages who are more nitpicky, or 'research items'.

You can also buy visual customizations, including a new location (same level).

Eventually, there will be side stories and even side quests, but no main one.

Note:

New tabs and functions (content) are under planning and could be added.

The customers are virtual customers, not other players (some people were confused about that).

Made using Godot 4.6

store_data.about_the_game:
Grow Giant and Challenge Legendary Monsters!

A Survivor-Style Roguelite RPG

Grow Giant and Crush Your Enemies

The core feature of Lunadra is its Giant Form and Tiny Form system, which can be activated periodically.
In Giant Form, unleash overwhelming power and massive area attacks to wipe out hordes of enemies.
However, transforming requires enough space, making positioning and timing critical.
In Tiny Form, gain incredible speed and enjoy a high-mobility dodge-focused combat style.

Deadly Battles Against Legendary Monsters

Standing before the player are terrifying Legendary Monsters capable of threatening the world itself.
Massive area attacks, devastating magic, and relentless assaults await.
Surviving these extreme battles will not be easy.

Create Your Ultimate Build

Freely combine Weapon Cards, Support Cards, and Beast Cards to create your own combat style.
Different combinations dramatically change your strategy and abilities, allowing for deep build customization.

Intense Battles Packed Into 10 Minutes

Hordes of enemies, gigantic bosses, and flashy skills collide in explosive combat.
Experience the thrill of survivor-like gameplay packed into intense 10-minute battles!

2-Player Co-op Supported

Challenge legendary monsters together with a friend or family member.
Work together and survive overwhelming encounters!

Story

In the world of Valdia, legendary monsters reign supreme.
Ancient beasts have destroyed countless kingdoms.
Luna, a black cat adventurer, receives forbidden power from the ancient dragon Selva.
It is an ancient magic known as Scale Change, capable of freely altering the user's size.
Now, the small adventurer begins a battle to surpass the legends.

store_data.about_the_game:
DESCEND. LOOT. EXTRACT. REPEAT.

Oath Eternal is a dark fantasy RPG inspired by the Metroidvania and Extraction genres. Equip your character and delve into the dungeon, but be sure to extract with your hard-earned loot before being lost to the darkness. Become more powerful with each raid, pushing further into the dungeon to uncover the secrets of Castle Veynhold.

Features:

  • Explore Metroidvania-style dungeons which blend hand-crafted areas with procedural generation

  • Defeat challenging bosses and dangerous enemies in fast-paced 2D combat

  • Extract with your hard-earned loot, or push deeper into the dungeon for more: the choice is yours

  • Customize your character with unique classes, equipment, abilities, and passive skills

  • Engage with Merchants to trade items, complete quests, and enchant your equipment

  • Navigate secret passages, hidden doors, puzzles, and traps

  • Replay dungeons with randomized layouts: no two runs are the same

  • Escalate the challenge with Elite Mode, a New Game Plus experience

store_data.about_the_game:
Escape to a world where every season transforms the land around you. Build your homestead, master new skills, uncover forgotten secrets, and explore a handcrafted world filled with hidden discoveries.

Plant crops, mine deep caverns, fish peaceful waters, gather resources, and acquire better tools as you forge your own path. Unlock powerful abilities through expansive skill trees, revealing new ways to harvest, gather, and shape the world around you.

As the seasons change, so does the landscape. Snow blankets familiar fields, forests bloom with new life, and the world evolves throughout the year, rewarding players who return to places they've explored before.

Ancient books, forgotten ruins, and mysterious landmarks hold clues to secrets waiting to be uncovered. Every corner of the world has a story to tell for those willing to look.

Whether you spend the day tending your farm, searching for hidden locations, improving your skills, or simply enjoying the changing seasons, your adventure is yours to create.

Features

  •  Purchase your own homestead.

  •  Experience a living world that changes through all four seasons.

  •  Mine, chop, fish, and gather your way to prosperity.

  •  Master profession-based skill trees with meaningful progression.

  •  Discover hidden lore, puzzles, and secrets throughout the world.

  •  Explore a handcrafted fantasy world filled with rewarding discoveries.

  •  Relax at your own pace or pursue every collectible and hidden mystery.

NODE ZERO is a sci-fi mystery puzzle experience set inside a cold, abstract digital system. Navigate corrupted interfaces, review fragmented data, and piece together the truth hidden behind a failing network.

What begins as a routine system check quickly turns into something far more unsettling.

INVESTIGATE THE NETWORK


Search through logs, examine evidence, and follow clues across a layered digital environment. Every proof pushes you deeper into the system, revealing more about the world, the network, and what went wrong.

SOLVE, CONNECT, DISCOVER


NODE ZERO is built around observation, deduction, and interpretation. You will need to pay attention to details, connect information across systems, and think carefully about what the interface is showing you.

FEATURES


  • Atmospheric sci-fi puzzle and mystery gameplay
  • A stylized digital world with a clean, terminal-inspired interface
  • Evidence-based progression built around observation and deduction
  • Multiple proofs to uncover and complete
  • Operator Assistance modes for different play styles
  • A focused, immersive experience with a mysterious narrative core

OPERATOR ASSISTANCE


Choose how much guidance you want during your run.

Guided offers stronger clue support and highlights important evidence, making it easier to follow the trail.

Standard presents the same information with less direct assistance, offering a more demanding investigative experience.

DESCEND DEEPER


The deeper you go, the more unstable the system becomes. Hidden patterns, buried records, and fragmented truths are waiting to be uncovered.

Find the signal. Follow the evidence. Reach NODE ZERO.

store_data.about_the_game:
The coin is fair. Everything else is up to you.

In FLIP & CONQUER, every battle is won or lost on heads or tails — but you decide who to attack, how many squares to wager, and which cards to spring. Start as a single tile and grow into an empire that spans the map.
Take squares, build your empire.

A Turn Is a Bet

Pick an enemy along your border and wager squares — one for a safe nibble, or a towering stack for a game-swinging gamble. Call heads or tails. Win the flip and the land is yours; lose it and you may forfeit your own. The coin is 50/50. Knowing how much to risk is not.

Stack the Deck

When a card comes your way, you don't draw it — you draft it, picking 1 of 3 and holding up to 3. Thirty-three cards span Attack, Defense, and Action: tilt the coin with Luck, arm the hidden Double Stake to secretly double what your attacker risks, or force a rival to skip a turn outright. Under fire? A reactive-defense window lets you answer an incoming attack with a counter-card.

Conquer With (and Against) Friends

Bring up to 8 empires onto one map over Steam. Forge up to 4 named teams — alliances that fly your banner — cut deals in text chat, and if you're knocked out early, stay and watch how it ends. Built to be taught in a single round and played all night.

A Campaign of Crossroads

Fight a branching campaign from Prologue to the throne across five paths — trials, fog of war, endless survival, scattered isles, and a Warlord that mirrors your own traits. Solo skirmishes fill the map with NPC empires whose difficulty sets how well they play, and whose personalities — aggressor, defender, opportunist, schemer — set what they want.

Your Empire, Your Colors

Carry one identity across every match: a name, a capital, a slogan, a build drawn from over 40 traits that changes how you play, and a procedural three-color flag that flies over every square you take.

  • Coin-flip combat, your stake: wager one square or your whole border — the flip is fair, the risk is yours.
  • Up to 8 empires online: Steam P2P, built for game nights.
  • 33 cards, drafted not dealt: 11 Attack, 6 Defense, 16 Action — pick 1 of 3 whenever a card comes.
  • Hidden traps & reactive defense: arm Double Stake in secret; answer attacks with a counter-card.
  • Up to 4 named teams: alliances under your banner — until the map says otherwise.
  • Five-branch campaign: trials, fog, survival, isles, and a trait-mirroring Warlord, from Prologue to throne.
  • NPC empires with personalities: difficulty sets their skill; six archetypes set their ambitions.
  • Over 40 traits, one identity: name, capital, slogan, a trait build, and a procedural three-color banner.
  • Boards up to 500×500: a quarter-million squares of land and sea to carve up.

The coin doesn't play favorites. Call it in the air.
