store_data.about_the_game:
Weave words and cross them for massive combos!
This is a competitive crossword puzzle game where you freely move letter blocks to create words,
crossing them to build massive chain reactions!

■ Intuitive Puzzles at Your Own Pace

There are no falling blocks to rush you like in traditional puzzle games.
With a generous time limit, you can freely move, rotate, and place blocks.
Create words of 3 or more letters, branch off them to build a crossword, and set up huge combos.

Thanks to balanced block generation and a time-triggered "Hint" feature, anyone can easily experience the exhilaration of massive chain reactions.

■ "Unleash" at Will and Crush Your Opponents!

You can "Unleash" your built-up combos all at once whenever you want!
All the words and combos you've created will disappear, scoring you huge points based on word length and chain count. At the same time, this sends "Garbage Blocks" to your opponent's grid as an attack based on your score.
Launch a preemptive strike before your opponent's grid is ready, patiently save up for a devastating blow,
offset incoming attacks, or intentionally take the hit to fire back a massive counter...
Attack whenever the timing suits your strategy!

At the end of this fierce battle, any player whose grid completely fills up will explosively crash and burn.
The last player standing wins!

■ Mind-Bending Game Modes

  • "A-row, Ka-row, N"
    The classic mode where you build crosswords using only 11 specific Japanese hiragana characters. This directly tests your Japanese vocabulary and your ability to use the board strategically.

  • "E.A.R.S.T"
    A mode restricted to just 5 English letters: E, A, R, S, and T. With fewer letter types, words connect quickly and smoothly, but your on-the-spot English vocabulary will be the key to victory.

  • "U-Ko-Chi-N"
    A chaotic mode using only 4 specific Japanese letters (U, Ko, Chi, N) to build a board using those 4 particular words starting with "Un..." and "Chin...". While very simple and easy to play, it pushes your crossword puzzle strategies to the absolute limit as you figure out how to intersect this highly limited vocabulary!
    We've even included an in-game explanation for these words. Take this opportunity to study the Japanese vocabulary that Japanese children love the most!

You can play these modes freely with 2 to 4 players, against friends or AI!

■ Create Your Own Dictionary! "Deck Spell" Mode

Not satisfied with the default modes? Then build your very own dictionary!

In this mode, you can completely customize the "Letter Types" and "Words" used in the game from scratch, registering them as your original deck for battles.
Since it uses exactly the characters you input, it theoretically supports all languages!
Whether it's Japanese, English, Korean, Chinese, or anything else, you can make a deck out of it.

Will you focus purely on word connectivity, or gather cool, ultimate-attack-sounding words?
Bring your carefully crafted "Strongest Deck" and face off against others.

■ Online Multiplayer

The game currently features experimental online multiplayer.
*Please note that as this is currently in testing, there may be unexpected bugs or behavior.

We plan to continue evolving the game in future updates, including adding up to 4-player online matches and online support for Deck Spell mode.

《我的钓鱼世界 2》是一款永久免费、高度写实的国产开放沙盒钓鱼模拟游戏，在前作一代完整写实垂钓内容基础上全面迭代升级，主打真实淡水 / 海鱼生态模拟、数十人联机赛事竞技与私人鱼塘家园养成双线玩法。

你可以独自前往数十片真实复刻的野外水域野钓，也能创建 20-50 人大型联机房间和全球钓友同台竞技，还能拥有专属私人鱼塘自由繁育鱼种、打造私人垂钓乐园。游戏无强制买断，核心垂钓、单人野钓、多人赛事全部免费体验，包含完整渔具搭配、多专业钓组物理模拟、数百种原生鱼种生态系统，单局垂钓时长自由，完整内容可支持数百小时长线休闲游玩。

一、全面升级・拟真垂钓物理生态体系

延续前作广受好评的写实垂钓核心物理引擎，二代大幅扩充鱼种与水域生态，复刻上百种淡水、海水鱼类独有的进食习惯、分层栖息、洄游逻辑，每一种鱼都会根据水温、季节、饵料、水深产生完全不同的咬钩行为，还原真实户外垂钓的判断与博弈乐趣。

游戏完整开放滑漂、飞铅、跑铅等多款专业台钓、船钓钓组，全品类鱼竿、饵料、线组、鱼钩、浮漂可自由自定义搭配，每一套线组都会产生对应的真实垂钓反馈；路亚、底钓全新钓法持续开发更新，持续完善全场景垂钓操作机制，无论是新手休闲垂钓，还是资深钓友追求专业精细调漂，都能找到适配自己的玩法。

二、自定义多人大型赛事联机系统

全新开放 20-50 人超大容量联机房间，你可以自由创建私人赛事房间，自定义赛事奖励、参赛规则、限时赛程、参赛人数，邀约好友同台比拼渔获重量、鱼种数量、最大单尾记录。

同时支持四人房间组队野钓，默认开局 4 人房间，方便好友随时随时交流；

三、自由沙盒・私人家园生态养成

store_data.about_the_game:
A desk pet with a fishing rod.

Cozy Coast runs quietly in a small window in the corner of your screen, idling while you work, study, or browse. Drop in whenever you like to cast a line, sort your catch, and watch your little stretch of coast come to life.

Fish at your own pace

  • Cast by hand, or buy a rod and let it fish for you.

  • Offline progress: the coast keeps fishing while you are away.

  • No pressure, no grind walls. A calm loop you can dip into for ten seconds or ten minutes.

Fill the almanac

  • 65 fish to find across four waters: the sea, the deep sea, the pond, and the deep pond.

  • A rarity ladder from common minnows all the way up to ultra-rare exotics for near-maxed anglers.

  • Seasonal shells, odd bycatch, and a night shift of fish that only bite after dark.

Grow your angler

  • Climb the rod ladder, unlock new waters, and spend skill points on a branching tree.

  • Forage the beach, crack open drifting loot chests, and shoo the gulls for rewards.

  • Dismantle your finds and forge trinkets worth more than the raw catch.

Make it yours

  • A shop with rods, upgrades, and special lures for chasing the rarest fish.

  • Dress up your little angler with hair, clothes, and rotating seasonal cosmetics.

A living coast

  • A gentle day and night cycle rolls over the shore, and the torch glows after dark.

  • Encrypted Steam Cloud saves that follow you between computers.



Cozy Coast launches as a complete solo game, and Early Access is where it grows into a whole little coast. These features are planned, the order and scope may change, and there are no dates: we would rather ship them right than rush them.

  • Kitchen and cooking: turn your catch into dishes that buff the next stretch of fishing.

  • Crops and the windmill: a small farm beside the fishery, growing on real time.

  • Animal pen and breeding: a cozy pen of animals making ingredients on idle timers.

  • Bar and brewing: age drinks that bend the rules, with a barkeep who buys a daily catch of the day.

  • The hub map: step out of the widget into a bigger, hand-authored map.

  • Fish with friends: share the hub with other anglers, brokered through Steam, no servers to run.

Tight lines. Cast whenever you like.

store_data.about_the_game:
Vilnius Museum of Antiquities: A Temple of the Past is an interactive exhibition taking visitors to the origins of Lithuanian museology. Founded by Count Eustachy Tyszkiewicz, the Vilnius Museum of Antiquities opened its doors to the public all the way back in 1856 in the premises of the closed Vilnius University. Although the museum was controlled by the Russian tsarist administration, which then ruled Lithuania, it operated as a public institution, gathering the region's intelligentsia and nobility for joint scientific and educational work and accumulating the historical heritage of the former Grand Duchy of Lithuania. One hundred and seventy troublesome years later, it welcomes visitors once more with the help of historical data and bits of the collection that have survived to the present day.

Open the doors to mid-19th-century Vilnius and immerse yourself in the richly detailed virtual replica of the grand Pranciškus Smuglevičius Hall. Take your time to observe the 129 scanned and meticulously recreated original historical relics from the ancient lands of Lithuania and around the world. Paintings, sculptures, books, archaeological finds, coins, and many more exhibits currently stored at the Lithuanian National Museum are waiting to be discovered and collected into your personal list of exhibits.

Befriend the collector at heart, Count Eustachy Tyszkiewicz, who founded the museum with his own personal collection, and be sure to ask him about his lifelong interest in all things ancient. Learn many curious stories about the founding of the museum and all the exhibit groups its collection encompasses. The more interest you take in the collection, the more Tyszkiewicz will have to say about it.

A storm is brewing, one exhibit at a time, and it's up to you to get to the bottom of the museum’s intricate story.

FEATURES

  • Historical recreation - Enter a version of a 19th-century museum recreated from historical data.

  • Alternative education - Immerse yourself in stories from the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.

  • Digital museum - Explore a virtual exhibition at your own pace from the comfort of your home.

  • Extensive collection - Find, collect, and learn about 129 original exhibits.

  • Reactive exploration - Uncover even more stories as you progress through the collection.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bocage is a puzzle game where you must complete grids with farm pieces while respecting placement rules. Each animal and building has constraints. Some animals, like cows, must be enclosed in pens, while others must be next to a water source.

Fill the grid while respecting each constraint and the puzzle is solved.
Piece after piece, constraint after constraint, you build a living bocage.

  • No timer.

  • No score.

Just the quiet satisfaction of solving each puzzle and creating a little bocage.

  • Grid-based puzzle challenges — fill each level completely while respecting placement rules

  • Farm tetromino pieces — animals and buildings with distinct constraints

  • Constraint logic depth — adjacency rules, affinities and aversions create emergent puzzle design

  • Living progression — solve each puzzle and watch your bocage landscape populate and grow

  • Pure puzzle satisfaction — no timer, no pressure, just you and the grid

  • Contemplative pace — designed to reward observation and patience

store_data.about_the_game:
I'm Just a Wall is a multiplayer prop hunt game where up to 30 players hide and seek as cats. Morph into a cactus, a piece of candy or a tree and disappear into the island, or play seeker and hunt down anything that looks just slightly off.

Morphing isn't perfect

To hide your ears and tail, you'll need to paint your own camouflage with a brush and pick a spot that fits the terrain. The island is regenerated every round, so yesterday's favorite hiding spot may be gone today, and caught cats join the seekers, tilting the round their way as time goes on.

Sitting still isn't the answer either

Treasure chests are hidden across the island, and the points go to whichever cat opens them first.

The closer a seeker gets, the louder their voice becomes

If you can hear one nearby, it might be time to stop talking.

store_data.about_the_game:
Discover the joys of making a quilt, where every step of the process is in your hands!

Firstly, you will need to plant some cotton seeds. Look after them and water them each day and they will turn into beautiful cotton plants.

When they are fully grown, they will need to be taken to the mill to be spun into fabric.

We can’t just have plain white fabrics, so we need to gather natural resources and take it to be dyed!

Once we have the beautiful fabrics in all different colours and patterns, we are almost ready to start our quilt, but we will need some wadding for the centre. Luckily we have some sheep, and their wool makes soft, quality wadding which is just what we need to get started.

Now we can make our quilt. Choose your template and create colourful, beautiful quilts as you fulfil the customers orders.

As you make friends and your collection grows you can experiment with different styles and eventually unlock the freeform quilts which will give you unlimited options for beautiful designs of your choice.

Quilting is only part of the experience. Life in this welcoming community is full of fun, with a cast of quirky characters to meet and plenty of activities to enjoy!

Spend your day catching fish for the local seafood shack, tracking down missing book pages for the bookshop, or joining in a lively community festival. With so many activities to enjoy, there's always something fun waiting for you!

Hadal Zone

Survive this puzzle-horror adventure and uncover the truth behind the terrible story hiding in the depths of the aquarium! But beware: once you cross the point of no return, there is no going back...

Welcome to Hadal Zone! Until a few years ago, it was the largest and most well-stocked aquarium in the world. But one day, something terrible happened, and the place became what it is today. That’s where you come in: you will have to venture inside the now-abandoned facility and discover the truth about what went down.

The Beauty of the Ocean Floor!

At Hadal Zone, you can find all kinds of marine animals! From tiny fish to the largest apex predators! Plus, you can enjoy your visit with an unprecedented experience thanks to numerous attractions like slides, arcades, interactive kiosks, and talking robots!

Not Just an Aquarium...

Thanks to recent acquisitions, Hadal Zone is no longer just an aquarium! In addition to the marine exhibits, there are multiple games and rides for both adults and children, workspaces, and even a mini-train that travels throughout the entire facility! Whether you want to observe the fish, enjoy some peace and quiet, or have fun with friends, this is the perfect place!

We're Waiting for You!

Now, all that's missing is you! We’re going to have so much fun together, and we can’t wait to see you!

store_data.about_the_game:
THE SKY TORE OPEN. IT NEVER CLOSED.

A rift split the heavens and the Swarm poured through. Numberless. Starving. You are a KYROX-pattern, thawed from a cold vault to answer for it. No name. One purpose. Hold the line or die screaming.

KILL, LOOT, SURVIVE

You start with a pistol. Everything else you tear off the things you kill. Grind through relentless waves of over twenty monster types, each with its own gross face, its own scream, and its own way to end you. Hear a Charger wind up behind you and turn before it lands. Miss, and the wave eats you.

BUILD A RUN THAT BREAKS THE RULES

Seven weapons, from the PULSE sidearm to the LANCE railgun that skewers six enemies in a single line. Every gun kicks its own way, and learning the recoil is the difference between clutch and corpse. Between waves you draft from over forty upgrades that snowball into a build: crit stacks, piercing rounds, lifesteal, explosive shots, dodge rolls. Push the Threat tiers for meaner enemies and fatter rewards, and bank shards in the Armory for permanent perks that ride with you into every run.

FACE THE WARDENS

Four boss archetypes command the Swarm. Each is a wall of teeth with three phases and its own fight, backed by elite enemies that roll deadly affixes. Nothing in here wants you to reach the next wave.

TAKE YOUR AIM ONLINE

When you think you are good enough, prove it. Best of five 1v1 duels over Steam, lag compensated, with every gun, every recoil pattern, and every ounce of feel carried straight over from the campaign. Just you, a rival, and whoever flinches first.

RUN THE DAILY

One seed. Everyone. Every day. Same waves, same drafts, same map for the entire world. Climb the leaderboard and hold your spot.

SIX ARENAS WITH SOUL

Neon kill-boxes. An ember-red fighting pit. A procedural dungeon that is never the same twice. And a real hand-built cathedral where a pipe organ plays you to your grave.

Pixel-perfect, CRT-soaked, and built by one person who refused to let it look like everything else. Survive the nights.

WEIRD CO.
Employee Welcome Letter 

Congratulations on your new assignment.

We are pleased to welcome you to WEIRD CO.'s Emotional Production Department as a Floor Technician. 

Your responsibilities include the installation and calibration of Emotional Capsules (Doses), as well as the optimization of production efficiency. 

Further information regarding workplace procedures, safety protocols, and production standards can be found in the attached documentation. 

Please report to your assigned production floor immediately.

We wish you a productive first shift.

—-

WEIRD CO. EMPLOYEE ORIENTATION

Production Floor Handbook, Revision 7.3

Your primary responsibility is to maintain a stable and efficient Emotional Production Floor. 

Emotional capsules ("Doses") will be delivered at the beginning of every shift. Install Doses into compatible production units ("Weirds") and ensure each vessel is fully assembled before initiating a Production Cycle. 

Production efficiency depends on proper vessel placement. Daily shipments vary, and production layouts should be adjusted accordingly. 

Once a Production Cycle has been initiated, all floor modifications are temporarily restricted until the cycle has concluded.

Additional vessel types, production technologies, and operational directives will become available as your assignment progresses.

Thank you for your continued cooperation.

—-

☐ Receive Daily Shipment

☐ Assemble Weirds

☐ Install Doses

☐ Verify Vessel Compatibility

☐ Initiate Production Cycle

☐ Monitor Production Output

☐ Prepare Floor for Next Shift

—

WEIRD CO.
Production Floor Safety Guidelines

The following guidelines have been established to ensure safe and efficient operation of the Emotional Production Department.

  • Do not initiate a Production Cycle unless all assigned Weirds have been fully assembled.

  • Emotional Capsules ("Doses") may only be installed or removed while the Production Floor is unlocked.

  • Never force incompatible Doses into the same Production Unit.

  • Production Units exhibiting unexpected behavior are to be reported through the appropriate channels.

  • Employees are reminded that apparent speech, emotional attachment, or memory retention does not constitute consciousness.

  • Questions regarding the Extraction Program are outside the responsibilities of Floor Technicians.

Failure to follow these guidelines may result in reduced production efficiency or disciplinary action.

A shogi where you don't capture — you grind them down.

Damage Shogi rebuilds traditional shogi around HP, Attack and Defense. Pieces no longer fall in one hit. You chip away their HP, and only defeat them when it reaches zero. Damage is randomized, and an attacked piece may

strike back. Every square becomes a gamble.

Three actions a turn — dense, deliberate play.

Instead of one move, you take three actions per turn. Move in, corner them, and strike — or drop a piece, defend, and wait for your moment. How you sequence three actions decides the game.

Tune the luck yourself.

Damage variance, counter success rate, actions per turn, randomness on/off — the rules are yours. Go for pure skill, or embrace swingy comebacks. You can even edit each piece's HP, Attack and Defense individually.

A CPU with real bite — and friends around the world.

Four CPU tiers: Weak / Normal / Strong / Expert. The Expert AI plays like a human — lying in wait just outside range, then cutting down anyone who steps in with a three-action burst. Play friends online via friend invite /

room code, with reconnection support.

Features

🎯 A fresh shogi battle driven by HP / Attack / Defense (promotion boosts movement & combat)

🎲 Randomized damage and counterattacks create constant tension (adjustable)

⚡ Three actions pper turn for deep tactical sequencing

🤖 Four CPU tiers (the Expert AI ambushes)

🌐 Online play (friend invite / room code, with reconnection)

🛠 Fully customizable ules and piece stats

🎌 Japanese & English

store_data.about_the_game:
The Casino of Time is a liminal themed roguelike casino game where you must survive for as long as possible.

You lived your life as a gambler and just passed away. However, you never made it to heaven due to your excessive gambling habits in life. Instead, as a final trial, you spawn into the transitional space known as the Casino of Time. Your goal is to escape this place and make it to heaven. The glass panes light up over time, showing you the correct path, so survive for as long as possible to see the correct way to heaven.

In this casino, time is your only currency. Your goal is to earn as much time as possible and last long enough to make it to heaven. Be careful though, your time drains faster and faster, making survival get progressively harder.

Play 5 different casino games in any way you like. Each game and its upgrades are finely balanced, so deciding on which game to play for your run is incredibly important, and not every game nor strategy can work every time.

Choose from a variety of upgrades every 2 minutes! There are many upgrades to choose from, each one changing how different games are played. As the game progresses, your upgrades stack, allowing you to earn more Time Faster. Decay rate also progresses exponentially to reflect the amount of power you gain from your upgrades, so playing well is essential to outrun your inevitable demise.

store_data.about_the_game:
It’s your lil’ spider against the world in this physics-based multiplayer battleground. Master your webs to swing, slingshot, climb, and build structures. Catch elemental flies to infuse your attacks with fire, electricity, and acid. Become the toughest, most aura’ed up spider of all!

FEATURES

  • Battle with up to 10 players 

  • Physics-based web swinging

  • Build (or break) web structures

  • Catch flies to gain elemental powers

  • Infuse webs with fire, electricity, and acid 

  • Collect hats and mask to customize your spider

  • Play capture the flag

  • Chase golden flies

  • Test your skills in a boss battle

  • Coming soon: Sandbox Mode, additional maps

360 DEGREES OF FREEDOM

Use your webs to navigate the map - walls, furniture, ceiling - it's all fair game. Webs harden to create networks that change the environment and unlock new opportunities for traversal and combat.

INTENSE SPIDER COMBAT

Battle online with up to 10 players. Use your webs, fly cannon, and the environment to take on opponents in thrilling, creative brawls. Crowns, bounties, revenge, hat theft…it’s all here!

ELEMENTAL POWERS

Elemental flies give you different powers like fire, electricity, and acid, each with their own effects and strategic uses. Control the battle field to burn, zap, and melt your opponents.

SO MUCH TO DO

Find gift boxes with hats and masks to wear, golden flies to chase, and other goodies. Plant flags (or steal them from others) for points and aura. There’s lots to do and discover in this lovingly-crafted spider playground.

store_data.about_the_game:
THIS CHURCH IS IN HELL. AND YOU'RE NOT ALONE IN IT


A ruined cathedral hangs suspended in the depths of Hell, and the damned rise from its cracked stone floors without end. Hunt Skeletons Together is a first-person action shooter set inside a cursed church and the burning hellscape around it, playable by 1 to 4 players online. Stand shoulder to shoulder with friends against the rising horde — or turn on each other in a brutal free-for-all where everyone fends for themselves. The choice is yours.

THE DEAD DON'T JUST SHAMBLE

These are no mindless bones. Climbed onto a pew, an altar, or a broken balcony to catch your breath? They'll leap after you — and the whole nearby pack springs at once. The ranged undead hurl bone shards and hexed stones across the nave, so no distance keeps you truly safe. And when the aisles fall quiet, an ancient bloodlord may be stalking the dark. No corner of this church is ever truly safe.

SWING, DON'T RUN

The floor belongs to the dead — so take to the air. Fire your grappling hook at the beams, arches and broken heights of the cathedral and swing clean over the horde, yank yourself out of a closing pack, or reposition to high ground in an instant. Mobility isn't an escape button; it's a weapon. Learn the church's rooftops and you'll rain fire down on the swarm before it ever reaches you.

SHATTER THEM TO PIECES

An advanced dismemberment system means every hit leaves its mark. Skull, arm, leg — whatever you strike is blown off and flung by physics, splintering into bone and dark ichor. Cripple a skeleton's legs and it won't fall for good; it starts crawling toward you, dragging what's left of itself across the consecrated stone.

WEAPONS

Assault rifle, shotgun and rocket launcher... and the fists that take over when everything runs dry. Rockets travel with real projectile physics, synced for everyone in the match. Swap weapons on the fly, with polished recoil, a dynamic crosshair and punchy hit feedback on every shot.

THREE MODES, ENDLESS CHAOS

  • Survival: Endless, ever-escalating waves of the dead. How long can you hold out?
  • PvP (Team): First to the kill limit wins. Undead off — the only target is each other.
  • Survival + PvP: The most chaotic mode. Stay alive against the horde while fighting your rivals at the same time. You decide who to shoot — and who to forge a fragile alliance with.

EVERY KILL COUNTS

Every skeleton you drop is XP. Level up and unlock new ways to make your hunter your own — helmets, hoods, armor sets, full outfits and more. The more you kill, the more your character truly becomes yours.

WITH FRIENDS, AND FAIR

Invite friends over Steam and host your own lobby. A server-authoritative architecture with lag compensation keeps your headshots landing even at high ping. Prefer to go it alone? Single-player is fully supported.

FEATURES

  • 1 to 4 players online — co-op and PvP
  • Grappling hook traversal — swing, escape and take the high ground
  • Distinct undead types with physical dismemberment / gore
  • Smart enemy AI that leaps at you and attacks from range
  • 3 weapons + melee
  • 3 game modes, 4 difficulty levels
  • Level-based cosmetic progression — helmets, hoods, armor and outfits for a long-term "one more run" loop

The church has fallen into Hell, and the dead keep climbing out. Survive together... or be the last one standing.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Just a little more would be enough. Sign one more contract... it's only a sliver of soul, right?"


You are cornered, and the Devil is the only one still lending. Every contract you play prints money — and the strongest ones are paid for in soul. The catch is simple and cruel: the only way to clear your debt is to sign more of the very contracts that damn you.

Floor the gas AND ride the brake

This is an economy-engine deckbuilder with a self-destruct button built in. You must earn enough to clear each deadline (the gas) while keeping your soul off zero (the brake). Pressing both at once — every single turn — is where the decisions get sharp and the runs get addictive.

Three resources, one Devil

No spreadsheet hell. Just Gold (what you owe), Blood (a risky short-term fuel), and Soul (your life, and the twist). Every turn is a trade between the three. Build a chain of contracts that snowballs gold — and watch your soul drain as it fires.

The lower your soul, the stronger you get — and the closer to ruin

Soul is tiered. Stay Calm and you're safe. Slip toward the Brink and the screen bleeds red, the heartbeat pounds, curse cards seep into your deck — but the darkest contracts also hit hardest. Playing on the edge is the whole thrill.

Eight creditors, one final pact

Climb a ladder of eight debtors, each with its own rule to break you. Clear one, draft one of three new contracts, and face something nastier. Chase four builds — Compound, Blood, Damnation, Redemption — each with its own engine and its own way to die.

Features

  • Four distinct archetypes and 100+ contract cards
  • Sigils (relics) that reshape your run, and an ascension ladder for the greedy
  • Devil's-bargain branch events — every choice costs something
  • A dark, woodcut-gothic look with full-screen "damnation" tension
  • Fully localized in 31 languages

The board is set. The quill is inked. Wishlist now — and sign your first contract.

"Signal 17 Hertz" is a detective visual novel set in late-2000s Moscow.

The story follows Roman, a first-year university student who moves to the capital in search of a fresh start. New friends, dorm life, classes, and the excitement of a big city seem like the beginning of an ordinary student experience.

Everything changes when a mysterious audio file called EXXXSTASY.wav begins spreading across Moscow. People share it with one another, play it at parties and clubs, discuss it online... and gradually begin to change.

Explore Moscow at the end of the 2000s, meet a cast of memorable characters, gather clues, and uncover the truth while figuring out who you can trust.

With every new discovery, the mystery grows deeper, revealing that beneath the surface of everyday student life lies something far more dangerous.

In a world immersed in total darkness, light is your only hope. Lose it, and your journey ends; keep it, and you may live to see another day. While venturing across lands where monsters try to devour your flame, you must harvest the energy required to keep hope well lit. Time is short, so may those who strive thrive!

Adventure

You have just 300 seconds to scour the land for resources and carry them, piece by piece, back to your sky fortress. But danger lurks everywhere. Not only must you dodge the monsters prowling the shadows, but you must also keep a constant eye on your flashlight—which may be on the verge of dying.

Of course, surprises await at every turn. You might stumble upon a long-lost ruin or unearth a chest of hidden treasure. From dense jungles and arid deserts to murky swamps, your journey will only grow more thrilling!

Resource Management

Every scrap of material is a trophy won from the jaws of death, but strict inventory limits will force you to balance short-term survival against long-term planning.

Above all, time is your ultimate resource. Whether you are caught up in tedious preparations or lose focus for a split second, the cold 300-second countdown never stops. When time runs out, if you haven't made it back to your fortress with your haul, you will be lost to the darkness forever.

Upgrades

The wandering monsters are born of the dark, yet they endlessly crave the light. Your very existence makes you an enemy to everything out there, but the light you carry is also your only weapon to drive them back. To survive, you can craft and upgrade your gear: unlock the ability to detect hidden creatures, turn stone to gold, master agile movement, or unleash attacks that pierce through any obstacle. As long as you have the resources, you can grow stronger—until you stand at the absolute top of the food chain!

store_data.about_the_game:
Want more out of your time-wasting games than just "numbers go up"? Background Hero is a RuneScape inspired skill-management and idle progression based game that aims to recreate that dopamine hit of maxing out a variety of skills.

At the core is a deep roster of skills to train, from woodcutting and mining to smithing, cooking, brewing, magic, and more, each with its own resource chains, recipes, and gear to chase. Decide what to work on next, push toward the level that unlocks a better recipe or tougher node, and watch your completion ring creep closer to 100%.

Every action you take builds Mastery, a system built around specializing. Stick with a favorite spot long enough and you'll unlock faster completion times, bonus yields, and a shot at not even burning through your materials.

Keep your eyes open while you gather, because rare finds turn up when you least expect them. What you do with them is up to you: brew a potion, craft a piece of gear, or sell it off for gold.

Beyond the daily grind, Achievements and Task Diaries lay out checklists that reward permanent bonuses once cleared, giving you something bigger to build toward.

Looking for a change of pace? Send your hero off on treasure hunts for a shot at rare rewards, then haul everything back to the trade market to buy, sell, and gear up for what comes next.

Background Hero rewards the player who commits to the grind. The more you dig into its systems, tuning your loadout, chasing mastery, and plotting your next upgrade, the faster your hero grows.

  • Several skills for grinding and perfect for completionists who chase that 100%

  • Each skill is populated with various items to actions to grind and items to earn

  • Gathering turns into Production with thoughtful chains of resources

  • Resource management at its finest with a fully fledged Trade Market & Inventory

  • Tiered combat and gear that's rewarding to engage with, giving you a goal to work towards

  • Cloud saves that function cross-platform with an in-game account

  • An idling adventure at its core, the game plays when you're away and rewards you when you come back!

store_data.about_the_game:
Run. Bet. Win!

Derby Heroines brings the full grammar of horse racing to a track-and-field girls' racing game. Study the paddock, read the odds, buy your tickets — then take the starting gate yourself. Bet on yourself and cash in with your own two feet.

▍Races are action

Manage your dash gauge, grab skill orbs on the track, and unleash your once-per-race special move. Pack running, slipstreams, photo finishes — with a live tracking board and full race commentary in four languages.

▍A real betting system

Seven bet types — Win, Place, Quinella Place, Quinella, Exacta, Trio, Trifecta — plus wheel, box and formation betting. Odds are simulated per race, so favorites and long shots actually make sense. Every bet uses in-game currency only. No real money, ever.

▍PINZUDO 5

Pick the winner of five straight races (R7–R11) for a jackpot-style payout with carryover. Hit all five and get rich.

▍Collect & train

Recruit 100+ track girls via gacha — many with gloriously silly racehorse-style names. Check distance aptitude and running style, pick your entry, and level her up with race XP.

▍Supported languages

UI & commentary: Japanese / English / Traditional Chinese / French

▍Streaming & video policy

Streaming, videos and monetization are welcome without prior permission, for individuals and companies alike. No spoiler restrictions. Clips, thumbnails and screenshots are all fine. Perfect for "pick the winner with your chat" streams!

store_data.about_the_game:
Time Boxing is a turn-based, hybrid card-battler and fighting game where every jab, hook, and uppercut is a card and every turn is a chance to bend the timeline to your will. Pick your fighter, draw your cards and trade blows in a championship match where past, present and future are all options for you to master.

This isn't just a brawl. It's a duel of choices you must make played out across a fractured clock. Do you land the combo now, or plan for a better combo in the future? Should you attack your opponent in the present, or steal a card from the past? The fighter who controls time controls the fight. But be careful, tampering with causality can create paradoxes, changing your fate and the outcome of the fight in your opponent’s favor.

FEATURES

A Roster of Time-Bending Fighters

Choose from a cast of boxers, each with their own unique abilities, signature cards and distinct playstyle. The brawler who overwhelms with raw aggression plays nothing like the tactician who weaves the timeline into a trap. Find the fighter that fits how you want to play.

Every Punch Is a Card

Build devastating combos from your hand. Chain blows, counter attacks, bait your opponent and unleash special cards unique to your fighter. Read your fight, manage your hand and decide when to commit and when to hold back.

Every Card is a Choice

Master the Timeline to keep track of Past, Present and Future actions. Rewind a punch just played, plant a haymaker in the future or dodge an incoming blow in the Present. Stack effects across turns, reshape the future to your advantage or even reverse the flow of time itself, shifting a future attack to the past. Time is your deepest resource and your sharpest weapon.

Beware the Paradox

Causality is unforgiving and must always be obeyed. If you play a future card but fail to complete the loop in the present, you’ll create a paradox and the damage will come back to you. The Timeline is your greatest strength, but can become your most dangerous opponent.

Build It or Optimize It

Craft a deck from the ground up around your favorite fighter, or pick from a finely tuned pre-built archetype and sharpen it to your style. Whether you love deep theorycrafting or just want to step into the ring, there's a deck for you.

STEP INTO THE RING

The bell is ringing. The clock is ticking. Time to Fight Time!

store_data.about_the_game:
Set in a 1950s-inspired city, A Nice Safe Job is a 2D cozy crime caper where wits and patience are your best tools. Start at the bottom of the Thieves Guild, crack devious safes, and liberate loot to become the city’s most notorious thief. Navigate a world where greed is your greatest enemy, and outsmarting the authorities is just another night on the job.

MASTER THE HEIST

Use a unique tactile interface to crack complex security mechanisms like tumbler locks and number pads. Solve environmental puzzles and study your surroundings. You have infinite time to crack the safe, but precision and observation is key.

GRAB THE LOOT

Once the safe is open, the timer starts. Balance greed against risk and grab as much high-value loot as you can before the police arrive. If the timer hits zero, you lose your haul.

RISE THROUGH THE RANKS

Sell your findings at the Pawn Shop to gain Money and XP. Filling your Rank Meter unlocks new city districts, with increasingly challenging jobs, and valuable loot to grab. Spend your money on an array of tools and devices to help in your safe-cracking adventures.

KEY FEATURES

COZY AESTHETIC

Immerse yourself in a charming 2D world paired with an effortlessly cool jazz soundtrack.

DYNAMIC SECURITY

Face escalating challenges when you revist locations, including security cameras, patrol guards, security dogs, and burglar alarms.

PUZZLING CHALLENGES

Tackle environmental puzzles by rotating safes to change your perspective and scour the environment for clues. Master a specialized thief’s toolkit - including screwdrivers, wire clippers, magnets, and even infrared glasses - to dismantle high-tech defenses.

COLORFUL CAST

Build relationships with a memorable cast on both sides of the law, from estranged family members to potential romances.

CITY LOCATIONS

Visit key hubs like Mulligan’s Pawn Shop to exchange loot for cash and rank, Kit’s Diner for valuable intel and local gossip, and the Night Library to uncover essential clues needed to solve the toughest puzzles.

A DEEPER MYSTERY

Catch the eye of ‘The Fox,’ the city’s king of thieves and prove your worth as their replacement by outshining a rival apprentice who will stop at nothing to claim the title for themselves.

store_data.about_the_game:
Kachow Kart Racing is a fast, chaotic, and fun arcade kart racing game set on colorful tracks. Get behind the wheel, drift through corners, collect boosters, overtake your rivals, and fight for first place all the way to the finish line!

This is not just a simple race. Use boosters and in-race advantages at the right moment to gain the upper hand against your opponents. Speed up, defend yourself, disrupt your rivals’ plans, and look for opportunities that can change the entire race with a single move.

Thanks to its easy-to-learn driving system, you can jump straight into the action. But to race well, you’ll need to master your drift timing, boost usage, and the interactive elements on each track. Every race becomes a fun mix of speed, reflexes, chaos, and smart decisions.

Race solo against AI opponents, compete with your friends in split-screen mode on the same screen, or prove yourself against other players in online ranked mode. Whether you want a casual race or a serious climb through the ranks, every corner matters.

Upgrade your kart in the garage, choose from different characters, purchase new tracks, and progress in your own racing style. With in-race abilities like smoke bombs, shields, oil traps, and more, being fast is not enough — using the right move at the right time is also a key part of winning.

Kachow Kart Racing brings together the fun spirit of classic kart racing with colorful visuals, arcade-style driving, interactive track elements, local fun, and online competition.

Key Features

Fast and colorful arcade kart racing

Easy-to-learn and fun driving system

Drifting, boosting, and high-speed racing action

Track boosters and interactive racing advantages

In-race abilities such as smoke bombs, shields, and oil traps

Online ranked mode

Split-screen local gameplay on the same screen

Races against AI opponents

Different characters, karts, wheels, and engine options

Purchase new tracks and progress through the game

Fun, chaotic, and competitive racing atmosphere

store_data.about_the_game:
Arthur Ruthven's thirty-fifth birthday is fast approaching, but he's worried that his life has started to stagnate.

Once a history teacher in Leith, an incident with a former pupil causes Arthur to retire early. Newly uneasy about teaching, and unsure if he can pursue the career he once loved, Arthur returns to his childhood home in the small village of Colinton, to live with his mother.

For the last three years, Arthur has worked with his mother in his family's old bookshop in obscurity. He would prefer to forget his days as a teacher, and the anxieties which came with them...

But Arthur can only keep his past at bay for so long, and his life takes an unexpected turn when his mother hires a new helper at the bookshop over the summer holidays: one Mason Tierney, one of Arthur's former students.

Mason has done some growing up in the five years since Arthur last saw him, and now, he's already twenty-one. Mason tries to be friendly with Arthur, but Arthur begins to worry. Is Mason being too friendly - and will Mason's interest in Arthur stir up uncomfortable memories Arthur would far rather see buried for good?



- 50,000 words of text (approx 2-3 hours of reading)
- A linear story with no choices or branches
- A relaxing BL romance story set in Scotland
- Two cute main characters
- A custom soundtrack
- Gay angst!

store_data.about_the_game:
Mine the Deep is a fast-paced sci-fi action game where the Company has discovered a highly profitable mining opportunity... currently occupied by an unreasonable number of armed drones.

As the Company's newest Miner, you'll be expected to harvest valuable resources, eliminate productivity-reducing drone activity, and return with as much profit as possible. Your continued survival is encouraged but not required.

Build an Arsenal Worth the Investment

Recover valuable resources and invest them in powerful upgrades that transform your ship into a devastating weapon platform. Expand your firepower, strengthen your defenses, and discover new ways to carve through the swarm.

Every Drone Has a Job

The drones aren't mindless targets. Each type fills a different role on the battlefield—some rush your position, others attack from range, shield their allies, or force you to rethink your priorities. Surviving means learning which threats deserve your immediate attention.

Every Asteroid Is Another Paycheck

The Deep is filled with resource-rich asteroids waiting to be mined... assuming you can survive long enough to reach them. Every haul brings you closer to your next upgrade—and one step closer to meeting the Company's profitability expectations.

Features

  • Battle massive swarms of autonomous drones.

  • Build increasingly destructive weapon loadouts through ship upgrades.

  • Face varied enemy types with unique roles and behaviors.

  • Mine valuable resources to fund your growing arsenal.

  • Balance risk and reward as every expedition grows more intense.

  • Enjoy a tongue-in-cheek corporate sci-fi world where profits always come first.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your reading, alive on your screen.

Readerpet is a reading-habit tamagotchi. Finish books, log them, and a Siamese cat named Grimalkin turns them into a garden — one plant per book, with your title and author on a little plaque. Keep your streak and creatures move in. Break it and… well. He forgives. Mostly.

  • 🌱 A garden only you could grow — every plant is a book you actually read. Your shelf, but alive.

  • 🐈 Grimalkin — proprietor, critic, cheese enthusiast. He has opinions about your reading pace and no qualms sharing them.

  • 🦋 Friends arrive — keep reading and creatures come to stay: Toast, Margot the moth (she flies, obviously), Bramble, Ash, and Seedling.

  • 🪟 The Window Box — dock your garden as a little strip at the bottom of your desktop, Grim strolling the path while you work. Pin it, resize it, or let it sink politely behind your windows.

  • 🛒 Grim's shop — décor for your garden and cottage, sold by a cat of questionable business ethics. Books are free. Books are always free.

  • 📱 One garden, everywhere — phone, browser, Steam: the same grove, synced.

  • 🌍 ALL the languages — the whole portal speaks 29, from Français to 日本語 to Українська. Grimalkin reads wherever you do.

Free to play. No ads, no energy bars, no dark patterns — the only thing Readerpet ever asks you to do is read.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're the captain of a klorb fishing ship on the vast Klorbing Sea, over a million square miles of the world's most violent and unpredictable waters. Every klorb season is a chance at big money in this modern-day gold rush: you and your crew race the other klorbing captains to catch as much as you can of the shared quota before it runs out.

A Living Ecosystem

Klorbin' is easy, just drop a catch pot and wait for the klorb climb in. A complete ecosystem lurks beneath the waters, and you're not the only predator hunting the klorb. Use the state of the ecosystem, the bait you use, and the environmental conditions to influence how fast a pot fills (or if it fills at all).

Manage Your Crew

Crewmembers have their own personalities, health, skills and quirks. A functional crew is required to perform every task on the ship, and the best klorbing captains manage the crew just as skillfully as they navigate their vessel.

Upgrade Your Vessel

Strange storms wreck equipment and crew alike, and you'll need to carefully maintain and upgrade your vessel just to stay afloat. Even the biggest and best-prepared ships have disappeared under mysterious circumstances. Many point fingers at captains who aren't afraid to play dirty...but others say there's something less-natural at work in these waters.

Unusual Hardware Welcome

 Want to take the helm for real? Dual-screen and secondary-touchscreen support is built in, and fully open-source, 3D-printable simulation controllers (wheel, throttle lever, and control panel) are free to build on our website.

Crewmembers have their own personalities, health, skills and quirks. A functional crew is required to perform every task on the ship, and the best klorbing captains manage the crew just as skillfully as they navigate their vessel.

Upgrade Your Vessel

Strange storms wreck equipment and crew alike, and you'll need to carefully maintain and upgrade your vessel just to stay afloat. Even the biggest and best-prepared ships have disappeared under mysterious circumstances. Many point fingers at captains who aren't afraid to play dirty...but others say there's something less-natural at work in these waters.

Unusual Hardware Welcome

 Want to take the helm for real? Dual-screen and secondary-touchscreen support is built in, and fully open-source, 3D-printable simulation controllers (wheel, throttle lever, and control panel) are free to build on our website.

store_data.about_the_game:
山河营造 is an ancient 3D top-down colony building and survival simulation. Lead a small group of settlers into mountains, water sources, wetlands, ore veins and nearby communities. From the first shelter, plan storage, farms, workshops, roads, rooms and defenses, then turn a temporary camp into a settlement that can survive winter and form its own order.

Settlers are not anonymous workers. They have skills, traits, needs, health, old wounds and social ties. Hunger, fatigue, cold, injury, disease, room quality and relationships affect their mood and efficiency. A shortage of materials, a blocked path, an illness or an outside demand can become a new story.

Construction is a process: blueprints need materials, hauling, work-site caches, staged building and room analysis. Production grows through resource chains including food, fuel, wood, stone, clay, pottery, water, herbs and basic crafts. Players need to understand why work stalls, then adjust storage, roads, work priorities and production plans.

Key features:

- Ancient mountain-and-river themed 3D colony management.

- Deterministic simulation: the same seed and input sequence reproduce the same result.

- Character-driven work scheduling, needs, mood, health and relationship systems.

- Survival expansion from shelter, food and fuel into farms, workshops, pottery, stored water, medicine and defenses.

- Seasonal pressure, resources, disease, corpse decay, trade, commissions and outside threats.

- Readable inspection panels, activity logs and 3D presentation that help players understand failure instead of facing a black box.

store_data.about_the_game:
FleetForge is a space strategy game about designing modular warships, commanding them in real-time fleet battles, and living with the damage on a contested campaign map. Play solo or online co-op as you build fleets, unlock new systems, and fight to hold the front.

Every hull becomes a bet on what will survive first contact.




A warship is a layout of tradeoffs. More guns mean more power, crew, ammo, and exposed space to protect. Every reactor, shield, corridor, magazine, hangar, and Marine bay changes how the ship fights - and how it dies. Then refit between battles as you learn what survives.




When fleets meet, you command multiple ships in real time. Focus fire, protect damaged hulls, screen against missiles and drones, and decide which ships hold formation when the line starts to break.




Crew are part of the machine. They operate systems, carry supplies, repair damage, and keep ships fighting after the first exchange. Marines add a different kind of threat: launch boarding pods, send them into enemy hulls, and turn a fleet battle into a fight inside the ship.




Carriers change the shape of a battle before the main guns ever fire. Strikecraft harass exposed targets, bombers punish vulnerable modules, and point defense decides whether a swarm breaks through or burns out before it reaches the hull.




Move fleets between connected systems, contest territory, manage income, and respond as pressure builds across the front. Research unlocks new modules and infrastructure over the campaign, giving you more ways to rebuild, refit, and hit back.

In co-op, share the campaign, assign captains, coordinate fleet movement, and launch tactical battles together.

A bad battle changes the war, but it does not have to end it. Repair what survived, replace what was destroyed, rework designs that failed under fire, and send a better force into the next fight.

Features


  • Design modular warships with weapons, shields, reactors, engines, crew spaces, hangars, magazines, and support systems.
  • Command real-time fleet battles across multiple ships, carriers, drones, Marines, and boarding craft.
  • Fight across a connected campaign map where territory, income, research, losses, and repairs shape what you can bring to the next battle.
  • Play solo or online co-op with shared campaign decisions and tactical fleet command.

store_data.about_the_game:
River Devil is a single-player Texas Hold’em roguelike built around bluffing, chip management, boss table rules, and the Fate Wheel system.

You enter a cursed casino where every table is controlled by strange opponents and demonic bosses. Winning is not only about making the strongest hand. You must read your enemies, manage your chips, choose when to fold, when to raise, and when to push all-in.

Between dangerous poker battles, the Fate Wheel may change your path, your pressure, your rewards, or even the rules of the table. Every spin can bring opportunity, risk, punishment, or a sudden reversal.

Game Features

- Single-player Texas Hold’em-inspired roguelike gameplay

- Bluff, raise, fold, call, or go all-in to survive each table

- Face opponents with different betting styles and personalities

- Challenge boss tables with special rules and dangerous twists

- Spin the Fate Wheel to trigger unpredictable events and run-changing outcomes

- Manage your chips as both your resource and your lifeline

- Win through strong hands, smart folds, calculated risks, or pure psychological pressure

- No shop system, no rest system — every run is driven by poker decisions and the Fate Wheel

Poker Strategy, Not Real-Money Gambling

River Devil uses fictional chips as an in-game resource. The game does not include real-money gambling, cash wagering, withdrawals, or gambling-related in-game purchases.

Can you beat the river, or will the river beat you?

store_data.about_the_game:
A dead god drifts in the dark. Strip it to the bone.

Something colossal died out here a long time ago. You didn't kill it you're here to take it apart. Point a fleet of mining drones, turrets and collectors at the carcass and watch it come apart cell by cell: a procedurally-drawn pixel-art titan dissolving into a storm of flying salvage while the counters climb.

Every upgrade is something you SEE

This is a visual automation-incremental in the spirit of The Gnorp Apologue. You don't buy an abstract "+10% damage"  you bolt another turret onto the rig, watch a new drone peel off the hull, and see the carcass start disappearing faster.

Build a whole arsenal of crews, each stripping the carcass a different way: auto-lasers, demolition rockets, reeling harpoons, orbiting Tesla coils that arc lightning between each other, flamethrowers, charging railguns and more.

Make the weapons feed each other

The fun isn't in one weapon it's in the reactions. Freeze cells with Cryo so they stop drifting away and the rest of your fleet keeps landing clean hits. Drop Burn onto that frost for a chain explosion. Paint Acid patches that don't hurt on their own but amplify every other weapon firing inside them.

Sometimes the dead ones aren't dead

When a corpse runs dry, you go hunting for the next and the next specimen is alive. Drop the automation, take the stick, and duel it yourself in a real-time bullet-dance: dash through its attacks, tear off enough of it to crack the core open, and drag the fresh, bigger carcass home to strip. No two of them move the same.

Evolve, and go again on something bigger

Every expedition banks Genome you spend on a mutation loadout that reshapes the next run. Grow your mother ship into a bigger hull, refit your fighter to match, and send out remote outposts side-ships you can pilot yourself in their own hands-on minigames for extra materials.

Strip it to the bone.

store_data.about_the_game:
You just quit your job to build apps from your bedroom.

Mum is charging you $5 a day. ByteWorks already has 4 apps live. The App Store Review Board is watching. The clock is ticking.

App Developer Tycoon is a turn-based narrative tycoon game about the indie developer grind — from bedroom coder to Silicon Valley HQ.

HOW IT WORKS


Each day you get Action Points to spend. Learn a new skill. Attend a calendar event. Keep your app pipeline flowing. Every decision has real consequences.

  • LEARN — A different skill is available to study each day. Miss it and it's gone until tomorrow.

  • ATTEND EVENTS — Hackathons, investor pitches, design workshops, networking coffees. Some cost money. Some earn money. All of them matter.

  • BUILD APPS — Choose a genre, write a compelling description, give it a name worth remembering. Then wait for the results.

THE APP STORE IS UNFORGIVING


Your apps are reviewed by real (simulated) users. A bad name tanks your score before a single person downloads it. A great description can save a mediocre app. Launch something brilliant and you might read:

"I don't usually leave reviews. I'm leaving one now."

Launch something terrible and:

"My nephew built a better version for a school project."

BUILD YOUR EMPIRE


Progress from Bedroom -> Garage -> Co-working Space -> Studio -> Silicon Valley HQ -> and beyond. Each workspace unlocks new genres, project slots, and possibilities — but comes with rising daily rent. The pressure never stops.

A WORLD THAT REACTS TO YOU


ByteWorks is watching. If your app goes to #1, they'll notice. If they clone your genre, they'll email you about it. The rivals are aggressive. The story events have teeth.

  • Story events with real consequences: take a week off and time actually advances 7 days.

  • A living app economy — trends shift, apps decay, nothing earns forever.

  • 46 Easter eggs hidden in app names (try naming your app "App Developer Tycoon").

  • Tutorial emails from Mum, Dad, your insufferable cousin Kevin, and the App Store Review Board.

FEATURES


  • Turn-based daily loop — never feels rushed

  • 12 app genres to unlock (Utility, Puzzle, Social, Fitness, Finance, Casual Game, Dating, Photo Editor, Education, AI Tool, VR App, Space Tech)

  • Skill tree up to Level 25 per skill

  • Rival studios that ship, compete, and taunt you

  • Revenue charts, finance logs, Hall of Fame

  • Auto-saves your progress

  • No ads. No microtransactions. Just the grind.

How far can you go?

store_data.about_the_game:
One More Leaf — Searching for Four-Leaf Clovers

A quiet meadow stretches before you, filled with 250,000 three-leaf clovers.

Somewhere among them are 100 four-leaf clovers, along with 21 mysterious clovers that exist only once each.

『One More Leaf』 is a calm exploration game where you slowly gaze across a sea of similar leaves, searching for tiny oddities and little strokes of luck.

What you do is simple.

Move around, zoom in, and find the clovers that catch your eye.

There are no timers, no game overs, and no penalties for mistakes.

Take your time, stay curious, and explore the meadow at your own pace.

■ Find tiny oddities among 250,000 clovers

The three-leaf clovers covering the meadow all look very similar.

But if you look closely, one leaf might seem just a little different.

A shape, a direction, a color, or simply a spot that catches your attention.

Follow those small feelings of curiosity as you search the vast meadow for special clovers.

When you find one, a quiet little celebration appears in the meadow.

This is not about grand achievements, but about the small joy of noticing something special.

■ 100 four-leaf clovers and 21 mysterious clovers

Hidden in the meadow are 100 four-leaf clovers.

There are also 21 mysterious clovers, each one found only once in the entire field.

What they look like is something to discover for yourself.

You may stumble upon an unexpected clover in a place you were only casually looking at.

■ Record your discoveries in the clover catalog

Every clover you find is recorded in your catalog.

Each special clover comes with a small story that is a little strange, a little charming, and just a bit funny.

Collecting them is not the only pleasure. With every discovery, your catalog slowly becomes livelier.

■ Explore at your own pace

You do not need to search the entire meadow all at once.

Check your position on the minimap, leave your own notes on places that interest you, and continue exploring little by little.

You can stop and resume the game whenever you like.

Search for just a short while, or settle in and explore for longer.

■ Recommended for players who enjoy

• Quiet and relaxing games

• Hidden-object games and spot-the-difference puzzles

• Games that can be played slowly at your own pace

• Careful exploration and completing collections

• The small happiness of finding something unexpected

Listen to gentle music and ambient sounds as you slowly gaze across a sea of leaves.

Find a single piece of luck hidden among a field of nearly identical scenery.

This is a game for those who want to spend a calm and peaceful moment searching for something small and special.

store_data.about_the_game:
Odd Stories: Backyard Mountain is an exploration adventure game in which what seems to be an ordinary favor for your uncle turns into the discovery of a mystery hidden deep underground.

Your uncle has gone on a business trip, leaving you the keys to his newly built house. However, there is one problem—a huge mountain of dirt and rocks behind the house that he hasn't had time to remove yet. What initially seems like nothing more than an ordinary pile of rubble soon turns out to hide something far more mysterious. How deep will you dare to dig?

Put on your exoskeleton and begin the excavation. Mine minerals, sell them, invest the money you earn in upgrades, and gradually increase your machine's capabilities. Dig faster, move more efficiently, and reach deeper and deeper, uncovering the secrets hidden beneath the surface.

Each new layer of the mountain brings new resources and even more questions. What is really beneath your uncle's house? Why is this mountain here in the first place? The answers await those who are not afraid to dig deep enough.

Key Features

  • Dig through a huge mountain and discover its underground layers.

  • Mine a variety of minerals and sell them to earn money.

  • Purchase upgrades that increase your digging speed and your exoskeleton's movement speed.

  • Discover mysterious objects and secrets hidden deep underground.

  • Upgrade your equipment to reach places that were previously inaccessible.

The deeper you dig, the more you realize that this mountain is not just an ordinary pile of dirt.

store_data.about_the_game:
Note: Sand Cruiser is in active development. All screenshots, videos and artwork show an early work-in-progress state and may change significantly before release.

A dying sun has scorched the world. The once-familiar star swelled into a red giant whose glare left the surface uninhabitable, and what remained of humanity fled into the cool deep. There, in the rock, they woke an ancient predator that stirs to the signs of life: the swarm.

Now humanity is caught between the sun above the world and the swarm beneath it. Its only way out is motion. It lives aboard colossal landcruisers that chase the planet's wandering cool zones and can never stay still for long.

Build your cruiser

Construct a rolling fortress from whatever the world gives up. Draw walls and floors however you see fit, place modules, lay out decks and roofs. Every build is a trade-off: roofs give vital shade and shield your crew from the killing sun, but every machine that keeps you alive, from the generator to the galley, throws off the heat and vibration that give you away to the swarm at night.

Command a living crew

By day you are the colony manager. Your crew are real individuals with skills, quirks and moods. Assign priorities and shifts, keep them fed and sane as they cook, repair, drill and harvest. A well-run post works; a hungry, exhausted one breaks down.

Survive the night

When the desert cools, the swarm rises. It is blind and hunts by signature alone: by day it follows your vibration unseen beneath the sand, by night it breaks through wherever your warm cruiser burns like a beacon in the dark. Post the watch, load the guns, aim the searchlights. Light here is not a comfort but firepower: what stands in the dark, you will rarely hit. Or run silent, cold and dark, and the night lets you be.

Read the land

The world is finite and gives up nothing freely. Sound out what lies beneath the sand with seismic charges, triangulate your finds and drill them out. Gather scrap from the surface, plunder weathered ruins and the wrecks of other cruisers. Deposits run dry and never return, so scarcity drives you ever onward.

Cruiser against cruiser against swarm

You share the desert with rival caravans. Most of the time you keep your distance, but in the most desperate hours two cruisers meet, and what follows is the most terrible battle this world knows. The combined heat and tremor of two cruisers at war is so vast that the swarm erupts from the ground even in daylight and falls on both at once. In the end there is no clean victor, only whoever is left.

A world that does not want you

The desert day burns, the night freezes, and the narrow band of survivable ground between them drifts across the planet with the seasons. You chase it forever, always a step from dying of thirst, of hunger, of heat. There is no destination, only the next day, bought.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Sunset Diffusion》is an isometric, lightweight narrative-driven exploration CRPG.

[Background]

Years ago, the scientific community announced a dire prophecy: the sun is going out. Now, the prophecy is on the verge of coming true. And you, a college student, for whom "graduation means death" is no longer just a joke—how will you choose to spend your few remaining days? Just lie flat and wait for death? Search for a way to survive? Or uncover the truth and "resolve" the crisis?

[Features]

store_data.about_the_game:
Turn your folder into a library where you can organize your files and texts

Project File Library is an desktop file-library experience where folders and files become books. Choose a project folder from your computer, and the app transforms its contents into a small 3D scene that you can organize, revisit, and reshape.

Build Your Library

  • Choose a local folder and generate books from its files and folders.

  • Move books between the floor, ordinary shelves, and a special hidden shelf.

  • Add as many shelves as you need as your project grows.

  • Save different arrangements for different folders.

  • Restore your previous layouts from local library data.

Browse and Edit

  • Explore your folder through a file tree.

  • Double-click text files to open and edit them.

  • Split long text files into custom subgroups.

  • Combine subgroups into larger groups for easier navigation.

  • Save edited text, grouping data, layout data, and editor style settings locally.

A Local Workspace

Project File Library works with files on your own computer. Arrangement data, text grouping information, and style settings are stored inside a local .lib folder in the selected project root. The app is designed around local organization rather than online accounts or cloud storage.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gravity is your arena. Orbital Hell locks you inside a hollow planet where the horizon curves up over your head and the horde comes from every direction. There are no corners to hide in: just you, your rotary cannon and hundreds of enemies orbiting with you.

ORBITAL ARSENAL

Your gatling fires on its own: you decide where to look and when to spend what matters. Charge the Extra Shot to sweep whole lanes of enemies, trigger the Orbital Shield to blast off the ground wiping out everything around you, and chain Boosts to surf the arena at full speed.

ENEMIES ARE PLATFORMS

Jump off the swarms to refresh your double jump and stay airborne: the floor is optional. Every bounce charges your shield, every kill feeds the combo and every combo rockets your score.

TWO MODES, ONE RANKING

  • Normal: survive escalating waves, bosses included, and chase the power surges that slow down time.
  • Boss Rush: a gauntlet of bosses with timed interlude rounds.

REPLAYS ON THE GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS

Every record uploads with its replay to the Steam leaderboards: watch any top player's best run from inside the game, and leave yours for others to beat.

PURE ARCADE

Neon low-poly style, dynamic music that grows with the horde, "one more run" sessions. Full controller and Steam Deck support.

store_data.about_the_game:
Diamonds and Spades

is a roguelite card game where you combine powerful tarot cards, constantly evolve your deck, and discover ever-new strategies. Over 100 tarot cards allow for countless combinations, and the built-in editor lets you design your very own cards.

Challenge your luck!

Start with a deck of 100 playing cards and draw card by card to score points. But every card drawn comes with a risk: if you draw a duplicate card, your round ends.

After each successfully completed level, you gain access to the shop. Upgrade your deck with jokers, new cards, and extraordinary tarot cards. The further you get, the higher the requirements become and the more creatively you must use your combinations. But be careful: boss levels can appear along your way, putting your strategy to the test.

Create powerful synergies!

Tarot cards grant you unique abilities and change the rules of the game. Combine different effects and discover synergies that can alter the course of an entire run.

By completing achievements, you unlock new tarot cards and open up even more possibilities for future runs.

Create your own tarot cards!

With the built-in editor, you can create your own tarot cards. Piece their logic together yourself, draw your own artwork, and play with your creations.

Share your cards with other players and try out the community's ideas.

  • Over 100 tarot cards with unique effects

  • Over 80 achievements to unlock new tarot cards

  • 3 different difficulty levels

  • Detailed statistics for your run and each individual tarot card

  • 9 unique boss levels

  • Built-in tarot card editor for creating and sharing your own cards

store_data.about_the_game:
How far would you go in a mania?

You install home theaters in hillside mansions and watch other people's money grow on the wall. Then, on a Bird Streets rooftop with $200 of grocery money, you buy your first coin — and by the time the fifth television is hung, you're up $212.44 and something in you has already changed.

All Time High is a premium, text-based thriller about the hunger to get rich. It's a story you read on the surfaces where the mania actually happens: a group chat, a news feed, a trading terminal, a bank notification at 2 a.m. There is no combat and no map — just choices, consequences, and a number that keeps climbing until it doesn't.

The slide is the game

A boutique fund notices you. A memecoin called $FROTH turns a joke into a fortune. A private token, $VELA, offers you the inside of a room you were only ever hired to wire. Every "just one more trade" is a door, and some of them only open one way.

You'll feel the thrill of the climb and the exact weight of what it costs — a partner who clocks the first lie by the receipt, an oldest friend who trusts you with seven years of savings "down to the cents," a reporter who asks questions she already knows the answers to.

What's inside

  • A story told through the interface — messages, feeds, email, and a live market terminal. The UI is the game.
  • Choices with a ledger — four hidden variables (cash, greed, integrity, heat) quietly track who you're becoming. The story remembers.
  • A market you actually trade — scripted market moments where a buy or sell moves your net worth and bends the story.
  • Six distinct endings — clean exit, exile, a federal knock, the fall guy, the whistleblower, rock bottom. Every ending names what it cost.
  • Adaptive music that shifts with the market and the tension, layer by layer.
  • A finishable one-shot — a 2.5–3.5 hour novella you can actually complete, built to be replayed for the endings you didn't take.

For players who like

Story-rich, choices-matter interactive fiction — where the interface is the game and the ending is yours to earn. If you read the news like a thriller and can't look away from a chart, this one's for you.

All Time High is a work of fiction. All companies, coins, characters, and events are invented; any resemblance to real people, assets, or firms is coincidental. Every part — story, design, music, and code — is human-authored under editorial control, created with AI assistance.

store_data.about_the_game:
Roll the dice. Build the table. See how high one bankroll can climb.


Incrementable Craps takes the familiar rhythm of a craps table and turns it into an incremental strategy run. Start with a single $1 Ante, read the odds, and decide how aggressively to push your bankroll. Every roll can fund the next investment—or end the run.


THE TABLE GROWS WITH YOU


Win rolls and spend bankroll on randomized Investments that unlock new betting spaces or improve the ones you already have. Add Field, Place, and Doubles bets; raise payouts; lower risk; increase maximum stakes; earn more rerolls; and automate rolls. Your choices reshape the table and the risk profile of each run.


PLAN EVERY ROLL


  • Place an Ante before the come-out roll.
  • Establish a Point to open side bets.
  • Use the outcome rail to see which totals mean profit, loss, or a push before you roll.
  • Size bets quickly with Min, Half, and Max controls.
  • Keep bets on the table until you choose to change them.
  • Spend limited rerolls to rescue a bad result and keep the run alive.

CHASE A BIGGER NUMBER


Milestones and event goals reward strong runs with new options and additional reroll capacity. Track the current run, past bests, and bankroll history, then compare your best bankroll against friends and the global Steam leaderboard.

FAIL, LEARN, ROLL AGAIN


When the bankroll hits zero, review the run's peak, rolls, investments, and milestone progress. Start fresh and try a different route through the table.


KEY FEATURES


  • A fast single-player dice strategy game built around fair 2d6 rolls.
  • An incremental table that expands through randomized Investments.
  • Ante, Field, Place, and Doubles bets with visible payout and risk information.
  • A 2–12 outcome preview that shows profit, loss, or a push before every roll.
  • Limited rerolls, automation, milestones, event goals, and run history.
  • Friend and global Steam leaderboards for best bankroll.
  • No real-money wagering or in-app purchases.

store_data.about_the_game:
Underroot is a cozy fantasy mining adventure where you wake up in a strange mushroom village with no memory of how you got there. Upon your arrival, you're handed a pickaxe and told to report to the mines first thing in the morning.

Most of your time is spent exploring the mines, gathering valuable ores, finding hidden treasures, completing quests, and slowly upgrading your gear. The village is warm and cozy, but the deeper you go underground, the more you start to wonder what really happened... and why you're here in the first place.

While mining is at the heart of Underroot, I also want the world to feel like it's yours to explore. You'll be able to place lights, personalize parts of the mines, keep track of discoveries in your journal, and return to the village between adventures to prepare for your next journey.

As development continues, there will be more of a village. I want the mornings to be peaceful, and quiet, before you head into the mines. There will also be more NPC's, quests, realms, equipment and story.

Features

  • Explore handcrafted underground realms filled with secrets.

  • Mine ores, gather resources, and search for hidden treasures.

  • Upgrade your pickaxe, oxygen tank, inventory, and more.

  • Complete quests and record discoveries in your journal.

  • Customize parts of the mines to make them feel like your own.

  • Return to a cozy village between expeditions to rest, prepare, and get to know its people.

  • Discover a story that slowly unfolds the deeper you go underground.

Underroot is being developed by a solo developer, and I'm excited to continue sharing its progress as it grows.

store_data.about_the_game:
SHENANIGANS PARTY

A fast, chaotic free-for-all party brawler for up to 24 players. No guns. No health bars. Just you, your friends, and one question every round: who gets launched off the map first?

SHOVE YOUR WAY TO VICTORY

Run, jump, sprint and dash across the arena. Charge up a hit and send your rivals flying in a ragdoll arc. The physics do the comedy for you, so no two knockouts ever look the same.

A DOZEN FRANTIC MINIGAMES

Sumo shove-offs, king of the hill, crown snatching, breaking ice floors, rising lava climbs, coin rushes, spinning sweeper beams and more. Every round lasts just 60 to 180 seconds, so the mayhem never slows down.

THE PARTY BOARD

Between minigames you head back to the board, roll the dice and fight for the lead. Collect coins, grab tickets and swing the match right up to the final round.

MAKE A FOOL OF YOURSELF

Build your character with outfits, hair, hats and colors. Earn coins in every match and unlock the look that makes falling off a cliff look good.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Practice solo against bots, or take the chaos online against friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
In SUPER MUSH BROS, play as a tiny protist trying to defend its world and friends from an imposing deathly infection, which saps the life and color from the land it conquers. Venture to the corners of the map to defeat the four DEATH BOSSES and destroy the infection once and for all.

The game contains:

12 unique bosses

18 individual levels

5 playable characters

15 songs

8 helpful items

more than 2 endings based off of in-game choices

more than 20 instances of dialogue

and loads more stuff

Maneuver your way to victory as Musho by using the arrowkeys! Although the movement is easy to pick up(just four inputs), there is tons of hidden complexity to master throughout your run. Learn to blip-jump, or to slow-fall using the ground-pound.

The game has a balanced and self-driven difficulty level, similar to the design of Super Mario levels. The game is a fit for players of all skill levels, since there are infinite solutions to every jump, enemy, and obstacle with enough ingenuity.

store_data.about_the_game:
A working microphone is required to play.

Headphones are strongly recommended — they stop the game's audio from leaking back into your mic and interfering with detection.

You may need to turn off Windows noise suppression / audio enhancements. These filters often mistake sustained vocal sounds for background noise and cut them off. The game's first-time setup will walk you through disabling them.

Moan for Me is an adult comedy game where your voice is the only controller. Vocalize into your microphone to match the scrolling wave patterns on screen — hit the right volume and pitch at the right moment, and the character on screen will be satisfied.
The real joke isn't on screen. It's you, alone in your room, making these sounds at your monitor and hoping nobody walks in.
Match the wave. Follow volume, pitch, and vibrato in real time. Sustain, climb, and hold your notes to fill the meter and earn ratings from Miss all the way up to Perfect.
Six characters, six challenges. Each one wants something different. Learn what each of them wants — and deliver it.
Easy to laugh at, hard to master. Under the comedy is a real performance game about breath control, pitch accuracy, and timing. Getting a Perfect actually takes skill.
A short experience. Moan for Me is a short game meant to be picked up, laughed at, and replayed as you chase higher ratings on each character.

Grab your mic. Close the door. Try to keep a straight face.
