store_data.about_the_game:
Something has broken loose inside the machine. Malware floods the datastreams, rogue processes swarm every sector, and the kernel is one bad upload from collapse. You are a Survivor - a combat program compiled to fight back.

Drop into Digital Survivor, an auto-firing survival roguelite where your weapons handle the shooting and your job is to move, dodge, route the swarm, and trigger the right hero tools at the right moment. Play it clean and one fragile run snowballs into a screen-clearing storm of damage.

SURVIVE THE BREACH, SECOND BY SECOND

The system never lets up. Endless waves close in from every edge of the arena while your arsenal fires automatically, carving lanes through the swarm. Survival comes down to reading the field, threading gaps, and staying ahead of the flood.

Normal runs are timed breaches across seven difficulty tiers: Warmup, Standard, Hard Breach, Overload, Nightmare, Singularity, and Blackout. Clear the timer to win, or take the Core Overclock gamble: survive two brutal extra minutes for a doubled payout and Void Key fragments, or fall and keep only half.

Between the fodder come the real threats. Alpha packs hunt in groups of five with rolled protocols like Voltaic Tether, Detonate, Phase Drive, Bulwark, Siphon Loop, Rage Cascade, and Arc Flak. At the top of the breach wait four boss processes: the Root Daemon, Siege Daemon, Warp Daemon, and Prism Daemon.

BUILD A LOADOUT THAT BREAKS THE SYSTEM

Every level-up is a fast decision. Take a weapon, passive, support upgrade, or ultimate. Reroll for a better option. Skip to bank upgrade tokens. Spend those tokens on guaranteed upgrades when randomness stops being your friend.

Max weapons into ultimates, then push further with weapon synergies. Pull enemies into a Null Well and grind them apart with Packet Saw. Freeze packs before burning them down with Firewall. Trip Glitch Mines with Chain Ping. The right combination turns pressure into a weapon.

Under the run is real gear. Six equipment slots, five rarities, armor sets, trinkets, socketed upgrade chips, per-piece enchantments, vault loot, and gearscore give you persistent build-craft between runs.

RAID THE DATA VAULT, THEN GET OUT

Extraction is the endgame raid mode. Spend a matching Void Key fragment, enter the Data Vault, and push through five guarded elite sites. Each site protects a Vault Crate. Purge the guards, crack the crate, and it joins your carried haul.

Then you still have to leave.

When the uplink opens, reach the extraction zone to bank every crate you carried. Die, quit, or fail before extraction and the carried haul is gone. No random post-raid loss, no void roll after a clean extract - if you make it out alive, everything you cracked comes home.

CHOOSE YOUR SURVIVOR

Start with a growing roster of Survivors, each built around a different way to break the system apart. More heroes are planned for future updates, expanding the roster with new weapons, mechanics, and playstyles.

Nova Runner is the speed starter: fast, aggressive, and built around constant movement. He has the best tempo and pickup reach, but takes extra damage and loses defenses if he stands still too long.

Kernel Knight is the tank guardian. His signature Buffer Overflow shield absorbs enemy fire, charges through pressure, then discharges into a dash-blast that launches crowds airborne. He is slower, tougher, and built around timing the moment you turn defense into impact.

Hex Witch is the active caster. Choose two SUPPORT protocols before a run, curse enemies with HEX, and chain cooldown refunds through cursed kills. She is fragile, but in the right hands she rewrites the swarm instead of simply surviving it.

RUN IT BACK FOREVER

Climb the Normal difficulty ladder one tier at a time. Push Core Overclock for bigger payouts and raid keys. Enter INFINITE mode when you want no win condition at all - just endless escalation and an exponential overtime wall that eventually breaks every build.

Every run feeds persistent progression: perma-upgrades, character upgrade points, gear, achievements, and seasonal online leaderboards. Compete on Score, Extraction Speed, Gearscore, and the Hall of Fame, with a fresh Leaderboard Character each season.

FEATURES

  • Auto-firing, skill-based survival combat - your arsenal shoots, your movement decides the run
  • Growing hero roster - master Nova Runner, Kernel Knight, and Hex Witch, with more Survivors to come
  • Fast level-up decisions - weapons, passives, support upgrades, rerolls, skip tokens, guaranteed upgrades, and ultimates
  • Weapon synergies that transform how builds play when the right tools meet
  • Alpha packs of five enemies with rolled protocols and dangerous counterplay
  • Four boss processes - Root Daemon, Siege Daemon, Warp Daemon, and Prism Daemon
  • Deep persistent gear - 6 slots, 5 rarities, armor sets, trinkets, enchantments, socketed chips, vault loot, and gearscore
  • High-stakes Extraction raids - crack up to 5 Vault Crates and extract alive or lose the carried haul
  • Seven-tier Normal ladder plus the Core Overclock gamble
  • INFINITE mode with endless scaling and an exponential overtime wall
  • 54 achievements plus perma-upgrades, character progression, and seasonal leaderboards

YOUR INTERVIEW NEVER ENDED

You showed up for a job application. You never left the building.

Unemployed Nightmare Together is a 1–4 player online co-op survival horror set inside a procedurally generated corporate nightmare. Somewhere in the flickering hallways, a relentless job application stalks the floors and the only way out is to finish your "onboarding" and reach the elevator before it drains the soul out of every last applicant. Work together. Watch each other's backs. Punch the clock, or get punched out.

FEATURES

A Predator That Learns You

An alive job application hunts the office with real perception, line-of-sight vision, sound-based hearing, and rising suspicion. It patrols, investigates noises, chases and corners you to drain your soul. The harder the difficulty, the sharper its senses. Stay quiet. Stay moving. Stay together.

True Co-op Survival

Nobody escapes alone. When a teammate is drained, they don't just die, they become a persistent corpse waiting for rescue. Grab a Resignation Letter, reach their body, and bring them back into entity will hunt you relentlessly through walls. Only a teammate can peel it off your back.

Proximity Voice Chat

Built-in 3D positional voice. You hear who's near you, not who's on your screen, whisper plans around a corner, or scream as footsteps close in behind you. Crystal-clear audio with noise gate and auto-gain, right out of the box.

A Different Office Every Time

Every match generates a brand-new floor plan from modular rooms, corridors, and locked zones. Layered keycard security, sabotaged power grids, and decorated offices mean no two escapes ever feel the same.

Sabotage the Lights, Restore the Power

An escalating power-and-lights system plunges whole sections of the building into darkness. Find the electrical room, flip the breakers, and keep the lights on, because the entity loves the dark, and a Director AI is watching, ready to strike the moment your team relaxes.

Beat the Clock

Fill the Freedom Bar by shredding paperwork and completing objectives. The office clock ticks from 08:00 toward 17:00. Reach quitting time, make it to the elevator, and get out alive. Miss the elevator, and you're stranded with it.

Make It Yours

Customize your character, unlock cosmetics through progression, and express yourself with a radial emote wheel. Feed the office cat in the lobby while you wait for your team to ready up.

CAN YOU MAKE IT TO 5 O'CLOCK?

Restore the power. Finish the paperwork. Revive your team. Reach the elevator before the office claims you for good.

Grab your friends. Clock in. And whatever you do: Don't apply!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Let's Farm Together

Welcome to Let's Farm Together, a relaxing and cozy farming adventure where you can build the countryside life you've always dreamed of, alone or with up to 4 players.

Take care of your farm, raise lovable animals, grow seasonal crops, catch fish, and customize both your farmer and your faithful dog as you create the perfect rural escape.

Raise Happy Farm Animals

Care for a variety of adorable animals, each with their own valuable products.

  • Feed and look after your livestock.
  • Milk cows and goats.
  • Shear sheep for wool.
  • Collect fresh eggs from chickens.
  • Sell animal products to grow your farm.

A happy farm is a productive farm!

Grow Seasonal Crops

Plant, nurture, and harvest a wide variety of crops throughout the year.

  • Prepare the soil with your hoe.
  • Water your crops every day.
  • Use fertilizer to help them grow faster.
  • Experience changing seasons, where different fruits and vegetables can only be grown at the right time of year.
  • Buy a greenhouse to grow crops all year long, regardless of the season.

Plan your harvests wisely and make every season count.

Go Fishing

Take a break from farming and relax by the water.

Catch different fish, sell your best catches, and earn extra income to expand your farm.

Build Your Farming Business

Harvest crops, collect animal products, catch fish, and sell everything you've produced to earn money.

Invest your profits to improve your farm and create the cozy countryside you've always wanted.

Customize Your Adventure

Make your farm truly yours.

  • Customize your farmer.
  • Dress up and personalize your loyal dog companion.

Play Together

Everything is better with friends!

Work together in online co-op for 1–4 players to plant crops, care for animals, fish, sell products, and build the ultimate cozy farm together.

Whether you prefer relaxing on your own or farming with friends, Let's Farm Together is all about slowing down, enjoying nature, and creating unforgettable memories on your very own farm.

store_data.about_the_game:
Vizza is an interactive simulation playground built for curiosity, experimentation, and visual beauty.

Explore a growing collection of GPU-accelerated systems that move, react, spread, collide, dissolve, and organize themselves in unexpected ways. Every mode gives you a hands-on way to play with motion, color, and emergent behavior, whether you are making flowing particle fields, organic reaction-diffusion textures, pulsing slime trails, or hypnotic moiré patterns.

This is not about winning or losing. Vizza is about adjusting a system, watching it respond, and finding beauty in the result.

Explore Interactive Simulations

Switch between a variety of visual systems, each with its own behavior and personality:

Slime Mold
Guide an agent-based simulation where tiny creatures follow trails and form branching, organic networks.

Gray-Scott
Experiment with reaction-diffusion patterns that resemble coral, cells, spots, waves, and other natural textures.

Particle Life
Create multi-species particle worlds where attraction and repulsion rules lead to swarms, clusters, or chaotic motion.

Flow
Watch particles drift through shifting flow fields, forming streams, currents, and delicate motion trails.

Pellets
Play with gravity and density-based particle interactions for satisfying, physical-looking movement.

Voronoi
Observe moving Voronoi cells as they shift, compete, and transform into geometric patterns.

Moiré
Generate layered interference patterns with distortion effects for abstract, hypnotic visuals.

Shape the Look

Vizza includes a Gradient Editor for creating custom color schemes that can be used across the simulations. Tune the atmosphere of each system, from soft and meditative to sharp, alien, chaotic, or vibrant.

A Visual Toy for Experimenters

Vizza is made for players who enjoy:

  • Generative art

  • Particle systems

  • Emergent behavior

  • Abstract visuals

  • Relaxing creative tools

  • Science-inspired sandboxes

  • Screensaver-like ambient experiences

Open a simulation, adjust the controls, and see what happens. Small changes can lead to surprising results.

Key Features

  • A collection of interactive GPU-accelerated simulations

  • Multiple visual modes based on particles, flow fields, cellular automata, reaction-diffusion, slime mold, and moiré effects

  • Friendly controls for shaping behavior and appearance

  • Custom color gradient creation

  • Preset and color scheme saving

  • A calm, open-ended experience with no fail state

  • Built for visual exploration, experimentation, and emergent beauty

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Cybersoul 2, where Multiplayer, Deckbuilding, Card Games, Auto Battlers, and a compulsive Dark Web, Souls & Star Power incremental idle system collide in a flash of neon. Jack into the ultimate Cyberpunk Card Battler, launching with 36+ dystopian Factions and over 1,300 cards. Battle 36 Heroes. Defeat your Friends. Go dark, play Solo offline.

Compiled in the static of a dying world, Cybersoul 2 takes the card battlers you know and hard-wires them into a high-tech, low-life future.

New Game Modes:

  • Raid Boss: Solo PvE vs a 99 HP triple-power boss. Bring your deck. Claim the kill.

  • Chaos Brawl: Classic combat with a random rule twist every game. Never the same fight twice.

  • Draft Arena: Draft your Hero Power and 30 cards, then duel solo or via Steam PvP.

  • Gauntlet: Escalating Solo Battle ladder. Push your deck until it breaks.

  • Auto Battle: Buy, build, FIGHT. Auto-combat army battles with unique rules.

  • Joker Poker: Roguelike Poker. Blinds, Jokers, Upgrades, Cybercoin bets.

Command the scrap-metal juggernauts of the Rust Legion, the chemical-fueled speedsters of the Stim Freaks, and the corporate overlords of the Credit Barons.

More Battle Heroes: 

  • Neon Dynasty, Silicon Priesthood, Riot Squad. 

  • Black Market, Helix Vats, Media Moguls. 

  • Chrono Drifters, Circuit Mystics, The Transhacks. 

  • Deep Spacers, Sonic Hedons, The Transcended. 

  • Gaia Overgrowth, Mad Motors, Cortex Collective. 

  • Roller Ballers, Idol Proxies, Vandal Krew. 

  • Xeno Preserve, Moon Marines, Offworld Miners. 

  • Radiation Zone, Black Ops, House of Love.

  • Divine Synchronicities, Deep Sea Horrors, Cosmic Abominations.

  • Cyber Vamps, Digital Zombies, Mecha Beasts.

  • World Wonders, Samsara Cycle, Fable Folklore.

With over 1,300 distinctive cards, each surging with cybernetic augmentations and system-breaking hacks, the tactical possibilities are limitless. But the Grid is unforgiving. Engage in visceral, turn-based combat against a ruthless AI that learns your exploits.

And when you need to disconnect from the warfare, the Glitch Arcade awaits! Gamble your life away and earn Credits & Energy in corrupted simulations of classics like 9-Player Poker, Blackjack, Pool, Match 3, Chess, Space Invaders, Brick Break, Snooker, and more.

Then, set your system to idle farm Dark Web, Soul Coins & Star Power incrementals. Spend your ill-gotten credits to build your digital empire, upgrade your rig, overclock your cards, and farm resources even while you sleep. 🔋

SYSTEM FEATURES

  • 36+ Dystopian Factions: Master the streets—from the brute force of the Moon Marines to the arcane code of the Chrono Drifters and the corrupted Media Moguls. Battle 36 merciless Heroes.

  • 1,300+ Cybersoul Cards: Compile a deck of cybernetic horrors, viruses, traps, and glitches, each rendered in a visceral analog-horror art style.

  • New Roguelite Game Modes: Chaos Brawl, adapt to a random rule twist. Arena, draft the best deck you can from random card offers. Gauntlet, take your random deck as far as you can for max rewards. Raid Boss, defeat a 99 HP triple hero power boss. Joker Poker, Roguelike Poker, bet Cybercoins from the Dark Web. Auto Battle, buy, build, FIGHT. Auto-combat army battles

  • Online Multiplayer: Test your skills, craft the strongest decks. Become the best. Get rewarded. Achieve glory.

  • Play with Friends: Who will be the ultimate 1v1 cyber champion?

  • Neural-Net AI Battles: Test your build against adaptive AI opponents that exploit your weaknesses and show no mercy.

  • Visceral Turn-Based Combat: Fast, brutal, and strategic. Execute combos that shatter the game logic and overload your opponent’s CPU.

  • Deep Deck Optimization: Tailor your loadout with a diverse host of mechs, mutants, and programs. Unlock encrypted data packs to find rare, holographic foils.

  • The Glitch Arcade: Hustle for Credits & Energy in hacked versions of Poker, Pool, Blackjack, Snooker, Chess, and Retro Arcade shooters.

  • Dark Web, Souls & Star Power Idle Games: Grow your influence and harvest resources from the Mainframe through an expansive idle system. Your wealth grows while you sleep.

  • Acid-Graphic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a world of hyper-stylized "Analog-Glitch" art, neon-soaked environments, and geometric brutalism.

  • 27+ Hour Industrial Soundtrack: Lose your mind to over 27 hours of pounding Synthwave, Dark Techno, and Industrial noise designed to keep your heart rate critical.

  • 819 Corrupted Voiceline Data Logs: Absorb cryptic truths and proverb-packed lore files from a world that has forgotten its own history.

  • Daily Login Rewards: Jack in daily to receive a supply drop of Credits, XP, and Energy.

  • Complete Challenges: Earn card packs by winning battles as the current Challenger.

  • New User Protocol: Learn the systems with interactive popup tutorials, making it easy for fresh meat and veteran hackers to upload their consciousness.

  • Offline Mode: Hone your skills solo against the machine. No signal required. Go dark.

💀 UPLOAD YOUR SOUL. BREAK THE SYSTEM. 💀

Cybersoul is a realm where strategy meets static, and humanity meets hardware. Overclock your deck, exploit the code, and engage in neon-soaked battles against the worst the future has to offer. Easier to learn than a firewall, harder to master than the stock market.

The System is broken.
Exploit it. 💾

store_data.about_the_game:
The Night Archive is an episodic first-person horror anthology where each episode places you inside a short, grounded account of fear, survival, and the things people never forget.

The Night Archive: Sable's

Episode 2 puts you into the shoes of 19-year-old Riley Sutter who ended up on the night shift.

Features

  • Atmospheric first-person horror built around real-world fear

store_data.about_the_game:
Twenty years of experience. Zero solved cases. An endless supply of dignity.

The legendary duo returns for the third time—and this time, it seems, they have nowhere left to fall. But they'll find a way.

Detective Johnson is a detective genius, a philosopher of the garbage, and the possessor of the city's keenest nose (mostly for his own socks). His headquarters is a cardboard box. His breakfast is also a cardboard box. His best employee is a trained rat courier named Skinny Joe, whom intern Billy accidentally... roasts.

That's where it all begins.

WHAT IS THIS GAME ABOUT

One day, the city's mayor sends Johnson a letter: civilization is threatened by catastrophe. Counterfeit money is circulating on the streets, with a green microbe with a mustache and suspiciously good haircut instead of the president. You must solve a case of counterfeit "Microbobucks," conducting an investigation through overgrown bacteria bars, radioactive dumps, abandoned sprat factories, and one very touchy bucket.

FEATURES

A non-linear plot with multiple paths.

Every decision you make has consequences. Usually fatal. But with dignity.

Countless ways to die ingloriously.

Be ground into a banknote. Be covered in mushrooms. Freeze in a refrigeration unit while making small talk with sprats about politics. Become the "missing link in evolution" in the city zoo, and countless other ways to remain the worst detectives in history.

Dialogues worth playing for.

An ending that depends on you.

Become an honest hero of the city with a certificate, a handshake, and a mug with the city hall logo. Or leave rich with a suitcase full of cash and a house by the sea. A guilty conscience is worse than socks—but the choice is yours.

WHO WILL BE INVOLVED

Those who enjoy dark humor, absurdity, and stories where the heroes screw up everything, but do it with a straight face. If you've ever laughed at the line "he already knew the letter A," you've come to the right place.

And if you've completed the first two parts, you already know that failure always welcomes its heroes with open arms.

Twenty years of career. One last tank of gas. One intern who will eat anything, including evidence.

Welcome to the bottom, detective.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Heroes aren't always born—sometimes, power awakens through beauty.

Glow up Hero is an anti-trope card-based roguelike tower-climbing game where "beauty is power" isn't just a slogan—it's the core mechanic. Recruit heroes inspired by real-world figures from history and contemporary life, assemble a squad of up to 4 heroes, and battle your way through towering floors with cunning card play. But the true game-changer lies in a transformation known as the "Glow Up"—a metamorphosis that redefines both looks and lethality.

⚔️ Core Gameplay: Card Crafting × Tower-Climbing Strategy

  • Hero Assembly – Collect hero cards based on real historical and modern figures. Each hero comes with signature gear and a unique deck.

  • Squad Formation – Deploy up to 4 heroes per battle. Team composition and skill synergies are the keys to victory.

  • Dual-Tier Decks – Each hero has 3 standard skill cards and 2 ultimate-limited cards. The limited cards are your ace moves—usable only once per battle, and once played, they're gone for good. Save them for the perfect moment.

  • Resource Management – Energy caps at 3 per turn, so every card played must count. Draw cards at the start of each turn; at turn's end, all unused cards are discarded without mercy—no hoarding, no second chances.

  • Basic Attacks Always Available – Even with an empty hand, every hero can still perform one basic attack per turn, keeping your tactical options alive.

🌸 Core Mechanism: The Glow Up = Power Evolution

This isn't just a cosmetic skin—it's a full-scale gameplay overhaul.

  • Triggering the Glow Up – Unlock the "Glow Up" state through specific in-game events, items, or conditions.

  • Visual Metamorphosis – Male heroes transform into stunning female forms; female heroes become even more radiant. Every Glow Up character is a brand-new visual experience.

  • Total Skill Enhancement – Once Glowed Up, all cards of that hero (both the 3 standard and 2 limited ones) receive substantial upgrades: increased damage, reduced energy costs, expanded effects, and better synergies. One card, two lives—the Glow Up changes everything about how you play.

📖 Mirror of Reality

Every hero and every enemy in the game is drawn from real-world individuals. Card descriptions and character backgrounds come with verifiable sources, allowing you to engage in a dialogue with history, culture, and real human stories—even as you scheme your way up the tower.

🎯 Perfect for Players Who:

  • Love deep card strategy and tight resource management

  • Enjoy character evolution and visual transformation mechanics

  • Can't resist anti-trope twists and narrative Easter eggs

Beauty is justice? No—beauty is power.

store_data.about_the_game:
A signal has arrived from the other side of the galaxy.
Earth's great flagship isn't ready to respond yet — the route must be charted first. You're alone aboard a small reconnaissance shuttle, tasked with collecting energy from every world you pass through to propel your ship, from one celestial body to the next, all the way to the signal itself.

From the Moon to the edge of the solar system
Eleven stages mark the journey: the Moon and its helium-3, the asteroid belt, Mars, Europa, Titan, the Kuiper belt, the Oort Cloud, interstellar space, an unknown exoplanet... all the way to the very source of the signal. Each world has its own resource, its own collector, its own propulsion technology to develop.

An incremental game that takes the time to tell a story
Odyssée Stellaire isn't just a string of numbers going up. A logbook grows richer as you progress. Artifacts from ancient civilizations, scattered across space, reveal an unsuspected past. The journey ends with a multi-act epilogue.

Key features

  • 🌌 11 stages to travel through, from the solar system to the unknown

  • ⚙️ Harvesting, boosts, and lab research for every resource

  • 🔁 Prestige system to start over stronger

  • 📜 Ongoing narration: logbook, anecdotes, epilogue

  • 🏆 45 Steam achievements to unlock along the journey

  • 💾 Steam Cloud save support

  • 🌍 Available in 8 languages (French, English, German, Spanish, Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese)

Safe travels, Commander!

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE LOOP OF AGONY

Loop of Agony is an unforgiving, dark, and fast-paced pixel platformer that will push your reflexes and patience to their absolute limits. Think fast, move faster, and never stop. Because in this ruthless world, there are no checkpoints. A millimeter of timing error, a wrong jump, or a momentary hesitation will mercilessly send you back to the very beginning of the level, back into the darkness of the loop.

There is no mercy here—only trying again and again until you achieve perfection.

A DEADLY ESCAPE ACROSS THREE REALMS

In this ascending journey that starts from the very bottom of darkness, you will pass through three distinct layers, each with its own deadly traps and atmospheric challenges:

  • Hell: The epicenter of flames and endless torment. Every step you take here leads to a trap designed to destroy you.

  • Purgatory: An eerie transitional realm filled with glitch effects that will cloud your mind and mess with your perception of reality.

  • Earth: The final confrontation zone where you are closest to freedom, but where obstacles become their most complex and lethal.

FLAWLESS FLUIDITY AND SPECIAL ABILITIES

Just running won't be enough to overcome the world's most dangerous parkours. You will need to master your character's special abilities. Keep up with the adrenaline-fueled, flawless fluidity of the game using mid-air dashes, gravity-defying jumps, and instant skills that must be triggered at the exact right moment. The controls are so smooth and responsive that when you die, the only one you can blame is your own fingers—not the game.

RACE AGAINST TIME: THE LEADERBOARDS

Is simply surviving enough for you? In Loop of Agony, the real battle is against the clock. Catch a perfect "speedrun" flow and compete with your friends and players around the world through the integrated Steam Leaderboards. Finish the levels in the shortest time possible without dying, and carve your name among the best.

Are you ready to break the loop of agony, push your limits, and reach the top?

Enhanced Affair


Dashiell "Dash" Kovac was a 200-meter world champion until a failed test he still denies stripped him of everything. Now he is Performance Director at the Proving Ground: a private desert compound outside Las Vegas where an openly "enhanced" Olympic-style circuit trains in full view of cameras, investors, and protesters. With the inaugural Ascendant Games approaching and a young athlete's cardiac scare threatening to crack the facade, Dash is pulled between profit and protection, truth and narrative — and three women who each hold a different kind of power over him.

Commit to one of three romance routes. Each has its own tone, conflicts, and endings, and each includes explicit adult scenes.

Meet the Cast




Vesper Ashcroft — The Backer
Ascendant's co-founder and president: the money, the operator, and the calmest person in the room — right up until she isn't. She reads people like a card table, prices every risk, and recruited Dash because his disgrace sells her future. Their connection threatens the one thing she never bargains with lightly: control.



Mica Moreau — The Natural
The compound's lone unenhanced wildcard: a clean middle-distance pro invited to lose on camera and "prove" the enhanced future. Quiet effort, dawn miles, and a desert sketchbook make her the one person Dash can't lie to — and the one truth that could cost him everything.



Ingrid Halstead — The Rival
Ascendant's marquee enhanced swimmer is here to break a record before time breaks her — and she's furious that her assigned coach is the former teammate she blames for a lost decade. She and Dash fight like it's survival, and the heat underneath their hostility is the one thing neither of them can drown for long.

Key Features


  • Three distinct romance routes with a single defining choice — commit to Ingrid, Mica, or Vesper
  • Explicit adult scenes in every romance route
  • A high-stakes sports setting: open enhancement, record bounties, medical supervision, and a media circus
  • Multiple endings per route, shaped by your choices
  • Unlockable CG gallery and achievements
  • Fully voiced characters with animated scenes

Adult Content


This game contains explicit sexual content between adults. Each of the three romance routes includes explicit adult scenes with nudity. All characters are adults.

Your plan was simple. Chant the words, take the pills, lie back, and let a demoness of your dreams (literally) show up to drain you dry. Reality had other plans — the first attempt nearly gets you killed by an executioner demon summoned when a ritual goes wrong. Lucky for you, a stranger intervened.

Now you're back at it, determined to get it right. With help from Ori, your childhood friend running the local occult shop.

Decode the riddles, gather the right components, and get the counts exactly right, or face the consequences.

Get it right, and you'll summon one of three demonesses, each with her own personality and her own price for a night with her:

Dimona — playful and surprisingly considerate, for a demon who could easily crush you.
Blodica — a narcissistic, bratty goddess who expects to be worshipped.
Dronica — cold, blunt, and always annoyed.

Get it wrong, and Deathica comes to collect what you owe.

  • A branching ritual puzzle system — solve riddles, gather components, and balance exact quantities across 3 unique summoning rituals

  • ~25K words

  • 4 distinct demon personalities, each with multiple intimate scenarios and dialogue paths

  • Multiple endings

  • 100 animations

  • A gallery featuring all animations in the game

Durak is the classic Russian shedding card game, built for quick, readable rounds on your phone.

Attack, defend, take the table when you must, and try not to be the last player holding cards. This version keeps the focus on the table: clear cards, simple controls, and a calm green felt layout that makes every move easy to read.

Classic Durak flow: attack, defend, beat the table, or take the cards.

Fast offline play against an AI opponent.

Clean card visuals designed for small screens.

Russian localization for the traditional Durak audience.

Settings for sound, music, language, and premium upgrade.

Whether you already know Durak from family games or are learning the rules for the first time, this is a simple way to enjoy a familiar card-game challenge anywhere.

Konbini Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator about putting a messy Japanese convenience store back in order. Sort 2,928 products across 15+ sections: drinks, noodles, candy, chips, and more. All at your own pace.

A Relaxing Konbini Organizing Simulator
The store is a mess and needs to be cleaned up. Return items to their shelves at your own pace, with no timers and no pressure.

Pick Up Items and Put Them Back
Pick up each product, find the right section, and place it under the correct price tag. That's all there is to it, just work through the store one shelf at a time.

Upgrade Your Skills
Earn upgrades as you play. Increase your movement speed and reach, and unlock a couple of unique abilities that make clearing the store faster.

One Completed Section at a Time
Empty racks fill with neat rows of onigiri, and the messy magazine stand settles into tidy stacks. Each finished section shows clear progress.

Key Features

  • Sort more than 2,900 products across 15+ konbini sections

  • Simple gameplay: pick up items and put them back where they belong

  • Skill upgrades for speed and reach, plus a few unique abilities

  • No time limits and no game over. A relaxed pace you set yourself

store_data.about_the_game:
Nordic is a PS1-aesthetic "foddylike" cross-country skiing game with drop-in drop-out multiplayer.  Nordic captures what makes cross-country skiing great; rhythm & cadence, the calm of nature and exploring the natural world with your friends!  It also captures the gruelling nature of the sport.  You must manage your energy and time your moments to push - especially if you want to be competitive and race.  All of this with complete control of each of your limbs.  

Game Design

Nordic skiing is not alpine.  Don't expect to see crazy flips or other SSX-style tricks.  Nordic is about rhythm and pace.  It's about finding your groove (sometimes literally, in classic ski tracks).  I always thought nordic skiing would translate well to a video game if it could capture the tactile feel of the technique on a game controller.  For that reason, the game has been designed with a controller in mind.  I have given a "foddylike" approach to the control scheme as you have skill expression over each of your limbs.  In this way you are free to ski in whatever style you want. 

Features

  • Skate and classic technique

  • "Foddylike" independent controls for each limb - express your style 

  • Ski Glide that rewards proper cadence

  • Energy — legs and arms tire and contribute to energy consumption, managing this is key to effective skiing

Game Modes

  • Nordic Valley — a crafted resort with that serves as a social hub and features races and capture the flag

  • Endless Trail — a procedural winter valley with an infinite groomed track through the pines

  • Race Mode — race a pre-defined track online or against bots

  • Custom Trail — ski real GPS trails from around the world, with true elevation, difficulty signs, and a paper trail map

Winter Atmosphere

  • Day and night cycles

  • Weather simulation

  • Wandering animals

  • PSX aesthetic

Catch Chick is a relaxing yet challenging multiplayer platforming adventure. The chickens have escaped — team up with your friends and set out on a journey to catch them all!

In the game, you will jump, climb, and dodge obstacles while finding your way through increasingly higher levels. Take on the challenge alone, or play online with friends.   • Levels filled with obstacles, platforms, and collectible goals

Catch the Escaped Chickens

Climb upward, overcome platforms and obstacles, and collect the escaped chickens along the way. With simple objectives, changing routes, and hilarious moments created by falling and retrying with friends, every run becomes a fun and memorable adventure.

SURVIVE THE ASH

Ashrun Survivors is a dark fantasy bullet heaven roguelite where every run challenges you to survive overwhelming hordes, create powerful builds, and decide how far you are willing to push your luck.

Choose your survivor, combine weapons and upgrades, collect experience, and evolve your arsenal into devastating new forms. Every decision can turn a struggling run into an unstoppable display of destruction.

BUILD A DEADLY ARSENAL

Begin each run with a selection of automatic weapons and shape your build as you level up.

Improve damage, attack speed, area, critical chance, survivability, and more. Combine the right upgrades to unlock powerful weapon evolutions capable of cutting through entire armies.

CHOOSE YOUR SURVIVOR

Play as multiple unlockable characters, each offering different strengths and build possibilities.

Develop your survivors through permanent progression, skill trees, relics, and other upgrades that open new strategies for future runs.

PUSH DEEPER

Surviving is only the beginning.

Face increasingly dangerous enemies, elite opponents, and powerful bosses. Take on optional challenges, activate run modifiers, and enter deeper stages for greater rewards.

You can escape with what you have earned—or risk everything by continuing.

GROW STRONGER BETWEEN RUNS

Each attempt contributes to your long-term progression.

Unlock new characters, relics, upgrades, weapons, and additional difficulty options. Experiment with different combinations and gradually prepare yourself for the most dangerous challenges Ashrun Survivors has to offer.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fast-paced bullet heaven combat

  • Dark fantasy pixel-art presentation

  • Multiple playable characters

  • Powerful weapon upgrades and evolutions

  • Permanent meta-progression and skill trees

  • Relics that support different playstyles

  • Optional run modifiers and difficulty levels

  • Elite enemies, bosses, and escalating hordes

  • Risk-and-reward progression between stages

  • Extensive achievements and long-term challenges
